>
> {也许|yě xǔ}{正|zhèng}{因为|yīn wèi}{这样|zhè yàng}，{这个|zhè ge}{故事|gù shi}{才|cái}{一直|yì zhí}{让|ràng}{人|rén}{难忘|nán wàng}。{每|měi}{个|gè}{时代|shí dài}{的|de}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{烦恼|fán nǎo}，{也|yě}{都|dōu}{会|huì}{在|zài}{心里|xīn li}{想象|xiǎng xiàng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{没有|méi yǒu}{战争|zhàn zhēng}、{没有|méi yǒu}{忧虑|yōu lǜ}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}。{对|duì}{今天|jīn tiān}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{大|dà}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{人|rén}{来|lái}{说|shuō}，"{世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán}"{可能|kě néng}{只是|zhǐ shì}{周末|zhōu mò}{的|de}{一|yí}{次|cì}{郊外|jiāo wài}{旅行|lǚ xíng}，{也|yě}{可能|kě néng}{是|shì}{下班|xià bān}{以后|yǐ hòu}{安安静静|ān ān jìng jìng}{读|dú}{的|de}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}。{说到底|shuō dào dǐ}，{桃花源|táo huā yuán}{也许|yě xǔ}{并|bìng}{不|bú}{在|zài}{地图|dì tú}{上|shàng}，{而|ér}{在|zài}{每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{的|de}{心里|xīn li}。{只要|zhǐ yào}{心里|xīn li}{安静|ān jìng}，{哪里|nǎ lǐ}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}{是|shì}{桃花源|táo huā yuán}。

{逃避|táo bì} (táo bì): to escape from; {现实|xiàn shí}: reality (HSK 5); {刻意|kè yì} (kè yì): deliberately; {想象|xiǎng xiàng}: to imagine (HSK 5).

1. What does {豁然开朗|huò rán kāi lǎng} mean today, and where does it come from?
2. In what two ways can {世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán} be used?
3. What does the writer think the story's ending suggests?
4. What might a {世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán} be for a city dweller today, according to the writer?

<details>
<summary>Answers and translation</summary>

1. Suddenly seeing clearly, understanding a problem at once; from the moment the narrow passage opens
   out into the village ({复|fù}{行|xíng}{数|shù}{十|shí}{步|bù}，{豁然开朗|huò rán kāi lǎng}).
2. As praise (a beautiful, peaceful place: {简直|jiǎn zhí}{是|shì}{世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán}) or with some criticism (escaping reality, looking for
   a place that doesn't exist).
3. That the Peach Blossom Spring can only be found by chance, not looked for on purpose ({只能|zhǐ néng}{偶然|ǒu rán}{遇到|yù dào}，{不|bù}{能|néng}{刻意|kè yì}
   {寻找|xún zhǎo}), and that it may not be a real place.
4. A weekend trip to the countryside, or a book read quietly after work.

"**Where is the 'Peach Blossom Spring beyond the world'?** 'The Peach Blossom Spring' has fewer than
four hundred characters, yet it has left Chinese several common expressions. {豁然开朗|huò rán kāi lǎng} is used today to
describe suddenly seeing a problem clearly; {世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán} has become an idiom for a quiet, lovely place far from
the world.

Interestingly, {世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán} can be praise, or carry a hint of criticism. To call a mountain village 'a real
{世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán}' is to say the scenery is beautiful and life there quiet and easy. But to say someone 'wants to find a
{世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán}' sometimes means they want to escape reality, to look for a place that doesn't exist at all.

For sixteen hundred years many people have wanted to know where the Peach Blossom Spring really is, and
quite a few places claim to be the village of the story. In fact, what Tao Yuanming wrote about may not be
a real place. The fisherman couldn't find the way the second time, and the prefect's men lost their way
too: an ending like this seems to be telling readers that the Peach Blossom Spring can only be come upon by
chance, not deliberately sought.

Today the words 'Peach Blossom Spring' often turn up in travel advertisements. A mountain village
with rather fine scenery, an island with rather fewer people: either may be called a {世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán}. Then the
tourists come in growing numbers, the roads are mended, restaurants and shops open, and life there gets
easier, but the old quiet slowly fades. On public holidays the village lanes are packed with people, and
even parking is hard. Someone once joked that as soon as a place is called a {世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán}, it soon stops
being one. It's an exaggeration, but it makes a point: quiet and beauty often can't stand too many
visitors.

Perhaps that's exactly why the story has stayed so memorable. People of every age have their own troubles,
and all of them imagine somewhere without war or worry. For people living in big cities today, a {世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán}
may be just a weekend trip to the countryside, or a book read quietly after work. In the end, the Peach Blossom
Spring may not be on any map, but in each of us: as long as your mind is quiet, anywhere can be the
Peach Blossom Spring."
</details>

## Say it

{晋|Jìn}{太元|Tài yuán}{中|zhōng}，{武陵|Wǔ líng}{人|rén}{捕|bǔ}{鱼|yú}{为业|wéi yè}。{缘|yuán}{溪|xī}{行|xíng}，{忘|wàng}{路|lù}{之|zhī}{远近|yuǎn jìn}。
= In the Taiyuan years of the Jin, a man of Wuling made his living by fishing. Following a stream, he lost track of how far he had gone.
{忽逢|hū féng}{桃|táo}{花|huā}{林|lín}，{夹|jiā}{岸|àn}{数|shù}{百|bǎi}{步|bù}，{中|zhōng}{无|wú}{杂树|zá shù}，{芳草|fāng cǎo}{鲜美|xiān měi}，{落英|luò yīng}{缤纷|bīn fēn}。
= Suddenly he came upon a forest of peach trees lining both banks for several hundred paces, with no other trees; the grass was fresh and lovely, and fallen petals lay everywhere.
{复|fù}{行|xíng}{数|shù}{十|shí}{步|bù}，{豁然开朗|huò rán kāi lǎng}。

## Key points

- {陶渊明|Táo Yuān míng} (about 365–427), poet of the Eastern Jin, who left office to farm; 《{桃花源记|Táo huā yuán jì}》 (usually dated about 421),
  set in the {太元|Tài yuán} era (376–396).
- The story: a fisherman follows a stream through a peach forest, enters a hill through a narrow opening
  and finds a village whose people fled the wars of the Qin; he can never find it again.
- Classical words: {缘|yuán} (along), {逢|féng} (meet), {甚|shèn} (very), {欲|yù} (want), {复|fù} fù (again), {便|biàn} (then), {舍|shě} shě (leave) / {屋舍|wū shè} shè,
  {悉|xī} (all), {属|shǔ} shǔ (kind), {衣着|yī zhuó} zhuó, {黄发|huáng fà} fà, {种作|zhòng zuò} zhòng.
- Its idioms today: {豁然开朗|huò rán kāi lǎng} (suddenly clear), {世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán} (an idyllic place apart from the world; also an escape from
  reality).

questions.stem: Which word means "importance"?

questions.explanation: {大型|dà xíng} is a type word: it goes straight before a noun ({大型|dà xíng}{企业|qǐ yè}) and doesn't take {很|hěn} or stand alone as the predicate. To put it after the noun you'd need {是|shì}…{的|de}: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{企业|qǐ yè}{是|shì}{大型|dà xíng}{的|de}.

Young people change jobs too often.

{欢迎|huān yíng}{各|gè}{厂商|chǎng shāng}{积极|jī jí}{参展|cān zhǎn}！”

({须|xū}{知|zhī}: notes for…, things to know; {将|jiāng}{于|yú}: will (be held) on, written; {展|zhǎn}{位|wèi}: a stand, booth; {展|zhǎn}{馆|guǎn}: the exhibition hall; {以|yǐ}{书面|shū miàn}{形式|xíng shì}: in writing; {代|dài}{为|wéi}{保管|bǎo guǎn} (bǎo guǎn): to look after on someone's behalf; {值|zhí}{钱|qián}: valuable; {不得|bù dé}: may not; {通道|tōng dào}: aisle; {参展证|cān zhǎn zhèng}: an exhibitor's pass; {明火|míng huǒ}: a naked flame; {撤|chè}{展|zhǎn}: to take down a stand)

to set out the rules and arrangements for exhibitors at a fair
to report on a fair that has just ended
to invite visitors to buy tickets
questions.explanation: {须|xū}{知|zhī} is a list of things participants must know. It addresses {参展|cān zhǎn}{厂商|chǎng shāng} (exhibitors): registration and fees, the limit on stands, withdrawing, delivering products, selling, invoices, opening hours, safety, clearing the stands and contacts.

questions.stem: A notice for exhibitors at a trade fair says: “{每|měi}{家|jiā}{厂商|chǎng shāng}{限|xiàn}{报|bào}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{展|zhǎn}{位|wèi}。{如|rú}{需|xū}{更|gèng}{多|duō}{展|zhǎn}{位|wèi}，{请|qǐng}{提前|tí qián}{与|yǔ}{主办单位|zhǔ bàn dān wèi}{联系|lián xì}，{同意|tóng yì}{后|hòu}{才能|cái néng}{预定|yù dìng}。” ({展|zhǎn}{位|wèi}: a stand, booth) What may a firm that wants three stands do?
choices: book three stands online at once
nothing: three stands are not allowed in any case
contact the organisers first, and book the third if they agree
share a stand with another firm
questions.explanation: {限|xiàn}{报|bào}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{展|zhǎn}{位|wèi} sets the normal limit at two; {如|rú}{需|xū}{更|gèng}{多|duō}…{请|qǐng}{提前|tí qián}{与|yǔ}{主办单位|zhǔ bàn dān wèi}{联系|lián xì}，{同意|tóng yì}{后|hòu}{才能|cái néng}{预定|yù dìng}: more are possible after contacting the organisers and getting their agreement.

questions.stem: A notice for exhibitors says: “{报名|bào míng}{后|hòu}{如|rú}{需|xū}{撤回|chè huí}{申请|shēn qǐng}，{请|qǐng}{于|yú}8{月|yuè}25{日|rì}{前|qián}{以|yǐ}{书面|shū miàn}{形式|xíng shì}{通知|tōng zhī}{主办单位|zhǔ bàn dān wèi}，{费用|fèi yòng}{退还|tuì huán}{一半|yí bàn}；8{月|yuè}25{日|rì}{以后|yǐ hòu}{撤回|chè huí}{的|de}，{费用|fèi yòng}{不|bú}{再|zài}{退还|tuì huán}。” ({以|yǐ}{书面|shū miàn}{形式|xíng shì}: in writing) A firm withdraws by email on 30 August. What happens?
choices: It gets all its money back.
It gets half its money back.
It must pay an extra fee.
questions.explanation: Withdrawals before 25 August get half back ({退还|tuì huán}{一半|yí bàn}); after 25 August, {费用|fèi yòng}{不|bú}{再|zài}{退还|tuì huán}: nothing is returned.

questions.stem: Choose the word for a written notice: {我|wǒ}{公司|gōng sī}{将|jiāng}{与|yǔ}{北京|Běi jīng}{一|yì}{所|suǒ}{中学|zhōng xué}___ {举办|jǔ bàn}{交流|jiāo liú}{活动|huó dòng}。 (Our company will hold an exchange together with a Beijing secondary school.)
questions.explanation: {与|yǔ} + partner + {一道|yí dào} + verb: "together with", the written partner of {一起|yì qǐ}. {一下|yí xià} is a quick try, {一边|yì biān} "while", and {一直|yì zhí} "all along".

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{培训|péi xùn}{为期|wéi qī}{三|sān}{天|tiān}。
{这|zhè}{次|cì}{培训|péi xùn}{为期|wéi qī}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}。
{为期|wéi qī}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{培训|péi xùn}。
questions.explanation: {为期|wéi qī} + a length of time is for planned events with a set length: {培训|péi xùn}{为期|wéi qī}{三|sān}{天|tiān} (or {为期|wéi qī}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{的|de}{培训|péi xùn}). It takes no {了|le}, and it isn't used for how long an illness lasted ({他|tā}{病|bìng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}).

questions.stem: Choose the word: {凡是|fán shì}{参加|cān jiā}{活动|huó dòng}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}，___ {要|yào}{准时|zhǔn shí}{到|dào}{校|xiào}。 (Every student taking part must arrive at the school on time.)
questions.explanation: {凡是|fán shì} X，{都|dōu} Y: every X without exception. The {都|dōu} in the second half is needed; {也|yě}, {才|cái} and {就|jiù} don't close the pattern.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {经过|jīng guò}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{的|de}{谈判|tán pàn}，{双方|shuāng fāng}{终于|zhōng yú}{有|yǒu}{了|le}{新|xīn}{的|de}___。 (After three days of talks, the two sides have made fresh progress.)
questions.explanation: {进展|jìn zhǎn} is how far things have got: {有|yǒu}{了|le}{进展|jìn zhǎn}, {进展|jìn zhǎn}{顺利|shùn lì}. {进度|jìn dù} is progress measured against a plan ({工作|gōng zuò}{进度|jìn dù}, {跟|gēn}{上|shàng}{进度|jìn dù}), {步骤|bù zhòu} a step and {流程|liú chéng} a whole procedure.

questions.stem: Which is a natural word pair?
questions.explanation: {征求|zhēng qiú}{意见|yì jiàn}: to ask for views. The others mix up the pairs: {提出|tí chū}{问题|wèn tí} (raise a question), {巩固|gǒng gù}{成果|chéng guǒ} (consolidate results), {纠正|jiū zhèng}{错误|cuò wù} (correct mistakes).

questions.stem: Which word fits the opening of a written staff notice? ___：{公司|gōng sī}{将|jiāng}{于|yú}{下|xià}{周|zhōu}{举办|jǔ bàn}{新|xīn}{员工|yuán gōng}{培训|péi xùn}。 ({将|jiāng}{于|yú}: will … on, written)
questions.explanation: A notice addresses {全体员工|quán tǐ yuán gōng} (all staff) or {各|gè}{部门|bù mén}. {大伙儿|dà huǒr} and {咱们|zán men} are warm spoken words, right for a boss at a meeting; {你们|nǐ men} alone is too blunt for a heading.

questions.stem: Read the passage and choose the words for the gaps: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{交流|jiāo liú}{活动|huó dòng}{由|yóu}{学校|xué xiào}（①），{具体|jù tǐ}{工作|gōng zuò}{由|yóu}{我|wǒ}{公司|gōng sī}（②）。{活动|huó dòng}{期间|qī jiān}，{各|gè}{组|zǔ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}{向|xiàng}{大卫|Dà wèi}（③）{工作|gōng zuò}{进度|jìn dù}。 ({具体|jù tǐ}: actual, specific)
choices: ① {主办|zhǔ bàn} ② {承办|chéng bàn} ③ {报道|bào dào}
① {主办|zhǔ bàn} ② {承办|chéng bàn} ③ {汇报|huì bào}
① {承办|chéng bàn} ② {主办|zhǔ bàn} ③ {汇报|huì bào}
① {指挥|zhǐ huī} ② {承办|chéng bàn} ③ {汇报|huì bào}
questions.explanation: ① {主办|zhǔ bàn}: the school is the host. ② {承办|chéng bàn}: the company runs the actual work for it ({具体|jù tǐ}{工作|gōng zuò} goes with {承办|chéng bàn}, not {主办|zhǔ bàn}). ③ {向|xiàng}…{汇报|huì bào}: to report to a superior; {报道|bào dào} is a news report.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {监督|jiān dū} jiān dū (to supervise): two high level tones, 1+1.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {纪律|jì lǜ} jì lǜ (discipline): two falling tones, 4+4. lǜ has ü, as in {绿|lǜ}.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? ___ {固|gù} (to consolidate)
questions.explanation: {={巩固|gǒng gù} gǒng gù: 巩 is 工 + 凡. 恐 (fear) has 心 below, 攻 (to attack) has 攵, and 功 (merit) has 力.=}

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {发现|fā xiàn}{问题|wèn tí}{要|yào}{马上|mǎ shàng}___ {正|zhèng}。 (When you find a problem, put it right at once.)
questions.explanation: {={纠正|jiū zhèng} jiū zhèng: 纠 is 纟 + 丩, five strokes.=}

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {周末|zhōu mò}{大家|dà jiā}___ {流|liú}{值班|zhí bān}。 (Everyone takes turns on duty at weekends.)
questions.explanation: {={轮流|lún liú} lún liú: 轮 is 车 + 仑, eight strokes.=}

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: The exchange lasts two weeks; the school is hosting it and our company is running it.
questions.explanation: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{活动|huó dòng}{为期|wéi qī}{两|liǎng}{周|zhōu}，{由|yóu}{学校|xué xiào}{主办|zhǔ bàn}，{我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}{承办|chéng bàn}。 {为期|wéi qī} + time is the predicate of the first clause; {由|yóu} introduces the host ({学校|xué xiào}{主办|zhǔ bàn}), and {我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}{承办|chéng bàn} follows.

questions.stem: Listen. What must each group do at five o'clock?

audio.text: 每天下午五点，各组要向大卫汇报这一天的工作进度。发现问题，马上纠正，不要等到最后。

choices: report the day's progress to David
hold a meeting with the students
questions.explanation: {各|gè}{组|zǔ}{要|yào}{向|xiàng}{大卫|Dà wèi}{汇报|huì bào}{这|zhè}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{进度|jìn dù}: each group reports the day's progress to David, and problems are put right at once ({马上|mǎ shàng}{纠正|jiū zhèng}).

questions.stem: Listen. Who must attend the training?

audio.text: 这次培训为期三天，从下周一开始。凡是今年入职的员工，都必须参加。

choices: all staff who joined this year
questions.explanation: {凡是|fán shì}{今年|jīn nián}{入职|rù zhí}{的|de}{员工|yuán gōng}，{都|dōu}{必须|bì xū}{参加|cān jiā}: everyone who joined the company this year ({入职|rù zhí}, to join a company), without exception.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's view?

audio.text: 我觉得开会的时候，领导应该多听取普通员工的意见。最了解工作中薄弱环节的，往往就是他们。

choices: Ordinary staff talk too much at meetings.
Leaders should make every decision alone.
Meetings are a waste of time.
Leaders should listen more to ordinary staff.
questions.explanation: {应该|yīng gāi}{多|duō}{听取|tīng qǔ}{普通|pǔ tōng}{员工|yuán gōng}{的|de}{意见|yì jiàn}: leaders should listen more to ordinary staff, because they know the weak links ({薄弱|bó ruò}{环节|huán jié}) best.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker doing?

audio.text: 大伙儿辛苦了！这次活动能这么顺利，每个人都出了力。今天晚上我请大家吃饭。

choices: thanking the team after an event
questions.explanation: {大伙儿|dà huǒr}{辛苦|xīn kǔ}{了|le} (thanks for all your hard work) and {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{出|chū}{了|le}{力|lì} (everyone did their bit): the speaker, probably the boss, thanks the team and invites them to dinner.

{好|hǎo}{的|de}{管理|guǎn lǐ}{首先|shǒu xiān}{要|yào}{有|yǒu}{清楚|qīng chu}{的|de}{分工|fēn gōng}。（②）{分工|fēn gōng}{不|bù}{能|néng}{只|zhǐ}{写|xiě}{在|zài}{纸|zhǐ}{上|shàng}，{还|hái}{要|yào}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{合理|hé lǐ}{的|de}{流程|liú chéng}。

{其次|qí cì}，{管理|guǎn lǐ}{者|zhě}{要|yào}{学会|xué huì}{听取|tīng qǔ}{意见|yì jiàn}。（③）{经常|jīng cháng}{征求|zhēng qiú}{他们|tā men}{的|de}{意见|yì jiàn}，{既|jì}{能|néng}{及时|jí shí}{发现|fā xiàn}{问题|wèn tí}，{也|yě}{能|néng}{调动|diào dòng}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{积极|jī jí}{性|xìng}。

{再次|zài cì}，{监督|jiān dū}{和|hé}{考核|kǎo hé}{是|shì}{必要|bì yào}{的|de}，{但|dàn}{力度|lì dù}{要|yào}{适当|shì dàng}。（④）{好|hǎo}{的|de}{考核|kǎo hé}{机制|jī zhì}{应该|yīng gāi}{是|shì}{引导|yǐn dǎo}，{而|ér}{不|bú}{是|shì}{约束|yuē shù}。

{最后|zuì hòu}，{管理|guǎn lǐ}{者|zhě}{自己|zì jǐ}{要|yào}{做|zuò}{示范|shì fàn}。（⑤）{员工|yuán gōng}{看|kàn}{的|de}{不|bú}{是|shì}{领导|lǐng dǎo}{怎么|zěn me}{说|shuō}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{领导|lǐng dǎo}{怎么|zěn me}{做|zuò}。”

A {考核|kǎo hé}{要求|yāo qiú}{太|tài}{低|dī}，{规范|guī fàn}{就|jiù}{成|chéng}{了|le}{一|yí}{句|jù}{空话|kōng huà}；{要求|yāo qiú}{太|tài}{高|gāo}，{员工|yuán gōng}{又|yòu}{会|huì}{害怕|hài pà}{出错|chū cuò}。 B {要求|yāo qiú}{员工|yuán gōng}{准时|zhǔn shí}，{自己|zì jǐ}{先|xiān}{不|bù}{迟到|chí dào}；{要求|yāo qiú}{员工|yuán gōng}{细致|xì zhì}，{自己|zì jǐ}{先|xiān}{认真|rèn zhēn}{对待|duì dài}{每|měi}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{小|xiǎo}{事|shì}。 C {这样|zhè yàng}{的|de}{管理|guǎn lǐ}{在|zài}{短|duǎn}{时间|shí jiān}{内|nèi}{也许|yě xǔ}{有效|yǒu xiào}。 D {所以|suǒ yǐ}，{管理|guǎn lǐ}{者|zhě}{应该|yīng gāi}{把|bǎ}{所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{决定|jué dìng}{都|dōu}{留|liú}{给|gěi}{自己|zì jǐ}。 E {最|zuì}{了解|liǎo jiě}{工作|gōng zuò}{中|zhōng}{薄弱|bó ruò}{环节|huán jié}{的|de}，{往往|wǎng wǎng}{是|shì}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{在|zài}{第一线|dì yí xiàn}{工作|gōng zuò}{的|de}{普通|pǔ tōng}{员工|yuán gōng}。 F {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{知道|zhī dào}{自己|zì jǐ}{负责|fù zé}{什么|shén me}，{遇到|yù dào}{问题|wèn tí}{找|zhǎo}{谁|shéi}，{工作|gōng zuò}{才|cái}{不|bú}{会|huì}{互相|hù xiāng}{推来推去|tuī lái tuī qù}。

({空话|kōng huà}: empty words; {出错|chū cuò}: to make a mistake; {对待|duì dài}: to treat; {第一线|dì yí xiàn}: the front line; {推来推去|tuī lái tuī qù}: to pass the buck)
choices: ① C ② E ③ F ④ A ⑤ B
① D ② F ③ E ④ A ⑤ B
① C ② F ③ E ④ A ⑤ B
① C ② F ③ E ④ B ⑤ A
questions.explanation: ① C: {可是|kě shì}{时间|shí jiān}{一|yì}{长|cháng} turns against "it may work for a short time". ② F explains {清楚|qīng chu}{的|de}{分工|fēn gōng}. ③ E: {他们|tā men} in the next sentence must be the ordinary staff of E. ④ A shows what {力度|lì dù}{要|yào}{适当|shì dàng} means (too low, too high). ⑤ B is the example of {做|zuò}{示范|shì fàn}. D contradicts the whole article ({听取|tīng qǔ}{意见|yì jiàn}) and is left over.

questions.stem: An article on management opens with a common view ({管理|guǎn lǐ}{就是|jiù shì}{命令|mìng lìng}{和|hé}{纪律|jì lǜ}) and its weakness; its next four paragraphs begin “{好|hǎo}{的|de}{管理|guǎn lǐ}{首先|shǒu xiān}{要|yào}{有|yǒu}{清楚|qīng chu}{的|de}{分工|fēn gōng}”, “{其次|qí cì}，{管理|guǎn lǐ}{者|zhě}{要|yào}{学会|xué huì}{听取|tīng qǔ}{意见|yì jiàn}”, “{再次|zài cì}，{监督|jiān dū}{和|hé}{考核|kǎo hé}{是|shì}{必要|bì yào}{的|de}，{但|dàn}{力度|lì dù}{要|yào}{适当|shì dàng}” and “{最后|zuì hòu}，{管理|guǎn lǐ}{者|zhě}{自己|zì jǐ}{要|yào}{做|zuò}{示范|shì fàn}”. How is it organised?
choices: a story with a moral at the end
a problem and a single solution
a common view, then four points of the writer's own in order
questions.explanation: {首先|shǒu xiān}, {其次|qí cì}, {再次|zài cì}, {最后|zuì hòu} mark four points in order, after an opening that sets out the view the writer argues against. There's no story and no comparison of companies.

questions.stem: An article on management says: “{好|hǎo}{的|de}{考核|kǎo hé}{机制|jī zhì}{应该|yīng gāi}{是|shì}{引导|yǐn dǎo}，{而|ér}{不|bú}{是|shì}{约束|yuē shù}：{让|ràng}{员工|yuán gōng}{知道|zhī dào}{怎样|zěn yàng}{做|zuò}{得|de}{更|gèng}{好|hǎo}，{而|ér}{不|bù}{只是|zhǐ shì}{知道|zhī dào}{哪里|nǎ lǐ}{做|zuò}{错|cuò}{了|le}。” What does the writer want staff appraisal to do?
choices: help staff see how to improve
questions.explanation: {引导|yǐn dǎo}，{而|ér}{不|bú}{是|shì}{约束|yuē shù}: to guide, not to restrain; appraisal should show staff {怎样|zěn yàng}{做|zuò}{得|de}{更|gèng}{好|hǎo} (how to do better), not only {哪里|nǎ lǐ}{做|zuò}{错|cuò}{了|le} (where they went wrong).

questions.stem: A report says “{今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{收益|shōu yì}{增长|zēng zhǎng}{了|le}{三|sān}{成|chéng}”. By how much did income rise?
questions.explanation: {成|chéng} counts tenths: {一|yì}{成|chéng} is 10 %, so {三|sān}{成|chéng} is 30 %. "Three times" would be {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} (to three times) and a third is {三|sān}{分|fēn}{之|zhī}{一|yī}.

questions.stem: The profit rate rose from 10 % to 12 %. Which sentence says so correctly? {利润率|lì rùn lǜ}{从|cóng}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{十|shí}{提高|tí gāo}{到|dào}{了|le}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{十二|shí èr}，___。
choices: {提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{二|èr}
{提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{百分点|bǎi fēn diǎn}
{提高|tí gāo}{到|dào}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{百分点|bǎi fēn diǎn}
questions.explanation: A change in a rate is counted in {百分点|bǎi fēn diǎn} (percentage points): {提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{百分点|bǎi fēn diǎn}. {提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{二|èr} would be a rise of 2 % in the rate itself (10 % → 10.2 %), {提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} would triple it, and {提高|tí gāo}{到|dào} + an amount of points makes no sense.

questions.stem: Last year the company received 300 students; this year, 600. Which is correct? {今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{人数|rén shù}___。
questions.explanation: Chinese counts the increase: 300 more is one time more, {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} (doubled). {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} would be 900 (tripled). {增加|zēng jiā}{到|dào}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} (up to twice) would also be right, but {增加|zēng jiā}{到|dào}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} is not.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {交通|jiāo tōng}{费|fèi}___ {总|zǒng}{支出|zhī chū}{的|de}{两|liǎng}{成|chéng}。 (Transport is 20 % of total spending.)
questions.explanation: A {占|zhàn} B {的|de} x: A makes up x of B. {占比|zhàn bǐ} and {比重|bǐ zhòng} are nouns ({交通|jiāo tōng}{费|fèi}{的|de}{占比|zhàn bǐ}{是|shì}{两|liǎng}{成|chéng}, {所|suǒ}{占|zhàn}{的|de}{比重|bǐ zhòng}{很|hěn}{大|dà}), and {占有|zhàn yǒu} is "to possess", not "to make up".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {上|shàng}{半年|bàn nián}{的|de}{收益|shōu yì}{超出|chāo chū}{了|le}{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}___。 (Income in the first half was better than we expected.)
questions.explanation: {超出|chāo chū}{预期|yù qī}: to exceed expectations. {预订|yù dìng} is booking, {前景|qián jǐng} prospects ({前景|qián jǐng}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}), and {期限|qī xiàn} a deadline.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {向|xiàng}{银行|yín háng}{贷款|dài kuǎn}，{除了|chú le}{本|běn}{金|jīn}，{还|hái}{要|yào}{付|fù}___。 (When you borrow from a bank, you pay interest on top of the principal. {本|běn}{金|jīn}: principal)
questions.explanation: {利息|lì xī} is interest: what you pay for borrowing (or are paid on savings). {收益|shōu yì} is income or a return, {余额|yú é} the balance of an account, {账单|zhàng dān} a bill.

questions.stem: Read the passage and choose the words for the gaps: {他|tā}{每|měi}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{都|dōu}{把|bǎ}{一|yí}{部分|bù fen}{工资|gōng zī}（①）{起来|qǐ lái}。{去年|qù nián}{他|tā}{向|xiàng}{银行|yín háng}（②）{买|mǎi}{了|le}{一|yí}{辆|liàng}{车|chē}，{分|fēn}{五|wǔ}{年|nián}{还|huán}，{每|měi}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{还|hái}{要|yào}{多|duō}{付|fù}{一些|yì xiē}（③）。
choices: ① {投资|tóu zī} ② {汇款|huì kuǎn} ③ {利息|lì xī}
① {储蓄|chǔ xù} ② {收购|shōu gòu} ③ {收益|shōu yì}
① {推销|tuī xiāo} ② {贷款|dài kuǎn} ③ {余额|yú é}
① {储蓄|chǔ xù} ② {贷款|dài kuǎn} ③ {利息|lì xī}

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {股票|gǔ piào} gǔ piào (share): a dipping tone, then a falling one, 3+4.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{应该|yīng gāi}{学会|xué huì}{理|lǐ}___。 (Young people should learn to manage their money.)

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Last year we received three hundred students; this year the number has doubled.
questions.explanation: {去年|qù nián}{我们|wǒ men}{接待|jiē dài}{了|le}{三百|sān bǎi}{名|míng}{学生|xué sheng}，{今年|jīn nián}{增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi}。 {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} counts the increase: three hundred more, twice as many. {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} would mean three times as many.

questions.stem: Listen. Why did income rise by only 30 %?

audio.text: 上半年学生人数差不多增加了一倍，可是支出也大幅增加了，所以收益只涨了三成。

choices: A bank loan had to be repaid.
questions.explanation: Student numbers nearly doubled ({增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi}), but {支出|zhī chū}{也|yě}{大幅|dà fú}{增加|zēng jiā}{了|le} (spending rose sharply too), so ({所以|suǒ yǐ}) income rose only 30 % ({三|sān}{成|chéng}).

questions.stem: Listen. What is the drawback of paying in instalments, according to the speaker?

audio.text: 分期付款的话，每个月付得少一点儿，可是总的来说，要多付一些利息。

questions.explanation: Monthly payments are smaller, but {总的来说|zǒng de lái shuō} (overall) you pay more interest ({多|duō}{付|fù}{一些|yì xiē}{利息|lì xī}).

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker think of buying lottery tickets?

audio.text: 有的人觉得买彩票也是一种理财，我可不这么看，那只是碰运气。

choices: It is a good way to save.
It is a kind of investment.
It is only trying one's luck, not managing money.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{可|kě}{不|bú}{这么|zhè me}{看|kàn} (I don't see it that way at all): to the speaker it's only {碰|pèng}{运气|yùn qi} (trying one's luck), not {理财|lǐ cái}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's main point?

audio.text: 理财的第一步不是投资，而是弄清楚自己每个月的收入和支出。知道钱从哪里来、到哪里去，再考虑别的。

choices: The first step in managing money is to know your income and spending.
Young people should invest as early as possible.
Saving money is impossible on a low income.
Investing is the most important part of managing money.
questions.explanation: {不|bú}{是|shì}{投资|tóu zī}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{弄|nòng}{清楚|qīng chu}{自己|zì jǐ}{每|měi}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{的|de}{收入|shōu rù}{和|hé}{支出|zhī chū}: the first step isn't investing but knowing what comes in and goes out each month.

questions.stem: Which is true of {鲁迅|Lǔ Xùn}?

that the boys will become farmers
questions.explanation: He hopes the children won't be divided as he and Runtu have been, and that they'll have a new life that neither of the two men has lived.

questions.stem: Lu Xun died in 1936. Why are his stories in the public domain in mainland China?
choices: He gave up his copyright before he died.
Copyright lasts for the author's life and fifty years after, which ended in 1986.
Chinese law has no copyright for fiction.
questions.explanation: China's copyright law protects an author's works for their life and fifty years after their death, to 31 December of the fiftieth year: for Lu Xun, the end of 1986.

questions.stem: In Lu Xun's 《{故乡|gù xiāng}》, Runtu asks for an incense burner and candlesticks, and the narrator laughs at him inwardly. Then he thinks (retold): “{可是|kě shì}“{我|wǒ}”{现在|xiàn zài}{的|de}{希望|xī wàng}，{不|bù}{也|yě}{是|shì}{自己|zì jǐ}{心里|xīn li}{做|zuò}{出来|chū lái}{的|de}{吗|ma}？{只|zhǐ}{不过|bú guò}{他|tā}{的|de}{愿望|yuàn wàng}{近|jìn}，“{我|wǒ}”{的|de}{愿望|yuàn wàng}{远|yuǎn}{罢了|bà le}。” What does he realise?

He should not have sold the house.

questions.stem: What did {屠呦呦|Tú Yōu yōu} (Tu Youyou) receive in 2015, and for what?
choices: the Nobel Prize in Chemistry, for a new kind of ether
the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine (half of it), for discoveries leading to a new therapy against malaria
the Nobel Peace Prize, for her work in Africa
the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine (all of it), for a vaccine
questions.explanation: She received half of the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine "for her discoveries concerning a novel therapy against Malaria"; the other half went to William C. Campbell and Satoshi Ōmura.

questions.stem: In {屠呦呦|Tú Yōu yōu}'s research on malaria ({疟疾|nüè ji}), what was the problem with the first extracts of {青蒿|qīng hāo} (sweet wormwood)?
choices: They worked sometimes and sometimes didn't.

questions.stem: {屠呦呦|Tú Yōu yōu} read in {葛洪|Gě Hóng}'s 《{肘后备急方|Zhǒu hòu Bèi jí Fāng}》 (4th century): “{青蒿|qīng hāo}{一握|yí wò}，{以|yǐ}{水|shuǐ}{二|èr}{升|shēng}{渍|zì}，{绞|jiǎo}{取汁|qǔ zhī}，{尽|jìn}{服|fú}{之|zhī}。” What idea did it give her?

Artemisinin was isolated the next year; she joined the group in 1969.

questions.stem: In her Nobel lecture, {屠呦呦|Tú Yōu yōu} said: “{没有|méi yǒu}{大家|dà jiā}{无私|wú sī}{合作|hé zuò}{的|de}{团队精神|tuán duì jīng shén}，{我们|wǒ men}{不|bù}{可能|kě néng}{在|zài}{短期|duǎn qī}{内|nèi}{将|jiāng}{青蒿素|qīng hāo sù}{贡献|gòng xiàn}{给|gěi}{世界|shì jiè}。” ({无私|wú sī}: selfless; {贡献|gòng xiàn}: to contribute) What is she stressing?

that the research took too long
that teamwork made the discovery possible
that the world did not want the medicine
questions.explanation: Without everyone's selfless teamwork ({团队精神|tuán duì jīng shén}), artemisinin couldn't have been given to the world so quickly: she credits the whole team.

questions.stem: In the sentence “{很|hěn}{多|duō}{种|zhǒng}{药|yào}{试|shì}{下来|xià lái}，{结果|jié guǒ}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{理想|lǐ xiǎng}，{研究|yán jiū}{陷入|xiàn rù}{了|le}{困境|kùn jìng}。”, what does {陷入|xiàn rù}{了|le}{困境|kùn jìng} mean?
