It soaked the plant in cold water instead of boiling it.
questions.explanation: {不|bú}{是|shì}{一般|yì bān}{的|de}{煮|zhǔ}{药|yào}{方法|fāng fǎ}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{用|yòng}{冷|lěng}{水|shuǐ}{泡|pào}: not the usual boiling, but soaking in cold water and wringing out the juice.

questions.stem: A reading on artemisinin ends: “{古人|gǔ rén}{的|de}{经验|jīng yàn}{里|lǐ}{可能|kě néng}{藏|cáng}{着|zhe}{宝贵|bǎo guì}{的|de}{线索|xiàn suǒ}，{但|dàn}{真正|zhēn zhèng}{的|de}{发现|fā xiàn}，{还|hái}{要|yào}{靠|kào}{现代|xiàn dài}{科学|kē xué}{的|de}{方法|fāng fǎ}{一|yí}{步|bù}{一|yí}{步|bù}{去|qù}{检验|jiǎn yàn}。” ({古人|gǔ rén}: people of old; {藏|cáng}: to hide; {线索|xiàn suǒ}: clue; {检验|jiǎn yàn}: to test) What is the writer's view?
choices: Modern science has nothing to learn from old books.
Old books may hold clues, but they must be tested by modern science.
questions.explanation: {可能|kě néng}{藏|cáng}{着|zhe}{宝贵|bǎo guì}{的|de}{线索|xiàn suǒ} (may hide precious clues), {但|dàn}…{还|hái}{要|yào}{靠|kào}{现代|xiàn dài}{科学|kē xué}{的|de}{方法|fāng fǎ}…{检验|jiǎn yàn} (but must still be tested, step by step, by modern science): both matter.

questions.stem: Who was {葛洪|Gě Hóng}?
choices: a writer on medicine of the Eastern Jin dynasty, about 1,600 years before artemisinin
a member of {屠呦呦|Tú Yōu yōu}'s research group
questions.explanation: {葛洪|Gě Hóng} (Ge Hong) wrote on medicine and alchemy in the Eastern Jin (4th century CE). His 《{肘后备急方|Zhǒu hòu Bèi jí Fāng}》 collects simple remedies people could use.

questions.stem: Choose the word for a news report: {随着|suí zhe}{年轻人|nián qīng rén}{外出|wài chū}{打工|dǎ gōng}，{农村|nóng cūn}{的|de}{老年|lǎo nián}{人口|rén kǒu}___ {增加|zēng jiā}。 (As young people leave to work elsewhere, the old population of the countryside keeps growing.)
questions.explanation: {日益|rì yì} (increasingly) is the written word, straight before a two-syllable verb: {日益|rì yì}{增加|zēng jiā}. {越来越|yuè lái yuè} means the same but belongs to speech, and in this sentence it would sound out of place in a news report; {往年|wǎng nián} is "in other years"; {一|yì}{天|tiān} alone makes no sense here ({一|yì}{天|tiān}{比|bǐ}{一|yì}{天|tiān} would).

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{日益|rì yì}{很|hěn}{严重|yán zhòng}。
{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{日益|rì yì}{严重|yán zhòng}。
{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{日益|rì yì}{严重|yán zhòng}{得|de}{多|duō}。
{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{日益|rì yì}{多|duō}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: {日益|rì yì} goes straight before a two-syllable adjective or verb, with no degree word and no {了|le}: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{日益|rì yì}{严重|yán zhòng}。 Not {很|hěn} after {日益|rì yì}, not {得|de}{多|duō}, and not a one-syllable word like {多|duō} (say {日益|rì yì}{增加|zēng jiā} or, in speech, {越来越|yuè lái yuè}{多|duō}).

questions.stem: What does "{今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{雨|yǔ}{比|bǐ}{往年|wǎng nián}{少|shǎo}。" mean?
choices: It will rain less next year than this year.
It rained less this year than it did the year before last.
There has been less rain this year than in other years.
It used to rain less in the past.
questions.explanation: {往年|wǎng nián} is "former years, other years, the usual years": this year has been drier than usual. Next year is {明年|míng nián}, the year before last {前年|qián nián}.

questions.stem: Which sentence would you expect in a report rather than a chat?
choices: {村|cūn}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{多|duō}{了|le}。
{村|cūn}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{比|bǐ}{以前|yǐ qián}{多|duō}{多|duō}{了|le}。
{村|cūn}{里|lǐ}{老人|lǎo rén}{多|duō}{得|de}{不得了|bù dé liǎo}。
{村|cūn}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{老年|lǎo nián}{人口|rén kǒu}{日益|rì yì}{增加|zēng jiā}。
questions.explanation: {日益|rì yì}{增加|zēng jiā} and {老年|lǎo nián}{人口|rén kǒu} (the elderly population) are the written register of reports and news. The others are what you'd say to a friend: {越来越|yuè lái yuè}{多|duō}, {比|bǐ}{以前|yǐ qián}{多|duō}{多|duō}{了|le}, {多|duō}{得|de}{不得了|bù dé liǎo}.

questions.stem: You want to ask an elderly woman her age politely. What do you say?
questions.explanation: {您|nín}{多|duō}{大|dà}{岁数|suì shu}{了|le}？ (or {您|nín}{多|duō}{大|dà}{年纪|nián jì}{了|le}？) is the polite question to an older person. {几|jǐ}{岁|suì} is for children; {寿命|shòu mìng} is lifespan (how long someone lives), and asking {您|nín}{衰老|shuāi lǎo}{了|le}{吗|ma}？ (have you aged?) would be rude.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{在|zài}{国外|guó wài}{住|zhù}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{年|nián}，{没有|méi yǒu}{朋友|péng you}，{常常|cháng cháng}{觉得|jué de}{很|hěn}___。 (He has lived abroad alone for many years, with no friends, and often feels very lonely.)
questions.explanation: {孤独|gū dú} is lonely as a lasting state: years alone, without friends. {富裕|fù yù} is well-off, {健全|jiàn quán} sound or able-bodied, {自愿|zì yuàn} voluntary.

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {补贴|bǔ tiē} (bǔtiē) an allowance; {求助|qiú zhù} (qiúzhù) to ask for help; {依赖|yī lài} (yīlài) to rely on; {保障|bǎo zhàng} (bǎozhàng) to guarantee. "To pity" would be {可怜|kě lián} (kělián).

questions.stem: What is the farmer doing in "{春天|chūn tiān}{到|dào}{了|le}，{农民|nóng mín}{们|men}{开始|kāi shǐ}{在|zài}{田|tián}{里|lǐ}{播种|bō zhǒng}。"?
questions.explanation: {播种|bō zhǒng} (bōzhǒng) is to sow seeds: spring is the season for it. Cutting the wheat is {割|gē}{小麦|xiǎo mài}; 种 is zhǒng (a seed) in {播种|bō zhǒng}, zhòng (to plant) in {种地|zhòng dì}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{土壤|tǔ rǎng}{十分|shí fēn}___，{种|zhòng}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{长|zhǎng}{得|de}{好|hǎo}。 (The soil here is very fertile: whatever you plant grows well.)
questions.explanation: {肥沃|féi wò} (féiwò) is fertile, of soil and land. {贫困|pín kùn} (poor) is for people and places, {孤独|gū dú} and {寂寞|jì mò} (lonely) for people.

questions.stem: Read the paragraph from a report on a village. What is the main change it describes? {后来|hòu lái}，{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{多|duō}{的|de}{年轻人|nián qīng rén}{到|dào}{城市|chéng shì}{打工|dǎ gōng}。{人口|rén kǒu}{的|de}{流动|liú dòng}{给|gěi}{村|cūn}{里|lǐ}{带|dài}{来|lái}{了|le}{收入|shōu rù}：{今天|jīn tiān}{村民|cūn mín}{的|de}{人均|rén jūn}{收入|shōu rù}{比|bǐ}{往年|wǎng nián}{高|gāo}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{大|dà}{部分|bù fen}{家庭|jiā tíng}{已经|yǐ jīng}{不|bú}{再|zài}{贫困|pín kùn}，{有的|yǒu de}{还|hái}{相当|xiāng dāng}{富裕|fù yù}。{另|lìng}{一|yì}{方面|fāng miàn}，{村|cūn}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{却|què}{日益|rì yì}{增加|zēng jiā}。
choices: Incomes have risen, but more and more of the people left are old.
The village has become poorer as young people leave.
Young people are coming back from the cities to farm.
The village has stopped farming altogether.
questions.explanation: Two sides of one change: income per head is much higher ({人均|rén jūn}{收入|shōu rù}{比|bǐ}{往年|wǎng nián}{高|gāo}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}) and most families are no longer poor, but ({另|lìng}{一|yì}{方面|fāng miàn}…{却|què}) the number of old people keeps growing ({日益|rì yì}{增加|zēng jiā}).

questions.stem: Read the paragraph. What does the doctor think old people need most? {魏医生|Wèi yī shēng}{说|shuō}，{衰老|shuāi lǎo}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{自然|zì rán}{的|de}{过程|guò chéng}，{老人|lǎo rén}{除了|chú le}{需要|xū yào}{医疗|yī liáo}{保障|bǎo zhàng}{以外|yǐ wài}，{还|hái}{需要|xū yào}{家人|jiā rén}{的|de}{关爱|guān ài}。"{很|hěn}{多|duō}{老人|lǎo rén}{生病|shēng bìng}{了|le}{也|yě}{不|bú}{愿意|yuàn yì}{求助|qiú zhù}，{怕|pà}{给|gěi}{孩子|hái zi}{添麻烦|tiān má fan}，"{他|tā}{说|shuō}，"{其实|qí shí}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{电话|diàn huà}、{一|yí}{次|cì}{回|huí}{家|jiā}，{就是|jiù shì}{最好|zuì hǎo}{的|de}{关怀|guān huái}。" ({添麻烦|tiān má fan}: to put someone to trouble.)
choices: to move into a care home
questions.explanation: Besides health cover, old people need {家人|jiā rén}{的|de}{关爱|guān ài} (their families' love): a phone call or a visit home is {最好|zuì hǎo}{的|de}{关怀|guān huái} (the best care).

questions.stem: A report on a village ends: "{人们|rén men}{常|cháng}{说|shuō}，{养老|yǎng lǎo}{需要|xū yào}{家庭|jiā tíng}、{社会|shè huì}{一起|yì qǐ}{努力|nǔ lì}。{在|zài}{石桥村|Shí qiáo cūn}，{这|zhè}{句|jù}{话|huà}{不|bú}{是|shì}{一|yí}{句|jù}{空话|kōng huà}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{每|měi}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}。" What does the writer mean? ({空话|kōng huà}: empty words.)
choices: Nobody in the village believes what people say about old age.
The village needs more help from society.
In this village, people really do look after the old together every day.
The writer thinks the saying is wrong.
questions.explanation: {不|bú}{是|shì}{一|yí}{句|jù}{空话|kōng huà}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{每|měi}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}: it isn't just something people say, it's what happens there every day. The writer admires the village; the sentence doesn't criticise anyone.

questions.stem: Listen. Where is the speaker probably?

audio.text: 我们小区的老人越来越多，社区准备开一个老年活动中心，欢迎大家自愿报名做志愿者。

questions.explanation: {小区|xiǎo qū} (the compound), {社区|shè qū} (the community) planning an activity centre for old people ({老年活动中心|lǎo nián huó dòng zhōng xīn}) and asking for volunteers ({志愿者|zhì yuàn zhě}): a community notice or meeting.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's attitude?

audio.text: 你别老说我可怜。我身体好着呢，自己买菜、做饭，日子过得挺好的，不用你们担心。

questions.explanation: {别|bié}{老|lǎo}{说|shuō}{我|wǒ}{可怜|kě lián} (stop saying I'm to be pitied), {身体|shēn tǐ}{好|hǎo}{着|zhe}{呢|ne} (I'm in fine health), {不用|bú yòng}{你们|nǐ men}{担心|dān xīn}: the speaker manages fine alone and is a little annoyed at being pitied.

questions.stem: Listen. What happened to the speaker's grandfather?

audio.text: 我爷爷做了一辈子农民，前年腿不好，丧失了劳动能力，家里的田就租给邻居了。

choices: He moved to the city to work.
He can no longer work, so his land is rented out.
He bought more land from a neighbour.
He started growing rice instead of wheat.
questions.explanation: {丧失|sàng shī}{了|le}{劳动|láo dòng}{能力|néng lì} (lost the ability to work) after his legs got bad, so {家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{田|tián}{就|jiù}{租|zū}{给|gěi}{邻居|lín jū}{了|le} (the family's field was rented to a neighbour). ({一辈子|yí bèi zi}: all one's life.)

questions.stem: Listen. Why does the speaker's grandmother not want to go to the care home?

audio.text: 镇上的养老院条件很好，可是奶奶说，这是她住了五十年的家，只要身体还行，她就不走。

choices: The care home is too expensive.
The care home is too far away.
She doesn't want to leave the home she has lived in for fifty years.
Her doctor told her not to.
questions.explanation: The care home is good ({条件|tiáo jiàn}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}), but {这|zhè}{是|shì}{她|tā}{住|zhù}{了|le}{五十|wǔ shí}{年|nián}{的|de}{家|jiā}: as long as her health holds ({只要|zhǐ yào}{身体|shēn tǐ}{还|hái}{行|xíng}), she won't leave.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {肥沃|féi wò} féi wò (fertile): a rising tone, then a falling one, 2+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {残疾|cán jí} cán jí (disability): two rising tones, 2+2.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: As young people leave, the problem of care for the old in the village is becoming increasingly serious.
questions.explanation: {随着|suí zhe}{年轻人|nián qīng rén}{的|de}{离开|lí kāi}，{村|cūn}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{养老|yǎng lǎo}{问题|wèn tí}{日益|rì yì}{严重|yán zhòng}。 {随着|suí zhe}… sets the background; {日益|rì yì} goes straight before the two-syllable adjective {严重|yán zhòng}, with no {很|hěn}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {他|tā}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{住|zhù}，{常常|cháng cháng}{觉得|jué de}{很|hěn}___ {独|dú}。 (He lives alone and often feels lonely.)
questions.explanation: {孤独|gū dú} gū dú (lonely). {={孤|gū}=}: {子|zi} on the left + {瓜|guā} guā for the sound, 8 strokes.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {祝|zhù}{您|nín}{健康|jiàn kāng}{长|cháng}___！ (Wishing you good health and a long life!)
questions.explanation: {长寿|cháng shòu} cháng shòu (long life). {={寿|shòu}=}: three horizontals, a left-falling stroke through them, then {寸|cùn}; 7 strokes. Traditional {+{寿|shòu}+} has 14.

questions.stem: What does "{他|tā}{的|de}{书|shū}{东|dōng}{一|yì}{本|běn}，{西|xī}{一|yì}{本|běn}，{到处|dào chù}{都|dōu}{是|shì}。" tell you?
choices: He has books from the east and the west.
He has one book in each room.
He keeps his books in good order.
His books are scattered all over the place.
questions.explanation: {东|dōng}{一|yī} + M，{西|xī}{一|yī} + M: here a…, there a…: things lie about with no order. {东|dōng} and {西|xī} don't mean east and west here. The format is spoken and usually a complaint about mess.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {楼道|lóu dào}{里|lǐ}{东|dōng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{箱子|xiāng zi}，{西|xī}{一|yí}{个|gè}{箱子|xiāng zi}。
{楼道|lóu dào}{里|lǐ}{东|dōng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{箱子|xiāng zi}，{西|xī}{一|yí}{辆|liàng}{箱子|xiāng zi}。
{楼道|lóu dào}{里|lǐ}{东|dōng}{个|gè}{箱子|xiāng zi}，{西|xī}{个|gè}{箱子|xiāng zi}。
{楼道|lóu dào}{里|lǐ}{东|dōng}{一|yì}{箱子|xiāng zi}，{西|xī}{一|yì}{箱子|xiāng zi}。
questions.explanation: {东|dōng}{一|yī} + measure word (+ noun)，{西|xī}{一|yī} + the same measure word: {东|dōng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{箱子|xiāng zi}，{西|xī}{一|yí}{个|gè}{箱子|xiāng zi}. The measure word can't change for the same noun (not {一|yí}{辆|liàng}{箱子|xiāng zi}), and neither {一|yī} nor the measure word can be dropped.

questions.stem: Choose the words: {我|wǒ}___，{最后|zuì hòu}{还是|hái shi}{决定|jué dìng}{搬|bān}{到|dào}{公司|gōng sī}{附近|fù jìn}{去|qù}{住|zhù}。 (I thought it over and over, and finally decided to move near the company.)
questions.explanation: {左思右想|zuǒ sī yòu xiǎng} is "to think something over and over" before a decision; {左|zuǒ}{看|kàn}{右|yòu}{看|kàn} is looking again and again; {东|dōng}{一|yí}{句|jù}{西|xī}{一|yí}{句|jù} is talking disjointedly, {东|dōng}{一下|yí xià}{西|xī}{一下|yí xià} doing something in fits and starts.

questions.stem: What does "{我|wǒ}{左|zuǒ}{等|děng}{右|yòu}{等|děng}，{他|tā}{就是|jiù shì}{不|bù}{来|lái}。" mean?
choices: I waited on the left and then on the right.
I waited a little, then left.
I waited and waited, but he just didn't come.
He waited for me for a long time.
questions.explanation: {左|zuǒ}{等|děng}{右|yòu}{等|děng}: to wait and wait, over and over; {就是|jiù shì}{不|bù}{来|lái}: he simply didn't come. {左|zuǒ} and {右|yòu} don't mean left and right here.

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {客厅|kè tīng}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}___ {大|dà}{窗户|chuāng hu}，{下午|xià wǔ}{阳光|yáng guāng}{特别|tè bié}{好|hǎo}。 (The living room has two big windows, and the afternoon sun is lovely.)
questions.explanation: {扇|shàn} (shàn) is the measure word for doors and windows: {两|liǎng}{扇|shàn}{窗户|chuāng hu}, {一|yí}{扇|shàn}{门|mén}. {栋|dòng} is for buildings, {户|hù} for households, and {支|zhī} (HSK 5) for pens and songs.

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {这|zhè}___ {楼|lóu}{一共|yí gòng}{住|zhù}{着|zhe}{十八|shí bā}___ {人家|rén jiā}。 (Eighteen households live in this building.)
questions.explanation: {一|yí}{栋|dòng}{楼|lóu} (a building), {十八|shí bā}{户|hù}{人家|rén jiā} (eighteen households). {扇|shàn} is for doors and windows.

questions.stem: How is 地方 read in "{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{菜|cài}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}地方{特色|tè sè}。"?
questions.explanation: {地方|dì fāng} dìfāng, with two full tones, is "local" ({地方|dì fāng}{特色|tè sè}, local character). HSK 3's {地方|dì fang} dìfang, with a light {方|fāng}, is "a place".

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {隔壁|gé bì} (gébì) next door; {拥挤|yōng jǐ} (yōngjǐ) crowded; {齐全|qí quán} (qíquán) complete: {家具|jiā jù}{齐全|qí quán}, fully furnished; {昂贵|áng guì} (ángguì) expensive. "Out of date" is {过时|guò shí} (guòshí).

questions.stem: An agent says: "{这|zhè}{套|tào}{房子|fáng zi}{朝南|cháo nán}，{通风|tōng fēng}{好|hǎo}，{周边|zhōu biān}{配套|pèi tào}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{齐全|qí quán}。" What is the agent NOT saying about the flat?
choices: There are shops and services nearby.
questions.explanation: {朝南|cháo nán} (facing south), {通风|tōng fēng}{好|hǎo} (well ventilated), {周边|zhōu biān}{配套|pèi tào}{齐全|qí quán} (everything you need in the area). Nothing is said about the price.

questions.stem:
Put a sentence into each gap (one sentence is left over).
{在|zài}{许多|xǔ duō}{大|dà}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{中心|zhōng xīn}，{至今|zhì jīn}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{不|bù}{少|shǎo}{八九十|bā jiǔ shí}{年代|nián dài}{建|jiàn}{的|de}{老|lǎo}{小区|xiǎo qū}。{这些|zhè xiē}{住宅|zhù zhái}{楼|lóu}{一般|yì bān}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{六七|liù qī}{层|céng}，{没有|méi yǒu}{电梯|diàn tī}，{楼道|lóu dào}{又|yòu}{窄|zhǎi}{又|yòu}{暗|àn}。（1） {前|qián}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}，{我|wǒ}{住|zhù}{的|de}{小区|xiǎo qū}{也|yě}{是|shì}{这样|zhè yàng}。（2）{小区|xiǎo qū}{里|lǐ}{没有|méi yǒu}{停车场|tíng chē chǎng}，{汽车|qì chē}{只好|zhǐ hǎo}{停|tíng}{在|zài}{人行道|rén xíng dào}{上|shàng}。 {去年|qù nián}，{按照|àn zhào}{城市|chéng shì}{规划|guī huà}，{我们|wǒ men}{小区|xiǎo qū}{开始|kāi shǐ}{改造|gǎi zào}。（3）{接着|jiē zhe}，{每|měi}{栋|dòng}{楼|lóu}{都|dōu}{装|zhuāng}{上|shàng}{了|le}{电梯|diàn tī}。 （4）{有的|yǒu de}{居民|jū mín}{担心|dān xīn}{噪声|zào shēng}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}{休息|xiū xi}，{有的|yǒu de}{舍不得|shě bu de}{把|bǎ}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{从|cóng}{楼道|lóu dào}{里|lǐ}{搬|bān}{走|zǒu}。 {当然|dāng rán}，{改造|gǎi zào}{不|bù}{能|néng}{解决|jiě jué}{所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}。{可是|kě shì}{让|ràng}{老|lǎo}{小区|xiǎo qū}{重新|chóng xīn}"{活|huó}"{起来|qǐ lái}，{也许|yě xǔ}{比|bǐ}{全部|quán bù}{拆|chāi}{了|le}{重建|chóng jiàn}{更|gèng}{有|yǒu}{意义|yì yì}。（5） ({年代|nián dài}: decade; {心事|xīn shì}: a worry; {舍不得|shě bu de}: unwilling to part with; {邻里|lín lǐ}: neighbours.)
choices: {随着|suí zhe}{住户|zhù hù}{们|men}{日益|rì yì}{衰老|shuāi lǎo}，"{上|shàng}{楼|lóu}{难|nán}"{成|chéng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{老人|lǎo rén}{的|de}{心事|xīn shì}。
{楼道|lóu dào}{里|lǐ}{东|dōng}{一|yí}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē}，{西|xī}{一|yí}{个|gè}{纸箱|zhǐ xiāng}，{人|rén}{走|zǒu}{过去|guò qù}{都|dōu}{得|děi}{侧|cè}{着|zhe}{身子|shēn zi}。
{第|dì}{一|yī}{步|bù}{是|shì}{拆除|chāi chú}{乱|luàn}{搭|dā}{乱|luàn}{建|jiàn}{的|de}{小|xiǎo}{房子|fáng zi}，{把|bǎ}{空|kòng}{出来|chū lái}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}{变成|biàn chéng}{绿地|lǜ dì}{和|hé}{停车场|tíng chē chǎng}。
{改造|gǎi zào}{的|de}{过程|guò chéng}{并|bìng}{不|bú}{顺利|shùn lì}。
{毕竟|bì jìng}，{这里|zhè lǐ}{不只|bù zhǐ}{有|yǒu}{房子|fáng zi}，{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{几|jǐ}{十|shí}{年|nián}{的|de}{邻里|lín lǐ}{感情|gǎn qíng}。
{所以|suǒ yǐ}，{居民|jū mín}{们|men}{都|dōu}{希望|xī wàng}{把|bǎ}{老|lǎo}{房子|fáng zi}{全部|quán bù}{拆|chāi}{了|le}，{重新|chóng xīn}{建|jiàn}。
questions.explanation: (1) follows the dark stairwells with no lift: the old residents' "stairs" worry. (2) explains {也|yě}{是|shì}{这样|zhè yàng} with the cluttered stairwell. (3) is the first step ({第|dì}{一|yī}{步|bù}), before {接着|jiē zhe}. (4) introduces the worries that follow: {并|bìng}{不|bú}{顺利|shùn lì}. (5) gives the reason ({毕竟|bì jìng}) for keeping the old compounds. The leftover sentence contradicts the conclusion that renovating may mean more than pulling them down.

questions.stem: Read the paragraph. How did the community workers deal with the residents? {改造|gǎi zào}{的|de}{过程|guò chéng}{并|bìng}{不|bú}{顺利|shùn lì}。{有的|yǒu de}{居民|jū mín}{担心|dān xīn}{噪声|zào shēng}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}{休息|xiū xi}，{有的|yǒu de}{舍不得|shě bu de}{把|bǎ}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{从|cóng}{楼道|lóu dào}{里|lǐ}{搬|bān}{走|zǒu}。{社区|shè qū}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{人员|rén yuán}{一|yí}{户|hù}{一|yí}{户|hù}{地|de}{上门|shàng mén}{沟通|gōu tōng}，{左思右想|zuǒ sī yòu xiǎng}，{想|xiǎng}{出|chū}{了|le}{不|bù}{少|shǎo}{办法|bàn fǎ}：{施工|shī gōng}{只|zhǐ}{在|zài}{白天|bái tiān}{进行|jìn xíng}，{没|méi}{地方|dì fang}{放|fàng}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}，{可以|kě yǐ}{先|xiān}{存|cún}{在|zài}{地下室|dì xià shì}{里|lǐ}。 ({施工|shī gōng}: building work; {地下室|dì xià shì}: basement.)
choices: They told the residents the work would go ahead anyway.
They stopped the work for a year.
They paid the residents to move out.
They visited every household and found practical solutions.
questions.explanation: {一|yí}{户|hù}{一|yí}{户|hù}{地|de}{上门|shàng mén}{沟通|gōu tōng} (they talked to each household at its door) and {想|xiǎng}{出|chū}{了|le}{不|bù}{少|shǎo}{办法|bàn fǎ}: building work only by day, and the basement for things with nowhere to go.

questions.stem: A resident writes: "{当然|dāng rán}，{改造|gǎi zào}{不|bù}{能|néng}{解决|jiě jué}{所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}：{房子|fáng zi}{还是|hái shi}{那么|nà me}{小|xiǎo}，{停车位|tíng chē wèi}{也|yě}{还是|hái shi}{不够|bú gòu}。{可是|kě shì}{在|zài}{房价|fáng jià}{昂贵|áng guì}、{新|xīn}{住宅|zhù zhái}{离|lí}{市|shì}{中心|zhōng xīn}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{远|yuǎn}{的|de}{今天|jīn tiān}，{让|ràng}{老|lǎo}{小区|xiǎo qū}{重新|chóng xīn}‘{活|huó}’{起来|qǐ lái}，{也许|yě xǔ}{比|bǐ}{全部|quán bù}{拆|chāi}{了|le}{重建|chóng jiàn}{更|gèng}{有|yǒu}{意义|yì yì}。" What is the writer's attitude to the renovation?
choices: in favour, while admitting its limits
angry that it took so long
questions.explanation: {当然|dāng rán}… concedes the problems (the flats are still small, still not enough parking), then {可是|kě shì}… argues it may mean more than rebuilding: in favour, but not uncritically.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker think of the flat?

audio.text: 房子是挺明亮的，可是离地铁站太远，每天早晚高峰挤公交车，我可受不了。

choices: It's bright, but too far from the metro.
questions.explanation: {挺|tǐng}{明亮|míng liàng}{的|de} (nice and bright), {可是|kě shì}{离|lí}{地铁|dì tiě}{站|zhàn}{太|tài}{远|yuǎn}: the speaker can't face the crowded buses ({挤|jǐ}{公交车|gōng jiāo chē}) in the rush hours.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker complaining about?

audio.text: 楼道里东一个纸箱，西一辆自行车，晚上灯又不亮，我差点儿摔了一跤。

questions.explanation: {东|dōng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{纸箱|zhǐ xiāng}，{西|xī}{一|yí}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē} (boxes and bikes everywhere) and the light doesn't work: the speaker nearly fell ({摔了一跤|shuāi le yì jiāo}).

questions.stem: Listen. Who is probably speaking?

audio.text: 这套房子两室一厅，七十平方米，家具齐全，周边配套也方便，租金每个月六千五。

questions.explanation: The rooms ({两室一厅|liǎng shì yì tīng}), the size, the furniture, the area and the monthly rent ({租金|zū jīn}): an agent showing a flat.

questions.stem: Listen. What did the speakers finally do?

audio.text: 我们左挑右选，看了十几套房子，最后还是选了公司旁边那套老房子。

choices: They chose an old flat next to the company.
They bought a new flat in the suburbs.
questions.explanation: {左|zuǒ}{挑|tiāo}{右|yòu}{选|xuǎn} (they picked and chose), after more than a dozen flats, {最后|zuì hòu}{还是|hái shi}{选|xuǎn}{了|le}{公司|gōng sī}{旁边|páng biān}{那|nà}{套|tào}{老|lǎo}{房子|fáng zi}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {拥挤|yōng jǐ} yōng jǐ (crowded): a level tone, then a dipping one, 1+3.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {住宅|zhù zhái} zhù zhái (housing): a falling tone, then a rising one, 4+2.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: We picked and chose and looked at a dozen flats, and finally settled on this one.
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{左|zuǒ}{挑|tiāo}{右|yòu}{选|xuǎn}，{看|kàn}{了|le}{十|shí}{几|jǐ}{套|tào}{房子|fáng zi}，{最后|zuì hòu}{选|xuǎn}{了|le}{这|zhè}{套|tào}。 {左|zuǒ}A{右|yòu}B comes before the result ({最后|zuì hòu}…); {东|dōng}{一|yí}{套|tào} would describe flats scattered about, not repeated choosing.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {市|shì}{中心|zhōng xīn}{的|de}{房子|fáng zi}{十分|shí fēn}___ {贵|guì}。 (Housing in the city centre is very expensive.)
questions.explanation: {昂贵|áng guì} áng guì (expensive, written). {={昂|áng}=}: {日|rì} over 卬, the part you also see in {仰|yǎng} and {迎|yíng}; 8 strokes.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {屋子|wū zi}{中间|zhōng jiān}___ {着|zhe}{一|yì}{盏|zhǎn}{灯|dēng}。 (A lamp hangs in the middle of the room. {盏|zhǎn}: the measure word for lamps.)
questions.explanation: {吊|diào} diào (to hang from above). {={吊|diào}=}: {口|kǒu} over {巾|jīn}, 6 strokes.

questions.topic: 除非…才 and 除非…否则
questions.stem: Choose the word: {除非|chú fēi}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{休息|xiū xi}，{你|nǐ}{的|de}{嗓子|sǎng zi}___ {能|néng}{好|hǎo}{得|de}{快|kuài}。 (Your throat will only get better quickly if you rest properly.)
questions.explanation: {除非|chú fēi} A，{才|cái} B: only if A will B. {就|jiù} would go with {只要|zhǐ yào} (as long as), {也|yě} with {即使|jí shǐ} or {哪怕|nǎ pà}.

questions.topic: 除非…才 and 除非…否则
questions.stem: Which sentence means "Unless you take the medicine on time, you won't get better"?
choices: {除非|chú fēi}{按时|àn shí}{吃|chī}{药|yào}，{否则|fǒu zé}{病|bìng}{能|néng}{好|hǎo}。
{除非|chú fēi}{不|bú}{按时|àn shí}{吃|chī}{药|yào}，{才能|cái néng}{好|hǎo}。
{除非|chú fēi}{按时|àn shí}{吃|chī}{药|yào}，{否则|fǒu zé}{病|bìng}{很|hěn}{难|nán}{好|hǎo}。
{只要|zhǐ yào}{按时|àn shí}{吃|chī}{药|yào}，{否则|fǒu zé}{病|bìng}{很|hěn}{难|nán}{好|hǎo}。
questions.explanation: {除非|chú fēi} A，{否则|fǒu zé} B: after {否则|fǒu zé} comes what happens without A: {病|bìng}{很|hěn}{难|nán}{好|hǎo}. {否则|fǒu zé}{病|bìng}{能|néng}{好|hǎo} says the opposite; {除非|chú fēi}{不|bú}{按时|àn shí}{吃|chī}{药|yào}，{才能|cái néng}{好|hǎo} reverses the logic; {只要|zhǐ yào} doesn't pair with {否则|fǒu zé}.

questions.topic: 除非…才 and 除非…否则
questions.stem: What does "{他|tā}{不|bú}{会|huì}{去|qù}{看病|kàn bìng}{的|de}，{除非|chú fēi}{疼|téng}{得|de}{受不了|shòu bu liǎo}。" mean?
choices: He went to the doctor because the pain was unbearable.
The doctor said the pain would go away.
He won't see a doctor unless the pain becomes unbearable.
questions.explanation: Result first, then {除非|chú fēi}: "B won't happen unless A". He'll go only if the pain becomes unbearable ({疼|téng}{得|de}{受不了|shòu bu liǎo}).

questions.stem: Which is the written form for a medicine leaflet: "This medicine is mainly used to treat pneumonia"?
choices: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{药|yào}{主要|zhǔ yào}{用于|yòng yú}{治疗|zhì liáo}{肺炎|fèi yán}。
{这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{药|yào}{主要|zhǔ yào}{用来|yòng lái}{治|zhì}{肺炎|fèi yán}。
{这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{药|yào}{主要|zhǔ yào}{用|yòng}{在|zài}{肺炎|fèi yán}。
{这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{药|yào}{主要|zhǔ yào}{拿|ná}{来|lái}{治|zhì}{肺炎|fèi yán}。
questions.explanation: {用于|yòng yú} (used for) with {治疗|zhì liáo} (to treat) is the written register of leaflets and labels. {用来|yòng lái} and {拿|ná}{来|lái} are spoken; {用|yòng}{在|zài} {肺炎|fèi yán} is not idiomatic.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {他|tā}{的|de}{血压|xuè yā}{很|hěn}{高于|gāo yú}{正常|zhèng cháng}{水平|shuǐ píng}。
{他|tā}{的|de}{血压|xuè yā}{高于|gāo yú}{正常|zhèng cháng}{水平|shuǐ píng}。
{他|tā}{的|de}{血压|xuè yā}{比|bǐ}{正常|zhèng cháng}{水平|shuǐ píng}{高于|gāo yú}。
{他|tā}{的|de}{血压|xuè yā}{于|yú}{正常|zhèng cháng}{水平|shuǐ píng}{高|gāo}。
questions.explanation: A {高于|gāo yú} B: higher than (written), with no {很|hěn} inside. The spoken form is {他|tā}{的|de}{血压|xuè yā}{比|bǐ}{正常|zhèng cháng}{水平|shuǐ píng}{高|gāo}.

questions.stem: Which word is the spoken word for "head"?
questions.explanation: {脑袋|nǎo dai} (nǎodai) is the head in speech ({头|tóu} is the everyday word). {面部|miàn bù} is the face and {口腔|kǒu qiāng} the mouth, both medical; {心脏|xīn zàng} is the heart.

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {症状|zhèng zhuàng} (zhèngzhuàng) a symptom; {感染|gǎn rǎn} (gǎnrǎn) infection; {免疫|miǎn yì} (miǎnyì) immunity; {康复|kāng fù} (kāngfù) recovery. "To disinfect" is {消毒|xiāo dú} (xiāodú).

questions.stem: How is 吐 read in "{他|tā}{喝|hē}{多|duō}{了|le}，吐{了|le}{一|yí}{地|dì}。" (He drank too much and was sick all over the floor.)?
questions.explanation: {吐|tù} tù is to vomit; {吐|tǔ} tǔ is to spit (out): {把|bǎ}{嘴|zuǐ}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{吐|tǔ}{出来|chū lái}.

questions.stem: Choose the word for a report: {他|tā}{因|yīn}{身体|shēn tǐ}___，{今天|jīn tiān}{没有|méi yǒu}{来|lái}{上班|shàng bān}。 (He didn't come to work today because he was unwell.)
questions.explanation: {身体|shēn tǐ}{不适|bú shì} (unwell) is the written phrase of notes and reports, here after the written {因|yīn} (because). {恶心|ě xīn} is to feel sick, {近视|jìn shì} short-sighted, {肥胖|féi pàng} obese.

questions.stem: Read the paragraph. Why does the writer call inflammation a "signal"? {一旦|yí dàn}{有|yǒu}{病毒|bìng dú}{或|huò}{细菌|xì jūn}{突破|tū pò}{了|le}{这|zhè}{道|dào}{防线|fáng xiàn}，{进入|jìn rù}{了|le}{身体|shēn tǐ}，{免疫|miǎn yì}{系统|xì tǒng}{就|jiù}{开始|kāi shǐ}{工作|gōng zuò}{了|le}。{血液|xuè yè}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{白细胞|bái xì bāo}{会|huì}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}{赶|gǎn}{到|dào}{感染|gǎn rǎn}{的|de}{部位|bù wèi}，{把|bǎ}{入侵者|rù qīn zhě}{包围|bāo wéi}{起来|qǐ lái}{消灭|xiāo miè}{掉|diào}。{这|zhè}{时候|shí hou}，{那个|nà ge}{部位|bù wèi}{常常|cháng cháng}{会|huì}{红|hóng}、{肿|zhǒng}、{发|fā}{热|rè}、{疼痛|téng tòng}，{这|zhè}{就是|jiù shì}{我们|wǒ men}{说|shuō}{的|de}"{发炎|fā yán}"。{炎症|yán zhèng}{虽然|suī rán}{让|ràng}{人|rén}{不|bù}{舒服|shū fu}，{但|dàn}{它|tā}{其实|qí shí}{是|shì}{身体|shēn tǐ}{在|zài}{抵抗|dǐ kàng}{疾病|jí bìng}{的|de}{信号|xìn hào}。 ({防线|fáng xiàn}: line of defence; {白细胞|bái xì bāo}: white blood cells; {入侵者|rù qīn zhě}: invaders; {包围|bāo wéi}: to surround.)
choices: It shows the illness has won.
It shows the body is fighting the illness.
It means a doctor must operate.
It means the patient has a virus, not bacteria.
questions.explanation: {炎症|yán zhèng}…{其实|qí shí}{是|shì}{身体|shēn tǐ}{在|zài}{抵抗|dǐ kàng}{疾病|jí bìng}{的|de}{信号|xìn hào}: the redness and swelling show the white blood cells at work against the invaders.

questions.stem: Read the paragraph. What makes vaccines work, according to it? {免疫|miǎn yì}{系统|xì tǒng}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{了不起|liǎo bu qǐ}{的|de}{本领|běn lǐng}：{它|tā}{会|huì}"{记|jì}{住|zhù}"{见|jiàn}{过|guo}{的|de}{敌人|dí rén}。{身体|shēn tǐ}{打败|dǎ bài}{某|mǒu}{种|zhǒng}{病毒|bìng dú}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{会|huì}{产生|chǎn shēng}{专门|zhuān mén}{对付|duì fu}{它|tā}{的|de}{抗体|kàng tǐ}。{下|xià}{次|cì}{同样|tóng yàng}{的|de}{病毒|bìng dú}{再|zài}{来|lái}，{免疫|miǎn yì}{系统|xì tǒng}{就|jiù}{能|néng}{更|gèng}{快|kuài}{地|de}{认|rèn}{出|chū}{它|tā}、{抑制|yì zhì}{它|tā}。{疫苗|yì miáo}{正|zhèng}{是|shì}{利用|lì yòng}{了|le}{这个|zhè ge}{原理|yuán lǐ}。 ({抗体|kàng tǐ}: antibodies; {疫苗|yì miáo}: vaccines; {原理|yuán lǐ}: a principle.)
choices: They kill every virus in the air.
The immune system remembers an enemy it has met before.
questions.explanation: The immune system "remembers" ({记|jì}{住|zhù}) a virus and makes antibodies; vaccines use exactly this principle ({正|zhèng}{是|shì}{利用|lì yòng}{了|le}{这个|zhè ge} {原理|yuán lǐ}).

questions.stem: A doctor writes: "{发烧|fā shāo}、{咳嗽|ké sou}{等|děng}{症状|zhèng zhuàng}{本身|běn shēn}{并|bìng}{不|bú}{是|shì}{病|bìng}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{身体|shēn tǐ}{在|zài}‘{报警|bào jǐng}’。{除非|chú fēi}{症状|zhèng zhuàng}{严重|yán zhòng}{或|huò}{持续不退|chí xù bú tuì}，{一般|yì bān}{不必|bú bì}{过于|guò yú}{紧张|jǐn zhāng}。" What is the doctor's attitude? ({报警|bào jǐng}: to raise the alarm; {持续不退|chí xù bú tuì}: not going down.)
choices: Every fever needs treatment at once.
Coughs are more dangerous than fevers.
People worry too little about their health.
Symptoms should be taken calmly unless they are serious or don't go away.
questions.explanation: Symptoms are the body raising the alarm, not the illness itself; {除非|chú fēi} they're serious or don't go down, {不必|bú bì}{过于|guò yú}{紧张|jǐn zhāng} (no need to worry too much): calm and balanced.

questions.stem: Listen. Which department should the patient go to?

audio.text: 我家孩子三岁，昨天晚上开始发烧，还一直咳嗽，请问挂哪个科？

questions.explanation: A three-year-old child with a fever and a cough: {儿科|ér kē} (paediatrics). {外科|wài kē} is surgery, {口腔科|kǒu qiāng kē} dentistry, {眼科|yǎn kē} the eye department.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the doctor mean?

audio.text: 这是病毒感染，抗菌的药没有用。除非你好好休息、多喝水，否则很难好得快。

choices: Rest and water are what will help most.
The patient must stay in hospital.
questions.explanation: It's a viral infection, so antibacterial drugs are no use ({没有|méi yǒu}{用|yòng}); {除非|chú fēi}…{否则|fǒu zé}: only rest and water will make it better fast.

questions.stem: Listen. What is wrong with the speaker?

audio.text: 我站起来的时候有点儿头晕，还觉得恶心，什么都不想吃。

choices: dizzy and nauseous, with no appetite
questions.explanation: {头晕|tóu yūn} (dizzy) when standing up, {恶心|ě xīn} (nauseous) and no wish to eat anything.

questions.stem: Listen. Why does the doctor think the speaker's resistance is low?

audio.text: 你最近是不是常常熬夜？长期睡眠不足，抵抗力就会下降，很容易感冒。

choices: The speaker works outdoors in the cold.
The speaker has been short of sleep for a long time.
questions.explanation: {长期|cháng qī}{睡眠|shuì mián}{不足|bù zú} (too little sleep over a long time) lowers resistance ({抵抗力|dǐ kàng lì}{下降|xià jiàng}).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {细菌|xì jūn} xì jūn (bacteria): a falling tone, then a level one, 4+1.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {肺炎|fèi yán} fèi yán (pneumonia): a falling tone, then a rising one, 4+2.

questions.topic: 除非…才 and 除非…否则
questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Unless you sort out your sleep, you'll be ill again in a while.
questions.explanation: {除非|chú fēi}{把|bǎ}{睡眠|shuì mián}{调整|tiáo zhěng}{好|hǎo}，{否则|fǒu zé}{过|guò}{一阵子|yí zhèn zi}{还|hái}{会|huì}{生病|shēng bìng}。 With {否则|fǒu zé}, the second clause says what happens without the condition; {才|cái} would need a result that follows from it ({除非|chú fēi}…，{才能|cái néng}{好|hǎo}).

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {他|tā}{得|dé}{了|le}___ {炎|yán}，{住|zhù}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{院|yuàn}。 (He got pneumonia and was in hospital for a week.)
questions.explanation: {肺炎|fèi yán} fèi yán. {={肺|fèi}=}: flesh ⺼ + 巿 (fú, not {市|shì}: its vertical goes straight through), 8 strokes.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {多|duō}{运动|yùn dòng}{能|néng}{提高|tí gāo}{身体|shēn tǐ}{的|de}___ {抗|kàng}{力|lì}。 (More exercise strengthens the body's resistance.)
questions.explanation: {抵抗力|dǐ kàng lì} dǐkànglì (resistance). {={抵|dǐ}=}: hand 扌 + 氐, the part of {低|dī} and {底|dǐ}; 8 strokes.

questions.stem: A notice says: "{除|chú}{节假日|jié jià rì}{外|wài}，{博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{开放|kāi fàng}。" When is the museum closed?
questions.explanation: {除|chú} A {外|wài}，{都|dōu} / {每|měi}{天|tiān}…: except A. The museum opens every day except public holidays ({节假日|jié jià rì}), so it's closed on them.

questions.stem: What does "{除|chú}{赔偿|péi cháng}{损失|sǔn shī}{外|wài}，{商店|shāng diàn}{还|hái}{要|yào}{公开|gōng kāi}{道歉|dào qiàn}。" say the shop must do?
choices: both pay for the loss and apologise in public
questions.explanation: {除|chú} A {外|wài}，{还|hái}…: besides A. With {还|hái}, A is included: the shop pays for the loss and, on top of that, apologises in public ({公开|gōng kāi}{道歉|dào qiàn}).

questions.stem: Choose the word: {商店|shāng diàn}{已经|yǐ jīng}{道歉|dào qiàn}{了|le}，___ {赔|péi}{多少|duō shao}{钱|qián}，{还|hái}{要|yào}{再|zài}{商量|shāng liang}。 (The shop has apologised; as for how much it will pay, that still has to be agreed.)
questions.explanation: {至于|zhì yú} turns to a related point, in the middle of a passage: "as for…". {关于|guān yú} (about) and {对于|duì yú} (towards, as regards) introduce a whole topic; {由于|yóu yú} is "because of".

questions.stem: Which sentence would you say to a friend rather than write in a notice?
choices: {除|chú}{本人|běn rén}{外|wài}，{任何|rèn hé}{人|rén}{不得|bù dé}{代领|dài lǐng}。
{除|chú}{节假日|jié jià rì}{外|wài}，{每|měi}{天|tiān}{开放|kāi fàng}。
{除|chú}{公开|gōng kāi}{道歉|dào qiàn}{外|wài}，{还|hái}{需|xū}{赔偿|péi cháng}。
{除了|chú le}{你|nǐ}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: {除了|chú le}…({以外|yǐ wài}) is the spoken frame: {除了|chú le}{你|nǐ}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{了|le}. {除|chú}…{外|wài} without {了|le}, and {不得|bù dé}, {需|xū}, {本人|běn rén}, are the written register of notices and reports.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {经理|jīng lǐ}{有|yǒu}___ {决定|jué dìng}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。 (The manager has the authority to decide this.)
questions.explanation: {权力|quán lì} (with {力|lì}, power) is authority. {权利|quán lì} (with {利|lì}) is a right, as in {公民|gōng mín}{的|de}{权利|quán lì} (citizens' rights); the two sound the same.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {她|tā}{买|mǎi}{的|de}{电脑|diàn nǎo}{有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}，{商店|shāng diàn}{不|bù}{肯|kěn}{换|huàn}，{她|tā}{就|jiù}{向|xiàng}{消费者|xiāo fèi zhě}{协会|xié huì}___ {了|le}。 (Her new computer was faulty and the shop wouldn't change it, so she complained to the consumers' association. {协会|xié huì}: an association.)
questions.explanation: {投诉|tóu sù} is to complain formally ({向|xiàng}…{投诉|tóu sù}). {赔偿|péi cháng} is to compensate, {保管|bǎo guǎn} to keep safe, {归还|guī huán} to give back.

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {骗子|piàn zi} (piànzi) a swindler; {上当|shàng dàng} (shàngdàng) to be fooled; {当场|dāng chǎng} (dāngchǎng) on the spot; {漏洞|lòu dòng} (lòudòng) a loophole, a gap. A judge is {法官|fǎ guān} (fǎguān).

questions.stem: A driver says: "{前面|qián miàn}{路口|lù kǒu}{往|wǎng}{右|yòu}{拐|guǎi}，{再|zài}{开|kāi}{两百|liǎng bǎi}{米|mǐ}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。" What should you do?
choices: Turn left at the next junction.
Turn right at the next junction and go on two hundred metres.
questions.explanation: {往|wǎng}{右|yòu}{拐|guǎi} is to turn right; {再|zài}{开|kāi}{两百|liǎng bǎi}{米|mǐ} (drive another two hundred metres). Reversing is {倒车|dào chē}.

questions.stem: How is 晕 read in 晕车 (carsick)?
questions.explanation: {晕车|yùn chē} yùnchē. On its own, {晕|yūn} (dizzy) has the first tone.

questions.stem: Read the paragraph from a news report. Why was the shop held responsible? {法院|fǎ yuàn}{审理|shěn lǐ}{后|hòu}{认为|rèn wéi}，{公民|gōng mín}{的|de}{个人|gè rén}{隐私|yǐn sī}{受|shòu}{法律|fǎ lǜ}{保护|bǎo hù}。{维修|wéi xiū}{店|diàn}{对|duì}{顾客|gù kè}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{负有|fù yǒu}{保管|bǎo guǎn}{的|de}{责任|zé rèn}，{员工|yuán gōng}{私自|sī zì}{复制|fù zhì}{顾客|gù kè}{的|de}{资料|zī liào}，{店家|diàn jiā}{管理|guǎn lǐ}{上|shàng}{存在|cún zài}{明显|míng xiǎn}{漏洞|lòu dòng}，{应当|yīng dāng}{承担|chéng dān}{责任|zé rèn}。 ({审理|shěn lǐ}: to hear a case; {负有|fù yǒu}: to bear; {私自|sī zì}: without permission.)
choices: The shop had a duty to keep the phone safe, and its management had an obvious gap.
The shop broke the customer's phone.
The customer never paid for the repair.
The employee was the owner's son.
questions.explanation: The shop bore responsibility for keeping customers' phones safe ({负有|fù yǒu}{保管|bǎo guǎn}{的|de}{责任|zé rèn}), and an employee could copy data without permission because of an obvious gap in management ({管理|guǎn lǐ}{上|shàng}{存在|cún zài}{明显|míng xiǎn}{漏洞|lòu dòng}).

questions.stem: In a news report, a customer refuses the shop's offer of 300 yuan and says: "{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{的|de}{不|bú}{是|shì}{钱|qián}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{说法|shuō fǎ}。" What does she want?
choices: a proper explanation and acknowledgement of what happened
questions.explanation: {要|yào}{一|yí}{个|gè}{说法|shuō fǎ} is to demand an explanation, for someone to take responsibility: {不|bú}{是|shì}{钱|qián}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{说法|shuō fǎ}.

questions.stem: A news report ends: "{一|yí}{位|wèi}{律师|lǜ shī}{表示|biǎo shì}，{这|zhè}{类|lèi}{案例|àn lì}{近年来|jìn nián lái}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{少见|shǎo jiàn}。{人|rén}{人|rén}{在|zài}{法律|fǎ lǜ}{面前|miàn qián}{平等|píng děng}，{商家|shāng jiā}{不论|bú lùn}{大小|dà xiǎo}，{都|dōu}{必须|bì xū}{遵守|zūn shǒu}{法规|fǎ guī}。{至于|zhì yú}{消费者|xiāo fèi zhě}{自己|zì jǐ}，{也|yě}{应当|yīng dāng}{提高|tí gāo}{保护|bǎo hù}{隐私|yǐn sī}{的|de}{意识|yì shí}。" What does {至于|zhì yú} introduce? ({意识|yì shí}: awareness.)
questions.explanation: {至于|zhì yú} turns from businesses to a related point: consumers too should be more aware of protecting their privacy.

questions.stem: Listen. Where does this probably take place?

audio.text: 请大家注意，车上人多，请保管好自己的钱包和手机，小心小偷儿。

choices: on a crowded bus or coach
questions.explanation: {车|chē}{上|shàng}{人|rén}{多|duō} (it's crowded on board), look after your wallets and phones, watch out for thieves: an announcement on a bus or coach.

questions.stem: Listen. Why was the driver stopped?

audio.text: 交警把他拦了下来，因为他在路口拐弯的时候没有打灯，这是第一次，所以只给了一个警告。

questions.explanation: {拐弯|guǎi wān}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{没有|méi yǒu}{打灯|dǎ dēng} (he didn't indicate when turning); a first time gets only a warning ({警告|jǐng gào}). ({打灯|dǎ dēng}: to indicate.)

questions.stem: Listen. How does the speaker feel?

audio.text: 我在网上买了一个包，收到的跟图片上的完全不一样，客服还不理我，真是上当了。

questions.explanation: The bag isn't like the picture and customer service ignores them ({不理|bù lǐ}{我|wǒ}): {真|zhēn}{是|shì}{上当|shàng dàng}{了|le} (I've really been taken in).

questions.stem: Listen. What happened to the speaker's wallet?

audio.text: 我下车的时候钱包掉在了座位下面，司机打扫车厢时发现了，马上开车送了回来。

choices: The driver found it and brought it back.
questions.explanation: It fell under the seat ({掉|diào}{在|zài}{了|le}{座位|zuò wèi}{下面|xià miàn}); the driver found it while cleaning ({打扫|dǎ sǎo}{车厢|chē xiāng}) and brought it back.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {隐私|yǐn sī} yǐn sī (privacy): a dipping tone, then a level one, 3+1.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {法官|fǎ guān} fǎ guān (a judge): a dipping tone, then a level one, 3+1.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Besides apologising publicly, the repair shop must also compensate the customer for the loss.
questions.explanation: {除|chú}{公开|gōng kāi}{道歉|dào qiàn}{外|wài}，{维修|wéi xiū}{店|diàn}{还|hái}{要|yào}{赔偿|péi cháng}{顾客|gù kè}{的|de}{损失|sǔn shī}。 {除|chú}…{外|wài} is the written frame (spoken: {除了|chú le}…{以外|yǐ wài}); {还|hái} makes it "besides", while {都|dōu} would make it "except". The subject can also come first: {维修|wéi xiū}{店|diàn}{除|chú}…{外|wài}，{还|hái}…

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {法|fǎ}___ {认为|rèn wéi}{商店|shāng diàn}{应当|yīng dāng}{承担|chéng dān}{责任|zé rèn}。 (The judge held that the shop should bear responsibility.)
questions.explanation: {法官|fǎ guān} fǎ guān (a judge). {={官|guān}=}: 宀 over 㠯, the sound part of {管|guǎn} and {馆|guǎn}; 8 strokes.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {今天|jīn tiān}{路况|lù kuàng}{不错|bú cuò}，{道路|dào lù}{很|hěn}___ {通|tōng}。 (The roads are fine today: traffic is flowing freely.)
questions.explanation:
{畅通|chàng tōng} chàng tōng (flowing freely). {={畅|chàng}=}: {申|shēn} + the right side of {场|chǎng}, 8 strokes; traditional {+{畅|chàng}+} has
14.

questions.stem: Choose the word for a written story: {我|wǒ}{原|yuán}{以为|yǐ wéi}{这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{新闻|xīn wén}{没|méi}{人|rén}{关注|guān zhù}，___ {第|dì}{二|èr}{天|tiān}{就|jiù}{成|chéng}{了|le}{热点|rè diǎn}。 (I thought nobody would notice the story, but the next day it became a hot topic.)
questions.explanation: {不料|bú liào} (unexpectedly) opens the second clause of a story: what happened was not what anyone expected. In speech, {没|méi}{想|xiǎng}{到|dào}. {不必|bú bì} is "need not", {不论|bú lùn} "no matter", {不|bú}{再|zài} "no longer".

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {他|tā}{本来|běn lái}{说|shuō}{不|bù}{来|lái}，{不料|bú liào}{第|dì}{二|èr}{天|tiān}{一|yì}{早|zǎo}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。
{明天|míng tiān}{不料|bú liào}{会|huì}{下雨|xià yǔ}。
{他|tā}{不料|bú liào}{了|le}{这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}。
questions.explanation: {不料|bú liào} starts the second clause and looks back on what happened. It takes no subject or object of its own (not {我|wǒ}{不料|bú liào} {他|tā}{会|huì}{来|lái}: say {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{想|xiǎng}{到|dào}{他|tā}{会|huì}{来|lái}), isn't used for the future, and isn't a verb with {了|le}.

questions.stem: A news story begins: "{日前|rì qián}，{市|shì}{博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{开|kāi}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{新|xīn}{的|de}{展览|zhǎn lǎn}。" When did the exhibition open?
questions.explanation: {日前|rì qián} (rìqián) is "a few days ago", a word of the news for a single recent event. {目前|mù qián} (at present) and {当下|dāng xià} (right now) are different.

questions.stem: Choose the word: ___，{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{多|duō}{的|de}{年轻人|nián qīng rén}{开始|kāi shǐ}{读|dú}{纸质书|zhǐ zhì shū}。 (Lately, more and more young people have started reading printed books.)
questions.explanation: {近来|jìn lái} (lately) covers a period up to now, so it suits a trend ({越来越|yuè lái yuè}{多|duō}…{开始|kāi shǐ}…). {日前|rì qián} marks a single event a few days ago; {往年|wǎng nián} is "other years"; {当选|dāng xuǎn} is to be elected.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {据|jù}{业内|yè nèi}___ {透露|tòu lù}，{这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{手机|shǒu jī}{明年|míng nián}{上市|shàng shì}。 (According to people in the trade, the phone goes on sale next year.)
questions.explanation: {人士|rén shì} is "a person, a figure" with a describing word: {业内人士|yè nèi rén shì} (people in the trade), {知情人士|zhī qíng rén shì} (informed sources). {众人|zhòng rén} is everyone present, {外界|wài jiè} the outside world, {主播|zhǔ bō} a presenter.

questions.stem: Which word means "negative" in "{负面|fù miàn}{新闻|xīn wén}{往往|wǎng wǎng}{传|chuán}{得|de}{更|gèng}{快|kuài}。"?
questions.explanation: {负面|fù miàn} (fùmiàn) is negative; its opposite is {正面|zhèng miàn} (positive; also "the front"). {往往|wǎng wǎng} is "often, tend to"; {传|chuán} to spread.

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {编辑|biān jí} (biānjí) an editor; {频道|pín dào} (píndào) a channel; {线索|xiàn suǒ} (xiànsuǒ) a clue; {真相|zhēn xiàng} (zhēnxiàng) the truth. A microphone is {话筒|huà tǒng} or {麦克风|mài kè fēng}.

questions.stem: In everyday use, what are {群众演员|qún zhòng yǎn yuán}?
choices: film extras (people in the crowd scenes)
questions.explanation: {群众|qún zhòng} is the masses, ordinary people, bystanders: {群众演员|qún zhòng yǎn yuán} are film extras, {围观|wéi guān}{群众|qún zhòng} onlookers.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {她|tā}{在|zài}{班|bān}{上|shàng}{很|hěn}___，{常常|cháng cháng}{主动|zhǔ dòng}{发言|fā yán}。 (She's very active in class and often speaks up of her own accord.)
questions.explanation: {活跃|huó yuè} (huóyuè) is active, lively. {出名|chū míng} is famous, {负面|fù miàn} negative, {官方|guān fāng} official.

questions.stem: Read the paragraph from a commentary. What does the writer give in it? {为什么|wèi shén me}{会|huì}{这样|zhè yàng}？{首先|shǒu xiān}，{负面|fù miàn}{消息|xiāo xi}{更|gèng}{容易|róng yì}{引起|yǐn qǐ}{人们|rén men}{的|de}{担忧|dān yōu}，{也|yě}{更|gèng}{容易|róng yì}{被|bèi}{转发|zhuǎn fā}。{其次|qí cì}，{一些|yì xiē}{发布者|fā bù zhě}{为了|wèi le}{追求|zhuī qiú}{点击量|diǎn jī liàng}，{故意|gù yì}{把|bǎ}{标题|biāo tí}{写|xiě}{得|de}{很|hěn}{夸张|kuā zhāng}。{另外|lìng wài}，{有的|yǒu de}{媒体|méi tǐ}{为了|wèi le}{抢|qiǎng}{时间|shí jiān}，{没有|méi yǒu}{认真|rèn zhēn}{核实|hé shí}，{就|jiù}{跟|gēn}{着|zhe}{报道|bào dào}，{让|ràng}{错误|cuò wù}{的|de}{信息|xìn xī}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}"{主流|zhǔ liú}"{的|de}{声音|shēng yīn}。 ({点击量|diǎn jī liàng}: clicks; {夸张|kuā zhāng}: exaggerated; {核实|hé shí}: to verify.)
choices: three reasons why false news spreads fast
questions.explanation: {为什么|wèi shén me}{会|huì}{这样|zhè yàng}？ then {首先|shǒu xiān}, {其次|qí cì}, {另外|lìng wài}: three reasons (negative news worries people, exaggerated headlines, media that don't verify).

questions.stem: A commentary says: "{当然|dāng rán}，{我们|wǒ men}{不|bù}{能|néng}{因此|yīn cǐ}{就|jiù}{要求|yāo qiú}{大家|dà jiā}{不|bú}{再|zài}{转发|zhuǎn fā}、{不|bú}{再|zài}{议论|yì lùn}。{公众|gōng zhòng}{关心|guān xīn}{食品|shí pǐn}{安全|ān quán}，{这|zhè}{本身|běn shēn}{是|shì}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{好|hǎo}{事|shì}。" What is the writer doing here?
questions.explanation: {当然|dāng rán}… admits a point on the other side (discussion itself is good) before the writer returns to the argument: a concession.

questions.stem: A reader comments on an article: "{王记者|Wáng jì zhě}{说|shuō}{得|de}{有|yǒu}{道理|dào li}，{但|dàn}{我|wǒ}{觉得|jué de}{只|zhǐ}{要求|yāo qiú}{读者|dú zhě}‘{等一等|děng yi děng}’{不|bú}{太|tài}{公平|gōng píng}。{普通|pǔ tōng}{人|rén}{没有|méi yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}{也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}{能力|néng lì}{去|qù}{核实|hé shí}{每|měi}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{消息|xiāo xi}。{希望|xī wàng}{媒体|méi tǐ}{在|zài}{辟谣|pì yáo}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{也|yě}{能|néng}{像|xiàng}{报道|bào dào}{谣言|yáo yán}{时|shí}{一样|yí yàng}，{放|fàng}{在|zài}{显眼|xiǎn yǎn}{的|de}{位置|wèi zhì}。" What is the reader's attitude? ({辟谣|pì yáo}: to refute a rumour; {显眼|xiǎn yǎn}: eye-catching.)
choices: partial agreement, with a different emphasis
questions.explanation: {说|shuō}{得|de}{有|yǒu}{道理|dào li} (a fair point), {但|dàn}… (but): the reader thinks the media, not only readers, must do more. Partial agreement.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the editor want?

audio.text: 这篇稿子写得不错，可是标题太夸张了，换一个吧。周四下午四点以前交给我。

choices: a new headline by Thursday afternoon
questions.explanation: The piece is good, but the headline ({标题|biāo tí}) is too exaggerated: change it, by four on Thursday afternoon.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's attitude to the news?

audio.text: 这种消息我一般不马上转发，先等一等，看看官方渠道怎么说。

questions.explanation: The speaker doesn't share such news straight away but waits to see what official channels ({官方|guān fāng}{渠道|qú dào}) say: careful.

questions.stem: Listen. What happened to the little shop?

audio.text: 这家小店本来没什么人知道，不料一个视频在网上火了，现在天天排长队。

choices: It became famous because of a video.
It moved to a new street.
questions.explanation: No one knew it before; {不料|bú liào} a video went viral ({火|huǒ}{了|le}), and now there are long queues every day: it has become famous ({出名|chū míng}{了|le}).

questions.stem: Listen. Who is probably speaking?

audio.text: 各位观众，晚上好。欢迎收看今天的新闻节目，下面请看一组系列报道。

questions.explanation: {各位|gè wèi}{观众|guān zhòng} (viewers), {欢迎|huān yíng}{收看|shōu kàn}{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{新闻|xīn wén}{节目|jié mù} (welcome to today's news): a news presenter ({主播|zhǔ bō}).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {频道|pín dào} pín dào (a channel): a rising tone, then a falling one, 2+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {论坛|lùn tán} lùn tán (a forum): a falling tone, then a rising one, 4+2.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: They had planned to go hiking at the weekend, but it unexpectedly poured with rain.
questions.explanation: {他们|tā men}{本来|běn lái}{打算|dǎ suàn}{周末|zhōu mò}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}，{不料|bú liào}{下|xià}{起|qǐ}{了|le}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}。 {本来|běn lái}… sets up the plan; {不料|bú liào} opens the clause with what happened instead.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {郑华|Zhèng Huá}{是|shì}{王芳|Wáng Fāng}{的|de}___ {辑|jí}。 (Zheng Hua is Wang Fang's editor.)
questions.explanation: {编辑|biān jí} biān jí. {={编|biān}=}: silk 纟 + 扁, as in {遍|biàn}, {篇|piān} and {骗|piàn}; 12 strokes. Traditional {+{编|biān}+} has 15.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {他|tā}{常|cháng}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{的|de}{论|lùn}___ {上|shàng}{回答|huí dá}{别人|bié ren}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}。 (He often answers people's questions on an online forum.)
questions.explanation: {论坛|lùn tán} lùn tán. {={坛|tán}=}: earth {土|tǔ} + {云|yún} in simplified; traditional {+{坛|tán}+} has 亶; 7 strokes.

questions.stem: Who wrote the first eighty chapters of 《{红楼梦|Hóng lóu mèng}》 (Dream of the Red Chamber)?
questions.explanation: {曹雪芹|Cáo Xuě qín} (Cáo Xuěqín, born between 1715 and 1724, died 1763 or 1764). {程伟元|Chéng Wěi yuán} and {高鹗|Gāo È} published the 120-chapter edition of 1791; {鲁迅|Lǔ Xùn} is a twentieth-century writer.

questions.stem: What is generally said about the last forty chapters of 《{红楼梦|Hóng lóu mèng}》?
choices: They were lost and never printed.
They were added in the twentieth century.
Who wrote them is still debated.
questions.explanation: The manuscripts have eighty chapters; the 1791 printed edition by {程伟元|Chéng Wěi yuán} and {高鹗|Gāo È} has 120. The last forty are often credited to {高鹗|Gāo È} (or to the two editors working from manuscripts), but their authorship is still debated.

questions.stem: Under what title did 《{红楼梦|Hóng lóu mèng}》 first circulate in manuscript?
questions.explanation: 《{石头记|Shí tou jì}》 (The Story of the Stone): {宝玉|Bǎo yù}'s jade is said to be a stone left over when {女娲|Nǚ wā} mended the sky.

questions.stem: What is {红学|hóng xué}?
choices: the study of 《{红楼梦|Hóng lóu mèng}》
questions.explanation: {红学|hóng xué} (hóngxué, "Red-ology") is the study of 《{红楼梦|Hóng lóu mèng}》: its manuscripts, its author's life and its characters.

questions.stem: Which of these is NOT one of the main young characters of 《{红楼梦|Hóng lóu mèng}》?
questions.explanation: {贾宝玉|Jiǎ Bǎo yù}, {林黛玉|Lín Dài yù} and {薛宝钗|Xuē Bǎo chāi} are the three cousins at the heart of the novel; {孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng} is the Monkey King of 《{西游记|Xī yóu jì}》.

questions.stem: What is {大观园|Dà guān yuán} in 《{红楼梦|Hóng lóu mèng}》?
choices: the garden where the young people of the {贾|Jiǎ} family live
questions.explanation: {大观园|Dà guān yuán} (the Grand View Garden) is built for a daughter of the family who has become an imperial consort; the young people live and write poems there.

questions.stem: In a retelling of 《{红楼梦|Hóng lóu mèng}》 chapter 3, {黛玉|Dài yù} thinks before she arrives: "{外婆|wài pó}{家|jiā}{和|hé}{别人|bié ren}{家|jiā}{不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}，{规矩|guī ju}{很|hěn}{多|duō}……{每|měi}{一|yí}{步|bù}{都|dōu}{要|yào}{小心|xiǎo xīn}，{每|měi}{一|yí}{句|jù}{话|huà}{都|dōu}{要|yào}{想|xiǎng}{好|hǎo}{了|le}{再说|zài shuō}，{千万|qiān wàn}{不|bù}{能|néng}{让|ràng}{人|rén}{笑话|xiào hua}。" Why is she so careful? ({规矩|guī ju}: rules; {笑话|xiào hua}: to laugh at.)
choices: She has heard the household has many rules and doesn't want to be laughed at.
She is afraid of her grandmother's anger.
She doesn't want to stay there.
questions.explanation: {规矩|guī ju}{很|hěn}{多|duō} (many rules) and {千万|qiān wàn}{不|bù}{能|néng}{让|ràng}{人|rén}{笑话|xiào hua} (she mustn't give anyone cause to laugh at her): she is young, alone and determined not to put a foot wrong.

questions.stem: In 《{红楼梦|Hóng lóu mèng}》 chapter 3, what does {宝玉|Bǎo yù} say when he first sees {黛玉|Dài yù}?
choices: "{这个|zhè ge}{妹妹|mèi mei}{我|wǒ}{曾|céng}{见过|jiàn guo}{的|de}。"
questions.explanation: {宝玉|Bǎo yù}{看罢|kàn bà}，{因笑道|yīn xiào dào}："{这个|zhè ge}{妹妹|mèi mei}{我|wǒ}{曾|céng}{见过|jiàn guo}{的|de}。" (I have seen this cousin before.) He asks about her jade later; {我|wǒ}{来|lái}{晚|wǎn}{了|le} is {王熙凤|Wáng Xī fèng}'s entrance.

questions.stem: In a retelling of the same scene: "{宝玉|Bǎo yù}{又|yòu}{问|wèn}{黛玉|Dài yù}：‘{你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{玉|yù}{没有|méi yǒu}？’{黛玉|Dài yù}{说|shuō}：‘{我|wǒ}{没有|méi yǒu}。’{不料|bú liào}{宝玉|Bǎo yù}{听|tīng}{了|le}，{一下子|yí xià zi}{发起|fā qǐ}{脾气|pí qi}{来|lái}，{把|bǎ}{脖子|bó zi}{上|shàng}{的|de}{玉|yù}{摘|zhāi}{下来|xià lái}，{重重|zhòng zhòng}{地|de}{摔|shuāi}{在|zài}{地上|dì shang}。" What does {不料|bú liào} show?
choices: that his reaction came as a surprise
questions.explanation: {不料|bú liào} (unexpectedly) marks what nobody expected: a simple answer sets off a temper and the jade thrown on the floor.

questions.stem: In a retelling of the first meeting of {宝玉|Bǎo yù} and {黛玉|Dài yù}, everyone in the room speaks softly. Then someone laughs aloud in the courtyard: "{我|wǒ}{来|lái}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}，{没|méi}{能|néng}{迎接|yíng jiē}{从|cóng}{远处|yuǎn chù}{来|lái}{的|de}{客人|kè rén}！" Who is it, and what does it show about her? ({迎接|yíng jiē}: to welcome.)
choices: a maid who is late for work
{王熙凤|Wáng Xī fèng}, bold and sure of her place in the house
questions.explanation: It's {王熙凤|Wáng Xī fèng}'s famous entrance: where everyone else speaks softly, she arrives laughing. She is bold, lively and manages much of the household.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the three syllables?
questions.explanation: {红楼梦|Hóng lóu mèng}: two rising tones, then a falling one, 2+2+4.

questions.stem: Someone says of a friend: "{她|tā}{跟|gēn}{林黛玉|Lín Dài yù}{一样|yí yàng}，{特别|tè bié}{敏感|mǐn gǎn}，{动不动|dòng bu dòng}{就|jiù}{哭|kū}。" What do they mean? ({动不动|dòng bu dòng}: at the slightest thing.)
choices: She is delicate and sensitive, quick to cry.
She has a lot of cousins.
questions.explanation: {林黛玉|Lín Dài yù} is a byword for a delicate, sensitive girl who cries easily.

questions.stem: What is the most common form of {相声|xiàng sheng} (crosstalk)?
choices: {单口相声|dān kǒu xiàng sheng} (one performer)
{对口相声|duì kǒu xiàng sheng} (two performers)
{群口相声|qún kǒu xiàng sheng} (three or more)
a sung opera with an orchestra
questions.explanation: {对口相声|duì kǒu xiàng sheng}, a dialogue between two performers, is the usual form; {单口相声|dān kǒu xiàng sheng} is a story told by one, {群口相声|qún kǒu xiàng sheng} a group act.

questions.stem: In a two-person {相声|xiàng sheng}, what does the {捧哏|pěng gén} (pěnggén) do?
choices: tells the main story and the jokes
supports the lead: asks, reacts and sets up the jokes
questions.explanation: The {逗哏|dòu gén} (dòugén) leads and makes the jokes; the {捧哏|pěng gén} is the partner who questions, objects and reacts, making the jokes land. Performers say {三分逗|sān fēn dòu}，{七分捧|qī fēn pěng}.

questions.stem: What are the four basic skills of {相声|xiàng sheng}?
questions.explanation: {说|shuō} (speaking), {学|xué} (imitating), {逗|dòu} (joking) and {唱|chàng} (singing). {听说读写|tīng shuō dú xiě} are the four language skills; {唱念做打|chàng niàn zuò dǎ} are the skills of Chinese opera; {琴棋书画|qín qí shū huà} are the traditional arts of a scholar.

questions.stem: Where is {相声|xiàng sheng} usually traced to?
choices: street performers of the late Qing dynasty in Beijing and Tianjin
the imperial court of the Tang dynasty
questions.explanation: To street performers of the mid-nineteenth century, late Qing, in places like Beijing's {天桥|Tiān qiáo} and the markets of Tianjin; its roots may be older.

questions.stem: Who was {侯宝林|Hóu Bǎo lín} (1917–1993)?
choices: one of the most popular and influential crosstalk performers of his generation
questions.explanation: {侯宝林|Hóu Bǎo lín} (Hóu Bǎolín), born in Tianjin, was one of the best-known crosstalk performers of the twentieth century and taught many who came after him.

questions.stem: In a sketch, A says "{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{个|gè}{忙人|máng rén}。" and the doctor waves a hand in front of his eyes. Why?
choices: The doctor is testing his hearing.
{忙人|máng rén} sounds exactly like {盲人|máng rén} (a blind person).
The doctor wants him to leave.
questions.explanation: {忙人|máng rén} (a busy person) and {盲人|máng rén} (a blind person) are both máng rén: the doctor hears "I'm blind".

questions.stem: In a sketch, the doctor says: "{吐|tǔ}{没关系|méi guān xi}，{吐|tù}{才|cái}{有|yǒu}{关系|guān xi}。" What is the joke?
choices: The doctor can't pronounce the word.
The doctor is talking about soil.
Spitting is fine; it's vomiting that matters: one character, two readings.
questions.explanation: {吐|tǔ} tǔ is to spit (anyone spits when brushing their teeth); {吐|tù} tù is to vomit, the real symptom.

questions.stem: In a sketch, the patient says he feels dizzy "{一|yí}{坐|zuò}{车|chē}{就|jiù}{晕|yūn}", and the doctor says: "{那|nà}{是|shì}{晕车|yùn chē}，{不|bù}{归|guī}{我们|wǒ men}{内科|nèi kē}{管|guǎn}，{您|nín}{去|qù}{车站|chē zhàn}{吧|ba}。" What makes it funny?
choices: The doctor treats "carsickness" as if it were a matter for the bus station.
The patient is a bus driver.
questions.explanation: {晕车|yùn chē} is carsickness, a symptom like any other, but the doctor pretends it's the bus station's business because it has {车|chē} in it. ({不|bù}{归|guī}…{管|guǎn}: not … 's responsibility.)

questions.stem: A sketch ends: {甲|jiǎ}: "{大夫|dài fu}，{我|wǒ}{要是|yào shi}{能|néng}{按时|àn shí}{睡觉|shuì jiào}，{还|hái}{来|lái}{找|zhǎo}{您|nín}{干|gàn}{什么|shén me}？" {乙|yǐ}: "{嗐|hài}，{去你的吧|qù nǐ de ba}！" What is {乙|yǐ}'s last line?
choices: a traditional closing line of the partner: "Oh, get away with you!"
questions.explanation: {去你的吧|qù nǐ de ba} is the {捧哏|pěng gén}'s traditional last line, with mock exasperation, ending the piece. ({大夫|dài fu} dàifu: a doctor.)

questions.stem: In {相声|xiàng sheng}, what is a {包袱|bāo fu} (bāofu, "a bundle")?
choices: the punchline, built up and then "shaken open"
questions.explanation: A {包袱|bāo fu} is the punchline: it's tied up slowly and then shaken open ({抖包袱|dǒu bāo fu}).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {逗哏|dòu gén} dòu gén (the lead in crosstalk): a falling tone, then a rising one, 4+2.

questions.stem: Which pair could a crosstalk performer use for a joke on two meanings of the same word?
choices: {局|jú} (a bureau) and {局|jú} (a game, a set)
questions.explanation: {局|jú} is a bureau ({公安局|gōng ān jú}, lesson 09) and also a game or set ({一|yì}{局|jú}, lesson 29): "{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{公安局|gōng ān jú}{上班|shàng bān}。" "{哦|ò}，{打牌|dǎ pái}{的|de}{那个|nà ge}{局|jú}？" The others are just opposites.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Rather than complaining about the weather at home, you'd do better to go out for a walk"?
choices: {与其|yǔ qí}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{抱怨|bào yuàn}{天气|tiān qì}，{不如|bù rú}{出去|chū qù}{走走|zǒu zou}。
{与其|yǔ qí}{出去|chū qù}{走走|zǒu zou}，{不如|bù rú}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{抱怨|bào yuàn}{天气|tiān qì}。
{不如|bù rú}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{抱怨|bào yuàn}{天气|tiān qì}，{与其|yǔ qí}{出去|chū qù}{走走|zǒu zou}。
{与其|yǔ qí}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{抱怨|bào yuàn}{天气|tiān qì}，{但是|dàn shì}{出去|chū qù}{走走|zǒu zou}。
questions.explanation: {与其|yǔ qí} + the choice you give up, {不如|bù rú} + the one you recommend: {与其|yǔ qí}{抱怨|bào yuàn}{天气|tiān qì}，{不如|bù rú}{出去|chū qù}{走走|zǒu zou}. {与其|yǔ qí}{出去|chū qù}{走走|zǒu zou}，{不如|bù rú}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{抱怨|bào yuàn}{天气|tiān qì} reverses the advice, {不如|bù rú}…{与其|yǔ qí}… puts the two words in the wrong order, and {与其|yǔ qí} never pairs with {但是|dàn shì}.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {与其|yǔ qí}{等|děng}{他|tā}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{你|nǐ}{自己|zì jǐ}{去|qù}{找|zhǎo}{他|tā}。
{与其|yǔ qí}{等|děng}{他|tā}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}，{还是|hái shi}{你|nǐ}{自己|zì jǐ}{去|qù}{找|zhǎo}{他|tā}。
{与其|yǔ qí}{等|děng}{他|tā}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}，{就|jiù}{你|nǐ}{自己|zì jǐ}{去|qù}{找|zhǎo}{他|tā}。
{与其|yǔ qí}{等|děng}{他|tā}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}，{你|nǐ}{还|hái}{不如|bù rú}{自己|zì jǐ}{去|qù}{找|zhǎo}{他|tā}。
questions.explanation: {与其|yǔ qí}…({还|hái}){不如|bù rú}: "rather than wait for him to call, you'd do better to go and find him yourself". {还|hái} or {倒|dào} often stands before {不如|bù rú}. {还是|hái shi}, {就|jiù} and {所以|suǒ yǐ} can't complete {与其|yǔ qí}.

questions.stem: What does the speaker mean? {与其|yǔ qí}{说|shuō}{他|tā}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{不如|bù rú}{说|shuō}{他|tā}{不|bù}{敢|gǎn}{去|qù}。
choices: He would rather go than stay at home.
He wants to go, but he isn't allowed to.
It isn't so much that he doesn't want to go as that he's afraid to.
He should go, because he isn't afraid.
questions.explanation: {与其|yǔ qí}{说|shuō} A，{不如|bù rú}{说|shuō} B corrects a description: "not so much A as B". The speaker replaces "doesn't want to" ({不|bù}{想|xiǎng}) with the real reason, "doesn't dare" ({不|bù}{敢|gǎn}). Nothing is said about permission or about staying at home.

questions.stem: Which word fits the gap? {这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{在|zài}___ {这|zhè}{部|bù}{新|xīn}{电影|diàn yǐng}。

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker telling the listener?

audio.text: 下午是正式的会见，你千万别迟到。朋友聚会晚到一会儿没关系，这个可不行。

choices: They will meet at the friends' party in the afternoon.
The party with friends has been cancelled.
Being a little late this afternoon won't matter.
Be on time: the afternoon meeting is a formal one.

questions.stem: Which is the natural way to say "These trousers are too loose"?

By the way, that restaurant you mentioned last time: where is it, exactly?" {还|hái}{行|xíng}{吧|ba} and {够|gòu}{花|huā} (enough to spend) avoid a figure; {对|duì}{了|le} (by the way) changes the subject, politely.

questions.stem: A sign on a shop door says {无人|wú rén}{超市|chāo shì}. What kind of shop is it?
choices: a supermarket with no staff, where you pay yourself
a supermarket that has closed down
a supermarket with nobody in it today

questions.explanation: {无|wú}- is the prefix "without": {无人|wú rén} is "unmanned, with no people (working)", as in {无人机|wú rén jī} (a drone). {无人|wú rén}{超市|chāo shì} is a shop with no staff: customers scan and pay by themselves. {超市|chāo shì} itself is a shortened word ({超级|chāo jí}{市场|shì chǎng}).

questions.stem: What is a {准妈妈|zhǔn mā ma}?

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Because it's windy and dry here all year round, the grass is getting sparser and sparser.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {听|tīng}{到|dào}{这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}，{大家|dà jiā}___ {安静|ān jìng}{了|le}{下来|xià lái}。 (When they heard the news, everyone fell silent at once.)
questions.explanation: {顿时|dùn shí} (at once: written) describes a situation that changes immediately because of what came before. {接连|jiē lián} is "one after another", {眼看|yǎn kàn} "about to; looking on helplessly", and {一阵|yí zhèn} a spell of something ({一|yí}{阵雨|zhèn yǔ}): none fits before {安静|ān jìng}{了|le}{下来|xià lái}.

{明天|míng tiān}{我|wǒ}{顿时|dùn shí}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}。

It can't be used for the future, for orders or for what someone decides to do: there, use {马上|mǎ shàng} or {立刻|lì kè} ({明天|míng tiān}{一早|yì zǎo}{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}, {你|nǐ}{马上|mǎ shàng}{过来|guò lái}, {我们|wǒ men}{马上|mǎ shàng}{出发|chū fā}{吧|ba}).

questions.stem: What does "{眼看|yǎn kàn}{就|jiù}{要|yào}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{赶快|gǎn kuài}{回去|huí qù}{吧|ba}。" mean?

We watched the rain, then went back.
It's about to rain: let's hurry back.
Look, it's raining: we can't go back.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这个|zhè ge}{月|yuè}，{南方|nán fāng}___ {下|xià}{了|le}{十|shí}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}{的|de}{大雨|dà yǔ}。 (This month it rained heavily in the south for more than ten days in a row.)
questions.explanation: {接连|jiē lián} (one after another, in a row) goes before the verb, often with a number of days or times: {接连|jiē lián}{下|xià}{了|le}{十|shí}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}. {顿时|dùn shí} is a sudden change, {赶忙|gǎn máng} is "hurriedly", and {一时|yì shí} is "for a moment".

questions.stem: How is 炸 read in "{气球|qì qiú}炸{了|le}，{把|bǎ}{孩子|hái zi}{吓了一跳|xià le yí tiào}。" (The balloon burst and gave the child a fright.)?

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这个|zhè ge}{地区|dì qū}{去年|qù nián}___ {了|le}{严重|yán zhòng}{的|de}{旱灾|hàn zāi}。 (This region suffered a severe drought last year.)

questions.stem: What length of year did the {授时历|Shòu shí lì} use?
questions.explanation: 365.2425 days (365 days 5 hours 49 minutes 12 seconds), about twenty-six seconds longer than the modern figure, and the same average year as the Gregorian calendar of 1582.

questions.stem: When did the {授时历|Shòu shí lì} come into use?
questions.explanation: It was finished in 1280 and used from 1281, early in the Yuan dynasty. 1582 is the Gregorian calendar; 1088 is Shen Kuo's book.

questions.stem: Why did a precise calendar matter so much in ancient China?
choices: because farming depended on knowing when to sow and harvest
because taxes were paid every day
because ships needed it to cross the sea
because people celebrated their birthdays on the solar terms

questions.stem: Why did a taller gnomon give a more precise year?

It could be used at night.

choices: a brick tower for measuring the sun's shadow, with a long stone ruler
a bronze statue of {郭守敬|Guō Shǒu jìng}

questions.explanation: The {观星台|Guān xīng tái}, built in 1276: a brick tower over nine metres high with a stone "ruler" over thirty metres long to its north. It is part of a UNESCO World Heritage site listed in 2010.
