questions.explanation: {原先|yuán xiān}{要|yào}{走|zǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{钟头|zhōng tóu} (it used to take two hours on foot: {钟头|zhōng tóu} is "hour"), {现在|xiàn zài}…{坐|zuò}{车|chē}{二十|èr shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le} (now twenty minutes by car).

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker mean?

audio.text: 当初要是听了妈妈的话，我也不会走这么多弯路。

choices: They are glad they ignored their mother.
Their mother took the wrong road.
They are lost on a winding road.
They wish they had listened to their mother back then.
questions.explanation: {当初|dāng chū}{要是|yào shi}{听|tīng}{了|le}{妈妈|mā ma}{的|de}{话|huà} (if I'd listened to Mum back then), {我|wǒ}{也|yě}{不|bú}{会|huì}{走|zǒu}{这么|zhè me}{多|duō}{弯|wān}{路|lù} (I wouldn't have taken so many detours): {走|zǒu}{弯|wān}{路|lù} is a figure for wasting time on wrong turns in life.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {遥远|yáo yuǎn} yáo yuǎn (distant): a rising tone, then a dipping one, 2+3.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {月光|yuè guāng} yuè guāng (moonlight): a falling tone, then a high level one, 4+1.

questions.stem: Which word fills the gap? {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}___ {大学|dà xué}{的|de}{时光|shí guāng}，{那|nà}{时候|shí hou}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}{到|dào}{现在|xiàn zài}{还|hái}{常|cháng}{联系|lián xì}。 (I look back fondly on my university days: I'm still in touch with friends from then.)
questions.explanation: {怀念|huái niàn} is for something gone that you remember fondly: {怀念|huái niàn}{大学|dà xué}{的|de}{时光|shí guāng}. {向往|xiàng wǎng} and {幻想|huàn xiǎng} look forward to or imagine something you don't have; {期望|qī wàng} is an expectation.

questions.stem: What is a {词牌|cí pái}?
choices: the name of a tune whose pattern of lines, characters, rhymes and tones a {词|cí} follows
questions.explanation: A {词牌|cí pái} such as 《{如梦令|Rú mèng lìng}》 names the tune and its pattern, not the subject: many poets wrote different poems to the same {词牌|cí pái}. Writing a {词|cí} is {填词|tián cí}, "filling in" the pattern.

questions.stem: Whom did Li Qingzhao marry in 1101, and what did the couple collect?
choices: {杜甫|Dù Fǔ}; poems by other poets
{赵明诚|Zhào Míng chéng}; old books, painting and calligraphy, and inscriptions on bronze and stone
questions.explanation: She married {赵明诚|Zhào Míng chéng} (Zhao Mingcheng) in 1101; they spent their money on {古书|gǔ shū}、{书画|shū huà}{和|hé}{金石|jīn shí} (old books, calligraphy and painting, inscriptions on bronze and stone).

questions.stem: What changed Li Qingzhao's life in 1127?
choices: The Northern Song capital, Kaifeng, fell to the Jin army, and the couple had to move south.
questions.explanation: In 1127 {开封|Kāi fēng}, the Northern Song capital, was taken by the {金|Jīn} (Jin) army; the war reached Shandong, their house was burned, and they went south. Zhao Mingcheng died in 1129.

questions.stem: How many characters does a 《{如梦令|Rú mèng lìng}》 have, and what is special about its fifth and sixth lines?
choices: 28; they rhyme with the first line
33; they are the same two characters said twice
questions.explanation: 《{如梦令|Rú mèng lìng}》 has 33 characters in lines of 6, 6, 5, 6, 2, 2 and 6: the fifth and sixth lines repeat two characters ({争渡|zhēng dù}，{争渡|zhēng dù} / {知否|zhī fǒu}，{知否|zhī fǒu}), a pause before the last line.

questions.stem: In Li Qingzhao's 《{如梦令|Rú mèng lìng}》 beginning {常记|cháng jì}{溪亭|xī tíng}{日暮|rì mù}，{沉醉|chén zuì}{不|bù}{知|zhī}{归路|guī lù}, what does {沉醉|chén zuì}{不|bù}{知|zhī}{归路|guī lù} say?
choices: She was afraid of the dark road.
She was so lost in pleasure she couldn't find the way home.
She knew the way home well.
questions.explanation: {沉醉|chén zuì} (deeply drunk, lost in pleasure) + {不|bù}{知|zhī}{归路|guī lù} (didn't know the way back: {归|guī} is "to return"). It's a happy memory of an outing at dusk.

questions.stem: In the same poem, what happens in the lines {误入|wù rù}{藕花|ǒu huā}{深处|shēn chù}。{争渡|zhēng dù}，{争渡|zhēng dù}，{惊起|jīng qǐ}{一滩|yì tān}{鸥鹭|ōu lù}？
choices: The boat sinks among the lotus flowers.
They catch a lot of fish.
They watch the birds sleeping quietly.
They stray deep among the lotus flowers, row hard to get out, and startle the waterbirds into flight.
questions.explanation: {误入|wù rù} (strayed in by mistake) {藕花|ǒu huā}{深处|shēn chù} (deep among the lotus flowers); {争渡|zhēng dù} (rowing hard); {惊起|jīng qǐ}{一滩|yì tān}{鸥鹭|ōu lù} (startled a sandbank of gulls and egrets into the air).

questions.stem: In 《{如梦令|Rú mèng lìng}》 ({昨|zuó}{夜|yè}{雨疏风骤|yǔ shū fēng zhòu}，{浓睡|nóng shuì}{不消残酒|bù xiāo cán jiǔ}。{试问|shì wèn}{卷帘人|juǎn lián rén}，{却道|què dào}{海棠|hǎi táng}{依旧|yī jiù}。{知否|zhī fǒu}，{知否|zhī fǒu}？{应是|yīng shì}{绿肥红瘦|lǜ féi hóng shòu}。), what does {却道|què dào}{海棠|hǎi táng}{依旧|yī jiù} tell us?
choices: The poet says the flowers have all fallen.
The crab-apple tree has been cut down.
The one rolling up the blind says the crab-apple blossom is just as before.
The poet goes out to look at the flowers.
questions.explanation: The poet asks the one rolling up the blind ({卷帘人|juǎn lián rén}), who answers that the {海棠|hǎi táng} (crab-apple) is {依旧|yī jiù}, just as before: lesson 25's word.

questions.stem: In the same poem, what does {绿肥红瘦|lǜ féi hóng shòu} mean after a night of wind and rain?
choices: The leaves are full and the flowers fewer.
The flowers are red and the leaves are dry.
Green wine is better than red.
Everyone in the house is ill.
questions.explanation: {绿|lǜ} for the leaves, {红|hóng} for the blossom; {肥|féi} (plump) and {瘦|shòu} (thin), words for bodies: the leaves are lush and the flowers have been stripped by the storm. The poet knows what the careless {依旧|yī jiù} missed.

questions.stem: How is 兴 read in 兴尽晚回舟 (our fun all spent, we turned the boat back late)?
questions.explanation: {兴尽|xìng jìn}: enjoyment exhausted, having had one's fill. {兴|xìng} xìng is "interest, enjoyment", as in {兴趣|xìng qù}; {兴|xīng} xīng is "to rise; excited", as in HSK 4's {兴奋|xīng fèn} and lesson 15's {兴起|xīng qǐ}; {高兴|gāo xìng} has xìng.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {海棠|hǎi táng} hǎi táng (crab-apple): a dipping tone, then a rising one, 3+2.

questions.stem: Listen to a line of a poem. Which one is it?

audio.text: 知否，知否？应是绿肥红瘦。

choices: {常记|cháng jì}{溪亭|xī tíng}{日暮|rì mù}
{知否|zhī fǒu}，{知否|zhī fǒu}？{应是|yīng shì}{绿肥红瘦|lǜ féi hóng shòu}
{争渡|zhēng dù}，{争渡|zhēng dù}，{惊起|jīng qǐ}{一滩|yì tān}{鸥鹭|ōu lù}
{试问|shì wèn}{卷帘人|juǎn lián rén}，{却道|què dào}{海棠|hǎi táng}{依旧|yī jiù}
questions.explanation: {知否|zhī fǒu}，{知否|zhī fǒu}？{应是|yīng shì}{绿肥红瘦|lǜ féi hóng shòu}: "Don't you know, don't you know? It must be green grown plump and red grown thin", the last lines of {昨|zuó}{夜|yè}{雨疏风骤|yǔ shū fēng zhòu}.

questions.stem: How do people often contrast Li Qingzhao's early and later {词|cí}?
choices: early: light and lively, about a girl's joys and love; later: full of sorrow and loneliness
questions.explanation: {前期|qián qī}{的|de}{词|cí}{轻松|qīng sōng}、{活泼|huó po}…{后期|hòu qī}{的|de}{词|cí}{则|zé}{充满|chōng mǎn}{了|le}{悲伤|bēi shāng}: the early work is light, the later work, after 1127 and her husband's death, sorrowful.

questions.stem: Why does Mulan go to war, in 《{木兰诗|Mù lán shī}》?
choices: Her father's name is on the call-up lists, he is old, and there is no older brother to go in his place.
She wants to become a general.
Her husband has been called up.
questions.explanation: The call-up lists all carry her father's name; he is old and the family has no older son, so Mulan goes in his place, dressed as a man ({女扮男装|nǚ bàn nán zhuāng}).

questions.stem: Where does the text of 《{木兰诗|Mù lán shī}》 that we read today come from?
choices: a novel by {曹雪芹|Cáo Xuě qín}
《{乐府诗集|Yuè fǔ Shī jí}》, a collection compiled by {郭茂倩|Guō Mào qiàn}
a Ming play by {徐渭|Xú Wèi}
questions.explanation: The text is preserved in 《{乐府诗集|Yuè fǔ Shī jí}》, compiled by {郭茂倩|Guō Mào qiàn}; another anthology, 《{文苑英华|Wén yuàn Yīng huá}》, treats it as a Tang poem. Most scholars see it as a folk song of the Northern Dynasties.

questions.stem: What do the opening lines {唧唧|jī jī}{复|fù}{唧唧|jī jī}，{木兰|Mù lán}{当户织|dāng hù zhī}。{不闻|bù wén}{机杼声|jī zhù shēng}，{唯闻|wéi wén}{女叹息|nǚ tàn xī} describe?
choices: the sound of horses at night
Mulan weaving at the door, but sighing instead of working the loom
questions.explanation: {当户织|dāng hù zhī}: weaving, facing the door; {不闻|bù wén}{机杼声|jī zhù shēng} (no sound of loom and shuttle is heard), {唯闻|wéi wén}{女叹息|nǚ tàn xī} (only the girl's sighs): she has stopped weaving, worried about the call-up.

questions.stem: In {不闻|bù wén}{机杼声|jī zhù shēng}，{唯闻|wéi wén}{女叹息|nǚ tàn xī}, what does {闻|wén} mean?
questions.explanation: In old Chinese {闻|wén} is "to hear" ({不闻|bù wén}, {唯闻|wéi wén}: doesn't hear, only hears). HSK 4's {闻|wén} "to smell" is the modern sense; {新闻|xīn wén} (news) keeps the old "heard".

questions.stem: What does Mulan ask for when the emperor offers her a high post and rewards?
choices: nothing but a fast horse to get home
questions.explanation: She refuses office ({木兰不用尚书郎|Mù lán bú yòng shàng shū láng}) and wants only a swift mount to take her home ({愿驰千里足|yuàn chí qiān lǐ zú}，{送儿还故乡|sòng ér huán gù xiāng}).

questions.stem: How long had Mulan's comrades fought beside her without knowing she was a woman?
questions.explanation: {同行十二年|tóng xíng shí èr nián}，{不知木兰是女郎|bù zhī Mù lán shì nǚ láng}: twelve years together, and they never knew Mulan was a girl.

questions.stem: What is the point of the closing lines {雄兔|xióng tù}{脚扑朔|jiǎo pū shuò}，{雌兔|cí tù}{眼迷离|yǎn mí lí}；{双兔|shuāng tù}{傍地走|bàng dì zǒu}，{安能|ān néng}{辨|biàn}{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{雄雌|xióng cí}？
choices: Male hares are faster than females.
When two hares run side by side, no one can tell the male from the female: so no one could tell Mulan was a woman.
questions.explanation: Apart, a buck and a doe can be told by their feet and eyes; running side by side close to the ground ({傍地走|bàng dì zǒu}), who can tell ({安能|ān néng}{辨|biàn}) which is which? The image is Mulan's own answer to her comrades' surprise.

questions.stem: Which modern idiom comes from the closing lines of 《{木兰诗|Mù lán shī}》?
questions.explanation: {扑朔迷离|pū shuò mí lí} (pū shuò mí lí), "so confusing you can't tell what's what", joins {扑朔|pū shuò} and {迷离|mí lí} from the hares. The other three are lesson 28's idioms.

questions.stem: Who gave Mulan the family name {花|huā} (Hua)?
choices: the Ming writer {徐渭|Xú Wèi}, in a play
questions.explanation: The ballad gives no family name. {徐渭|Xú Wèi} (Xu Wei, 1521–1593) turned the story into a two-act play and called her {花木兰|Huā Mù lán}, the name most later versions use.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {叹息|tàn xī} tàn xī (to sigh): a falling tone, then a high level one, 4+1.

questions.stem: Listen. Which part of the story is this?

audio.text: 战友们都大吃一惊，他们跟木兰一起打了十二年的仗，竟然不知道她是个姑娘。

choices: Mulan's comrades discovering she is a woman
questions.explanation: {战友|zhàn yǒu}{们|men}{都|dōu}{大吃一惊|dà chī yì jīng} (her comrades were astonished): after twelve years of fighting together they never knew she was a girl ({竟然|jìng rán}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{她|tā}{是|shì}{个|gè}{姑娘|gū niang}).

questions.stem: Which detail of the homecoming is in the ballad?
choices: A great feast at the emperor's palace.
Her old parents go out of the town to meet her, and her younger brother sharpens a knife for a feast.
She marries one of her comrades.
She opens a school for girls.
questions.explanation: In the ballad her old parents, holding each other up, go outside the town to meet her, her sister dresses up, and her younger brother sharpens his knife to kill a pig and sheep for the guests. The homecoming is all about her family; there is no palace feast or wedding.

questions.stem: Choose the word: ___ {数据|shù jù}{完全|wán quán}{准确|zhǔn què}，{也|yě}{不|bù}{足以|zú yǐ}{证明|zhèng míng}{这个|zhè ge}{结论|jié lùn}。 (Even if the data are completely accurate, that isn't enough to prove the conclusion.)
questions.explanation: {即便|jí biàn}…{也|yě} is the written "even if": the condition is granted, and {也|yě} says the result still stands. {因为|yīn wèi} would need {所以|suǒ yǐ}, {只要|zhǐ yào} (as long as) would need {就|jiù}, and {虽然|suī rán} (although) states a fact, not a supposition: the English is "even if".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {读者|dú zhě}{先|xiān}{是|shì}{质疑|zhì yí}{这|zhè}{篇|piān}{报道|bào dào}，___ {开始|kāi shǐ}{质疑|zhì yí}{整个|zhěng gè}{网站|wǎng zhàn}。 (Readers first questioned the report, and then went on to question the whole website.)
questions.explanation: {进而|jìn ér} (and then, going a step further) joins a first step to a further one. {然而|rán ér} would turn against the first clause, {否则|fǒu zé} is "otherwise" and {何况|hé kuàng} "let alone". Compare {从而|cóng ér}, which gives a result: {他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{练习|liàn xí}，{从而|cóng ér}{提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{水平|shuǐ píng}.

questions.stem: Which sentence uses {则|zé} correctly? (Northerners love noodles, whereas southerners prefer rice.)
choices: {则|zé}{北方|běi fāng}{人|rén}{爱|ài}{吃|chī}{面|miàn}{条|tiáo}，{南方|nán fāng}{人|rén}{更|gèng}{爱|ài}{吃|chī}{米饭|mǐ fàn}。
{北方|běi fāng}{人|rén}{爱|ài}{吃|chī}{面|miàn}{条|tiáo}，{则|zé}{南方|nán fāng}{人|rén}{更|gèng}{爱|ài}{吃|chī}{米饭|mǐ fàn}。
{北方|běi fāng}{人|rén}{爱|ài}{吃|chī}{面|miàn}{条|tiáo}，{南方|nán fāng}{人|rén}{则|zé}{更|gèng}{爱|ài}{吃|chī}{米饭|mǐ fàn}。
{北方|běi fāng}{人|rén}{则|zé}{爱|ài}{吃|chī}{面|miàn}{条|tiáo}，{南方|nán fāng}{人|rén}{更|gèng}{爱|ài}{吃|chī}{米饭|mǐ fàn}。
questions.explanation: Contrastive {则|zé} goes in the second half, after its subject: {南方|nán fāng}{人|rén}{则|zé}…. It never comes before the subject, and it doesn't mark the first half of the contrast.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā}___ {在意|zài yì}{别人|bié ren}{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ}。 (He doesn't care in the least what others think.)
questions.explanation: {毫不|háo bù} + a two-syllable verb or adjective: {毫不|háo bú}{在意|zài yì}. {毫无|háo wú} takes a noun ({毫无|háo wú}{兴趣|xìng qù}, {毫无|háo wú}{道理|dào li}), {不止|bù zhǐ} is "more than", and {无疑|wú yí} "undoubtedly", which doesn't give "not in the least".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {在|zài}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{帮助|bāng zhù}{下|xià}，{问题|wèn tí}{终于|zhōng yú}___ {解决|jiě jué}。 (With everyone's help, the problem was finally solved.)
questions.explanation: {得以|dé yǐ} (to be enabled to, manage to) says something got done thanks to what came before. {足以|zú yǐ} is "enough to" ({这|zhè}{足以|zú yǐ}{说明|shuō míng}{问题|wèn tí}), {从而|cóng ér} "thereby" (it gives a result: it can't stand before a verb like this), and {难以|nán yǐ} "hard to", which contradicts {终于|zhōng yú} and the help.

questions.stem: What does "{贵|guì}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{未必|wèi bì}{好|hǎo}。" mean?
questions.explanation: {未必|wèi bì} is "not necessarily": softer than {不|bù} and more formal than {不|bù}{一定|yí dìng}. It doubts a claim without denying it. "Good things needn't be expensive" turns the sentence round.

questions.stem: One friend asks: "{这样|zhè yàng}{下去|xià qù}，{公司|gōng sī}{会|huì}{倒闭|dǎo bì}{吗|ma}？" The other answers: "{不至于|bú zhì yú}。" What does the answer mean?
questions.explanation: {不至于|bú zhì yú} (won't go so far as to, isn't that bad) says the feared outcome is too extreme: things aren't that serious. It can stand alone as a reply.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: We can't judge a student's ability by marks alone.
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{不|bù}{能|néng}{只|zhǐ}{用|yòng}{分数|fēn shù}{来|lái}{衡量|héng liáng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{学生|xué sheng}{的|de}{能力|néng lì}。 {衡量|héng liáng} (to weigh up, judge by a standard) takes the thing judged as its object; {用|yòng}{分数|fēn shù}{来|lái} gives the means, and {只|zhǐ} goes before it. {忽略|hū lüè} (to overlook) doesn't fit.

questions.stem: {径|jìng} jìng ({途径|tú jìng}) has a sound part made of {又|yòu} over {工|gōng}. Which of these characters has the same part, and a similar sound?
questions.explanation: {={经|jīng} jīng has 纟 and the same {又|yòu}-over-{工|gōng} part as {径|jìng} jìng, as do {轻|qīng} qīng, {颈|jǐng} jǐng and {劲|jìn} jìn. {很|hěn}, {往|wǎng} and {街|jiē} share {径|jìng}'s radical 彳 (the "step" radical), not its sound part. (Traditional: 徑 and 經, with 巠.)=}

questions.stem: In an argued essay, which sentence is the concession?
choices: {当然|dāng rán}，{我|wǒ}{并|bìng}{不|bú}{是|shì}{说|shuō}{书|shū}{不|bú}{重要|zhòng yào}。
{我|wǒ}{认为|rèn wéi}，{这个|zhè ge}{结论|jié lùn}{未必|wèi bì}{站得住|zhàn de zhù}。
{首先|shǒu xiān}，{有|yǒu}{关联|guān lián}{不|bù}{等于|děng yú}{有|yǒu}{因果|yīn guǒ}。
{由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}，{我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{理性|lǐ xìng}{地|de}{看待|kàn dài}{数据|shù jù}。
questions.explanation: A concession grants something to the other side before keeping your view: {当然|dāng rán}，{我|wǒ}{并|bìng}{不|bú}{是|shì}{说|shuō}… (Of course, I'm not saying…). The others are the thesis ({我|wǒ}{认为|rèn wéi}…), a reason ({首先|shǒu xiān}…) and the conclusion ({由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}…).

questions.stem: Read: "{愿意|yuàn yì}{给|gěi}{孩子|hái zi}{买|mǎi}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{书|shū}{的|de}{家庭|jiā tíng}，{往往|wǎng wǎng}{也|yě}{更|gèng}{重视|zhòng shì}{教育|jiào yù}，{父母|fù mǔ}{更|gèng}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}{陪|péi}{孩子|hái zi}{读书|dú shū}、{聊|liáo}{天|tiān}。{已|yǐ}{有|yǒu}{研究者|yán jiū zhě}{做|zuò}{过|guo}{同类|tóng lèi}{调查|diào chá}，{在|zài}{排除|pái chú}{了|le}{家庭|jiā tíng}{收入|shōu rù}{等|děng}{因素|yīn sù}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{两|liǎng}{组|zǔ}{孩子|hái zi}{的|de}{差别|chā bié}{就|jiù}{变|biàn}{得|de}{十分|shí fēn}{微小|wēi xiǎo}{了|le}。" What does this suggest about the finding that children with more books read better?
choices: Books make no difference to children at all.
Families with more money buy fewer books.
Family factors, not the books, may explain much of the difference.
questions.explanation: Once family income and other factors were ruled out ({排除|pái chú}{了|le}…{因素|yīn sù}), the difference became tiny ({十分|shí fēn}{微小|wēi xiǎo}): the family environment may be doing the work. "No difference at all" goes too far: the passage says the difference became small, not that it vanished, and it says nothing about the figures being wrong.

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{认为|rèn wéi}，{这个|zhè ge}{结论|jié lùn}{看似|kàn sì}{有|yǒu}{道理|dào li}，{其实|qí shí}{未必|wèi bì}{站得住|zhàn de zhù}。{调查|diào chá}{本身|běn shēn}{并|bìng}{没有|méi yǒu}{错|cuò}，{问题|wèn tí}{在于|zài yú}{我们|wǒ men}{怎样|zěn yàng}{看待|kàn dài}{它|tā}{的|de}{结果|jié guǒ}。" What is the writer's attitude?
choices: The survey is wrong and should be ignored.
The survey is fine; the conclusion drawn from it is doubtful.
The writer has no view on it.
questions.explanation: {看似|kàn sì}{有|yǒu}{道理|dào li}，{其实|qí shí}{未必|wèi bì}{站得住|zhàn de zhù}: it looks reasonable but doesn't necessarily hold; {调查|diào chá}{本身|běn shēn}{并|bìng}{没有|méi yǒu}{错|cuò}: the survey itself isn't wrong. The writer doubts the reading of the survey, not the survey.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {前提|qián tí} (a premise): two rising tones, 2+2.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {核心|hé xīn} (the core): a rising tone, then a high level one, 2+1.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {这|zhè}{座|zuò}{城市|chéng shì}___ {现|xiàn}{出|chū}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}{新|xīn}{的|de}{面貌|miàn mào}。 (The city presents a new face.)
questions.explanation: {呈现|chéng xiàn} (to present, show). {={呈|chéng}: {口|kǒu} over {王|wáng}, 7 strokes, the same in both scripts; it's the sound part of {程|chéng} chéng.=}

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {读书|dú shū}{是|shì}{了解|liǎo jiě}{世界|shì jiè}{的|de}{重要|zhòng yào}{途|tú}___。 (Reading is an important way of learning about the world.)
questions.explanation: {途径|tú jìng} (a way, channel). {={径|jìng}: 彳 and {又|yòu} over {工|gōng}, 8 strokes. Traditional 徑 has 巠 on the right (10 strokes).=}

questions.stem: Listen: an editor speaks and a writer replies. What does the writer agree to do?

audio.text: 你这篇文章写得不错，可是第一句说这项调查毫无价值，是不是有点儿说过头了？——您说得对，我改成"这项调查的结论未必站得住"吧。

choices: make the first sentence less extreme
questions.explanation: The editor thinks {毫无|háo wú}{价值|jià zhí} (utterly worthless) goes too far ({说过头|shuō guò tóu}{了|le}); the writer replaces it with a softer claim, {结论|jié lùn}{未必|wèi bì}{站得住|zhàn de zhù} (the conclusion doesn't necessarily hold): {毫无|háo wú} becomes {未必|wèi bì}.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker suggest?

audio.text: 这些数据看似说明了问题，其实还不能排除其他原因。我建议先搜集更多的资料，再下结论。

questions.explanation: {先|xiān}{搜集|sōu jí}{更|gèng}{多|duō}{的|de}{资料|zī liào}，{再|zài}{下|xià}{结论|jié lùn}: first gather more material, then draw a conclusion. {看似|kàn sì}…{其实|qí shí} says the data only seem to settle it; other causes can't yet be ruled out ({不|bù}{能|néng}{排除|pái chú}{其他|qí tā}{原因|yuán yīn}).

questions.stem: Listen. What surprised everyone?

audio.text: 谁也没料到，这位新来的研究员只用了一个月，就把这个难题解决了。

choices: that the problem was never solved
that the researcher left after a month
how quickly a newcomer solved a hard problem
questions.explanation: {谁|shéi}{也|yě}{没|méi}{料|liào}{到|dào}: nobody expected; {只|zhǐ}{用|yòng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{就|jiù}…{解决|jiě jué}{了|le}: solved it in only a month. {料|liào} (liào) is "to expect"; {难题|nán tí} is a hard problem.

questions.stem: Listen to the announcement. What happens if it rains tomorrow?

audio.text: 即便明天下雨，比赛也照常进行，请大家按时到场。

choices: The match goes ahead as usual.
The match is put off to another day.
questions.explanation: {即便|jí biàn}…{也|yě} (even if): {即便|jí biàn}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{比赛|bǐ sài}{也|yě}{照|zhào}{常|cháng}{进行|jìn xíng}: even if it rains, the match goes ahead as usual ({照|zhào}{常|cháng}, as usual). Nothing is said about moving it indoors.

questions.stem: Which sentence belongs in a museum's printed notice?
choices: {里面|lǐ miàn}{千万|qiān wàn}{别|bié}{抽|chōu}{烟|yān}{啊|a}！
{你们|nǐ men}{别|bié}{在|zài}{里面|lǐ miàn}{抽|chōu}{烟|yān}{吧|ba}。
questions.explanation: {馆|guǎn}{内|nèi}{严禁|yán jìn}{吸|xī}{烟|yān} is notice language: {馆|guǎn}{内|nèi} (in the museum), {严禁|yán jìn} (strictly forbidden), no particles. The others are things you'd say: {千万|qiān wàn}{别|bié}…{啊|a}, {可|kě}{不行|bù xíng}, {别|bié}…{吧|ba} are spoken.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {请|qǐng}{保管|bǎo guǎn}{好|hǎo}{贵重|guì zhòng}{物品|wù pǐn}，___ {丢失|diū shī}。 (Please look after your valuables so that they aren't lost.)
questions.explanation: {以免|yǐ miǎn} (so as not to) introduces what you want to avoid: {以免|yǐ miǎn}{丢失|diū shī}. {以便|yǐ biàn} (so that) introduces what you want to make possible, {因此|yīn cǐ} gives a result, and {为了|wèi le}{丢失|diū shī} would make losing them the aim.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {请|qǐng}{提前|tí qián}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{到|dào}{场|chǎng}，___ {工作|gōng zuò}{人员|rén yuán}{安排|ān pái}{座位|zuò wèi}。 (Please arrive ten minutes early so that staff can seat you.)
questions.explanation: {以便|yǐ biàn} (so that, in order to) starts the second clause with the purpose: what arriving early makes possible. {以免|yǐ miǎn} would mean "so that the staff don't seat you", {于是|yú shì} "and so (then)", {何况|hé kuàng} "let alone".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā}___ {成功|chéng gōng}，{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}{从来|cóng lái}{不|bú}{放弃|fàng qì}。 (The reason he succeeded is that he never gave up.)
questions.explanation: {之所以|zhī suǒ yǐ}…{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi} puts the result first and then its cause: {他|tā}{之所以|zhī suǒ yǐ}{成功|chéng gōng}，{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}…. {因为|yīn wèi} and {由于|yóu yú} introduce a cause, not a result, and {所以|suǒ yǐ} can't come before {是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {报名|bào míng}{明天|míng tiān}___。 (Registration closes tomorrow.)
questions.explanation: {截止|jié zhǐ} (to close, stop) can end the sentence: {明天|míng tiān}{截止|jié zhǐ}. {截至|jié zhì} (up to, as of) needs a date or time after it ({截至|jié zhì}{十|shí}{月|yuè}{底|dǐ}, {已|yǐ}{有|yǒu}…). {开头|kāi tóu} is "to begin", and {限于|xiàn yú} (to be limited to) needs an object.

questions.stem: Which phrase uses the written {该|gāi} (the said, this) correctly?
questions.explanation: The written {该|gāi} goes straight before the noun, with no number or measure word: {该|gāi}{公司|gōng sī}, {该|gāi}{产品|chǎn pǐn}, {该|gāi}{展览|zhǎn lǎn}. It points back to something just mentioned.

questions.stem: Which sentence uses {加以|jiā yǐ} correctly?
choices: {我们|wǒ men}{必须|bì xū}{研究|yán jiū}{加以|jiā yǐ}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}。
{我们|wǒ men}{必须|bì xū}{加以|jiā yǐ}{研究|yán jiū}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}。
{对|duì}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}，{我们|wǒ men}{必须|bì xū}{加以|jiā yǐ}{研究|yán jiū}。
{对|duì}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}，{我们|wǒ men}{必须|bì xū}{加以|jiā yǐ}{研究|yán jiū}{了|le}{它|tā}。
questions.explanation: {加以|jiā yǐ} takes a two-syllable verb as its object, and the thing acted on goes before it, usually with {对|duì}: {对|duì}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{加以|jiā yǐ}{研究|yán jiū}. It can't take a further object after the verb, and takes no {了|le}.

questions.stem: Listen to the announcement. Which of these may visitors do?

audio.text: 馆内严禁吸烟，未经许可不得拍照，请勿触摸展品。

choices: walk round and look at the exhibits
questions.explanation: {严禁|yán jìn}{吸|xī}{烟|yān} (smoking strictly forbidden), {未经|wèi jīng}{许可|xǔ kě}{不得|bù dé}{拍照|pāi zhào} (no photos without permission), {请勿|qǐng wù}{触摸|chù mō}{展品|zhǎn pǐn} (please don't touch the exhibits): looking is the only thing left.

questions.stem: {={叙|xù} ({叙述|xù shù}, to narrate)=} is written {+{叙|xù}+} in traditional characters. What changes?
choices: {={又|yòu} on the right becomes 攵=}
questions.explanation: {={叙|xù} has {余|yú} and {又|yòu} (9 strokes); traditional 敘 keeps {余|yú} and has 攵 on the right (11 strokes in the tracing data).=}

questions.stem: Listen. When is the meeting now?

audio.text: 会议原来定在十月上旬，因为有几位专家来不了，现在推迟到中旬了。

questions.explanation: {上旬|shàng xún} is the first ten days of a month, {中旬|zhōng xún} the middle ten, {下旬|xià xún} the last ten. It was set for early October ({原来|yuán lái}{定|dìng}{在|zài}{十|shí}{月|yuè}{上旬|shàng xún}) and has been put off to mid-October ({推迟|tuī chí}{到|dào}{中旬|zhōng xún}).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: The revised edition of this dictionary will be officially published all over the country in early March next year.
questions.explanation: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{词典|cí diǎn}{的|de}{修订|xiū dìng}{版|bǎn}{将|jiāng}{于|yú}{明年|míng nián}{三|sān}{月|yuè}{上旬|shàng xún}{在|zài}{全|quán}{国|guó}{各地|gè dì}{正式|zhèng shì}{出版|chū bǎn}。 {将|jiāng}{于|yú} + time (written "will, on/in"), then the place with {在|zài}, then the verb with {正式|zhèng shì} (officially) before it ({正式|zhèng shì} can also come before {在|zài}…). {修订|xiū dìng}{版|bǎn} is a revised edition.

questions.stem: Read: "{观众|guān zhòng}{入场|rù chǎng}{时|shí}{须|xū}{出示|chū shì}{预约|yù yuē}{信息|xìn xī}{和|hé}{本人|běn rén}{有效|yǒu xiào}{证件|zhèng jiàn}。{未经|wèi jīng}{预约|yù yuē}{者|zhě}{一律|yí lǜ}{不得|bù dé}{入场|rù chǎng}。{六|liù}{岁|suì}{以下|yǐ xià}{儿童|ér tóng}{须|xū}{由|yóu}{成人|chéng rén}{陪同|péi tóng}。" Who will not be let in?
choices: a visitor who has booked and shows an identity card
an eight-year-old with a booking, and her mother
a five-year-old who has a booking, with a parent
questions.explanation: {未经|wèi jīng}{预约|yù yuē}{者|zhě}{一律|yí lǜ}{不得|bù dé}{入场|rù chǎng}: no one without a booking is admitted, without exception. Children under six need an adult with them, which the five-year-old has; the others have booked.

questions.stem: Read: "{部分|bù fen}{书画|shū huà}{作品|zuò pǐn}{对|duì}{光线|guāng xiàn}{极为|jí wéi}{敏感|mǐn gǎn}，{展厅|zhǎn tīng}{内|nèi}{光线|guāng xiàn}{较为|jiào wéi}{昏暗|hūn àn}，{观众|guān zhòng}{不宜|bù yí}{在|zài}{展厅|zhǎn tīng}{内|nèi}{长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān}{停留|tíng liú}。" Why are the rooms dim?
choices: Some works are very sensitive to light.
questions.explanation: {对|duì}{光线|guāng xiàn}{极为|jí wéi}{敏感|mǐn gǎn}: extremely sensitive to light, so the rooms are rather dim ({较为|jiào wéi}{昏暗|hūn àn}) and visitors shouldn't stay long ({不宜|bù yí}…{长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān}{停留|tíng liú}). {极为|jí wéi} and {较为|jiào wéi} are the written {非常|fēi cháng} and {比较|bǐ jiào}.

questions.stem: Which word is the written partner of {没有|méi yǒu} in "{他|tā}{没有|méi yǒu}{参加|cān jiā}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{会议|huì yì}"?
questions.explanation: {未|wèi} is the written "did not, have not": {他|tā}{未|wèi}{参加|cān jiā}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{会议|huì yì}. {非|fēi} is "is not" (written {不|bú}{是|shì}), {无|wú} "have no" (written {没有|méi yǒu} + noun), and {勿|wù} "do not" in requests ({请勿|qǐng wù}{吸|xī}{烟|yān}).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {书籍|shū jí} (books, written): a high level tone, then a rising one, 1+2.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {目录|mù lù} (a table of contents): two falling tones, 4+4.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {他|tā}{把|bǎ}{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}{的|de}{要点|yào diǎn}___ {在|zài}{本子|běn zi}{上|shàng}。 (He copied the teacher's main points into his notebook.)
questions.explanation: {抄|chāo} (to copy by hand), as in {抄写|chāo xiě}. {={抄|chāo}: 扌 (hand) and {少|shǎo}, which gives the -ao of {抄|chāo} chāo, {炒|chǎo} chǎo and {吵|chǎo} chǎo; 7 strokes, the same in both scripts.=}

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {展览|zhǎn lǎn}{将|jiāng}{于|yú}{十二|shí èr}{月|yuè}{上|shàng}___ {结束|jié shù}。 (The exhibition will close in early December.)
questions.explanation: {上旬|shàng xún} (the first ten days of a month). {={旬|xún}: 勹 round {日|rì} (a day), 6 strokes, the same in both scripts.=}

questions.stem: Listen to the announcement at the airport. What will happen about the departure time?

audio.text: 各位旅客请注意，由于天气原因，本次航班推迟起飞，具体起飞时间另行通知，请您在候机厅耐心等候。

questions.explanation: {推迟|tuī chí}{起飞|qǐ fēi} (the take-off is delayed); {具体|jù tǐ}{起飞|qǐ fēi}{时间|shí jiān}{另行|lìng xíng}{通知|tōng zhī}: the exact time will be announced separately. {另行|lìng xíng} (separately, later) is notice language, like {另行|lìng xíng}{公告|gōng gào}.

questions.stem: Listen: a museum guide tells a friend about an exhibition. What do visitors have to do?

audio.text: 跟你说，我们馆下个月有个展览，不要钱，就是要在网上预约，没约的人进不去。

choices: buy a ticket at the door
questions.explanation: {不要|bú yào}{钱|qián} (it's free), {就是|jiù shì}{要|yào}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{预约|yù yuē} (you just have to book online), {没|méi}{约|yuē}{的|de}{人|rén}{进|jìn}{不|bu}{去|qù} (people who haven't booked can't get in). The written notice says the same thing as {须|xū}{网上|wǎng shàng}{预约|yù yuē}，{未经|wèi jīng}{预约|yù yuē}{者|zhě}{一律|yí lǜ}{不得|bù dé}{入场|rù chǎng}.

questions.stem: Choose the idiom: {节日|jié rì}{期间|qī jiān}，{公园|gōng yuán}{里|lǐ}___。 (During the holiday the park is packed with people.)
questions.explanation: {人山人海|rén shān rén hǎi} (a sea of people) works as a predicate for a crowded place. {成千上万|chéng qiān shàng wàn} needs a noun after it ({成千上万|chéng qiān shàng wàn}{的|de}{游客|yóu kè}), {千家万户|qiān jiā wàn hù} is "every household", and {一模一样|yì mú yí yàng} "exactly alike".

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {众所周知|zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī}，{健康|jiàn kāng}{非常|fēi cháng}{至关重要|zhì guān zhòng yào}。
{很|hěn}{众所周知|zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī}，{健康|jiàn kāng}{至关重要|zhì guān zhòng yào}。
{众所周知|zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī}，{健康|jiàn kāng}{很|hěn}{至关重要|zhì guān zhòng yào}。
{众所周知|zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī}，{健康|jiàn kāng}{至关重要|zhì guān zhòng yào}。
questions.explanation: An idiom has its degree built in: no {很|hěn}, {非常|fēi cháng} or {十分|shí fēn} before it. {至|zhì}{关|guān} already means "extremely", and {众所周知|zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī} starts the sentence on its own, with a comma.

questions.stem: Which sentence uses {大吃一惊|dà chī yì jīng} correctly?
choices: {这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}{大吃一惊|dà chī yì jīng}{了|le}{我|wǒ}。
{我|wǒ}{大吃一惊|dà chī yì jīng}{这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}。
{这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{大吃一惊|dà chī yì jīng}。
{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{大吃一惊|dà chī yì jīng}。
questions.explanation: {大吃一惊|dà chī yì jīng} takes no object: put the cause first with {让|ràng} ({这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{大吃一惊|dà chī yì jīng}) or before it in a clause ({听|tīng}{到|dào}{这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}，{我|wǒ}{大吃一惊|dà chī yì jīng}). Like any idiom, it takes no {很|hěn}.

questions.stem: Choose the idiom: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{新|xīn}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}___！ (I wish you every success in your new job!)
questions.explanation: {一帆风顺|yì fān fēng shùn} (one sail, the wind fair: plain sailing) is a common wish: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一帆风顺|yì fān fēng shùn}. The others mean a crowd, a great shock and talking to oneself.

questions.stem: Which is the pinyin of 一模一样 (exactly alike)?
questions.explanation: {模|mú} is mú here, as in {模样|mú yàng} (not the mó of {模仿|mó fǎng} and {模特儿|mó tèr}). The first {一|yī} is yì before a second tone, the second yí before a fourth.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the restaurant like at weekends?

audio.text: 这家饭馆每到周末都人山人海，要是不提前预约，至少要等一个小时。

questions.explanation: {人山人海|rén shān rén hǎi} (a sea of people): it's packed, so without booking you wait at least an hour ({至少|zhì shǎo}{要|yào}{等|děng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}).

questions.stem: {人山人海|rén shān rén hǎi} is built of two parallel halves that repeat one character ({人|rén}…{人|rén}…). Which idiom is built the same way?
questions.explanation: {自言自语|zì yán zì yǔ} repeats {自|zì} in two parallel halves: {自|zì}{言|yán} / {自|zì}{语|yǔ}, like {人|rén}{山|shān} / {人|rén}{海|hǎi} (and {多才多艺|duō cái duō yì}). {一帆风顺|yì fān fēng shùn} is "one sail" + "the wind is fair", {众所周知|zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī} uses {所|suǒ} + verb, and {至关重要|zhì guān zhòng yào} is adverb + adjective.

questions.stem: Listen: one person compliments another. Where did the second speaker grow up?

audio.text: 你的英语说得跟美国人一模一样，你是在国外长大的吗？——不是，我是在北京长大的，不过我妈妈是英语老师。

questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{长大|zhǎng dà}{的|de}: in Beijing. {一模一样|yì mú yí yàng} (exactly alike) is the compliment; the explanation is that the speaker's mother teaches English.

questions.stem: Which of these loanwords copies the sound of the foreign word?
questions.explanation: {咖啡|kā fēi} kā fēi copies the sound of "coffee". {电脑|diàn nǎo} (electric brain) and {热狗|rè gǒu} (hot dog) translate the meaning, and {手机|shǒu jī} (hand machine) is a Chinese coinage.

questions.stem: {={歪|wāi} (crooked) is made of two characters, one on top of the other. Which two?=}
questions.explanation: {={歪|wāi} is {不|bù} over {正|zhèng}: what is "not straight" is crooked (9 strokes, the same in both scripts). {止|zhǐ} is only the bottom part of {正|zhèng}.=}

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Reading aloud for half an hour every morning is vital for getting the tones of Putonghua right.
questions.explanation: {坚持|jiān chí}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{朗读|lǎng dú}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{对|duì}{练|liàn}{好|hǎo}{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}{的|de}{声调|shēng diào}{至关重要|zhì guān zhòng yào}。 The whole activity is the subject; {对|duì}… goes before {至关重要|zhì guān zhòng yào}, which takes no {很|hěn}. {每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang} can also come before {坚持|jiān chí}.

questions.stem: Put five of the six sentences into the gaps: {我|wǒ}{出生|chū shēng}{在|zài}{南方|nán fāng}{的|de}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{城|chéng}，{从小|cóng xiǎo}{说|shuō}{方言|fāng yán}。（1）{十八|shí bā}{岁|suì}{那|nà}{年|nián}，{我|wǒ}{到|dào}{北京|Běi jīng}{上|shàng}{大学|dà xué}，{一开口|yì kāi kǒu}{同学|tóng xué}{们|men}{就|jiù}{笑|xiào}。（2）{于是|yú shì}{我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{到|dào}{操场|cāo chǎng}{朗读|lǎng dú}{课文|kè wén}，{还|hái}{把|bǎ}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{声音|shēng yīn}{录|lù}{下来|xià lái}，{跟|gēn}{广播|guǎng bō}{一|yí}{句|jù}{一|yí}{句|jù}{地|de}{比|bǐ}。（3）{为了|wèi le}{练|liàn}{好|hǎo}{它们|tā men}，{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{容易|róng yì}{说|shuō}{错|cuò}{的|de}{词|cí}{抄|chāo}{在|zài}{卡片|kǎ piàn}{上|shàng}，{走|zǒu}{到|dào}{哪儿|nǎr}{都|dōu}{带|dài}{着|zhe}。（4）{现在|xiàn zài}，{我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{用|yòng}{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}{工作|gōng zuò}，{回|huí}{到|dào}{老家|lǎo jiā}{又|yòu}{说|shuō}{方言|fāng yán}。（5） — A. {最|zuì}{难|nán}{的|de}{是|shì}"zh、ch、sh"{和|hé}"z、c、s"，{在|zài}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{方言|fāng yán}{里|lǐ}{这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{组|zǔ}{音|yīn}{没有|méi yǒu}{区别|qū bié}。 B. {小时候|xiǎo shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{以为|yǐ wéi}{全|quán}{世界|shì jiè}{的|de}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{这样|zhè yàng}{说话|shuō huà}{的|de}。 C. {我|wǒ}{下|xià}{决心|jué xīn}{要|yào}{把|bǎ}{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}。 D. {一|yì}{年|nián}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{同学|tóng xué}{们|men}{已经|yǐ jīng}{听|tīng}{不|bu}{出|chū}{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{哪里|nǎ lǐ}{人|rén}{了|le}。 E. {在|zài}{我|wǒ}{看来|kàn lái}，{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}{和|hé}{方言|fāng yán}{就|jiù}{像|xiàng}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{两|liǎng}{种|zhǒng}{母语|mǔ yǔ}。 F. {方言|fāng yán}{的|de}{声调|shēng diào}{比|bǐ}{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}{多|duō}，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{我|wǒ}{学|xué}{声调|shēng diào}{特别|tè bié}{快|kuài}。
questions.explanation: (1) B continues the childhood. (2) C, the decision, comes before {于是|yú shì} (and so he practised). (3) A names the hardest sounds, which {它们|tā men} in the next sentence points back to. (4) D gives the result a year later. (5) E is the view that closes the text. F is left over: learning tones fast contradicts the struggle the text describes, and (3) needs the hard sounds of A for {它们|tā men} (them) to point back to.

questions.stem: Read: "{在|zài}{我|wǒ}{看来|kàn lái}，{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}{和|hé}{方言|fāng yán}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{矛盾|máo dùn}，{就|jiù}{像|xiàng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{可以|kě yǐ}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{种|zhǒng}{母语|mǔ yǔ}。{前者|qián zhě}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{走|zǒu}{出|chū}{了|le}{家乡|jiā xiāng}，{后者|hòu zhě}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{记|jì}{住|zhù}{了|le}{自己|zì jǐ}{从|cóng}{哪里|nǎ lǐ}{来|lái}。" What helped the writer leave home?
questions.explanation: {前者|qián zhě} (the former) is the first of the two just named, {普通话|pǔ tōng huà}; {后者|hòu zhě} (the latter) is the dialect, which reminds him where he comes from.

questions.stem: Read: "{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{方言|fāng yán}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{词|cí}，{形容|xíng róng}{雨|yǔ}{后|hòu}{空气|kōng qì}{又|yòu}{湿|shī}{又|yòu}{凉|liáng}、{让|ràng}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{舒服|shū fu}{的|de}{感觉|gǎn jué}，{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}{里|lǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{也|yě}{找|zhǎo}{不|bu}{到|dào}{一|yí}{个|gè}{恰当|qià dàng}{的|de}{词|cí}{来|lái}{翻译|fān yì}。" What point is the writer making?
choices: Putonghua has more words than any dialect.
A dialect can express things Putonghua has no word for.
Dialect words are easy to translate.
questions.explanation: {怎么|zěn me}{也|yě}{找|zhǎo}{不|bu}{到|dào}{一|yí}{个|gè}{恰当|qià dàng}{的|de}{词|cí}{来|lái}{翻译|fān yì}: however hard he tries, he can't find a suitable word to translate it. The example supports his view that dialects hold things Putonghua can't replace.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {方言|fāng yán} (a dialect): a high level tone, then a rising one, 1+2.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {符号|fú hào} (a symbol): a rising tone, then a falling one, 2+4.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{巧|qiǎo}___ {的|de}{办法|bàn fǎ}。 (That's a very ingenious method.)
questions.explanation: {巧妙|qiǎo miào} (ingenious). {={妙|miào}: {女|nǚ} and {少|shǎo}, 7 strokes, the same in both scripts; {少|shǎo} doesn't give the sound here.=}

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一|yī}___ {风|fēng}{顺|shùn}！ (I wish you plain sailing!)
questions.explanation: {一帆风顺|yì fān fēng shùn} (one sail, the wind fair). {={帆|fān}: {巾|jīn} (cloth) and {凡|fán} fán, which gives the sound; 6 strokes, the same in both scripts.=}

questions.stem: Listen. How did the speaker improve their Putonghua?

audio.text: 我刚来北京的时候，说"是"，别人总是听成"四"。后来我每天朗读半个小时，现在已经没有人听得出我是南方人了。

choices: by moving back to the south
questions.explanation: {每|měi}{天|tiān}{朗读|lǎng dú}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}: reading aloud for half an hour a day. Now nobody can tell they're from the south ({没有|méi yǒu}{人|rén}{听|tīng}{得|de}{出|chū}{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{南方|nán fāng}{人|rén}).

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker advise?

audio.text: 众所周知，学语言入门不难，难的是坚持。所以我建议大家每天练习一点儿，不要一下子学太多。

choices: learning as much as possible at once
giving up if it gets hard
questions.explanation: {每|měi}{天|tiān}{练习|liàn xí}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}，{不要|bú yào}{一下|yí xià}{子|zi}{学|xué}{太|tài}{多|duō}: practise a little every day, not too much at once, because the hard part is keeping going ({难|nán}{的|de}{是|shì}{坚持|jiān chí}).

questions.stem: Choose the word: {甲|jiǎ}{队|duì}{以|yǐ}{二|èr}{比|bǐ}{三|sān}___ {给|gěi}{了|le}{乙|yǐ}{队|duì}。 (Team A lost 2–3 to Team B.)
questions.explanation: {败|bài}{给|gěi} (to lose to) is written for {输|shū}{给|gěi}. {击败|jī bài} and {战胜|zhàn shèng} mean "to defeat" and take the loser as their object ({甲|jiǎ}{队|duì}{击败|jī bài}{了|le}{乙|yǐ}{队|duì}), and {夺取|duó qǔ} is "to win, capture" (a title or a medal).

questions.stem: Which verb goes with {台球|tái qiú} (billiards)?
questions.explanation: {打|dǎ} goes with games played with the hands, a cue or a bat: {打|dǎ}{台球|tái qiú}, {打|dǎ}{棒球|bàng qiú}, {打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}. {下|xià} is for board games ({下|xià}{围棋|wéi qí}, {下|xià}{象棋|xiàng qí}), {踢|tī} for football, and {跳|tiào} for jumping ({跳水|tiào shuǐ}, {跳绳|tiào shéng}).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {金牌|jīn pái} (a gold medal): a high level tone, then a rising one, 1+2.

questions.stem: After a game of chess, a friend says: "{好|hǎo}{你|nǐ}{个|gè}{大卫|Dà wèi}，{居然|jū rán}{赢|yíng}{了|le}{我|wǒ}！" How does the speaker feel?
questions.explanation: {好|hǎo}{你|nǐ}{个|gè} X is a mock-annoyed exclamation when someone has surprised you; with {居然|jū rán} (unexpectedly) it's teasing surprise, between friends. It's spoken only: never in formal praise.

questions.stem: What does "{你|nǐ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{新|xīn}{来|lái}{的|de}，{倒|dào}{管|guǎn}{到|dào}{我|wǒ}{头|tóu}{上来|shàng lái}{了|le}？" mean?
choices: You're new, so I'll look after you.
You've only just arrived, and you're telling me what to do?
You've just arrived: put your hat on.
You're new, so ask me what to do.
questions.explanation: X {到|dào} Y {头|tóu}{上来|shàng lái}{了|le} says something unwelcome has reached even Y: {管|guǎn}{到|dào}{我|wǒ}{头|tóu}{上来|shàng lái}{了|le}, now you're even bossing me about. {倒|dào} adds "contrary to what you'd expect" from a newcomer.

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {我们|wǒ men}{下|xià}{一|yī}___ {棋|qí}{吧|ba}。 (Let's play a game of chess.)
questions.explanation: {局|jú} is a game or a set: {一|yì}{局|jú}{棋|qí}, {三|sān}{局|jú}{两|liǎng}{胜|shèng} (best of three). {轮|lún} is a round of a competition ({第|dì}{一|yī}{轮|lún}), {顿|dùn} is for meals, and {趟|tàng} for trips.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {他|tā}{一口气|yì kǒu qì}{跑|pǎo}{了|le}{十|shí}{公里|gōng lǐ}。
{他|tā}{很|hěn}{一口气|yì kǒu qì}{跑|pǎo}{了|le}{十|shí}{公里|gōng lǐ}。
{他|tā}{跑|pǎo}{了|le}{一口气|yì kǒu qì}{十|shí}{公里|gōng lǐ}。
{他|tā}{一口气|yì kǒu qì}{地|de}{很|hěn}{跑|pǎo}{了|le}{十|shí}{公里|gōng lǐ}。
questions.explanation: {一口气|yì kǒu qì} (in one breath, without stopping) is an adverbial by itself, before the verb: {一口气|yì kǒu qì}{跑|pǎo}{了|le}{十|shí}{公里|gōng lǐ}. It takes no {很|hěn} and no {地|de}, and can't go between the verb and the distance.

questions.stem: In "{他|tā}{一|yì}{枪|qiāng}{就|jiù}{打中|dǎ zhòng}{了|le}{目标|mù biāo}。", what does 中 mean, and how is it read?
questions.explanation: {打中|dǎ zhòng} is "to hit": {中|zhòng} is zhòng here, as in {射中|shè zhòng}, {猜中|cāi zhòng} and {中奖|zhòng jiǎng}. zhōng is the middle ({中间|zhōng jiān}, {比赛|bǐ sài}{中|zhōng}).

questions.stem: {={夺|duó} (to seize) is {大|dà} over {寸|cùn}.=} What does its traditional form, {+{夺|duó}+}, add?
choices: nothing: the two are the same
questions.explanation: {=Traditional 奪 has 隹 (a short-tailed bird) between {大|dà} and {寸|cùn} (14 strokes; simplified {夺|duó}, 6): a hand ({寸|cùn}) holding a bird.=}

questions.stem: Read: "{体操|tǐ cāo}{对|duì}{身体|shēn tǐ}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú}{极为|jí wéi}{严格|yán gé}，{个子|gè zi}{一|yì}{高|gāo}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{动作|dòng zuò}{就|jiù}{难以|nán yǐ}{完成|wán chéng}。{十二|shí èr}{岁|suì}{时|shí}，{她|tā}{长|zhǎng}{高|gāo}{了|le}{十|shí}{几|jǐ}{厘米|lí mǐ}，{在|zài}{一|yí}{次|cì}{选拔|xuǎn bá}{中|zhōng}{被|bèi}{淘汰|táo tài}{了|le}。" Why was she eliminated?
choices: She had grown too tall for many moves.
questions.explanation: {个子|gè zi}{一|yì}{高|gāo}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{动作|dòng zuò}{就|jiù}{难以|nán yǐ}{完成|wán chéng}: once you grow tall, many moves become hard; she grew more than ten centimetres at twelve. Her injury came later, in diving.

questions.stem: Read: a diver sprains her foot, and her coach says: "{受伤|shòu shāng}{不|bù}{可怕|kě pà}，{可怕|kě pà}{的|de}{是|shì}{你|nǐ}{自己|zì jǐ}{先|xiān}{放弃|fàng qì}。" What does the coach mean?
choices: She should be afraid of getting hurt.
Giving up on herself would be worse than the injury.
questions.explanation: The injury isn't what's frightening ({不|bù}{可怕|kě pà}); what's frightening is giving up on yourself first ({自己|zì jǐ}{先|xiān}{放弃|fàng qì}).

questions.stem: A diver who was dropped from gymnastics as a child and later won a medal says: "{被|bèi}{淘汰|táo tài}{不|bù}{等于|děng yú}{失败|shī bài}。{换|huàn}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}，{也许|yě xǔ}{就是|jiù shì}{新|xīn}{的|de}{起点|qǐ diǎn}。" What is her message?
choices: Being eliminated can be the start of something new.
questions.explanation: {被|bèi}{淘汰|táo tài}{不|bù}{等于|děng yú}{失败|shī bài}: being eliminated isn't the same as failing; {换|huàn}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}…{新|xīn}{的|de}{起点|qǐ diǎn}: a different road may be a new starting point, as diving was for her.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: In the last round of the competition, she chose a very difficult dive.
questions.explanation: {她|tā}{在|zài}{比赛|bǐ sài}{的|de}{最后|zuì hòu}{一|yì}{轮|lún}{选择|xuǎn zé}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{难度|nán dù}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{动作|dòng zuò}。 The time phrase {在|zài}…{最后|zuì hòu}{一|yì}{轮|lún} goes after the subject, or before it at the start. {轮|lún} is the round of a competition; {局|jú} is a game (of chess, of table tennis).

questions.stem: In a formal notice of a company chess tournament, which line comes last, before the name and the date?
choices: {为|wèi}{丰富|fēng fù}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{业余|yè yú}{生活|shēng huó}，{公司|gōng sī}{定于|dìng yú}{十一|shí yī}{月|yuè}{中旬|zhōng xún}{举办|jǔ bàn}{围棋|wéi qí}{比赛|bǐ sài}。
{一|yī}、{时间|shí jiān}：{十一|shí yī}{月|yuè}{十五|shí wǔ}{日|rì}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}。
questions.explanation: {特此|tè cǐ}{通知|tōng zhī} (this notice is hereby given) closes a notice. {各位|gè wèi}{同事|tóng shì}： is the greeting at the top, the {为|wèi}… sentence gives the reason, and the numbered details come in between.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {体操|tǐ cāo} (gymnastics): a dipping tone, then a high level one, 3+1.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{队|duì}{正在|zhèng zài}{争|zhēng}___ {冠军|guàn jūn}。 (The two teams are fighting for the championship.)
questions.explanation: {争夺|zhēng duó} (to fight for). {={夺|duó}: {大|dà} over {寸|cùn}, 6 strokes; traditional 奪 has 隹 between them (14).=}

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {大家|dà jiā}{一起|yì qǐ}{使|shǐ}___ {推|tuī}，{车|chē}{终于|zhōng yú}{动|dòng}{了|le}。 (We all pushed hard together, and at last the car moved.)

questions.stem: Listen to the announcement. Where should the runners meet before eight?

audio.text: 今天的长跑比赛全程五公里，起点在公园东门，终点在湖边，请各位选手八点以前到起点集合。

choices: at the east gate of the park
questions.explanation: {到|dào}{起点|qǐ diǎn}{集合|jí hé}: meet at the start, and {起点|qǐ diǎn}{在|zài}{公园|gōng yuán}{东|dōng}{门|mén}: the start is at the east gate. The lake is the finish ({终点|zhōng diǎn}).

questions.stem: Listen. How does the speaker feel about the team's result?

audio.text: 这次比赛我们虽然只拿了季军，可是比去年进步了不少，大家已经很努力了。

choices: disappointed and ready to give up
questions.explanation: {虽然|suī rán}{只|zhǐ}{拿|ná}{了|le}{季军|jì jūn} (although only third), {可是|kě shì}{比|bǐ}{去年|qù nián}{进步|jìn bù}{了|le}{不|bù}{少|shǎo} (but much better than last year): the speaker stresses the progress and the effort.

questions.stem: Listen. Why isn't the speaker taking part in the competition?

audio.text: 我本来想报名参加滑雪比赛，可是上个星期扭伤了脚，只好在家看电视解说了。

questions.explanation: {扭|niǔ}{伤|shāng}{了|le}{脚|jiǎo}: sprained a foot (an ankle) last week, so {只好|zhǐ hǎo}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{看|kàn}{电视|diàn shì}{解说|jiě shuō}: has to watch the commentary on TV at home.

questions.stem: As reported from the sample papers, how many questions does the written part of the new HSK 6 have?
questions.explanation: Listening 40, reading 40 and writing 2: 82 questions in about 125 minutes. (72 is the new HSK 5's written exam.) The speaking test, with five tasks, isn't counted in the 82.

questions.stem: In the speaking test of the new HSK 6, how many photos is the story told from, as reported?
questions.explanation: Four numbered photos at level 6; levels 4 and 5 use three. The other tasks are two passages to retell and two opinion questions.

questions.stem: What are the two writing tasks of the new HSK 6, as reported?
choices: a story from four pictures and an essay of at least 200 characters
five sentences with given words and a text of at least 80 characters
a practical text of at least 150 characters and an argued essay of at least 300
questions.explanation: A practical text (such as a notice looking for a flatmate) of at least 150 characters, and an essay of at least 300 giving and defending your opinion, in about 45 minutes. The picture story and the 200-character essay are HSK 5's.

questions.stem: In the "sentences for gaps" part, a sentence begins with {然而|rán ér}. What should come before its gap?
choices: the cause of what it says
questions.explanation: {然而|rán ér} (however) turns against what came before, so the text before the gap must say something it contrasts with. A sentence beginning {因此|yīn cǐ} needs a cause before it; one beginning {这|zhè} or {该|gāi} needs something to point back to.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {活动|huó dòng}{当天|dàng tiān}{请|qǐng}{穿|chuān}{运动|yùn dòng}{鞋|xié}，___ {走路|zǒu lù}{时|shí}{受伤|shòu shāng}。 (Please wear trainers on the day so you don't get hurt walking.)
questions.explanation: {以免|yǐ miǎn} (so as not to) introduces what you want to avoid: getting hurt. {以便|yǐ biàn} would make getting hurt the aim, {因此|yīn cǐ} gives a result, and {何况|hé kuàng} is "let alone".

questions.stem: Listen: one friend speaks to another in a shop. What does the speaker really mean?

audio.text: 你不觉得这件衣服有点儿贵吗？我们再去别的店看看吧。

choices: Buy it now before it sells out.
questions.explanation: The question {你|nǐ}{不|bù}{觉得|jué de}…{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{贵|guì}{吗|ma}？ isn't asking for information: it's a polite way of saying "it's too expensive", and {再|zài}{去|qù}{别的|bié de}{店|diàn}{看看|kàn kan}{吧|ba} makes the suggestion plain. Listening tasks at this level often test intent like this.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker really mean about the topic?

audio.text: 这个题目倒是不错，就是材料还没准备好，下次再说吧。

choices: It's a good topic, but not for now.
questions.explanation: {倒是|dào shi}{不错|bú cuò} grants that the topic is good; {就是|jiù shì}… adds the problem (the material isn't ready), and {下|xià}{次|cì}{再说|zài shuō}{吧|ba} puts it off. The real answer is "not this time".

questions.stem: Listen. Why is the bakery closing?

audio.text: 小区门口那家面包店好像要关门了。——听说房租涨了一倍，老板实在撑不下去了。

choices: The building is being pulled down.
questions.explanation: {房租|fáng zū}{涨|zhǎng}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi}: the rent has gone up by 100 per cent (doubled), and {撑|chēng}{不|bu}{下去|xià qù} (can't keep going) says the owner can't afford it any more.

questions.stem: Listen to the start of a TV programme. What happens next?

audio.text: 我们今天请来的两位嘉宾，一位是体育大学的老师，一位是徒步俱乐部的负责人。他们的看法未必一致，我们先请老师谈谈。

questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{请|qǐng}{老师|lǎo shī}{谈谈|tán tan}: first the lecturer (the {体育|tǐ yù}{大学|dà xué}{的|de}{老师|lǎo shī}) is asked to speak. {未必|wèi bì}{一致|yí zhì} says their views may not agree.

questions.stem: Put three of the four sentences into the gaps: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{以为|yǐ wéi}，{记忆|jì yì}{力|lì}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{人|rén}{天|tiān}{生|shēng}{就|jiù}{好|hǎo}。（1）{研究者|yán jiū zhě}{发现|fā xiàn}，{记忆|jì yì}{力|lì}{强|qiáng}{的|de}{人|rén}，{大都|dà dōu}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{套|tào}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{方法|fāng fǎ}。{比如|bǐ rú}，{他们|tā men}{会|huì}{把|bǎ}{要|yào}{记|jì}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{跟|gēn}{熟悉|shú xī}{的|de}{事物|shì wù}{联系|lián xì}{起来|qǐ lái}。（2）{这样|zhè yàng}，{同样|tóng yàng}{的|de}{内容|nèi róng}，{花|huā}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}{少|shǎo}{了|le}，{却|què}{记得|jì de}{更|gèng}{牢|láo}。（3） — A. {这样|zhè yàng}{的|de}{方法|fāng fǎ}{其实|qí shí}{谁|shéi}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}{学会|xué huì}。 B. {然而|rán ér}，{事实|shì shí}{恰恰|qià qià}{相反|xiāng fǎn}。 C. {因此|yīn cǐ}，{他们|tā men}{从不|cóng bú}{复习|fù xí}。 D. {又|yòu}{比如|bǐ rú}，{他们|tā men}{会|huì}{把|bǎ}{一|yì}{长|cháng}{串|chuàn}{数字|shù zì}{分|fēn}{成|chéng}{几|jǐ}{组|zǔ}{来|lái}{记|jì}。
questions.explanation: (1) B: {然而|rán ér} turns against the belief just stated ({恰恰|qià qià}{相反|xiāng fǎn}, quite the opposite). (2) D: {又|yòu}{比如|bǐ rú} adds a second example after {比如|bǐ rú}. (3) A: {这样|zhè yàng}{的|de}{方法|fāng fǎ} points back to the methods and closes the text. C is left over: {因此|yīn cǐ} has no cause to point to, and "they never revise" follows from nothing in the passage.

questions.stem: Read: "{当然|dāng rán}，{我们|wǒ men}{今天|jīn tiān}{读|dú}{古|gǔ}{书|shū}，{未必|wèi bì}{都|dōu}{同意|tóng yì}{书|shū}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{观点|guān diǎn}。{但|dàn}{这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{句|jù}{话|huà}{之所以|zhī suǒ yǐ}{能|néng}{一直|yì zhí}{流传|liú chuán}{下来|xià lái}，{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}{它们|tā men}{说|shuō}{的|de}{道理|dào li}{并|bìng}{不|bú}{过时|guò shí}。" What is the writer's attitude to the old sayings?
choices: Not every view must be accepted, but these sayings still hold.
Old books are no longer worth reading.
Everything in old books is right.
questions.explanation: {当然|dāng rán}…{未必|wèi bì}{都|dōu}{同意|tóng yì} is a concession; {但|dàn}…{之所以|zhī suǒ yǐ}…{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}…{并|bìng}{不|bú}{过时|guò shí} is the view: the sayings last because what they say isn't out of date. The attitude is balanced, and positive about these lines.

questions.stem: Read Anna's email to her teacher: "{说|shuō}{实话|shí huà}，{报名|bào míng}{以前|yǐ qián}{我|wǒ}{犹豫|yóu yù}{了|le}{很|hěn}{久|jiǔ}。{工作|gōng zuò}{这么|zhè me}{忙|máng}，{我|wǒ}{担心|dān xīn}{没有|méi yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}{复习|fù xí}。{可是|kě shì}{大卫|Dà wèi}{说|shuō}，{与其|yǔ qí}{等到|děng dào}'{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}'，{不如|bù rú}{现在|xiàn zài}{就|jiù}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{因为|yīn wèi}{永远|yǒng yuǎn}{不|bú}{会|huì}{有|yǒu}{完全|wán quán}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{那|nà}{一|yì}{天|tiān}。" What did David advise?
choices: Wait until she has more time.
Not take the exam this year.
Start preparing now rather than wait.
questions.explanation: {与其|yǔ qí}…{不如|bù rú}…: rather than wait until she "has time", it's better to start now, because nobody is ever completely ready.

questions.stem: Read: "{周末|zhōu mò}{王芳|Wáng Fāng}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{改|gǎi}{作文|zuò wén}。{她|tā}{说|shuō}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{文章|wén zhāng}{内容|nèi róng}{不错|bú cuò}，{可是|kě shì}{口语词|kǒu yǔ cí}{用|yòng}{得|de}{太|tài}{多|duō}，{像|xiàng}{聊|liáo}{天|tiān}，{不|bú}{像|xiàng}{议论文|yì lùn wén}。" What is the problem with the writer's essays?
choices: They're too colloquial for an argued essay.
questions.explanation: {内容|nèi róng}{不错|bú cuò} (the content is fine), but {口语词|kǒu yǔ cí}{用|yòng}{得|de}{太|tài}{多|duō}，{像|xiàng}{聊|liáo}{天|tiān} (too many spoken words, like a chat): the register is wrong for a {议论文|yì lùn wén} (an argued essay).

questions.stem: What comes after HSK 6 in the new HSK, as reported?
choices: levels 7, 8 and 9, each with its own exam
levels 7–9, tested together in one exam that adds translation
nothing: HSK 6 is the top level
a single level 7 exam with no speaking
questions.explanation: Levels 7, 8 and 9 (the advanced band) share one combined exam, which reports a level from your score and, as reported, adds translation to listening, reading, writing and speaking.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {阅读|yuè dú} (reading): a falling tone, then a rising one, 4+2.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {听力|tīng lì} (listening): a high level tone, then a falling one, 1+4.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {考试|kǎo shì}{以前|yǐ qián}，{一定|yí dìng}{要|yào}___ {固|gù}{一下|yí xià}{学|xué}{过|guo}{的|de}{内容|nèi róng}。 (Before the exam, be sure to consolidate what you've learned.)
questions.explanation: {巩固|gǒng gù} (to consolidate), a handwriting character of lesson 03. {={巩|gǒng}: {工|gōng} and {凡|fán}, 6 strokes; traditional 鞏 has {革|gé} underneath (15).=}

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {他|tā}{做|zuò}{事|shì}{一|yī}___ {很|hěn}{认真|rèn zhēn}。 (He has always been conscientious.)
questions.explanation: {一贯|yí guàn} (consistently, all along), a handwriting character of lesson 24. {={贯|guàn}: 毌 over {贝|bèi}, 8 strokes; traditional 貫 has 貝.=}

questions.stem: Which of these does NOT belong in a formal letter of complaint?
choices: the rule or contract that was broken
questions.explanation: A complaint states the facts, cites the rule broken, makes clear numbered requests and stays calm: no exclamation marks, no insults. That's what makes it hard to ignore.

questions.stem: A learner's argued essay has a clear thesis, two reasons with examples and a conclusion. What is still missing, according to the checklist?
choices: a concession to the other side
questions.explanation: The four parts are thesis, reasons, concession and conclusion: {当然|dāng rán}… or {即便|jí biàn}…{也|yě}… grants a point to the other side before keeping your view. A greeting and a date belong to a practical text; idioms only where they fit.

questions.stem: What do modern scholars mostly think about the authorship of the 《{道德经|Dào dé jīng}》?
choices: It is probably a compilation, and who wrote it is uncertain.
Laozi certainly wrote all of it in the 6th century BCE.
It was written in the Tang dynasty.
questions.explanation: Tradition credits it to Laozi, but most scholars see it as a compilation put together over time, and some doubt Laozi existed as one person. The oldest copy found, at Guodian (1993), dates from before about 300 BCE.

questions.stem: How is the 《{道德经|Dào dé jīng}》 arranged?
choices: 81 short chapters in two parts, about five thousand characters
20 long chapters, about twenty thousand characters
one continuous poem of a hundred lines
questions.explanation: 81 brief chapters, about 5,000 characters, in two parts: the {道经|Dào jīng} (chapters 1–37) and the {德经|Dé jīng} (38–81).

questions.stem: In "{上|shàng}{善|shàn}{若|ruò}{水|shuǐ}。{水|shuǐ}{善|shàn}{利|lì}{万物|wàn wù}{而|ér}{不争|bù zhēng}。", what are the two {善|shàn}?
questions.explanation: {上|shàng}{善|shàn} is "the highest good" (a noun); {水|shuǐ}{善|shàn}{利|lì}{万物|wàn wù} is "water is good at benefiting all things", where {善|shàn} is {善于|shàn yú}. One character doing two jobs in one line is typical of classical Chinese.

questions.stem: What does {不争|bù zhēng} mean in "{水|shuǐ}{善|shàn}{利|lì}{万物|wàn wù}{而|ér}{不争|bù zhēng}"?
choices: does not contend, does not compete
questions.explanation: {争|zhēng} is "to contend, compete": water benefits all things and yet doesn't compete with them ({而|ér} is "and yet", modern {却|què}).

questions.stem: In "{千|qiān}{里|lǐ}{之|zhī}{行|xíng}，{始|shǐ}{于|yú}{足|zú}{下|xià}", what does {足|zú}{下|xià} mean?
choices: you (a polite word in old letters)
beneath one's feet: where you stand now
questions.explanation: {足|zú} is "foot", so {足|zú}{下|xià} is "under the foot": the journey begins where you are standing. {足|zú}{下|xià} was also a polite "you" in old letters, but that isn't its sense here.

questions.stem: Which modern Chinese sentence best paraphrases "{千|qiān}{里|lǐ}{之|zhī}{行|xíng}，{始|shǐ}{于|yú}{足|zú}{下|xià}"?
choices: {走路|zǒu lù}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{看|kàn}{着|zhe}{脚下|jiǎo xià}。
{走|zǒu}{一千|yì qiān}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{路|lù}，{要|yào}{先|xiān}{买|mǎi}{一|yì}{双|shuāng}{好|hǎo}{鞋|xié}。
{一千|yì qiān}{里|lǐ}{太|tài}{远|yuǎn}{了|le}，{最好|zuì hǎo}{不要|bú yào}{去|qù}。
{走|zǒu}{一千|yì qiān}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{远|yuǎn}{路|lù}，{也|yě}{是|shì}{从|cóng}{脚下|jiǎo xià}{的|de}{第|dì}{一|yī}{步|bù}{开始|kāi shǐ}{的|de}。
questions.explanation: {之|zhī} is the classical {的|de}, {行|xíng} a journey, {始|shǐ}{于|yú} "begins at": even a thousand-li journey starts with the first step from where you stand.

questions.stem: In "{知|zhī}{人|rén}{者|zhě}{智|zhì}，{自|zì}{知|zhī}{者|zhě}{明|míng}", what does {者|zhě} mean?
questions.explanation: X {者|zhě} is "one who X": {知|zhī}{人|rén}{者|zhě}, one who knows others; {自|zì}{知|zhī}{者|zhě}, one who knows oneself. It's HSK 4's suffix {者|zhě} ({读者|dú zhě}, {作者|zuò zhě}) in its classical use.

questions.stem: In "{知|zhī}{人|rén}{者|zhě}{智|zhì}，{自|zì}{知|zhī}{者|zhě}{明|míng}", which is held up as the higher thing?
questions.explanation: The second half turns inwards and is the higher one: {明|míng} (clear-sighted) for knowing oneself, after {智|zhì} (clever) for knowing others. The chapter goes on in the same way: overcoming oneself is true strength.

questions.stem: What is {之|zhī} in "{千|qiān}{里|lǐ}{之|zhī}{行|xíng}"?
questions.explanation: {千|qiān}{里|lǐ}{之|zhī}{行|xíng} is "a journey of a thousand li": {之|zhī} links the description to the noun, like modern {的|de}.

questions.stem: Read: "{主人|zhǔ rén}{选|xuǎn}{这|zhè}{四|sì}{个|gè}{字|zì}，{往往|wǎng wǎng}{不|bú}{是|shì}{为了|wèi le}{研究|yán jiū}{哲学|zhé xué}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{它|tā}{的|de}{意思|yì si}：{做|zuò}{人|rén}{应该|yīng gāi}{像|xiàng}{水|shuǐ}{一样|yí yàng}，{对|duì}{别人|bié ren}{有|yǒu}{帮助|bāng zhù}，{却|què}{不|bù}{跟|gēn}{别人|bié ren}{争|zhēng}。" Why do people hang {上|shàng}{善|shàn}{若|ruò}{水|shuǐ} on their walls, according to this?
choices: They like the idea of helping others without competing.
They like the shape of the characters.
questions.explanation: {不|bú}{是|shì}{为了|wèi le}{研究|yán jiū}{哲学|zhé xué}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{它|tā}{的|de}{意思|yì si}: not to study philosophy but because they like the meaning: be like water, helpful to others and not competing with them.

questions.stem: Read: "{老师|lǎo shī}{用|yòng}{它|tā}{鼓励|gǔ lì}{刚|gāng}{入门|rù mén}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}，{父母|fù mǔ}{用|yòng}{它|tā}{告诉|gào su}{孩子|hái zi}{做|zuò}{事|shì}{不要|bú yào}{怕|pà}{难|nán}，{公司|gōng sī}{在|zài}{新|xīn}{项目|xiàng mù}{开始|kāi shǐ}{时|shí}{也|yě}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{引用|yǐn yòng}{它|tā}。" Which saying is this about?
choices: {水|shuǐ}{善|shàn}{利|lì}{万物|wàn wù}{而|ér}{不争|bù zhēng}
questions.explanation: Encouraging beginners, telling children not to fear difficulty, starting a new project: all about beginnings, the message of {千|qiān}{里|lǐ}{之|zhī}{行|xíng}，{始|shǐ}{于|yú}{足|zú}{下|xià}.

questions.stem: What is {道|dào} (dào) in the 《{道德经|Dào dé jīng}》?
choices: a moral rule written by the emperor
the Way: how the world works, which can't be fully named
questions.explanation: {道|dào} is the book's central idea, the Way of the world, which the text says can't be fully named or explained; {德|dé} is the power or virtue of following it.

questions.stem: When did {陶渊明|Táo Yuān míng} (Tao Yuanming) live?
choices: about 365–427, under the Eastern Jin and into the Song
questions.explanation: Tao Yuanming lived from about 365 (the year is uncertain) to 427, under the Eastern Jin and into the first years of the Song that followed. He left office and spent his later life farming and writing.

questions.stem: What does the idiom {世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán} mean today?
choices: a peaceful, beautiful place cut off from the world
questions.explanation: {世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán} (a Peach Blossom Spring outside the world) is a quiet, idyllic place apart from the world; it can also hint at escaping reality, looking for a place that doesn't exist.

questions.stem: In "{缘|yuán}{溪|xī}{行|xíng}，{忘|wàng}{路|lù}{之|zhī}{远近|yuǎn jìn}", what does {缘|yuán} mean?
choices: to follow, go along ({沿着|yán zhe})
questions.explanation: {缘|yuán}{溪|xī}{行|xíng} is "going along the stream": {缘|yuán} means {沿着|yán zhe} here. {忘|wàng}{路|lù}{之|zhī}{远近|yuǎn jìn}: he forgot how far he had gone.

questions.stem: In "{便|biàn}{舍|shě}{船|chuán}，{从|cóng}{口|kǒu}{入|rù}", how is 舍 read, and what does it mean?
choices: shě: to give as a present
questions.explanation: {舍|shě}{船|chuán} is "to leave the boat": {舍|shě} is shě, as in {舍不得|shě bu de}. In {屋舍|wū shè}{俨然|yǎn rán} below it's shè, a house, as in {宿舍|sù shè}.

questions.stem: What does {豁然开朗|huò rán kāi lǎng} describe in the story, and how is it used today?
choices: the sun rising; today, an early start
a sudden storm; today, bad news
the fisherman's joy at a big catch; today, good luck
the narrow passage suddenly opening out; today, suddenly seeing something clearly
questions.explanation: After a few dozen paces in the narrow passage, {豁然开朗|huò rán kāi lǎng}: suddenly it opened out, wide and bright. Today the phrase is used for suddenly understanding a problem.

questions.stem: Who are {黄发|huáng fà}{垂髫|chuí tiáo} in "{黄发|huáng fà}{垂髫|chuí tiáo}，{并|bìng}{怡然|yí rán}{自|zì}{乐|lè}"?
questions.explanation: {黄发|huáng fà} (yellowed hair, fà) stands for the old, {垂髫|chuí tiáo} (hanging locks) for children: young and old alike were content ({怡然|yí rán}{自|zì}{乐|lè}).

questions.stem: In "{阡陌|qiān mò}{交通|jiāo tōng}，{鸡|jī}{犬|quǎn}{相|xiāng}{闻|wén}", what does {交通|jiāo tōng} mean?
questions.explanation: {阡陌|qiān mò} are the paths between fields, and {交通|jiāo tōng} has its older sense here: they cross and connect. Its modern sense "traffic" came much later.

questions.stem: Why did the villagers' ancestors come to the hidden valley, according to the story?
choices: to flee the wars of the Qin
to start a new city for the emperor
questions.explanation: They fled the wars of the Qin dynasty with their families and never went out again, so they knew nothing of the Han, let alone the Wei and Jin.

questions.stem: What happened when the prefect sent men with the fisherman to find the village again?
choices: They followed his marks but lost their way.
The villagers came out to meet them.
questions.explanation: He had marked the way, but following the marks they got lost and never found the path again. Later Liu Ziji planned to look for it, but fell ill and died first.

questions.stem: In what period is the story set?
choices: the Taiyuan era of the Jin (376–396)
questions.explanation: {晋|Jìn}{太元|Tài yuán}{中|zhōng}: in the Taiyuan years of the Jin, 376–396. The villagers' ancestors had come in the Qin, centuries earlier.

questions.stem: Read: "{故事|gù shi}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{渔人|yú rén}{第|dì}{二|èr}{次|cì}{去|qù}{就|jiù}{找|zhǎo}{不|bu}{到|dào}{路|lù}{了|le}，{太守|tài shǒu}{派|pài}{的|de}{人|rén}{也|yě}{迷|mí}{了|le}{路|lù}，{这样|zhè yàng}{的|de}{结尾|jié wěi}，{似乎|sì hū}{就是|jiù shì}{在|zài}{告诉|gào su}{读者|dú zhě}：{桃花源|táo huā yuán}{只能|zhǐ néng}{偶然|ǒu rán}{遇到|yù dào}，{不|bù}{能|néng}{刻意|kè yì}{寻找|xún zhǎo}。" What does the writer think the ending suggests?
choices: Such a place can only be found by chance.
Anyone can find it with a good map.
questions.explanation: {只能|zhǐ néng}{偶然|ǒu rán}{遇到|yù dào}，{不|bù}{能|néng}{刻意|kè yì}{寻找|xún zhǎo}: it can only be come upon by chance, not deliberately sought. The writer doesn't say the fisherman lied.

questions.stem: In "{男|nán}{女|nǚ}{衣着|yī zhuó}，{悉|xī}{如|rú}{外|wài}{人|rén}", how is 着 read, and what does {悉|xī} mean?
questions.explanation: {衣着|yī zhuó} (yī zhuó) is clothing, and {悉|xī} means "all, entirely": the men's and women's clothes were all like those of people outside.
