glossary.definition: A syllable that regularly goes at the end of words and makes a word of a certain kind. HSK 6 has -{化|huà} (to become, make: {现代化|xiàn dài huà}, {年轻|nián qīng}{化|huà}), -{性|xìng} (the quality: {重要|zhòng yào}{性|xìng}, {积极|jī jí}{性|xìng}: nouns), -{型|xíng} (type, size: {大型|dà xíng}, {新型|xīn xíng}: before a noun), -{式|shì} (style: {中式|zhōng shì}, {老式|lǎo shì}) and {业|yè} (trade: {服务|fú wù}{业|yè}, {旅游|lǚ yóu}{业|yè}). Knowing them lets you read words you have never met.

A syllable that regularly goes at the front of words. Lesson 01 has {副|fù} (deputy: {副|fù}{经理|jīng lǐ}, {副|fù}{总|zǒng}{经理|jīng lǐ}) and {总|zǒng} (chief: {总|zǒng}{经理|jīng lǐ}, {总裁|zǒng cái}); lesson 16 adds {超|chāo}-, {多|duō}-, {反|fǎn}-, {无|wú}-, {亚|yà}- and {准|zhǔn}-.

"Either… or…": {要么|yào me} X，{要么|yào me} Y sets out the courses of action, one of which must be chosen: {要么|yào me}{降价|jiàng jià}，{要么|yào me}{延期|yán qī}{交货|jiāo huò}。 It mostly looks forward to a decision (it can also list someone's usual options); {不|bú}{是|shì} X {就是|jiù shì} Y stresses that it is always one or the other, often as a complaint ({他|tā}{不|bú}{是|shì}{迟到|chí dào}{就是|jiù shì}{请假|qǐng jià}), and {还是|hái shi} asks "or?" in a question. Alone at the start of a reply, {要么|yào me} suggests one way out: {要么|yào me}{这样|zhè yàng}{吧|ba}…

"Only if…; unless…": {除非|chú fēi} X，{才|cái} Y (only if X, then Y: {除非|chú fēi}{休息|xiū xi}{好|hǎo}，{才能|cái néng}{恢复|huī fù}) or {除非|chú fēi} X，{否则|fǒu zé} / {不然|bù rán} Y (unless X, Y: {除非|chú fēi}{你|nǐ}{早|zǎo}{点儿|diǎnr}{出发|chū fā}，{否则|fǒu zé}{会|huì}{迟到|chí dào}). The {除非|chú fēi} clause names the one condition that would change things. Lesson 08 teaches it; see the complex-sentences sheet.

"Even if X, still Y": {就算|jiù suàn}{失败|shī bài}{了|le}，{也|yě}{要|yào}{吸取|xī qǔ}{经验|jīng yàn}。 {就算|jiù suàn} is spoken; {即使|jí shǐ}…{也|yě} (HSK 4) is neutral, {哪怕|nǎ pà}…{也|yě} (HSK 5) emphatic and {即便|jí biàn}…{也|yě} (lesson 26) written. {就算|jiù suàn} is lesson 23's word.

{凡是|fán shì} + a description, then {都|dōu} + what holds: every member of the group, without exception. {凡是|fán shì}{参加|cān jiā}{活动|huó dòng}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}，{都|dōu}{要|yào}{准时|zhǔn shí}{到|dào}{校|xiào}。 A little formal, common in rules and notices; close to {所有|suǒ yǒu}…{都|dōu} or {只要|zhǐ yào}{是|shì}…{都|dōu}. The {都|dōu} is needed. Lesson 24 teaches it fully.

Before a verb, usually with {才|cái}: "only after a struggle, at long last": {我们|wǒ men}{好不容易|hǎo bù róng yì}{才|cái}{订|dìng}{到|dào}{了|le}{酒店|jiǔ diàn}。 {好容易|hǎo róng yì} means the same in this position. As a predicate they differ: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{好不容易|hǎo bù róng yì} is "this is really not easy", but {这|zhè}{道|dào}{题|tí}{好容易|hǎo róng yì} is "this question is so easy".

A measure word that counts actions rather than things, after the verb: {次|cì}, {遍|biàn}, {趟|tàng} (HSK 2–4), and at HSK 6 {番|fān}, for actions that take time and effort, nearly always with {一|yī}: {一|yì}{番|fān}{努力|nǔ lì}, {研究|yán jiū}{了|le}{一|yì}{番|fān}, {费|fèi}{了|le}{一|yì}{番|fān}{功夫|gōng fu}.

A complex sentence that offers choices: {或者|huò zhě} (or, in a statement), {还是|hái shi} (or?, in a question), {要么|yào me}…{要么|yào me} (either… or…, a choice to be made), {不|bú}{是|shì}…{就是|jiù shì} (it is always one or the other), {或是|huò shì}…{或是|huò shì} (written). See the complex-sentences sheet.

The first task of the HSK 6 speaking test, as reported: you hear or read a short passage and tell it again in your own words (two passages, about a minute and a half each). Keep the order of events and the main facts; you needn't keep every detail.

The last task of the HSK 6 speaking test, as reported: two questions asking for your view ({你|nǐ}{认为|rèn wéi}…？{为什么|wèi shén me}？), with a few minutes to prepare. A good answer states a view, gives two reasons with an example each, admits a limit or the other side, and ends by returning to the view.

A short preposition of the written register, used in reports, notices, labels and news, with a longer spoken partner: {于|yú} (in comparisons "than", after {用|yòng} "for": {高于|gāo yú} / {比|bǐ}…{高|gāo}, {低于|dī yú} / {比|bǐ}…{低|dī}, {用于|yòng yú} / {用来|yòng lái}; also "at, in": {于|yú}2031{年|nián}), {除|chú} (except: {除|chú}…{外|wài} / {除了|chú le}…{以外|yǐ wài}), {因|yīn} (because of: {因|yīn}{病|bìng} / {因为|yīn wèi}{生病|shēng bìng}) and {至于|zhì yú} (as for). {于|yú} stays straight after its adjective or verb, with nothing between: not {很|hěn}{高于|gāo yú}. Taught from lesson 08; lesson 27 brings them together.

The written form of {除了|chú le}…{以外|yǐ wài}: {除|chú} + noun or clause + {外|wài} (or {以外|yǐ wài}). With {都|dōu} / {一律|yí lǜ} it leaves A out ("except A": {除|chú}{节假日|jié jià rì}{外|wài}，{每|měi}{天|tiān}{开放|kāi fàng}, open every day except public holidays); with {还|hái} / {也|yě} it adds A ("besides A": {除|chú}{赔偿|péi cháng}{损失|sǔn shī}{外|wài}，{还|hái}{要|yào}{公开|gōng kāi}{道歉|dào qiàn}, besides paying for the loss, it must apologise publicly). Notices, rules and news; in speech, {除了|chú le}…{以外|yǐ wài}. Taught in lesson 09.

"As for…, as to…": turns from what has been said to a related point, often a less certain or less important one, at the head of its clause: {商店|shāng diàn}{已经|yǐ jīng}{道歉|dào qiàn}{了|le}，{至于|zhì yú}{赔|péi}{多少|duō shao}{钱|qián}，{还|hái}{要|yào}{再|zài}{商量|shāng liang} (the shop has apologised; as for how much it will pay, that has still to be agreed). {关于|guān yú} (about, on) introduces the topic of a whole text; {至于|zhì yú} switches topics in the middle. Previewed in lesson 09; lesson 27 teaches it with the other written words. {不至于|bú zhì yú} (not so bad as to…) is lesson 26's.

"Unexpectedly, who would have thought": a written conjunction at the start of the second clause, saying that what happened was not what anyone expected, often after {本来|běn lái} or {原|yuán}{以为|yǐ wéi}: {我|wǒ}{原|yuán}{以为|yǐ wéi}{没|méi}{人|rén}{关注|guān zhù}，{不料|bú liào}{第|dì}{二|èr}{天|tiān}{就|jiù}{成|chéng}{了|le}{热点|rè diǎn}. It takes no subject of its own (not {我|wǒ}{不料|bú liào}…: say {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{想|xiǎng}{到|dào}…) and looks back on the past. Spoken: {没|méi}{想|xiǎng}{到|dào}; the adverb {竟然|jìng rán} can follow for more surprise. Taught in lesson 10.

A fixed frame of spoken Chinese with slots to fill, whose meaning is more than its words: {东|dōng}{一|yī}A，{西|xī}{一|yī}A (scattered all over), {左|zuǒ}A{右|yòu}B (again and again), {早|zǎo}{不|bù}X{晚|wǎn}{不|bù}X (at just the wrong moment), {看|kàn}{把|bǎ}{你|nǐ}X{得|de} (look how X you are), {放|fàng}{着|zhe}X{不|bù}Y (to pass over X and do Y), X{归|guī}X，Y{归|guī}Y (X is one thing, Y another), {这|zhè}{也|yě}{不|bù}X，{那|nà}{也|yě}{不|bù}Y (won't do this or that). They belong to speech, stories and dialogue, not to reports. HSK 6 teaches them from lesson 07; all are on the reference sheet of colloquial formats.

A colloquial format: {东|dōng}{一|yī} + measure word (+ noun)，{西|xī}{一|yī} + the same measure word (+ noun): things scattered here and there, in disorder: {楼道|lóu dào}{里|lǐ}{东|dōng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{箱子|xiāng zi}，{西|xī}{一|yí}{个|gè}{箱子|xiāng zi}; {他|tā}{东|dōng}{一|yí}{句|jù}，{西|xī}{一|yí}{句|jù}，{说|shuō}{了|le}{半天|bàn tiān}{也|yě}{没|méi}{说|shuō}{清楚|qīng chu} (he talked about this and that and never made it clear). {东|dōng} and {西|xī} don't mean east and west here. Spoken, and usually critical. Taught in lesson 07.

A colloquial format: {左|zuǒ} + verb + {右|yòu} + a verb of the same meaning (or the same verb): an action done over and over, usually before a result or decision: {左思右想|zuǒ sī yòu xiǎng} (to think it over and over; also written), {左|zuǒ}{看|kàn}{右|yòu}{看|kàn} (to look and look), {左|zuǒ}{等|děng}{右|yòu}{等|děng} (to wait and wait), {左|zuǒ}{挑|tiāo}{右|yòu}{选|xuǎn} (to pick and choose). The result follows, often with {还是|hái shi}, {也|yě}, {就是|jiù shì} or {最后|zuì hòu}. Taught in lesson 07.

A degree complement of HSK 6: verb or adjective + {透|tòu} + {了|le}, "through and through, utterly": {熟|shú}{透|tòu}{了|le} (completely ripe), {湿|shī}{透|tòu}{了|le} (soaked through), {烦|fán}{透|tòu}{了|le} (utterly fed up), {坏|huài}{透|tòu}{了|le} (rotten through). It says a state has gone as far as it can; {了|le} is needed. Often of unpleasant states in speech ({糟糕|zāo gāo}{透|tòu}{了|le}, awful). Compare {死|sǐ}{了|le} and {极|jí}{了|le} (HSK 4). {透|tòu} (tòu) is lesson 12's word; the pattern is taught in lesson 20.

A short argued text on a news item, the level-6 task of commenting on a news article: say what happened (with its source: {据|jù}…{报道|bào dào}), state your view (the thesis), give reasons ({首先|shǒu xiān}, {其次|qí cì}, {另外|lìng wài}), make a concession ({当然|dāng rán}…), and conclude, in the written register. A reader's reply agrees or disagrees in part (…{说|shuō}{得|de}{有|yǒu}{道理|dào li}，{但|dàn}…). Modelled in lesson 10.

A sentence that weighs two choices and prefers the second: {与其|yǔ qí} + the choice you give up, ({还|hái} / {倒|dào}){不如|bù rú} + the one you recommend: {与其|yǔ qí}{抱怨|bào yuàn}，{不如|bù rú}{适应|shì yìng} (rather than complain, adapt); {与其|yǔ qí}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{等|děng}，{还|hái}{不如|bù rú}{自己|zì jǐ}{去|qù}{找|zhǎo}{他|tā}. With {说|shuō} it corrects a description, "not so much A as B": {与其|yǔ qí}{说|shuō}{他|tā}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{不如|bù rú}{说|shuō}{他|tā}{不|bù}{敢|gǎn}{去|qù}. It fits speech and writing; in conversation {还|hái}{不如|bù rú} alone often does the work. Taught in lesson 11.

A concessive sentence whose second half uses the adverb {却|què} (yet, however) instead of, or as well as, {但是|dàn shì}: {这|zhè}{座|zuò}{城|chéng}{虽然|suī rán}{很|hěn}{小|xiǎo}，{历史|lì shǐ}{却|què}{很|hěn}{长|cháng} (the town is small, yet its history is long). {却|què} goes after the subject of its clause and before the verb or adjective ({历史|lì shǐ}{却|què}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}), never before the subject; {但是|dàn shì} goes before the subject. {却|què} can stand without {虽然|suī rán} ({大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{了|le}，{他|tā}{却|què}{没|méi}{去|qù}). In written Chinese {虽然|suī rán} is shortened to {虽|suī}: {城|chéng}{虽|suī}{小|xiǎo}，{历史|lì shǐ}{却|què}{很|hěn}{长|cháng} (lesson 27). Taught in lesson 15.

The written particle {所|suǒ} before a verb that takes an object, turning it into a description of that object: (subject +) {所|suǒ} + verb + {的|de} (+ noun): {我|wǒ}{所|suǒ}{知道|zhī dào}{的|de}{情况|qíng kuàng} (what I know), {我们|wǒ men}{馆|guǎn}{所|suǒ}{收藏|shōu cáng}{的|de}{文物|wén wù} (the relics our museum holds). In {为|wéi} wéi + doer + {所|suǒ} + verb it makes a formal passive: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{技艺|jì yì}{早已|zǎo yǐ}{为|wéi}{人们|rén men}{所|suǒ}{熟悉|shú xī} (this craft has long been familiar to people). In speech {所|suǒ} is simply left out ({我|wǒ}{知道|zhī dào}{的|de}{情况|qíng kuàng}). Not the {所|suǒ} of {所以|suǒ yǐ} or {所有|suǒ yǒu}, nor the measure word for schools ({一|yì}{所|suǒ}{学校|xué xiào}). Taught in lesson 14; lesson 27 gathers the written words.

glossary.term: purpose clause with 以便 and 以免
glossary.definition: Two written words that begin a second clause giving the purpose of the first. {以便|yǐ biàn} yǐ biàn: so that, in order that ({请|qǐng}{提前|tí qián}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{到达|dào dá}，{以便|yǐ biàn}{工作人员|gōng zuò rén yuán}{安排|ān pái}{讲解|jiǎng jiě}). {以免|yǐ miǎn} yǐ miǎn: so as not to, lest ({请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{触摸|chù mō}{展|zhǎn}{品|pǐn}，{以免|yǐ miǎn}{损坏|sǔn huài}{文物|wén wù}). They belong to notices, instructions and reports; in speech, say {好|hǎo} + verb ({早|zǎo}{点儿|diǎnr}{来|lái}，{好|hǎo}{给|gěi}{你们|nǐ men}{安排|ān pái}) or {免|miǎn}{得|de} / {不然|bù rán}. Met in lesson 14; lesson 27 teaches them with the written register.

How Chinese builds words from parts that keep their meaning: {电|diàn} + {脑|nǎo} (a computer), {网|wǎng} + {站|zhàn} (a website). Two kinds of part come in sets: a prefix before a word ({超|chāo}- {超大|chāo dà}, {多|duō}- {多功能|duō gōng néng}, {反|fǎn}- {反作用|fǎn zuò yòng}, {无|wú}- {无线|wú xiàn} / {无人|wú rén}, {亚|yà}- {亚健康|yà jiàn kāng}, {准|zhǔn}- {准妈妈|zhǔn mā ma}) and a suffix after it (-{化|huà} {数字化|shù zì huà}, -{式|shì} {自助式|zì zhù shì}, -{型|xíng} {新型|xīn xíng}, -{性|xìng} {可能性|kě néng xìng}, -{率|lǜ} {成功率|chéng gōng lǜ}). Knowing them lets you work out words no list gives you. Not every first character is a prefix: {亚洲|Yà zhōu} (Asia) and {无论|wú lùn} (no matter) are not built this way.

"Now…, now…": two opposite states that keep changing, each after {一时|yì shí} (for a moment: lesson 25): {海|hǎi}{上|shàng}{的|de}{天气|tiān qì}{一时|yì shí}{晴|qíng}{一时|yì shí}{雨|yǔ} (sunny one minute, rainy the next); {他|tā}{一时|yì shí}{说|shuō}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{一时|yì shí}{又|yòu}{说|shuō}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{了|le}. A little written; in speech, {一会儿|yí huìr}…{一会儿|yí huìr}….

The written {一起|yì qǐ}, "together", before the verb: {请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{明天|míng tiān}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{码头|mǎ tou}{集合|jí hé}，{一同|yì tóng}{出发|chū fā}。 Used in notices, reports and formal invitations; in a chat, say {一起|yì qǐ}.

aliases: 把 with a thing as subject
glossary.definition: A {把|bǎ} sentence whose subject is a thing or an event, the cause, rather than a person acting on purpose: {这么|zhè me}{多|duō}{作业|zuò yè}{把|bǎ}{孩子|hái zi}{累|lèi}{坏|huài}{了|le} (all this homework has worn the child out), {这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}{把|bǎ}{妈妈|mā ma}{高兴|gāo xìng}{得|de}{一|yì}{晚上|wǎn shang}{没|méi}{睡着|shuì zháo}, {一|yì}{场|chǎng}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}{把|bǎ}{我们|wǒ men}{淋|lín}{透|tòu}{了|le}. After {把|bǎ} comes the person (or thing) affected; the verb is often an adjective or a verb of feeling ({累|lèi}, {急|jí}, {高兴|gāo xìng}, {吓|xià}) and needs a result or a degree: {坏|huài}{了|le}, {得|de} + a description, {透|tòu}{了|le}, {死|sǐ}{了|le}. {让|ràng} says much the same more neutrally ({这么|zhè me}{多|duō}{作业|zuò yè}{让|ràng}{孩子|hái zi}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}). Taught in lesson 21.

aliases: 看 / 瞧 + 把 + someone + adjective + 得
glossary.definition: A spoken exclamation that teases or sympathises with someone showing a strong feeling: {看|kàn} or {瞧|qiáo}, {把|bǎ} + the person, an adjective, then {得|de} with nothing after it: {看|kàn}{把|bǎ}{你|nǐ}{高兴|gāo xìng}{得|de}！ (look at you, you're so happy!), {瞧|qiáo}{把|bǎ}{他|tā}{急|jí}{得|de}！ The degree complement after {得|de} is left for the listener to fill in. It's also written with {的|de} ({看|kàn}{把|bǎ}{你|nǐ}{高兴|gāo xìng}{的|de}). Without {把|bǎ}, {瞧|qiáo}{你|nǐ} / {看|kàn}{你|nǐ} + adjective + {的|de} says much the same ({瞧|qiáo}{你|nǐ}{美|měi}{的|de}！), and {瞧|qiáo}{你|nǐ}{说|shuō}{的|de}！ brushes off praise. Taught in lesson 22.

glossary.term: 这也不 X，那也不 Y
aliases: 这也不 X 那也不 Y
glossary.definition: A complaint or exaggeration that someone rejects everything, or that nothing works: {这|zhè}{也|yě}{不|bù}{吃|chī}，{那|nà}{也|yě}{不|bù}{吃|chī}，{你|nǐ}{到底|dào dǐ}{想|xiǎng}{吃|chī}{什么|shén me}？ (you won't eat this, you won't eat that), {他|tā}{这|zhè}{也|yě}{不|bù}{满意|mǎn yì}，{那|nà}{也|yě}{不|bù}{满意|mǎn yì}. The two verbs can be the same or of one kind ({这|zhè}{也|yě}{不|bú}{让|ràng}{说|shuō}，{那|nà}{也|yě}{不|bú}{让|ràng}{问|wèn}). The positive form, {这|zhè}{也|yě}{想|xiǎng} X，{那|nà}{也|yě}{想|xiǎng} X, is for someone who wants everything. Taught in lesson 23.
glossary.topic: 这也不 X，那也不 Y

glossary.definition: Passing over an obvious, available choice to do something else, nearly always critical: {放|fàng}{着|zhe} + what is there + {不|bù} + the expected verb, then what the person does instead, often with {非|fēi}{要|yào} or {却|què}: {放|fàng}{着|zhe}{电梯|diàn tī}{不|bú}{坐|zuò}，{非|fēi}{要|yào}{走|zǒu}{楼梯|lóu tī} (there's a lift right there and he insists on the stairs), {放|fàng}{着|zhe}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{不|bú}{做|zuò}，{你|nǐ}{要|yào}{去|qù}{冒险|mào xiǎn}？ Taught in lesson 23.

Up to, until: {到|dào} + a time, a point or a limit + {为止|wéi zhǐ} marks where something stops: {到|dào}{今天|jīn tiān}{为止|wéi zhǐ} (as of today), {到|dào}{目前|mù qián}{为止|wéi zhǐ} (so far), {今天|jīn tiān}{就|jiù}{学|xué}{到|dào}{这儿|zhèr}{为止|wéi zhǐ}, {吃|chī}{到|dào}{饱|bǎo}{为止|wéi zhǐ}. {为止|wéi zhǐ} is wéi zhǐ. {截至|jié zhì} (lesson 27) is its formal partner in reports. Taught in lesson 25.

The name of a tune whose pattern a {词|cí} (a song lyric, the form the Song dynasty is famous for) follows: it fixes the number of lines, the characters in each, the rhymes and the tones, not the subject. Many poets wrote to the same {词牌|cí pái}, such as 《{如梦令|Rú mèng lìng}》 (33 characters in lines of 6, 6, 5, 6, 2, 2, 6). Writing a {词|cí} is {填词|tián cí}, "filling in" the pattern. Taught in honors lesson 25h1.

How the parts of a text fit together. An argued text has four: the thesis ({论点|lùn diǎn}), the grounds ({论据|lùn jù}: reasons and examples), a concession, and the conclusion; a commentary on the news first says what the news claimed. Discourse markers show the joins: {首先|shǒu xiān}, {其次|qí cì}, {当然|dāng rán}, {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}, {总之|zǒng zhī}.

The view an argued text defends, stated early and clearly: {我|wǒ}{认为|rèn wéi}…; {在|zài}{我|wǒ}{看来|kàn lái}…; {这个|zhè ge}{结论|jié lùn}{看似|kàn sì}{有|yǒu}{道理|dào li}，{其实|qí shí}{未必|wèi bì}{站得住|zhàn de zhù}。 {论点|lùn diǎn} (lùn diǎn) is the word for it. Everything else in the essay supports it.

What supports a thesis: reasons with facts, figures or examples ({论据|lùn jù}, lùn jù). Good grounds are specific and say only what the evidence shows: {有|yǒu}{关联|guān lián}{不|bù}{等于|děng yú}{有|yǒu}{因果|yīn guǒ} (a connection is not cause and effect); {未必|wèi bì} (not necessarily) is better than a claim you can't prove.

Granting a point to the other side before keeping your own view: {当然|dāng rán}，{我|wǒ}{并|bìng}{不|bú}{是|shì}{说|shuō}…; {即便|jí biàn}…，{也|yě}…; {虽然|suī rán}…，{但|dàn}…; {诚然|chéng rán}，… (written). A concession makes an argument fairer and stronger; the exam's essay checklist expects one.

The last part of an argued text, which draws the grounds together and answers the question: {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}，…; {总之|zǒng zhī}，…; {综上所述|zōng shàng suǒ shù}，… (very written); often with a suggestion ({与其|yǔ qí}…，{不如|bù rú}…).

The level of formality a text is written or spoken in. The same message can be in everyday words ({没|méi}{约|yuē}{的|de}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{进|jìn}{不|bu}{去|qù}) or written ones ({未经|wèi jīng}{预约|yù yuē}{者|zhě}{一律|yí lǜ}{不得|bù dé}{入场|rù chǎng}): one-character words ({于|yú}, {须|xū}, {未|wèi}, {至|zhì}), nouns for whole clauses, no particles, set phrases. Notices, reports and essays take the written register; chats take the spoken one. Neither is wrong: each fits its place.

A text with a fixed frame and a job to do: a notice ({启事|qǐ shì}, {通知|tōng zhī}, {公告|gōng gào}), a request, a complaint, a thank-you letter. The frame: a title or a greeting, the reason ({因|yīn}…, {由于|yóu yú}…), the details in order ({一|yī}、{二|èr}、{三|sān}、), what you ask for, and a closing ({特此|tè cǐ}{通知|tōng zhī}; the name and the date). The exam's first writing task is one, of at least 150 characters.

An essay that states and defends an opinion ({议论文|yì lùn wén}, yì lùn wén): thesis, two reasons with examples, a concession, a conclusion, in the written register. The exam's second writing task is one, of at least 300 characters.

A fixed phrase, almost always of four characters, kept from the classical language: its characters and their order can't change, and its meaning is often more than its parts ({人山人海|rén shān rén hǎi}, a sea of people). Many are two parallel halves; each has its own job in a sentence (predicate, attributive with {的|de}, adverbial with {地|de}, sentence opener). No {很|hěn} before an idiom: ×{很|hěn}{众所周知|zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī}.

A fixed expression used as a unit that isn't a classical idiom: {方方面面|fāng fāng miàn miàn} (every aspect), {不得了|bù dé liǎo}, {说不定|shuō bu dìng}, {特此|tè cǐ}{通知|tōng zhī}. Like an idiom, it isn't changed.

Words that go together by habit: {采取|cǎi qǔ}{措施|cuò shī} (to take measures), {发挥|fā huī}{作用|zuò yòng} (to play a role), {毫无|háo wú}{疑问|yí wèn} (beyond doubt). In the exam's gap-filling, the right word is often the one that collocates with its neighbours, even when the choices mean nearly the same.

Words that point back to something already said: {这|zhè}, {那|nà}, {该|gāi} (the said), {上述|shàng shù} (the above), {前者|qián zhě} / {后者|hòu zhě} (the former / the latter), {它们|tā men}. In the exam's sentence-insertion part, a sentence that starts with one of them needs the thing it points to just before its gap.

The second reading part of the HSK 6 exam, as reported: a passage with five gaps and six sentences, one of them left over. Choose by reference ({这|zhè}, {该|gāi}, {它们|tā men}) and by connectors ({然而|rán ér} turns against what came before, {因此|yīn cǐ} draws a result), then check that the leftover sentence really fits nowhere.

references.title: The 413 characters of HSK 6
references.body:
Every new character of this course in the order it is taught. With the 1,527 of the pinyin course and HSK 1–5 they make the 1,940 characters of the level. Pinyin gives the readings our words use ("and others" when the character has more readings in later levels). Radical is the one the stroke-order data (Make Me a Hanzi) gives, which is usually but not always the radical a dictionary files it under. Strokes follow mainland stroke order. ✎ marks the 150 characters HSK expects you to write by hand at level 6; the second table lists all 700 handwriting characters of levels 1–6.

The list shows the simplified forms the course teaches, so it stays in simplified characters when the script switch is on Traditional; the Traditional column gives the Taiwan form the switch shows ("same" when the two scripts write it alike, and the form each of our words uses when a character has two). Radicals and stroke counts are those of the simplified form.

references.title: Colloquial formats of HSK 6
references.body:
A colloquial format is a fixed frame of spoken Chinese: some words are given, you fill the slots, and the
whole means more than its parts. HSK 5's formats ({从|cóng}…{来|lái}{看|kàn}, A{的|de}A，B{的|de}B, {不|bù}X{白|bái}{不|bù}X, X{来|lái}X{去|qù}…) are on the HSK 5 sheet
of fixed formats. These are the level-6 ones. "Lesson" says where this course teaches a format; "reference"
means it's listed for recognition, for reading and listening. All of them belong to speech, dialogue and
stories, not to reports or formal letters. The examples are our own.

## Scattered, repeated, done over and over

| Format | Meaning | Example | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| {东|dōng}{一|yī}A，{西|xī}{一|yī}A | here a…, there a…: scattered, in a mess | {楼道|lóu dào}{里|lǐ}{东|dōng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{箱子|xiāng zi}，{西|xī}{一|yí}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē}。 Boxes here, bikes there, all over the stairwell. | 07 |
| {左|zuǒ}A{右|yòu}B | again and again, before a result | {我|wǒ}{左思右想|zuǒ sī yòu xiǎng}，{还是|hái shi}{决定|jué dìng}{搬家|bān jiā}。 I thought it over and over and still decided to move. | 07 |
| A{这|zhè}A{那|nà} | to do this and that, all sorts (often too much) | {他|tā}{一|yì}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{就|jiù}{问|wèn}{这|zhè}{问|wèn}{那|nà}。 As soon as he gets home he asks about everything. | reference |
| A{一|yī} + M，B{一|yī} + M | a bit of this, a bit of that, done in bits | {你|nǐ}{一|yí}{句|jù}，{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{句|jù}，{说个不停|shuō ge bù tíng}。 One remark from you, one from me: we talked non-stop. | reference |

In {东|dōng}{一|yī}A，{西|xī}{一|yī}A the measure word repeats ({东|dōng}{一|yí}{个|gè}…，{西|xī}{一|yí}{个|gè}…); {东|dōng} and {西|xī} don't mean east and west. {左|zuǒ}A{右|yòu}B pairs
two verbs of the same meaning ({思|sī} / {想|xiǎng}, {挑|tiāo} / {选|xuǎn}) or one verb twice ({左|zuǒ}{看|kàn}{右|yòu}{看|kàn}, {左|zuǒ}{等|děng}{右|yòu}{等|děng}).

## Timing and effort

| Format | Meaning | Example | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| {好不|hǎo bù}{容易|róng yì} / {好容易|hǎo róng yì} | with great difficulty, at last | {我|wǒ}{好不|hǎo bù}{容易|róng yì}{才|cái}{买|mǎi}{到|dào}{票|piào}。 I only got a ticket with great difficulty. | 05 |
| {早|zǎo}{不|bù}X，{晚|wǎn}{不|bù}X | at just the wrong moment | {早|zǎo}{不|bú}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{晚|wǎn}{不|bú}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{偏偏|piān piān}{我|wǒ}{出门|chū mén}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{下|xià}。 It had to rain just when I went out. | 13 |
| {到|dào}…{为止|wéi zhǐ} | up to, until (a point) | {到|dào}{今天|jīn tiān}{为止|wéi zhǐ}，{已经|yǐ jīng}{有|yǒu}{一百|yì bǎi}{人|rén}{报名|bào míng}{了|le}。 As of today, a hundred people have signed up. | 25 |
| X{了|le}{就|jiù}X{了|le} | what's done is done; never mind | {丢|diū}{了|le}{就|jiù}{丢|diū}{了|le}，{别|bié}{难过|nán guò}{了|le}。 It's lost, and that's that: don't be upset. | 25 |

{好容易|hǎo róng yì} and {好不|hǎo bù}{容易|róng yì} mean the same, "with great difficulty", in spite of the {不|bù}. {偏偏|piān piān} (piānpiān): just, contrary to
what one wants.

## Moods and reactions

| Format | Meaning | Example | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| {看|kàn}{把|bǎ}{你|nǐ}X{得|de} / {瞧|qiáo}{把|bǎ}{他|tā}X{得|de} | look how X you are (teasing) | {看|kàn}{把|bǎ}{你|nǐ}{高兴|gāo xìng}{得|de}！ Look how pleased you are! | 22 |
| {瞧|qiáo}{你|nǐ}X{的|de} / {看|kàn}{你|nǐ}X{的|de} | look how X you are (teasing or critical) | {瞧|qiáo}{你|nǐ}{急|jí}{的|de}，{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{呢|ne}。 Look at you in a hurry: there's still ten minutes. | 22 |
| {这|zhè}{也|yě}{不|bù}X，{那|nà}{也|yě}{不|bù}Y | won't do this or that: too fussy | {他|tā}{这|zhè}{也|yě}{不|bù}{吃|chī}，{那|nà}{也|yě}{不|bù}{吃|chī}。 He won't eat this, he won't eat that. | 23 |
| {放|fàng}{着|zhe}X{不|bù}Y | to pass over X (the obvious choice) and do something else | {放|fàng}{着|zhe}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{不|bú}{做|zuò}，{非|fēi}{要|yào}{去|qù}{冒险|mào xiǎn}。 He's giving up a perfectly good job to take a risk. | 23 |
| {算了|suàn le} / {得了|dé le} | forget it, never mind; that'll do | {算了|suàn le}，{我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}{再说|zài shuō}{吧|ba}。 Forget it: let's talk about it tomorrow. | 23 |
| {那|nà}{倒|dào}({也|yě}){是|shì} | that's true (conceding a point) | "{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{比|bǐ}{打车|dǎ chē}{快|kuài}。""{那|nà}{倒是|dào shi}。" "The metro's faster than a taxi." "That's true." | 23 |
| {好|hǎo}{你|nǐ}{个|gè}X | why, you…! (mock anger, surprise) | {好|hǎo}{你|nǐ}{个|gè}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}，{又|yòu}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}！ Why, Xiao Wang, late again! | 29 |
| X{到|dào}Y{头上|tóu shang}{来|lái}{了|le} | X has gone as far as (bothering) Y | {骗子|piàn zi}{骗|piàn}{到|dào}{我|wǒ}{头上|tóu shang}{来|lái}{了|le}！ The con men are even trying it on me! | 29 |

## Judging and separating

| Format | Meaning | Example | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| X{归|guī}X，Y{归|guī}Y | X is one thing, Y is another | {朋友|péng you}{归|guī}{朋友|péng you}，{钱|qián}{的|de}{事|shì}{要|yào}{说|shuō}{清楚|qīng chu}。 Friends are friends, but money has to be clear. | reference |
| {不|bù}X{不|bù}…，{一|yī}X… | you don't know until you…: once you X, you find… | {不|bú}{看|kàn}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}，{一|yí}{看|kàn}{吓一跳|xià yí tiào}。 You'd never know until you looked: one look gave me a fright. | reference |

For the formats of HSK 4 (X{是|shì}X，Y{是|shì}Y; {还|hái}X{呢|ne}) and HSK 5, see those courses' sheets.

references.title: Complex sentences of HSK 4–6
references.body:
Every connector of levels 4 to 6, grouped by what the two clauses do. As before, a connector that is
an adverb ({就|jiù}, {也|yě}, {才|cái}, {都|dōu}, {却|què}, {便|biàn}, {则|zé}) goes after the subject of its clause, before the verb; a conjunction
({尽管|jǐn guǎn}, {即使|jí shǐ}, {要么|yào me}, {除非|chú fēi}, {与其|yǔ qí}…) goes at the start of its clause or straight after the subject. "Register" says
where each one belongs. The last column gives the level and, for HSK 6, the lesson that teaches it
(HSK 6 lessons in the later modules are previews here).

## Concession: although, even if

| Pattern | Meaning | Register | Example | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {虽然|suī rán} X，{但是|dàn shì} / {可是|kě shì} Y | although X, Y | neutral | {虽然|suī rán}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{但是|dàn shì}{很|hěn}{开心|kāi xīn}。 | HSK 2 |
| {尽管|jǐn guǎn} X，{但是|dàn shì} / {还是|hái shi} Y | even though X (it's a fact), Y | neutral, a little formal | {尽管|jǐn guǎn}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{比赛|bǐ sài}{还是|hái shi}{开始|kāi shǐ}{了|le}。 | HSK 4 |
| X，{然而|rán ér} Y | X; however, Y | written | {计划|jì huà}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{然而|rán ér}{没有|méi yǒu}{人|rén}{执行|zhí xíng}。 | HSK 4 |
| X，{却|què} Y | X, yet Y (contrary to expectation) | neutral | {他|tā}{工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{努力|nǔ lì}，{收入|shōu rù}{却|què}{不|bù}{高|gāo}。 | HSK 4 |
| {虽|suī} X，{却|què} / {但|dàn} Y | though X, yet Y | written | {公司|gōng sī}{虽|suī}{小|xiǎo}，{发展|fā zhǎn}{却|què}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}。 | HSK 6, 15 and 27 |
| {即使|jí shǐ} X，{也|yě} Y | even if X, still Y | neutral | {即使|jí shǐ}{失败|shī bài}{了|le}，{也|yě}{不|bú}{后悔|hòu huǐ}。 | HSK 4 |
| {哪怕|nǎ pà} X，{也|yě} Y | even if X (emphatic), still Y | spoken | {哪怕|nǎ pà}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{学生|xué sheng}，{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{要|yào}{上课|shàng kè}。 | HSK 5 |
| {就算|jiù suàn} X，{也|yě} Y | even if X, still Y | spoken | {就算|jiù suàn}{有|yǒu}{挫折|cuò zhé}，{也|yě}{别|bié}{灰心|huī xīn}。 | HSK 6, 05 (23) |
| {即便|jí biàn} X，{也|yě} Y | even if X, still Y | written | {即便|jí biàn}{条件|tiáo jiàn}{有限|yǒu xiàn}，{也|yě}{应该|yīng gāi}{按时|àn shí}{完成|wán chéng}。 | HSK 6, 26 |
| {再|zài} X {也|yě} Y | however X, still Y | neutral | {再|zài}{忙|máng}{也|yě}{要|yào}{吃|chī}{早饭|zǎo fàn}。 | HSK 5 |

## Condition: if, unless, as long as

| Pattern | Meaning | Register | Example | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {如果|rú guǒ} / {要是|yào shi} X，{就|jiù} Y | if X, Y | neutral / spoken | {要是|yào shi}{你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}，{就|jiù}{来|lái}{吧|ba}。 | HSK 3–4 |
| {只要|zhǐ yào} X，{就|jiù} Y | as long as X, Y | neutral | {只要|zhǐ yào}{努力|nǔ lì}，{就|jiù}{能|néng}{进步|jìn bù}。 | HSK 3 |
| {只有|zhǐ yǒu} X，{才|cái} Y | only if X, Y | neutral | {只有|zhǐ yǒu}{多|duō}{练|liàn}，{才能|cái néng}{说|shuō}{好|hǎo}。 | HSK 3 |
| {既然|jì rán} X，{就|jiù} Y | since X (we agree it's so), Y | neutral | {既然|jì rán}{决定|jué dìng}{了|le}，{就|jiù}{别|bié}{再|zài}{想|xiǎng}{了|le}。 | HSK 4 |
| X，{否则|fǒu zé} Y | X; otherwise Y | neutral | {快|kuài}{走|zǒu}{吧|ba}，{否则|fǒu zé}{要|yào}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}。 | HSK 4 |
| X，{不然|bù rán} / {要|yào}{不然|bù rán} Y | X; otherwise Y | {不然|bù rán} neutral; {要|yào}{不然|bù rán} spoken | {带|dài}{上|shàng}{伞|sǎn}，{不然|bù rán}{会|huì}{感冒|gǎn mào}{的|de}。 | HSK 5 |
| {不管|bù guǎn} / {无论|wú lùn} X，{都|dōu} Y | no matter X, Y | neutral; {无论|wú lùn} a little formal | {不管|bù guǎn}{多|duō}{晚|wǎn}，{他|tā}{都|dōu}{会|huì}{回|huí}{电话|diàn huà}。 | HSK 4 |
| {假如|jiǎ rú} X，({就|jiù}) Y | supposing X | a little formal | {假如|jiǎ rú}{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{你|nǐ}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{接受|jiē shòu}。 | HSK 5 |
| {万一|wàn yī} X，({就|jiù}) Y | in case X (unwelcome) | neutral | {万一|wàn yī}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{活动|huó dòng}{就|jiù}{延期|yán qī}。 | HSK 5 |
| {一旦|yí dàn} X，{就|jiù} Y | once X happens, Y | neutral | {一旦|yí dàn}{签|qiān}{了|le}{合同|hé tong}，{就|jiù}{要|yào}{履行|lǚ xíng}。 | HSK 5 |
| {要不是|yào bu shì} X，Y | if it weren't for X (X is true) | neutral | {要不是|yào bu shì}{你|nǐ}{帮忙|bāng máng}，{我|wǒ}{早|zǎo}{就|jiù}{放弃|fàng qì}{了|le}。 | HSK 5 |
| {除非|chú fēi} X，{才|cái} Y | only if X, Y | neutral | {除非|chú fēi}{休息|xiū xi}{好|hǎo}，{才能|cái néng}{恢复|huī fù}。 | HSK 6, 08 |
| {除非|chú fēi} X，{否则|fǒu zé} / {不然|bù rán} Y | unless X, Y | neutral | {除非|chú fēi}{早|zǎo}{点儿|diǎnr}{出发|chū fā}，{否则|fǒu zé}{会|huì}{迟到|chí dào}。 | HSK 6, 08 |
| {凡是|fán shì} X，{都|dōu} Y | every X, without exception, Y | a little formal | {凡是|fán shì}{学生|xué sheng}{外出|wài chū}，{都|dōu}{要|yào}{有|yǒu}{老师|lǎo shī}{跟随|gēn suí}。 | HSK 6, 03 (24) |

## Alternatives: or, either… or

| Pattern | Meaning | Register | Example | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X {或者|huò zhě} Y | X or Y (statement) | neutral | {今天|jīn tiān}{或者|huò zhě}{明天|míng tiān}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}。 | HSK 3 |
| X {还是|hái shi} Y？ | X or Y? (question) | neutral | {你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{茶|chá}{还是|hái shi}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}？ | HSK 2 |
| {不|bú}{是|shì} X，{就是|jiù shì} Y | it's always either X or Y | neutral | {他|tā}{不|bú}{是|shì}{迟到|chí dào}{就是|jiù shì}{请假|qǐng jià}。 | HSK 4 |
| {或是|huò shì} X，{或是|huò shì} Y | either X or Y | written | {或是|huò shì}{电话|diàn huà}，{或是|huò shì}{邮件|yóu jiàn}，{均|jūn}{可|kě}。 | HSK 5 |
| {要么|yào me} X，{要么|yào me} Y | either X or Y (choose one) | neutral | {要么|yào me}{降价|jiàng jià}，{要么|yào me}{延期|yán qī}{交货|jiāo huò}。 | HSK 6, 02 |
| {与其|yǔ qí} X，{不如|bù rú} Y | rather than X, better Y | neutral, a little formal | {与其|yǔ qí}{抱怨|bào yuàn}，{不如|bù rú}{想|xiǎng}{办法|bàn fǎ}。 | HSK 6, 11 |
| {不|bú}{是|shì} X，{而|ér}{是|shì} Y | not X but Y | neutral | {他|tā}{不|bú}{是|shì}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{来|lái}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{太|tài}{忙|máng}{了|le}。 | HSK 4 |

## Purpose: so that, in order to

| Pattern | Meaning | Register | Example | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {为了|wèi le} X，Y | in order to X, Y | neutral | {为了|wèi le}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{练习|liàn xí}。 | HSK 3 |
| {为了|wèi le} X {而|ér} Y | Y in order to X | written | {他|tā}{为了|wèi le}{理想|lǐ xiǎng}{而|ér}{努力|nǔ lì}。 | HSK 4 |
| X，{为|wèi}{的|de}{是|shì} Y | X; the purpose is Y | neutral | {他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{加班|jiā bān}，{为|wèi}{的|de}{是|shì}{早|zǎo}{点儿|diǎnr}{完成|wán chéng}。 | HSK 5 |
| X，{以便|yǐ biàn} Y | X, so that Y (written) | written | {请|qǐng}{提前|tí qián}{报名|bào míng}，{以便|yǐ biàn}{安排|ān pái}{住宿|zhù sù}。 | HSK 6, 27 |
| X，{以免|yǐ miǎn} Y | X, so as to avoid Y | written | {请|qǐng}{带|dài}{好|hǎo}{证件|zhèng jiàn}，{以免|yǐ miǎn}{耽误|dān wu}{时间|shí jiān}。 | HSK 6, 27 |

## Progression: not only… but also; furthermore

| Pattern | Meaning | Register | Example | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {不但|bú dàn} / {不仅|bù jǐn} X，{而且|ér qiě} / {还|hái} Y | not only X but also Y | neutral; {不仅|bù jǐn} a little formal | {他|tā}{不但|bú dàn}{会|huì}{说|shuō}，{而且|ér qiě}{会|huì}{写|xiě}。 | HSK 3–4 |
| {连|lián} X {都|dōu} / {也|yě} Y | even X Y | neutral | {他|tā}{连|lián}{职位|zhí wèi}{要求|yāo qiú}{都|dōu}{没|méi}{看|kàn}。 | HSK 4 |
| X，{甚至|shèn zhì} Y | X, even Y | neutral | {他|tā}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}，{甚至|shèn zhì}{周末|zhōu mò}{也|yě}{上班|shàng bān}。 | HSK 4 |
| {不但|bú dàn}{不|bù} X，{反而|fǎn ér} Y | not only not X, but on the contrary Y | neutral | {他|tā}{不但|bú dàn}{不|bù}{生气|shēng qì}，{反而|fǎn ér}{笑|xiào}{了|le}。 | HSK 5 |
| X，{进而|jìn ér} Y | X, and then going further, Y | written | {先|xiān}{了解|liǎo jiě}{问题|wèn tí}，{进而|jìn ér}{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{办法|bàn fǎ}。 | HSK 6, 26 |

## Cause, result and inference

| Pattern | Meaning | Register | Example | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {由于|yóu yú} X，{因此|yīn cǐ} Y | because of X, therefore Y | a little formal | {由于|yóu yú}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{因此|yīn cǐ}{比赛|bǐ sài}{延期|yán qī}。 | HSK 4 |
| X，{于是|yú shì} Y | X, and so (then) Y | neutral, narrative | {他|tā}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{于是|yú shì}{早早|zǎo zǎo}{睡|shuì}{了|le}。 | HSK 4 |
| X，{因而|yīn ér} / {从而|cóng ér} Y | X, and so / thereby Y | written | {公司|gōng sī}{改进|gǎi jìn}{了|le}{流程|liú chéng}，{从而|cóng ér}{提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{效率|xiào lǜ}。 | HSK 5 |
| X，{可见|kě jiàn} Y | X, so it's clear that Y | neutral | {天天|tiān tiān}{排队|pái duì}，{可见|kě jiàn}{很|hěn}{受|shòu}{欢迎|huān yíng}。 | HSK 5 |
| {之所以|zhī suǒ yǐ} X，{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi} Y | the reason X is that Y | written | {之所以|zhī suǒ yǐ}{成功|chéng gōng}，{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{充分|chōng fèn}。 | HSK 6, 27 |
| X，{则|zé} Y | X, then Y (contrast or consequence) | written | {考核|kǎo hé}{太|tài}{松|sōng}，{则|zé}{规范|guī fàn}{成|chéng}{了|le}{空话|kōng huà}。 | HSK 6, 26 |

## Time

| Pattern | Meaning | Register | Example | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {一|yī} X，{就|jiù} Y | as soon as X, Y | neutral | {他|tā}{一|yí}{下班|xià bān}{就|jiù}{回|huí}{家|jiā}。 | HSK 3 |
| {自从|zì cóng} X ({以来|yǐ lái} / {以后|yǐ hòu})，Y | since X | neutral; {以来|yǐ lái} a little formal | {自从|zì cóng}{毕业|bì yè}{以来|yǐ lái}，{他|tā}{一直|yì zhí}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}。 | HSK 5 |
| X，{便|biàn} Y | X, and at once Y | written | {他|tā}{一|yí}{到|dào}{家|jiā}{便|biàn}{开始|kāi shǐ}{工作|gōng zuò}。 | HSK 5 |
| {一时|yì shí} X，{一时|yì shí} Y | now X, now Y | neutral | {天气|tiān qì}{一时|yì shí}{冷|lěng}，{一时|yì shí}{热|rè}。 | HSK 6, module 4 |

references.title: Essays and practical texts
references.body:
The two kinds of writing the HSK 6 exam asks for (as reported from the sample papers): a practical
text of at least 150 characters and an argued essay of at least 300. Lessons 26, 27 and 29 have
models; this sheet puts the frames and the connectors in one place.

## The argued essay ({议论文|yì lùn wén})

| Part | Its job | Typical openings |
|---|---|---|
| 1. The question or phenomenon | say what is being discussed, or what a news item claimed | {如今|rú jīn}，…; {日前|rì qián}，…; {有|yǒu}{人|rén}{认为|rèn wéi}…，{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{人|rén}{认为|rèn wéi}… |
| 2. The thesis ({论点|lùn diǎn}) | state your view clearly, early | {我|wǒ}{认为|rèn wéi}…; {在|zài}{我|wǒ}{看来|kàn lái}，…; {我|wǒ}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{完全|wán quán}{赞成|zàn chéng}…; {这个|zhè ge}{结论|jié lùn}{看似|kàn sì}…，{其实|qí shí}{未必|wèi bì}… |
| 3. Reason 1, with an example | the first ground ({论据|lùn jù}) | {首先|shǒu xiān}，…; {一|yì}{方面|fāng miàn}，…; {比如|bǐ rú}…; {以|yǐ}…{为|wéi}{例|lì} |
| 4. Reason 2, with an example | the second ground | {其次|qí cì}，…; {另|lìng}{一|yì}{方面|fāng miàn}，…; {此外|cǐ wài}，…; {更|gèng}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{是|shì}，… |
| 5. The concession | grant a point to the other side, then keep your view | {当然|dāng rán}，{我|wǒ}{并|bìng}{不|bú}{是|shì}{说|shuō}…; {诚然|chéng rán}，…; {即便|jí biàn}…，{也|yě}…; {虽然|suī rán}…，{但|dàn}… |
| 6. The conclusion | draw it together; a suggestion | {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}，…; {总之|zǒng zhī}，…; {与其|yǔ qí}…，{不如|bù rú}…; {只有|zhǐ yǒu}…，{才|cái}… |

Four or five paragraphs are plenty for 300–400 characters. The concession can share a paragraph with
a reason.

### Checklist

1. Is the thesis clear by the end of the first paragraph?
2. Does each reason have an example or a fact?
3. Where you aren't sure, did you say {未必|wèi bì}, {不|bù}{一定|yí dìng} or {可能|kě néng}, instead of claiming too much?
4. Is there a concession?
5. Does the conclusion answer the question asked?
6. Are the connectors varied but not crowded (three or four, not ten)?
7. Is the register written throughout: no {吧|ba}, {啊|a}, {嘛|ma}, {挺|tǐng}, {特别|tè bié}{好|hǎo}{玩|wán}?
8. Idioms: one or two, where they fit, never with {很|hěn}.
9. Did you count to the minimum, and check the characters you often get wrong?

## Connectors by job

| Job | Spoken or neutral | Written |
|---|---|---|
| cause | {因为|yīn wèi}…{所以|suǒ yǐ}… | {由于|yóu yú}…，{因此|yīn cǐ} / {因而|yīn ér}…; {因|yīn} + noun; {之所以|zhī suǒ yǐ}…{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}… |
| result | {所以|suǒ yǐ}, {于是|yú shì} | {从而|cóng ér}, {因此|yīn cǐ}, {可见|kě jiàn} |
| a further step | {然后|rán hòu}{再|zài} | {进而|jìn ér} |
| contrast | {但是|dàn shì}, {可是|kě shì}, {不过|bú guò} | {然而|rán ér}, {却|què}, {而|ér}, {则|zé} |
| concession | {虽然|suī rán}…{但是|dàn shì}…; {就算|jiù suàn}…{也|yě}… | {虽|suī}…{却|què} / {但|dàn}…; {即便|jí biàn}…{也|yě}…; {尽管|jǐn guǎn}…{仍|réng}… |
| condition | {要是|yào shi}…{就|jiù}… | {如果|rú guǒ}…{则|zé}…; {只要|zhǐ yào}…{便|biàn}…; {除非|chú fēi}…{否则|fǒu zé}… |
| purpose | {为了|wèi le}…; {好让|hǎo ràng}… | {以便|yǐ biàn}…; {以免|yǐ miǎn}… |
| alternatives | {要么|yào me}…{要么|yào me}… | {与其|yǔ qí}…{不如|bù rú}… |
| addition | {还|hái}{有|yǒu}, {另外|lìng wài} | {此外|cǐ wài}, {并且|bìng qiě}, {同时|tóng shí} |
| conclusion | {总|zǒng}{的|de}{来|lái}{说|shuō} | {总之|zǒng zhī}, {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}, {综上所述|zōng shàng suǒ shù} |

{综上所述|zōng shàng suǒ shù} (zōng shàng suǒ shù, "to sum up the above") is a very written way to start a conclusion.

## How strong is the claim?

| Weaker | | Stronger |
|---|---|---|
| {也许|yě xǔ}, {可能|kě néng}, {未必|wèi bì}, {不|bù}{一定|yí dìng} | {看似|kàn sì}…{其实|qí shí}, {算是|suàn shì}, {大都|dà dōu} | {无疑|wú yí}, {毫无|háo wú}{疑问|yí wèn}, {必然|bì rán}, {足以|zú yǐ}{说明|shuō míng} |

## Practical texts ({应用文|yìng yòng wén})

Every practical text has a frame. Keep it, and fill it with the details the task asks for.

| Kind | Opening | Middle | Closing |
|---|---|---|---|
| {启事|qǐ shì} (a notice: a flatmate, a lost item, a job) | a title: {合租|hé zū}{启事|qǐ shì}, {寻物启事|xún wù qǐ shì} | {因|yīn}…，{现|xiàn}…; what you have or need; requirements | {有意者|yǒu yì zhě}{请|qǐng}{于|yú}…{前|qián}{联系|lián xì}; contact; date |
| {通知|tōng zhī} (a notice to a group) | {关于|guān yú}…{的|de}{通知|tōng zhī}; {各位|gè wèi}{同事|tóng shì}： | {为|wèi}…，{定于|dìng yú}…; numbered items: {一|yī}、{时间|shí jiān} {二|èr}、{地点|dì diǎn}… | {特此|tè cǐ}{通知|tōng zhī}; who; date |
| {公告|gōng gào} (a public announcement by an organisation) | {关于|guān yú}…{的|de}{公告|gōng gào} | {现|xiàn}{将|jiāng}{有关|yǒu guān}{事项|shì xiàng}{公告|gōng gào}{如下|rú xià}：{一|yī}、…{二|èr}、… | {特此|tè cǐ}{公告|gōng gào}; the organisation; date |
| {申请|shēn qǐng} / a request | {尊敬|zūn jìng}{的|de}…： or a name you know | the reason; what you ask for; when it suits you | {请|qǐng}{您|nín}{考虑|kǎo lǜ}; {谢谢|xiè xie}; name; date |
| {投诉信|tóu sù xìn} (a complaint) | {尊敬|zūn jìng}{的|de}…{负责人|fù zé rén}： | the facts with dates; the rule or contract broken; numbered requests | {希望|xī wàng}…{尽快|jǐn kuài}{答复|dá fù}; name; date |
| {感谢信|gǎn xiè xìn} (a thank-you letter) | {尊敬|zūn jìng}{的|de}…： | what happened; what they did; what it meant to you | {再次|zài cì}{表示|biǎo shì}{感谢|gǎn xiè}; {此致|cǐ zhì}{敬礼|jìng lǐ}; name; date |

Notes:

- **Polite forms**: {您|nín}, {贵|guì}{公司|gōng sī} / {贵|guì}{中心|zhōng xīn} (your company), {本人|běn rén} (I, formally), {请|qǐng}…, {希望|xī wàng}…, {麻烦|má fan}{您|nín}….
- **Dates** go at the end, under the name: 2031{年|nián}9{月|yuè}10{日|rì}.
- **Numbered items** use {一|yī}、{二|èr}、{三|sān}、 (with the comma 、), and sub-items （{一|yī}）（{二|èr}）.
- **A complaint stays calm**: facts, the rule, the requests. No exclamation marks.
- **Register**: a notice to strangers is written ({须|xū}, {未经|wèi jīng}, {一律|yí lǜ}, {不得|bù dé}); a note to a landlord you know can be
  warmer ({您|nín}{好|hǎo}, {谢谢|xiè xie}{您|nín}), but still without chat particles.

## Useful written words (lesson 27)

{于|yú} (in, at), {至|zhì} (to), {该|gāi} (the said), {上述|shàng shù} (the above), {诸多|zhū duō} (many), {极为|jí wéi} / {较为|jiào wéi}, {须|xū} (must), {未|wèi} (not yet), {不得|bù dé} / {不宜|bù yí} /
{严禁|yán jìn}, {一律|yí lǜ}, {以便|yǐ biàn} / {以免|yǐ miǎn}, {截至|jié zhì} + date, {截止|jié zhǐ}{日期|rì qī}, {上旬|shàng xún} / {中旬|zhōng xún} / {下旬|xià xún}, {携带|xié dài}, {出示|chū shì}, {指定|zhǐ dìng}, {许可|xǔ kě}, {加以|jiā yǐ} + verb, {特此|tè cǐ}.

references.title: Idioms and set phrases of HSK 4–6
references.body:
The {成语|chéng yǔ} (idioms) and set phrases of levels 4 to 6, and the four-character patterns that work like
grammar. "Use" says how each one behaves in a sentence. Lesson 28 explains how idioms are built and
where they go; HSK 5's lesson 20h2 has more on where they come from.

Three rules for all of them: don't change their characters or their order; don't put {很|hěn}, {非常|fēi cháng} or {十分|shí fēn}
before them (~~{很|hěn}{众所周知|zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī}~~); and in an essay, use one or two where they fit, not one in every sentence.

## The idioms of HSK 6 (lesson 28)

| Idiom | Literally | Meaning | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| {成千上万|chéng qiān shàng wàn} | become thousands, reach ten thousands | thousands upon thousands | before a noun with {的|de}: {成千上万|chéng qiān shàng wàn}{的|de}{游客|yóu kè}; after {有|yǒu} |
| {千家万户|qiān jiā wàn hù} | thousand families, ten thousand households | every home (of a city, a country) | object: {走|zǒu}{进|jìn}{了|le}{千家万户|qiān jiā wàn hù} |
| {家家户户|jiā jiā hù hù} | family family household household | each and every household | subject, with {都|dōu}: {家家户户|jiā jiā hù hù}{都|dōu}{贴|tiē}{春联|chūn lián} |
| {方方面面|fāng fāng miàn miàn} | side side aspect aspect | every aspect | object: {考虑|kǎo lǜ}{到|dào}{方方面面|fāng fāng miàn miàn}; {生活|shēng huó}{的|de}{方方面面|fāng fāng miàn miàn} |
| {人山人海|rén shān rén hǎi} | people mountain, people sea | a huge crowd | predicate of a place: {车站|chē zhàn}{里|lǐ}{人山人海|rén shān rén hǎi} |
| {自言自语|zì yán zì yǔ} | self speak, self talk | to talk to oneself | verb, or adverbial with {地|de} |
| {多才多艺|duō cái duō yì} | much talent, much art | talented in many ways | predicate or attributive of a person: {她|tā}{多才多艺|duō cái duō yì}; {一|yí}{位|wèi}{多才多艺|duō cái duō yì}{的|de}{演员|yǎn yuán} |
| {衣食住行|yī shí zhù xíng} | clothes, food, housing, travel | the basic needs of life | subject or object |
| {一模一样|yì mú yí yàng} | one mould, one shape | exactly alike (yì mú yí yàng) | predicate: A {和|hé} B {一模一样|yì mú yí yàng}; attributive: {一模一样|yì mú yí yàng}{的|de}{裙子|qún zi} |
| {一帆风顺|yì fān fēng shùn} | one sail, the wind fair | plain sailing | a wish: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一帆风顺|yì fān fēng shùn}！; with {不|bù}: {不|bù}{可能|kě néng}{总是|zǒng shì}{一帆风顺|yì fān fēng shùn} |
| {众所周知|zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī} | what everyone knows thoroughly | as everyone knows | opens a sentence: {众所周知|zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī}，… |
| {至关重要|zhì guān zhòng yào} | extremely important | of vital importance | predicate, with {对|duì}: {对|duì}{健康|jiàn kāng}{至关重要|zhì guān zhòng yào} |
| {大吃一惊|dà chī yì jīng} | greatly eat one shock | to be astonished | no object: {这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{大吃一惊|dà chī yì jīng} |

{成语|chéng yǔ} itself is lesson 28's word.

## The idioms of HSK 5

| Idiom | Meaning | Use |
|---|---|---|
| {各行各业|gè háng gè yè} | all lines of work | subject or object: {各行各业|gè háng gè yè}{都|dōu}{需要|xū yào}{人才|rén cái} |
| {五颜六色|wǔ yán liù sè} | of every colour | attributive with {的|de}: {五颜六色|wǔ yán liù sè}{的|de}{花|huā} |
| {亲朋好友|qīn péng hǎo yǒu} | friends and relatives | object: {请|qǐng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{亲朋好友|qīn péng hǎo yǒu} |
| {丰富多彩|fēng fù duō cǎi} | rich and varied | attributive or predicate: {丰富多彩|fēng fù duō cǎi}{的|de}{活动|huó dòng} |
| {酸甜苦辣|suān tián kǔ là} | all life's experiences | subject or object: {生活|shēng huó}{的|de}{酸甜苦辣|suān tián kǔ là} |
| {一路顺风|yí lù shùn fēng} | have a good journey | a wish: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一路顺风|yí lù shùn fēng}！ |

## Set phrases (HSK 5–6)

| Phrase | Meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| {不得了|bù dé liǎo} | extremely (after {得|de}); terrible! | {好吃|hǎo chī}{得|de}{不得了|bù dé liǎo} |
| {说不定|shuō bu dìng} | perhaps | {说不定|shuō bu dìng}{他|tā}{已经|yǐ jīng}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 |
| {用不着|yòng bu zháo} | there's no need | {用不着|yòng bu zháo}{带|dài}{伞|sǎn}。 |
| {没法儿|méi fǎr} | no way to, can't (spoken) | {我|wǒ}{没法儿|méi fǎr}{做|zuò}{完|wán}。 |
| {算了|suàn le}, {得了|dé le} | forget it; that's enough | {算了|suàn le}，{别|bié}{说|shuō}{了|le}。 (lesson 23) |
| {好不|hǎo bù}{容易|róng yì} | with great difficulty | {好不|hǎo bù}{容易|róng yì}{才|cái}{买|mǎi}{到|dào}{票|piào}。 (lessons 05, 12) |
| {毫无|háo wú}{疑问|yí wèn} | beyond doubt | {毫无|háo wú}{疑问|yí wèn}，{这|zhè}{是|shì}{最好|zuì hǎo}{的|de}{办法|bàn fǎ}。 (lesson 26) |
| {特此|tè cǐ}{通知|tōng zhī} | this notice is hereby given | the last line of a notice (lesson 27) |

## Four-character patterns

These are grammar: you fill them with suitable words.

| Pattern | Meaning | Examples | Level |
|---|---|---|---|
| {一|yī}A{一|yī}B | one A, one B (two things together) | {一|yí}{上|shàng}{一下|yí xià}, {一|yì}{前|qián}{一|yí}{后|hòu} | HSK 4 |
| {无|wú}A{无|wú}B | without A or B | {无忧无虑|wú yōu wú lǜ} (without a care) | HSK 4 |
| {有|yǒu}A{有|yǒu}B | with both A and B | {有说有笑|yǒu shuō yǒu xiào} (talking and laughing) | HSK 4 |
| A{来|lái}A{去|qù} | back and forth, over and over | {想|xiǎng}{来|lái}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}, {走|zǒu}{来|lái}{走|zǒu}{去|qù} | HSK 5 |
| {说|shuō}A{就|jiù}A | do it the moment it's said | {说|shuō}{走|zǒu}{就|jiù}{走|zǒu} | HSK 5 |
| {没|méi}A{没|méi}B | with no A or B | {没完没了|méi wán méi liǎo} | HSK 5 |
| A{着|zhe}A{着|zhe} | while doing A | {说|shuō}{着|zhe}{说|shuō}{着|zhe}{就|jiù}{哭|kū}{了|le} | HSK 5 |
| A{这|zhè}A{那|nà} | A this and A that | {问|wèn}{这|zhè}{问|wèn}{那|nà} (to ask about everything) | HSK 6 |
| {左|zuǒ}A{右|yòu}B | A again and again | {左思右想|zuǒ sī yòu xiǎng} (to think it over and over) | HSK 6 (lesson 07) |
| {东|dōng}{一|yī}A，{西|xī}{一|yī}A | an A here, an A there | {东|dōng}{一|yí}{个|gè}，{西|xī}{一|yí}{个|gè} (scattered all over) | HSK 6 (lesson 07) |

## Idioms met in passing (glossed in their lessons)

| Idiom | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|
| {跋山涉水|bá shān shè shuǐ} | to cross mountains and wade rivers: a long, hard journey | 26 |
| {喜怒哀乐|xǐ nù āi lè} | joy, anger, sorrow and happiness: every feeling | 28 |
| {不知道天高地厚|bù zhī dào tiān gāo dì hòu} | not to know how high the sky is: naive and overconfident | 29 |
| {豁然开朗|huò rán kāi lǎng} | suddenly opening out; suddenly seeing clearly | 30h2 |
| {世外桃源|shì wài táo yuán} | a peaceful place cut off from the world | 30h2 |

## Talking about idioms

| Word | Use |
|---|---|
| {出自|chū zì} | {这个|zhè ge}{成语|chéng yǔ}{出自|chū zì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{古代|gǔ dài}{的|de}{故事|gù shi}。 (comes from) |
| {比喻|bǐ yù} | {一帆风顺|yì fān fēng shùn}{比喻|bǐ yù}{事情|shì qing}{进行|jìn xíng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{顺利|shùn lì}。 (is a figure for) |
| {形容|xíng róng} | {人山人海|rén shān rén hǎi}{形容|xíng róng}{人|rén}{非常|fēi cháng}{多|duō}。 (describes) |
| {含义|hán yì} | {这个|zhè ge}{成语|chéng yǔ}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{层|céng}{含义|hán yì}。 (meaning; lesson 28) |

references.title: Spoken and written Chinese (HSK 6)
references.body:
HSK 4 and 5 set the first written words ({此|cǐ}, {与|yǔ}, {由|yóu}, {将|jiāng}, {已|yǐ}, {仅|jǐn}, {便|biàn}, {较|jiào}, {及|jí}, {其|qí}, {某|mǒu}, {如何|rú hé}…) beside their spoken
partners. HSK 6 completes the written register of notices, contracts, reports and essays. Each written
word below stands beside the everyday word that does the same job. Use the written word in writing
and formal speech; in a chat it sounds stiff. The last column is the lesson that teaches it (27 brings
most of them together); later modules extend this sheet.

## Prepositions and place

| Written | Spoken | Meaning | Example | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {于|yú} | {在|zài} / {从|cóng} / {比|bǐ} | at, in, on; from; than | {会议|huì yì}{将|jiāng}{于|yú}{周五|zhōu wǔ}{举行|jǔ xíng}。 The meeting will be held on Friday. | 27 |
| {位于|wèi yú} / {用于|yòng yú} / {源于|yuán yú} | {在|zài} / {用|yòng}{在|zài} / {来自|lái zì} | located in / used for / coming from | {公司|gōng sī}{位于|wèi yú}{市|shì}{中心|zhōng xīn}。 The company is in the city centre. | HSK 5, 15 |
| {因|yīn} | {因为|yīn wèi} | because of | {活动|huó dòng}{因|yīn}{雨|yǔ}{延期|yán qī}。 The event was put off because of rain. | 27 |
| {除|chú}…{外|wài} | {除了|chú le}…{以外|yǐ wài} | except, apart from | {除|chú}{周日|zhōu rì}{外|wài}，{每|měi}{天|tiān}{开放|kāi fàng}。 Open every day except Sunday. | 09 |
| {至于|zhì yú} | {说|shuō}{到|dào} | as for | {至于|zhì yú}{价格|jià gé}，{我们|wǒ men}{下|xià}{周|zhōu}{再|zài}{谈|tán}。 As for the price, we'll discuss it next week. | 27 |

## Time and length

| Written | Spoken | Meaning | Example | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {为期|wéi qī} + time | {一共|yí gòng} + time | lasting | {培训|péi xùn}{为期|wéi qī}{三|sān}{天|tiān}。 The training lasts three days. | 03 |
| {日前|rì qián} / {近来|jìn lái} / {当今|dāng jīn} | {前|qián}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān} / {最近|zuì jìn} / {现在|xiàn zài} | recently / lately / today | {日前|rì qián}，{公司|gōng sī}{举办|jǔ bàn}{了|le}{博览会|bó lǎn huì}。 The company recently held a fair. | 10 |
| {日益|rì yì} | {越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè} | increasingly | {竞争|jìng zhēng}{日益|rì yì}{激烈|jī liè}。 Competition grows fiercer by the day. | 06 |
| {截至|jié zhì} | {到|dào}…{为止|wéi zhǐ} | up to (a date) | {截至|jié zhì}{五|wǔ}{月底|yuè dǐ}，{共|gòng}{有|yǒu}{五百|wǔ bǎi}{人|rén}{报名|bào míng}。 By the end of May, five hundred had signed up. | 27 |
| {不料|bú liào} | {没|méi}{想|xiǎng}{到|dào} | unexpectedly | {不料|bú liào}{第|dì}{二|èr}{天|tiān}{就|jiù}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。 Unexpectedly, it rained the next day. | 10 |

## Together, all, only

| Written | Spoken | Meaning | Example | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {与|yǔ}…{一道|yí dào} / {一同|yì tóng} | {跟|gēn}…{一起|yì qǐ} | together with | {我|wǒ}{公司|gōng sī}{将|jiāng}{与|yǔ}{学校|xué xiào}{一道|yí dào}{举办|jǔ bàn}{活动|huó dòng}。 Our company will hold the event together with the school. | 03, 17 |
| {共计|gòng jì} / {总计|zǒng jì} | {一共|yí gòng} | in total | {共计|gòng jì}{六千五百|liù qiān wǔ bǎi}{元|yuán}。 6,500 yuan in total. | 04 |
| {诸多|zhū duō} | {很|hěn}{多|duō} | many | {遇到|yù dào}{诸多|zhū duō}{困难|kùn nan} to meet many difficulties | 27 |
| {一律|yí lǜ} | {都|dōu} | all, without exception | {一律|yí lǜ}{不|bú}{退|tuì}。 No refunds in any case. | 27 |
| {限|xiàn} | {只能|zhǐ néng} / {最|zuì}{多|duō} | limited to | {每|měi}{人|rén}{限|xiàn}{购|gòu}{两|liǎng}{件|jiàn}。 Limited to two per person. | 02 |

## Must, may not, have to

| Written | Spoken | Meaning | Example | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {须|xū} / {必须|bì xū} | {得|děi} / {一定|yí dìng}{要|yào} | must | {各|gè}{组|zǔ}{须|xū}{在|zài}6{月|yuè}20{日|rì}{前|qián}{提交|tí jiāo}{流程|liú chéng}。 Each group must hand in its plan by 20 June. | HSK 5 |
| {只得|zhǐ dé} | {只好|zhǐ hǎo} | to have no choice but to | {酒店|jiǔ diàn}{没有|méi yǒu}{房间|fáng jiān}，{只得|zhǐ dé}{换|huàn}{一|yì}{家|jiā}。 The hotel was full, so we had to go elsewhere. | 05 |
| {不得|bù dé} / {严禁|yán jìn} | {不|bù}{能|néng} / {千万|qiān wàn}{别|bié} | may not / strictly forbidden | {严禁|yán jìn}{吸|xī}{烟|yān}。 No smoking. | 27 |
| {不宜|bù yí} | {最好|zuì hǎo}{别|bié} | not advisable | {不宜|bù yí}{久|jiǔ}{坐|zuò}。 It's best not to sit too long. | 27 |

## Degree and manner

| Written | Spoken | Meaning | Example | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {极为|jí wéi} / {较为|jiào wéi} | {非常|fēi cháng} / {比较|bǐ jiào} | extremely / fairly | {情况|qíng kuàng}{较为|jiào wéi}{复杂|fù zá}。 The situation is fairly complicated. | 27 |
| {特|tè} | {特别|tè bié} | specially | {特|tè}{此|cǐ}{通知|tōng zhī}。 Hereby notified. | 27 |
| {未|wèi} / {未必|wèi bì} | {没|méi} / {不|bù}{一定|yí dìng} | not yet / not necessarily | {他|tā}{未|wèi}{参加|cān jiā}{会议|huì yì}。 He did not attend the meeting. | 26, 27 |
| {为何|wèi hé} / {为此|wèi cǐ} | {为什么|wèi shén me} / {因为|yīn wèi}{这个|zhè ge} | why / for this reason | {为此|wèi cǐ}，{公司|gōng sī}{推行|tuī xíng}{了|le}{新|xīn}{制度|zhì dù}。 For this reason the company brought in a new system. | 27 |

## Formulas of notices, advertisements and letters

| Written | Spoken | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| {诚聘|chéng pìn}{以下|yǐ xià}{人员|rén yuán} | {我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{招|zhāo}{人|rén} | we are hiring the following staff | 01 |
| {有|yǒu}…{经验|jīng yàn}{者|zhě}{优先|yōu xiān} | {最好|zuì hǎo}{在|zài}…{干|gàn}{过|guo} | priority to those with experience in… | 01 |
| {薪水|xīn shuǐ}{面议|miàn yì} | {工资|gōng zī}{可以|kě yǐ}{谈|tán} | salary by negotiation | 01 |
| {有意者|yǒu yì zhě}{请|qǐng}{于|yú}…{前|qián}{将|jiāng}…{发至|fā zhì}… | {有|yǒu}{兴趣|xìng qù}{的话|de huà}，…{以前|yǐ qián}{把|bǎ}…{发|fā}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ} | those interested should send… to… by… | 01 |
| {贵公司|guì gōng sī} / {贵厂|guì chǎng} / {我|wǒ}{公司|gōng sī} | {你们|nǐ men}{公司|gōng sī} / {我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī} | your company (polite) / our company | 01, 02 |
| {由|yóu}{双方|shuāng fāng}{各|gè}{承担|chéng dān}{一半|yí bàn} | {咱们|zán men}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{一半|yí bàn} | each side bears half | 02 |
| {如|rú}…，…{有权|yǒu quán}… | {要是|yào shi}…，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}… | if…, … has the right to… | 02 |
| {请|qǐng}{于|yú}…{前|qián}{答复|dá fù} | …{以前|yǐ qián}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ} | please reply by… | 02 |
| {关于|guān yú}…{的|de}{通知|tōng zhī} | {跟|gēn}{大家|dà jiā}{说|shuō}{一下|yí xià}… | notice concerning… | 03 |
| {现|xiàn}{将|jiāng}{有关|yǒu guān}{事项|shì xiàng}{通知|tōng zhī}{如下|rú xià} | {有|yǒu}{几|jǐ}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{跟|gēn}{大家|dà jiā}{说|shuō}{一下|yí xià} | the following matters are hereby notified | 03 |
| {全体员工|quán tǐ yuán gōng} | {大伙儿|dà huǒr} | all staff | 03 |
| {在此|zài cǐ}…{表示|biǎo shì}{真诚|zhēn chéng}{的|de}{感谢|gǎn xiè} | {太|tài}{谢谢|xiè xie}{你们|nǐ men}{了|le} | we hereby express our sincere thanks | 05 |

## More pairs from later lessons

| Written | Spoken | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| {抵达|dǐ dá} | {到|dào} | to arrive | 11 |
| {用餐|yòng cān} | {吃饭|chī fàn} | to have a meal | 12 |
| {适宜|shì yí} | {合适|hé shì} | suitable | 12 |
| {添加|tiān jiā} | {加|jiā} | to add | 12 |
| {来临|lái lín} | {来|lái} | to arrive, come (of a time or a season) | 13 |
| {观赏|guān shǎng} | {看|kàn} | to watch, enjoy the sight of | 13 |
| {历经|lì jīng} | {经过|jīng guò} | to go through (years, hardships) | 14 |
| {所|suǒ} + verb: {我|wǒ}{所|suǒ}{知道|zhī dào}{的|de} | verb: {我|wǒ}{知道|zhī dào}{的|de} | what I know | 14 |
| {以便|yǐ biàn} | {好|hǎo} + verb | so that | 14, 27 |
| {以免|yǐ miǎn} | {免得|miǎn de} / {不然|bù rán} | so as to avoid; or else | 27 |
| {虽|suī}…{却|què} | {虽然|suī rán}…{但是|dàn shì} | though… yet | 15, 27 |
| {便捷|biàn jié} | {方便|fāng biàn} | convenient | 16 |
| {存储|cún chǔ} | {存|cún} | to store (data) | 16 |
| {顿时|dùn shí} | {一下子|yí xià zi} | at once, all of a sudden | 19 |
| {遭受|zāo shòu} | {受到|shòu dào} | to suffer (a loss, a disaster) | 19 |
| {转移|zhuǎn yí} | {搬到|bān dào} | to move (people, goods) elsewhere | 19 |
| {凌晨|líng chén} | {半夜|bàn yè} / {早上|zǎo shang} | before dawn | 19 |
| {突发|tū fā} | {突然|tū rán}{发生|fā shēng} | to happen suddenly | 19 |
| {罕见|hǎn jiàn} | {很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{见|jiàn} | rare | 19 |
| {赶忙|gǎn máng} | {赶紧|gǎn jǐn} | hurriedly | 19 |
| {日夜|rì yè} | {白天|bái tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang} | day and night | 19 |
| {率先|shuài xiān} | {第|dì}{一|yī}{个|gè} | to be the first (to do something) | 20 |

## The same message in both registers

Spoken (a meeting): {大伙儿|dà huǒr}，{我们|wǒ men}{跟|gēn}{学校|xué xiào}{一起|yì qǐ}{办|bàn}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{活动|huó dòng}，{一共|yí gòng}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}。{学生|xué sheng}{出去|chū qù}，{一定|yí dìng}{要|yào}{有|yǒu}{老师|lǎo shī}{或者|huò zhě}{导游|dǎo yóu}{跟|gēn}{着|zhe}。

Written (a notice): {我|wǒ}{公司|gōng sī}{将|jiāng}{与|yǔ}{北京|Běi jīng}{一|yì}{所|suǒ}{中学|zhōng xué}{一道|yí dào}{举办|jǔ bàn}{此次|cǐ cì}{活动|huó dòng}，{为期|wéi qī}{两|liǎng}{周|zhōu}。{凡是|fán shì}{学生|xué sheng}{外出|wài chū}，{都|dōu}{必须|bì xū}{有|yǒu}{老师|lǎo shī}{或|huò}{导游|dǎo yóu}{跟随|gēn suí}。

references.title: Word formation (HSK 6)
references.body:
Chinese builds many words from parts that keep their meaning. A **prefix** goes before a word and a
**suffix** after it; a set of each comes up again and again in news, adverts and product names.
Lesson 01 brings the suffixes, lesson 16 the prefixes; this sheet puts them together with the HSK 1–6
words they explain. Words in *italics* in the English column aren't course words: they're there to
show the pattern.

## Prefixes

| Prefix | Meaning | Words | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| {超|chāo}- chāo | super-, extra-, beyond | {超市|chāo shì} (supermarket: {超级|chāo jí}{市场|shì chǎng}), {超级|chāo jí} (super), {超大|chāo dà} (*extra-large*), {超长|chāo cháng} (*extra-long*) | HSK 1, 5; 16 |
| {多|duō}- duō | multi- | {多媒体|duō méi tǐ} (multimedia), {多元|duō yuán} (diverse), {多样|duō yàng} (varied), {多功能|duō gōng néng} (*multifunctional*) | 16; 11; HSK 4 |
| {反|fǎn}- fǎn | counter-, anti-, reverse | {反对|fǎn duì} (to oppose), {反馈|fǎn kuì} (feedback), {反面|fǎn miàn} (*the reverse side*), {反作用|fǎn zuò yòng} (*a backlash*) | HSK 4; 02; 16 |
| {无|wú}- wú | without, -less | {无关|wú guān} (unrelated), {无限|wú xiàn} (unlimited), {无数|wú shù} (countless), {无线|wú xiàn} (*wireless*), {无人|wú rén} (*unmanned*) | HSK 5; 16 |
| {亚|yà}- yà | second, sub- | {亚军|yà jūn} (runner-up), {亚健康|yà jiàn kāng} (*sub-health*) | 29; 16 |
| {准|zhǔn}- zhǔn | -to-be | {准妈妈|zhǔn mā ma} (*a mother-to-be*), {准大学生|zhǔn dà xué sheng} (*a student about to start university*) | 16 |
| {副|fù}- fù | deputy, vice- | {副|fù}{经理|jīng lǐ}, {副|fù}{主任|zhǔ rèn} | 01 |

Not every first character is a prefix. {无论|wú lùn} (no matter) and {无聊|wú liáo} (bored) are words of their own; {反正|fǎn zhèng}
(anyway) and {反而|fǎn ér} (on the contrary) are adverbs; {亚洲|Yà zhōu} (Asia) is a sound from an old foreign name; {准|zhǔn} in {准时|zhǔn shí}
and {准确|zhǔn què} is "accurate", and {准备|zhǔn bèi} is "to prepare".

## Suffixes

| Suffix | Meaning | Words | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| -{化|huà} huà | -ise, -ify: becoming so | {现代化|xiàn dài huà}, {数字化|shù zì huà}, {优化|yōu huà}, {绿化|lǜ huà}, {简化|jiǎn huà}, {智能化|zhì néng huà} (*becoming smart*) | HSK 5; 16; 18; 28 |
| -{式|shì} shì | -style, a way of | {正式|zhèng shì}, {方式|fāng shì}, {形式|xíng shì}, {模式|mó shì}; {中式|Zhōng shì} / {西式|xī shì} (*Chinese / Western style*), {自助式|zì zhù shì} (*self-service*), {新式|xīn shì} / {老式|lǎo shì} (*new / old style*) | HSK 4–5; 16; 20 |
| -{型|xíng} xíng | type, model | {大型|dà xíng}, {小型|xiǎo xíng}, {新型|xīn xíng}, {类型|lèi xíng}, {典型|diǎn xíng} | HSK 5; 27 |
| -{性|xìng} xìng | -ness, -ity | {个性|gè xìng}, {弹性|tán xìng}, {特性|tè xìng}; {可能性|kě néng xìng}, {重要性|zhòng yào xìng}, {安全性|ān quán xìng}, {积极性|jī jí xìng} (*possibility, importance, safety, enthusiasm*) | HSK 5; 20; 16 |
| -{率|lǜ} lǜ | rate, ratio | {效率|xiào lǜ}, {汇率|huì lǜ}, {频率|pín lǜ}, {概率|gài lǜ}; {成功率|chéng gōng lǜ}, {准确率|zhǔn què lǜ} (*success rate, accuracy rate*) | HSK 5; 16 |
| -{业|yè} yè | trade, industry | {服务|fú wù}{业|yè}, {农业|nóng yè}, {工业|gōng yè} | 01 |

Some words merely look like these. {变化|biàn huà} and {文化|wén huà} are old words in which {化|huà} isn't a living suffix;
{性格|xìng gé} (character) has {性|xìng} first. {率|shuài} is shuài in {率先|shuài xiān} and {率领|shuài lǐng}.

## Using the words

- A word with -{化|huà} can be a verb ({优化|yōu huà}{系统|xì tǒng}, to optimise the system) or a noun ({实现|shí xiàn}{数字化|shù zì huà}, to achieve
  digitalisation).
- Words with -{性|xìng} are nouns: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{的|de}{重要性|zhòng yào xìng} (the importance of this matter); with {很|hěn} you need the adjective
  instead ({这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{很|hěn}{重要|zhòng yào}).
- Words like {无线|wú xiàn} sort things into kinds and aren't graded: say {无线|wú xiàn}{网络|wǎng luò}, not ~~{很|hěn}{无线|wú xiàn}~~.
- New words follow the patterns: {超长|chāo cháng}{待机|dài jī} (an extra-long standby time), {美化|měi huà} (to beautify), {新式|xīn shì} (new-style).

language.name: Chinese
language.vocabSource: covers the words and characters of HSK 3.0 level 6 (2025 exam syllabus; 5,400 words and 1,940 characters with levels 1-5); grouping, glosses and examples are our own

vocab.note: yī when you count and inside numbers ({十一|shí yī}, eleven). Before other words its tone changes, and this app writes the change: {一|yí}{个|gè} (one, of something), {一起|yì qǐ} (together).
vocab.example: {一|yī}、{二|èr}、{三|sān}！
vocab.exampleEn: One, two, three!

vocab.note: For counting and inside numbers ({十二|shí èr}, twelve). Before a measure word Chinese says {两|liǎng} instead: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}, two people (Chinese HSK 1).
vocab.example: {一|yī}、{二|èr}、{三|sān}、{四|sì}、{五|wǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: One, two, three, four, five.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{是|shì}{三|sān}{个|gè}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are three of us.

vocab.note: Tens are built with it: {二十|èr shí} (20 = two tens), {十二|shí èr} (12 = ten and two).
vocab.example: {三|sān}{十|shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Thirty people.

vocab.note: After a country it gives the people: {中国|Zhōng guó}{人|rén}, a Chinese person, Chinese people.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm Chinese.

vocab.note: Also used for age: {你|nǐ}{多|duō}{大|dà}？ How old are you? (Chinese HSK 1). Its opposite is {小|xiǎo}.
vocab.example: {中国|Zhōng guó}{很|hěn}{大|dà}。
vocab.exampleEn: China is big.

vocab.note: Fourth tone, falling. Don't confuse it with {十|shí} (ten, rising): {四十四|sì shí sì} is 44.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{是|shì}{四|sì}{个|gè}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are four of us.

vocab.example: {五|wǔ}{个|gè}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Five people.

vocab.note: Spelled liù, a short form of liòu: you hear a light o before the u. The tone mark goes on the u.
vocab.example: {六|liù}{十|shí}{六|liù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Sixty-six.

vocab.note: q is said like the ch of "cheese", with a puff of air.
vocab.example: {七|qī}{月|yuè}。
vocab.exampleEn: July (the seventh month).

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{八|bā}{岁|suì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm eight (years old).

vocab.example: {九十九|jiǔ shí jiǔ}{个|gè}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Ninety-nine people.

vocab.note: To one person: a friend, a classmate, anyone your age. The polite form for older people and strangers is {您|nín} (Chinese HSK 1).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{是|shì}{王芳|Wáng Fāng}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Are you Wang Fang?

vocab.note: One word for "I" and "me": {我|wǒ} doesn't change.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{王芳|Wáng Fāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm Wang Fang.

vocab.note: Said ní hǎo (two third tones: the first rises). Answer with {你好|nǐ hǎo} too.
vocab.example: {你好|nǐ hǎo}，{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{王芳|Wáng Fāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Hello, I'm Wang Fang.

vocab.note: Alone it also means "OK, all right": {好|hǎo}！
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm fine. / I'm well.

vocab.note: bù, but bú before a fourth tone: {不|bú}{是|shì}, {不客气|bú kè qi}. This app writes the change; most dictionaries write bù everywhere.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{王芳|Wáng Fāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm not Wang Fang.

vocab.note: Links two nouns: A {是|shì} B. It never changes for I, you or they. Its negative is {不|bú}{是|shì}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm Chinese.

vocab.note: Before a surname it's a friendly way to address a younger person: {小|xiǎo}{王|Wáng}, "young Wang".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{狗|gǒu}{很|hěn}{小|xiǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: My dog is small.

vocab.note: Literally "middle country". A capital Z in pinyin, as for every name.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm Chinese. / I'm from China.

vocab.note: The second xie is light and short (neutral tone). Reply: {不客气|bú kè qi}.
vocab.example: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}！
vocab.exampleEn: Thank you!

vocab.note: The reply to {谢谢|xiè xie}. Literally "don't be so polite". 不 is bú here, before the fourth tone kè.
vocab.example: — {谢谢|xiè xie}！— {不客气|bú kè qi}。
vocab.exampleEn: — Thanks! — You're welcome.

vocab.note: An apology for something you did. The 不 in the middle is light (neutral tone). Reply: {没关系|méi guān xi}.
vocab.example: {对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{我|wǒ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{王芳|Wáng Fāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Sorry, I'm not Wang Fang.

vocab.note: The reply to {对不起|duì bu qǐ}. Literally "there's no connection".
vocab.example: — {对不起|duì bu qǐ}！— {没关系|méi guān xi}。
vocab.exampleEn: — Sorry! — That's all right.

vocab.note: Literally "again see". Two fourth tones: both fall.
vocab.example: {再见|zài jiàn}，{王芳|Wáng Fāng}！
vocab.exampleEn: Goodbye, Wang Fang!

vocab.note: Sounds the same as {她|tā} (she); only the writing differs: 亻 "person" here, 女 "woman" in 她.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's a teacher.

vocab.note: Sounds the same as {他|tā} (he). The radical 女 "woman" shows it means a woman.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{叫|jiào}{王芳|Wáng Fāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her name is Wang Fang.

vocab.note: For teachers, older people, customers and strangers; {你|nǐ} for friends and people your age.
vocab.example: {您|nín}{是|shì}{王老师|Wáng lǎo shī}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Are you Teacher Wang?

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{叫|jiào}{李明|Lǐ Míng}。
vocab.exampleEn: My name is Li Ming.

vocab.note: Stays where the answer goes: {你|nǐ}{叫|jiào}{什么|shén me}？ — {我|wǒ}{叫|jiào}{安娜|Ān nà}。 Second syllable neutral.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{叫|jiào}{什么|shén me}？
vocab.exampleEn: What's he called?

vocab.note: Second syllable neutral: míng zi.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{叫|jiào}{什么|shén me}{名字|míng zi}？
vocab.exampleEn: What's your name?

vocab.note: At the end of a statement, makes a yes-or-no question. Not used with question words such as {什么|shén me}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{是|shì}{学生|xué sheng}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Are you a student?

vocab.note: Before an adjective in a plain statement, usually unstressed: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo} is just "I'm fine".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{谢谢|xiè xie}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm fine, thanks.

vocab.note: Also a title after a family name: {王老师|Wáng lǎo shī}, Teacher Wang.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{不|bú}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: She isn't a teacher.

vocab.note: Second syllable neutral in mainland speech: xué sheng.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{学生|xué sheng}，{不|bú}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's a student, not a teacher.

vocab.note: Only for people, never after a number: {三|sān}{个|gè}{学生|xué sheng}, not 三个学生们.
vocab.example: {老师们|lǎo shī men}{好|hǎo}！
vocab.exampleEn: Hello, teachers!

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{学生|xué sheng}。
vocab.exampleEn: We're all students.

vocab.example: {你们|nǐ men}{是|shì}{哪|nǎ}{国|guó}{人|rén}？
vocab.exampleEn: Where are you all from?

vocab.note: Sounds the same as {她们|tā men} (they, all women). Used for any mixed group.
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{都|dōu}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{英语|Yīng yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: They can all speak English.

vocab.note: Only when everyone in the group is a woman; otherwise {他们|tā men}.
vocab.example: {她们|tā men}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: They're teachers.

vocab.note: In country names: {中国|Zhōng guó}, {美国|Měi guó}. {哪|nǎ}{国|guó}{人|rén}: a person of which country?
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{是|shì}{哪|nǎ}{国|guó}{人|rén}？
vocab.exampleEn: Where are you from?

vocab.note: Third tone. Don't confuse with {那|nà} (that), fourth tone.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{哪|nǎ}{国|guó}{人|rén}？
vocab.exampleEn: Where is he from? (Which country is he from?)

vocab.note: The usual word in classes and textbooks. {中文|Zhōng wén} means the same, especially written Chinese.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I can speak Chinese.

vocab.note: Used for the language in general and for written Chinese: a menu or a website in Chinese.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{也|yě}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{中文|Zhōng wén}。
vocab.exampleEn: She speaks Chinese too.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{说|shuō}{英语|Yīng yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: He speaks English.

vocab.note: A skill you have learned: {会|huì}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}. Also "will (probably)" later in the course.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can you speak Chinese?

vocab.note: After a noun or pronoun: {你|nǐ}{呢|ne}？ "And you?" Neutral tone.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{英国人|Yīng guó rén}，{你|nǐ}{呢|ne}？
vocab.exampleEn: I'm British. And you?

vocab.note: Before the verb, never at the end: {我|wǒ}{也|yě}{是|shì}{学生|xué sheng}. With {不|bù}: "not ... either".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{也|yě}{是|shì}{学生|xué sheng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm a student too.

vocab.note: After the plural subject, before the verb. With {也|yě}: {也|yě}{都|dōu}, never 都也.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{美国人|Měi guó rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: We're both American.

vocab.note: Negative {没有|méi yǒu}, never 不有. "There is" comes in lesson 17.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{哥哥|gē ge}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have an older brother.

vocab.note: The negative of {有|yǒu}. Later also "didn't" (lesson 25).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{没有|méi yǒu}{姐姐|jiě jie}。
vocab.exampleEn: I don't have an older sister.

vocab.note: Owner + {的|de} + thing: {老师|lǎo shī}{的|de}{名字|míng zi}. Usually dropped with family and home: {我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}{的|de}{名字|míng zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is the teacher's name.

vocab.note: Also said zhèi in speech, especially before a measure word.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is my mum.

vocab.note: Fourth tone. {哪|nǎ} (which) has the third tone. Also said nèi in speech.
vocab.example: {那|nà}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: That's our teacher.

vocab.note: Joins nouns and pronouns only, never sentences or verbs.
vocab.example: {爸爸|bà ba}{和|hé}{妈妈|mā ma}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Dad and Mum are both teachers.

vocab.note: No {的|de} after a pronoun: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}, my home or my family. Later also a measure word for shops and companies.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{家|jiā}{有|yǒu}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{人|rén}？
vocab.exampleEn: How many people are there in your family?

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{家人|jiā rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: These are my family.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: My dad is a teacher.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is my mum.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{哥哥|gē ge}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Do you have an older brother?

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{姐姐|jiě jie}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: My older sister speaks Chinese.

vocab.note: For a small number you expect, with a measure word: {几|jǐ}{个|gè}. For any number: {多少|duō shao}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{姐姐|jiě jie}？
vocab.exampleEn: How many older sisters do you have?

vocab.note: Between a number and a noun: {一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}. Often light in speech. {一|yī} becomes yí before it.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{有|yǒu}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are five people in my family.

vocab.note: Said once for each gap inside a number: {一千零五|yì qiān líng wǔ} (1,005).
vocab.example: {一百零五|yì bǎi líng wǔ}
vocab.exampleEn: one hundred and five

vocab.note: Always with a number in front: {一百|yì bǎi}, never 百 alone for 100.
vocab.example: {三百四十五|sān bǎi sì shí wǔ}
vocab.exampleEn: three hundred and forty-five

vocab.example: {两千零二十六|liǎng qiān líng èr shí liù}
vocab.exampleEn: two thousand and twenty-six

vocab.note: Before a measure word: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}. In counting and inside numbers it's {二|èr}: {十二|shí èr}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{妹妹|mèi mei}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have two younger sisters.

vocab.note: Age needs no {是|shì}: {我|wǒ}{二十|èr shí}{岁|suì}. Ask children {几岁|jǐ suì}, adults {多大|duō dà}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{女儿|nǚ ér}{六|liù}{岁|suì}。
vocab.exampleEn: My daughter is six.

vocab.note: Usually with {很|hěn}: {很多|hěn duō}{人|rén}. Before an adjective it asks "how": {多大|duō dà}, how old.
vocab.example: {中国|Zhōng guó}{有|yǒu}{很多|hěn duō}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: China has a lot of people.

vocab.note: For any number; the measure word is optional. {几|jǐ} is for small numbers and needs one.
vocab.example: {中国|Zhōng guó}{有|yǒu}{多少|duō shao}{人|rén}？
vocab.exampleEn: How many people does China have?

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{儿子|ér zi}{九|jiǔ}{岁|suì}。
vocab.exampleEn: My son is nine.

vocab.note: Both syllables keep their tones: nǚ ér.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{女儿|nǚ ér}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is my daughter.

vocab.example: {您|nín}{有|yǒu}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{孩子|hái zi}？
vocab.exampleEn: How many children do you have?

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{弟弟|dì di}{十五|shí wǔ}{岁|suì}。
vocab.exampleEn: My younger brother is fifteen.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{妹妹|mèi mei}{多大|duō dà}？
vocab.exampleEn: How old is your younger sister?

meanings: mouth (also: measure word for family members)
vocab.note: As a measure word for people, only for the size of a family: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{有|yǒu}{五|wǔ}{口|kǒu}{人|rén}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{家|jiā}{有|yǒu}{几|jǐ}{口|kǒu}{人|rén}？
vocab.exampleEn: How many people are there in your family?

vocab.note: Also before a verb, for where it happens: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{公司|gōng sī}{工作|gōng zuò}. Sounds like {再|zài} (again).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{在|zài}{家|jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: My mum is at home.

vocab.note: Verb and noun: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{大学|dà xué}{工作|gōng zuò} (I work at a university); {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{工作|gōng zuò}{吗|ma}？ (Do you have a job?)
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{公司|gōng sī}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He works for a company.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{医生|yī shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's a doctor.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{在|zài}{公司|gōng sī}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: My dad works for a company.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: We speak Chinese at school.

vocab.example: {王老师|Wáng lǎo shī}{在|zài}{大学|dà xué}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: Teacher Wang works at a university.

vocab.note: {生|shēng} keeps its first tone here, unlike {学生|xué sheng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{哥哥|gē ge}{是|shì}{大学生|dà xué shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: My older brother is a university student.

vocab.note: Before a noun: {男|nán}{老师|lǎo shī}, a male teacher. Not used alone as "a man".
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{老师|lǎo shī}{是|shì}{男|nán}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our Chinese teacher is a man.

vocab.note: Before a noun: {女|nǚ}{医生|yī shēng}, a female doctor. Not used alone as "a woman".
vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{女|nǚ}{医生|yī shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's a (female) doctor.

vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{星期一|xīng qī yī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Today is Monday.

vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{家|jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'll be at home tomorrow.

vocab.example: {昨天|zuó tiān}{星期天|xīng qī tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Yesterday was Sunday.

vocab.note: Counts without {个|gè}: {一天|yì tiān}, {两天|liǎng tiān}. Also "sky", as in {天气|tiān qì} (weather, lesson 20). Can be a measure word too.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{中国|Zhōng guó}{工作|gōng zuò}{三天|sān tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's working in China for three days.

vocab.note: Takes {个|gè} when counted: {两个星期|liǎng gè xīng qī}. Add {一|yī} to {六|liù} for Monday to Saturday: {星期一|xīng qī yī}, {星期六|xīng qī liù}.
vocab.example: {一个星期|yí gè xīng qī}{有|yǒu}{七天|qī tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: A week has seven days.

vocab.note: The written and more formal word, seen on calendars and timetables; in everyday speech {星期天|xīng qī tiān}.
vocab.example: {星期日|xīng qī rì}{学校|xué xiào}{没有|méi yǒu}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's nobody at the school on Sunday.

vocab.note: The everyday spoken word; {星期日|xīng qī rì} is the written one. There is no {星期七|xīng qī qī}.
vocab.example: {星期天|xīng qī tiān}{我|wǒ}{不|bù}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: I don't work on Sundays.

vocab.note: Month names are number + {月|yuè}: {一月|yī yuè} (January), {十二月|shí èr yuè} (December). "One month" is {一个月|yí gè yuè}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{十月|shí yuè}{不|bù}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm not working in October.

vocab.note: Number + {号|hào} in speech: {十六号|shí liù hào} (the 16th); writing uses {日|rì}. Also "number", as in {手机号|shǒu jī hào} (mobile number, lesson 10). Can be a measure word too.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{几号|jǐ hào}？
vocab.exampleEn: What's the date today?

vocab.note: Written and formal: 11{月|yuè}16{日|rì}. In speech, {号|hào}. As a noun, {日|rì} is also "sun".
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{是|shì}11{月|yuè}16{日|rì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Today is 16 November.

vocab.note: Counts without {个|gè}: {两年|liǎng nián}. Years are read digit by digit: 2026{年|nián}, èr líng èr liù nián.
vocab.example: {一年|yì nián}{有|yǒu}{十二个月|shí èr gè yuè}。
vocab.exampleEn: A year has twelve months.

vocab.note: Two o'clock is {两点|liǎng diǎn}. An amount of hours is {小时|xiǎo shí}. Also "a little" in {一点儿|yì diǎnr} (lesson 12).
vocab.example: {现在|xiàn zài}{几点|jǐ diǎn}？
vocab.exampleEn: What time is it?

vocab.note: Clock minutes: {八点十分|bā diǎn shí fēn} (8:10). An amount of minutes is {分钟|fēn zhōng}. Also a fen, a hundredth of a yuan.
vocab.example: {现在|xiàn zài}{九点二十分|jiǔ diǎn èr shí fēn}。

vocab.note: An amount of time, with no {个|gè}: {十分钟|shí fēn zhōng} (ten minutes). On the clock, {分|fēn}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{十分钟|shí fēn zhōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have ten minutes.

vocab.note: After the hour, half past: {八点半|bā diǎn bàn}. Half an hour: {半个小时|bàn gè xiǎo shí}.
vocab.example: {现在|xiàn zài}{七点半|qī diǎn bàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's half past seven.

vocab.note: Usually with {个|gè}: {两个小时|liǎng gè xiǎo shí} (two hours). Two o'clock is {两点|liǎng diǎn}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{一天|yì tiān}{工作|gōng zuò}{八个小时|bā gè xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: I work eight hours a day.

vocab.example: {现在|xiàn zài}{两点|liǎng diǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's two o'clock now.

vocab.note: Time you have or spend: {有时间|yǒu shí jiān} (to have time). To ask the clock time, use {几点|jǐ diǎn}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Do you have time?

vocab.note: The whole morning up to noon. Goes before the clock time: {上午|shàng wǔ}{十点|shí diǎn} (10 a.m.).
vocab.example: {王老师|Wáng lǎo shī}{上午|shàng wǔ}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Teacher Wang is at school in the morning.

vocab.note: Before the clock time: {下午|xià wǔ}{三点|sān diǎn} (3 p.m.).
vocab.example: {下午|xià wǔ}{三点|sān diǎn}{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{家|jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm at home at three in the afternoon.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{中午|zhōng wǔ}{在|zài}{公司|gōng sī}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm at the office at noon.

vocab.note: The early part of the morning, getting up and breakfast; {上午|shàng wǔ} is the whole morning until noon.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{早上|zǎo shang}{六点|liù diǎn}{起床|qǐ chuáng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I get up at six in the morning.

vocab.note: From about six until bedtime: {晚上|wǎn shang}{十一点|shí yī diǎn} is 11 p.m.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{晚上|wǎn shang}{在|zài}{家|jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm at home in the evening.

vocab.note: A separable verb: {起|qǐ} (rise) + {床|chuáng} (bed).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{几点|jǐ diǎn}{起床|qǐ chuáng}？
vocab.exampleEn: What time do you get up?

vocab.note: A separable verb: {睡|shuì} (sleep) + {觉|jiào} (a sleep), so no object follows it. "Sleep eight hours" uses {睡|shuì} alone (lesson 21).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{晚上|wǎn shang}{十一点|shí yī diǎn}{睡觉|shuì jiào}。
vocab.exampleEn: He goes to bed at eleven at night.

vocab.note: A separable verb: {上|shàng} (go on) + {班|bān} (a shift). The opposite is {下班|xià bān}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{八点|bā diǎn}{上班|shàng bān}。
vocab.exampleEn: I start work at eight.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{几点|jǐ diǎn}{下班|xià bān}？
vocab.exampleEn: What time do you finish work?

vocab.note: With {吃|chī} (to eat, lesson 11): {吃早饭|chī zǎo fàn}, to have breakfast.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{七点|qī diǎn}{吃|chī}{早饭|zǎo fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have breakfast at seven.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{公司|gōng sī}{吃|chī}{午饭|wǔ fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have lunch at the office.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{七点|qī diǎn}{吃|chī}{晚饭|wǎn fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We have dinner at seven.
