vocab.exampleEn: Listen, the birds outside are singing.

vocab.note: An adverb before the verb, often with {就|jiù}: {他|tā}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{画|huà}{画儿|huàr}. Compare {小时候|xiǎo shí hou} (then, in the past).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{鸟|niǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've loved birds ever since I was little.

vocab.note: A time word, before the verb: {我|wǒ}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}. It also takes {的|de}: {小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{的|de}{家|jiā} (my childhood home).
vocab.example: {小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{有|yǒu}{两只|liǎng zhī}{小|xiǎo}{鸟|niǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: When I was little we had two little birds at home.

meanings: auntie (a woman of your parents' age)
vocab.note: Family: your mother's sister. Outside the family, the friendly word for a woman of your parents' generation: {张阿姨|Zhāng ā yí}. Also a woman who helps at home.
vocab.example: {阿姨|ā yí}，{请问|qǐng wèn}{洗手间|xǐ shǒu jiān}{在|zài}{哪儿|nǎr}？
vocab.exampleEn: Excuse me (auntie), where's the toilet?

meanings: uncle (a man of your parents' age)
vocab.note: Family: your father's younger brother. Outside the family, the friendly word for a man of your parents' generation: {王叔叔|Wáng shū shu}. Second syllable light.
vocab.example: {王叔叔|Wáng shū shu}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{的|de}{老朋友|lǎo péng you}。
vocab.exampleEn: Uncle Wang is an old friend of my dad's.

vocab.note: {邻居|lín jū}{家|jiā}: the neighbours' home. {={邻|lín} has {令|lìng} as its sound part, as in {冷|lěng} and {零|líng}.=}
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{邻居|lín jū}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{医生|yī shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: My neighbour is a doctor.

vocab.note: Mainland usage: your husband or wife. Common with older speakers; younger ones often say {丈夫|zhàng fu} / {妻子|qī zi}. Light {人|rén}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{爱人|ài ren}，{她|tā}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is my wife; she's a teacher.

vocab.note: Both partners together: {他们|tā men}{是|shì}{夫妻|fū qī}. One partner is {爱人|ài ren}, {丈夫|zhàng fu} or {妻子|qī zi}.
vocab.example: {王叔叔|Wáng shū shu}{和|hé}{张阿姨|Zhāng ā yí}{是|shì}{夫妻|fū qī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Uncle Wang and Auntie Zhang are husband and wife.

vocab.note: {姐姐|jiě jie} + {妹妹|mèi mei}. {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{姐妹|jiě mèi}{吗|ma}？ Do you have any sisters?
vocab.example: {她们|tā men}{是|shì}{姐妹|jiě mèi}，{姐姐|jiě jie}{是|shì}{医生|yī shēng}，{妹妹|mèi mei}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: They're sisters; the older one is a doctor and the younger one a teacher.

vocab.note: The opposite of {孩子|hái zi}, said mostly where children are part of the picture. Light {人|rén}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{大人|dà ren}{和|hé}{孩子|hái zi}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}。
vocab.exampleEn: Adults and children both like this film.

vocab.note: {老|lǎo} (old) + {人|rén}. Polite in speech: {老人家|lǎo rén jiā}.
vocab.example: {小区|xiǎo qū}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{老人|lǎo rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of old people in the compound.

vocab.note: The general word. To point someone out, people often say {那个|nà ge}{男|nán}{的|de}; to address a man, {先生|xiān sheng} or {叔叔|shū shu}.
vocab.example: {门口|mén kǒu}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{男人|nán rén}{在|zài}{等|děng}{你|nǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a man waiting for you at the door.

vocab.note: The general word. To address a woman, use {女士|nǚ shì} or {阿姨|ā yí}, never {女人|nǚ rén}.
vocab.example: {那个|nà ge}{女人|nǚ rén}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: That woman is my teacher.

vocab.note: Only for people; "other (things)" is {别的|bié de}. {别人|bié ren}{的|de}: someone else's. Light {人|rén}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{别人|bié ren}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}，{不|bú}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is someone else's phone, not mine.

vocab.note: Always includes the listener; {我们|wǒ men} may or may not. Spoken, most common in the north.
vocab.example: {咱们|zán men}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{吧|ba}！
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go and eat together!

vocab.note: A group of apartment buildings with its own gate: {咱们|zán men}{小区|xiǎo qū}, {小区|xiǎo qū}{门口|mén kǒu}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{小区|xiǎo qū}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{超市|chāo shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a supermarket in our compound.

meanings: suffix for a member or staff
vocab.note: Never a word alone: {服务员|fú wù yuán} (waiter), {店员|diàn yuán} (shop assistant), {运动员|yùn dòng yuán} (athlete).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{这个|zhè ge}{饭店|fàn diàn}{的|de}{服务员|fú wù yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's a waiter at this restaurant.

vocab.note: Light zi, usually without a meaning of its own: {桌子|zhuō zi}, {房子|fáng zi}, {箱子|xiāng zi}. With a full tone, {子|zǐ}, it means "child" or "master", as in {孔子|Kǒng zǐ} (Confucius).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{杯子|bēi zi}{是|shì}{谁|shéi}{的|de}？
vocab.exampleEn: Whose cup is this?

vocab.note: Of people and relationships: {老人|lǎo rén}, {老朋友|lǎo péng you}, {他|tā}{老|lǎo}{了|le}. As a prefix before a family name, friendly: {老王|Lǎo Wáng}. Old things are usually {旧|jiù}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{是|shì}{老朋友|lǎo péng you}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: We're old friends.

vocab.note: {名|míng} (name, fame) + {人|rén}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{名人|míng rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's a local celebrity.

meanings: house (or flat: the home as a whole)
vocab.note: The home as a whole, and property: {买|mǎi}{房子|fáng zi} (to buy a flat). One room is {房间|fáng jiān} or {屋子|wū zi}.
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{去年|qù nián}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{房子|fáng zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: They bought a flat last year.

vocab.note: Heard most in the north. {房间|fáng jiān} is the standard word (and the only one for hotels).
vocab.example: {屋子|wū zi}{里|lǐ}{很|hěn}{热|rè}，{咱们|zán men}{出去|chū qù}{走走|zǒu zou}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's hot indoors; let's go out for a walk.

vocab.note: Furniture, boxes, a fridge: {搬|bān}{桌子|zhuō zi}. With direction complements: {搬|bān}{上去|shàng qù}, {搬|bān}{进来|jìn lái}. Same sound as {班|bān}; {半|bàn} falls.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{搬|bān}{一下|yí xià}{这个|zhè ge}{桌子|zhuō zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please help me move this table.

vocab.note: Separable: {搬|bān}{了|le}{三|sān}{次|cì}{家|jiā} (moved three times). Where to: {搬|bān}{到|dào} + place.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{下个月|xià gè yuè}{搬家|bān jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: We're moving next month.

vocab.note: Counts floors and says which one: {这个|zhè ge}{楼|lóu}{有|yǒu}{二十|èr shí}{层|céng}; {我|wǒ}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{十二|shí èr}{层|céng} (= {十二|shí èr}{楼|lóu}). Also layers: {两|liǎng}{层|céng}{衣服|yī fu}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{住|zhù}{几|jǐ}{层|céng}？
vocab.exampleEn: Which floor do you live on?

vocab.note: "Electric ladder." {坐|zuò}{电梯|diàn tī}: to take the lift. Escalators are often called {电梯|diàn tī} too.
vocab.example: {电梯|diàn tī}{坏|huài}{了|le}，{咱们|zán men}{走|zǒu}{楼梯|lóu tī}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: The lift's broken; let's take the stairs.

vocab.note: {走|zǒu}{楼梯|lóu tī}: to take the stairs (up or down).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每天|měi tiān}{走|zǒu}{楼梯|lóu tī}{上去|shàng qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: I walk up the stairs every day.

vocab.note: A sound loan of English "sofa". {坐|zuò}{在|zài}{沙发|shā fā}{上|shàng}: sit on the sofa.
vocab.example: {晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{在|zài}{沙发|shā fā}{上|shàng}{看|kàn}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the evening I like reading on the sofa.

vocab.note: "Ice box": {冰|bīng} (ice) + {箱|xiāng} (box). {在|zài}{冰箱|bīng xiāng}{里|lǐ}: in the fridge.
vocab.example: {冰箱|bīng xiāng}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{牛奶|niú nǎi}{和|hé}{鸡蛋|jī dàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's milk and eggs in the fridge.

vocab.note: {洗|xǐ} (wash) + {衣|yī} (clothes) + {机|jī} (machine), as in {手机|shǒu jī}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{的|de}{洗衣机|xǐ yī jī}{很|hěn}{旧|jiù}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our washing machine is quite old.

vocab.note: {开|kāi}{空调|kōng tiáo}: to turn on the air conditioning. {调|tiáo} is tiáo here.
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{太|tài}{热|rè}{了|le}，{开|kāi}{空调|kōng tiáo}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's too hot; let's put the air conditioning on.

vocab.note: {开|kāi}{灯|dēng}: switch on the light. Same sound as {登|dēng} (climb); {等|děng} (to wait) dips.
vocab.example: {房间|fáng jiān}{里|lǐ}{太|tài}{黑|hēi}{了|le}，{开|kāi}{灯|dēng}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's too dark in the room; switch the light on.

vocab.note: {坐车|zuò chē}{很|hěn}{方便|fāng biàn} (getting about is easy). Asking if a time suits: {你|nǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{方便|fāng biàn}{吗|ma}？ {便|biàn} is biàn here, pián in {便宜|pián yi}.
vocab.example: {小区|xiǎo qū}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{超市|chāo shì}，{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{很|hěn}{方便|fāng biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a supermarket in the compound, so shopping is easy.

vocab.note: For places and people: {请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{安静|ān jìng}{一下|yí xià}！ (Quiet please, everyone!)
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{小区|xiǎo qū}{很|hěn}{安静|ān jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our compound is very quiet.

vocab.note: The opposite of {新|xīn}: {旧|jiù}{衣服|yī fu}, {旧|jiù}{房子|fáng zi}. Old people and old friends are {老|lǎo}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{太|tài}{旧|jiù}{了|le}，{买|mǎi}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{新|xīn}{的|de}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: This piece of clothing is too worn; buy a new one.

vocab.note: The room with the toilet, basin and shower. In public, signs often say {洗手间|xǐ shǒu jiān}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{卫生间|wèi shēng jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our flat has two bathrooms.

vocab.note: For places: {打扫|dǎ sǎo}{房间|fáng jiān}. Clothes and dishes are washed: {洗|xǐ}. Two third tones: said dá sǎo.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{打扫|dǎ sǎo}{一|yí}{次|cì}{房间|fáng jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: I clean my room once a week.

vocab.note: {扫|sǎo}{地|dì}: to sweep the floor ({地|dì}, ground, is lesson 11's). Doubled: {扫|sǎo}{一|yi}{扫|sǎo}.
vocab.example: {吃|chī}{完|wán}{饭|fàn}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{他|tā}{扫|sǎo}{地|dì}，{我|wǒ}{洗碗|xǐ wǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: After the meal he sweeps the floor and I wash up.

vocab.note: An adjective, not a verb: {房间|fáng jiān}{很|hěn}{干净|gān jìng}. As a result complement: {洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng}, {打扫|dǎ sǎo}{干净|gān jìng}. {=Traditional 乾淨 (乾, dry), not 幹 (to do).=}
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{碗|wǎn}{洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've washed the bowls clean.

vocab.note: The opposite of {干净|gān jìng}: {脏|zāng}{衣服|yī fu} (dirty clothes). First tone; not zhāng.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{鞋|xié}{很|hěn}{脏|zāng}，{别|bié}{进来|jìn lái}！
vocab.exampleEn: Your shoes are filthy; don't come in!

vocab.note: Almost always with {在|zài} + place: {放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}, often in a {把|bǎ} sentence. Also in {放学|fàng xué} (school is out) and {放心|fàng xīn} (to be at ease).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{书|shū}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please put the books on the table.

vocab.note: The opposite of {开|kāi}: {关|guān}{门|mén}, {关|guān}{灯|dēng}, {关|guān}{空调|kōng tiáo}. {关上|guān shàng}: to shut.
vocab.example: {走|zǒu}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{灯|dēng}{关|guān}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please switch off the light when you leave.

meanings: to take a bath or shower
vocab.note: Separable: {洗|xǐ}{个|gè}{澡|zǎo} (have a quick shower), {洗|xǐ}{了|le}{澡|zǎo}. Two third tones: said xí zǎo.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每天|měi tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{洗澡|xǐ zǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have a shower every evening.

vocab.note: {牙|yá} (tooth) + {刷|shuā} (brush). Counted with {个|gè} or {把|bǎ}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{牙刷|yá shuā}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: My toothbrush has gone!

vocab.note: {刷|shuā}{牙|yá}: to brush your teeth. {刷|shuā}{卡|kǎ}: to pay by card ({卡|kǎ}, card: lesson 09).
vocab.example: {睡觉|shuì jiào}{以前|yǐ qián}{要|yào}{刷牙|shuā yá}。
vocab.exampleEn: Brush your teeth before you go to bed.

vocab.note: Also a measure word: {一|yì}{碗|wǎn}{米饭|mǐ fàn} (a bowl of rice). {洗碗|xǐ wǎn}: to wash up. Same sound as {晚|wǎn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{吃|chī}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{碗|wǎn}{米饭|mǐ fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He ate two bowls of rice.

vocab.note: Dishes of food are served on {盘子|pán zi}; rice is eaten from a {碗|wǎn}.
vocab.example: {桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{盘子|pán zi}{和|hé}{碗|wǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of plates and bowls on the table.

vocab.note: {空瓶子|kōng píng zi}: an empty bottle. {瓶|píng} is also a measure word: {一|yì}{瓶|píng}{水|shuǐ} (a bottle of water).
vocab.example: {把|bǎ}{这些|zhè xiē}{空瓶子|kōng píng zi}{丢|diū}{了|le}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Throw these empty bottles away.

vocab.note: The person loses the thing: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{手机|shǒu jī}{丢|diū}{了|le}. The thing itself {不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}. Also "to throw away".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{钱包|qián bāo}{丢|diū}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've lost my wallet.

meanings: measure word for things with a handle
vocab.note: Brings a particular object before the verb: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{碗|wǎn}{洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng}{了|le}; something must follow the verb. As a measure word: {一|yì}{把|bǎ}{椅子|yǐ zi}, {一|yì}{把|bǎ}{伞|sǎn}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{门|mén}{关|guān}{上|shàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please shut the door.

vocab.note: {冰箱|bīng xiāng} is an "ice box". A suitcase for travel is also {箱子|xiāng zi}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{箱子|xiāng zi}{太|tài}{重|zhòng}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{搬|bān}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: This box is too heavy; let's carry it together.

vocab.note: With {了|le}: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钥匙|yào shi}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le} (my keys have gone). Also "not see": {好久不见|hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn}！ (long time no see).
vocab.example: {刚才|gāng cái}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{还|hái}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}，{现在|xiàn zài}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: My phone was here a moment ago, and now it's gone.

vocab.note: Light duo. {耳朵|ěr duo}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}: hard of hearing.
vocab.example: {小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{的|de}{耳朵|ěr duo}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The puppy has long ears.

vocab.note: Third tone; {叫|jiào} (to be called) falls. The leg is {腿|tuǐ}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{走|zǒu}{了|le}{一|yì}{天|tiān}，{脚|jiǎo}{很|hěn}{疼|téng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've been walking all day and my feet hurt.

vocab.note: {她|tā}{脸|liǎn}{很|hěn}{小|xiǎo} (she has a small face). {洗|xǐ}{脸|liǎn}: to wash your face.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{脸|liǎn}{很|hěn}{红|hóng}，{好像|hǎo xiàng}{喝|hē}{酒|jiǔ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: His face is red; he seems to have been drinking.

vocab.note: The whole leg; the foot is {脚|jiǎo}. {他|tā}{腿|tuǐ}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}: he has long legs.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{腿|tuǐ}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}，{跑|pǎo}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has long legs and runs fast.

vocab.note: The mouth you see. {口|kǒu} is "mouth" in fixed words ({门口|mén kǒu}) and a measure word. Third tone; {最|zuì} falls.
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{的|de}{嘴|zuǐ}{小小|xiǎo xiǎo}{的|de}，{很|hěn}{可爱|kě ài}。
vocab.exampleEn: The child has a cute little mouth.

vocab.note: {刷|shuā}{牙|yá}: to brush your teeth. {我|wǒ}{牙|yá}{疼|téng}: I've got toothache.
vocab.example: {睡觉|shuì jiào}{以前|yǐ qián}{要|yào}{刷牙|shuā yá}。
vocab.exampleEn: You should brush your teeth before bed.

vocab.note: Usually no measure word (never {个|gè}): {她|tā}{的|de}{头发|tóu fa}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}. Light fa. {=Traditional 頭髮 (hair), not 發.=}
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{妹妹|mèi mei}{的|de}{头发|tóu fa}{很|hěn}{短|duǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: My younger sister has very short hair.

vocab.note: The measurement, on forms and in descriptions: {身高|shēn gāo}1.75{米|mǐ}, said {一米七五|yì mǐ qī wǔ}. Build is {个子|gè zi}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{身高|shēn gāo}{多少|duō shao}？
vocab.exampleEn: How tall are you?

vocab.note: Blunt about adults; a compliment for babies: {胖胖|pàng pàng}{的|de}. The opposite is {瘦|shòu}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{孩子|hái zi}{胖胖|pàng pàng}{的|de}，{真|zhēn}{可爱|kě ài}！
vocab.exampleEn: This child is nice and chubby; how sweet!

vocab.note: {你|nǐ}{瘦|shòu}{了|le}！ (You've lost weight!) is usually meant kindly. Falling tone; {手|shǒu} (hand) dips.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{好像|hǎo xiàng}{瘦|shòu}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: You seem to have lost weight.

vocab.note: For height: people, buildings, tables. Length is {短|duǎn}. Third tone; {爱|ài} falls.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{哥哥|gē ge}{矮|ǎi}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm a bit shorter than my brother.

vocab.note: For adults: {年轻人|nián qīng rén} (young people). A child is {小|xiǎo}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{妈妈|mā ma}{真|zhēn}{年轻|nián qīng}！
vocab.exampleEn: Your mum looks so young!

vocab.note: Children, small animals, anything sweet: {这个|zhè ge}{孩子|hái zi}{真|zhēn}{可爱|kě ài}！
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{家|jiā}{的|de}{小|xiǎo}{猫|māo}{真|zhēn}{可爱|kě ài}！
vocab.exampleEn: Your kitten is so cute!

vocab.note: Resemblance: {你|nǐ}{很|hěn}{像|xiàng}{你|nǐ}{妈妈|mā ma}. A {像|xiàng} B {一样|yí yàng} + adjective: as … as B. For "seem", use {好像|hǎo xiàng}. Also a noun, "likeness".
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{孩子|hái zi}{很|hěn}{像|xiàng}{他|tā}{爸爸|bà ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: This child looks a lot like his dad.

vocab.note: An impression from what you see: {他|tā}{好像|hǎo xiàng}{病|bìng}{了|le}. Before the verb or adjective, or at the start: {好像|hǎo xiàng}{要|yào}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {外面|wài miàn}{好像|hǎo xiàng}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: It looks as if it's raining outside.

vocab.note: A {跟|gēn} B {一样|yí yàng} (+ adjective): {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{她|tā}{一样|yí yàng}{高|gāo}. No {很|hěn} before the adjective. Negative: {不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{跟|gēn}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{一样|yí yàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: My phone is the same as yours.

vocab.note: More formal than {不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}; most at home before a noun: {不同|bù tóng}{的|de}{颜色|yán sè}. {不|bù} stays bù before the rising tone.
vocab.example: {不同|bù tóng}{的|de}{人|rén}{有|yǒu}{不同|bù tóng}{的|de}{习惯|xí guàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Different people have different habits.

vocab.note: Length and time: {短|duǎn}{头发|tóu fa}, {时间|shí jiān}{很|hěn}{短|duǎn}. Height is {矮|ǎi}. The opposite is {长|cháng}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{头发|tóu fa}{很|hěn}{短|duǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her hair is very short.

meanings: a cold (also: to catch a cold)
vocab.note: Noun and verb: {我|wǒ}{感冒|gǎn mào}{了|le} (I've caught a cold), {感冒药|gǎn mào yào} (cold medicine).
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{冷|lěng}{了|le}，{小心|xiǎo xīn}{感冒|gǎn mào}！
vocab.exampleEn: It's getting cold; be careful not to catch a cold!

vocab.note: Verb + object, like {睡觉|shuì jiào}: {发烧|fā shāo}{了|le}, {发高烧|fā gāo shāo} (a high fever). Degrees: {三十九|sān shí jiǔ}{度|dù}. Traditional 發燒.
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{发烧|fā shāo}{了|le}，{三十八|sān shí bā}{度|dù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The child has a temperature of 38 degrees.

vocab.note: Separable: {住|zhù}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{院|yuàn} (was in hospital for three days). Leaving is {出院|chū yuàn}.
vocab.example: {爷爷|yé ye}{病|bìng}{了|le}，{现在|xiàn zài}{在|zài}{住院|zhù yuàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandpa is ill and in hospital now.

vocab.note: The opposite of {住院|zhù yuàn}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{明天|míng tiān}{就|jiù}{可以|kě yǐ}{出院|chū yuàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: She can leave hospital tomorrow.

vocab.note: {病|bìng} + {人|rén}, like {老人|lǎo rén}.
vocab.example: {医院|yī yuàn}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{病人|bìng rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of patients in the hospital.

vocab.note: Adjective and noun: {身体|shēn tǐ}{很|hěn}{健康|jiàn kāng} (in good health), {健康|jiàn kāng}{很|hěn}{重要|zhòng yào} (health matters).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{七十|qī shí}{多|duō}{岁|suì}{了|le}，{身体|shēn tǐ}{很|hěn}{健康|jiàn kāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: My grandpa is over seventy and very healthy.

vocab.note: {锻炼|duàn liàn}{身体|shēn tǐ}: to keep fit. Traditional 鍛鍊 (the Taiwan form; 鍛煉 also exists).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每天|měi tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{锻炼|duàn liàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: I exercise for an hour every morning.

vocab.note: {给|gěi} + person + {检查|jiǎn chá}: {医生|yī shēng}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{检查|jiǎn chá}{了|le}{一下|yí xià}. Also a noun: a check-up.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{再|zài}{检查|jiǎn chá}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please check it once more.

vocab.note: With a verb: keep doing it: {坚持|jiān chí}{锻炼|duàn liàn}, {坚持|jiān chí}{每天|měi tiān}{跑步|pǎo bù}.
vocab.example: {学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{要|yào}{坚持|jiān chí}，{每天|měi tiān}{学|xué}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: With Chinese you have to keep at it, a little every day.

vocab.note: A warning before a danger or a verb: {小心|xiǎo xīn}{车|chē}！ {小心|xiǎo xīn}{感冒|gǎn mào}. {路上|lù shang}{小心|xiǎo xīn}！ (take care on the way). Also an adjective: careful.
vocab.example: {小心|xiǎo xīn}！{车|chē}{来|lái}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: Look out! There's a car coming!

vocab.note: {注意|zhù yì}{身体|shēn tǐ} (look after yourself), {注意|zhù yì}{休息|xiū xi}, {请|qǐng}{注意|zhù yì} (attention please). Same first syllable as {住院|zhù yuàn}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{要|yào}{注意|zhù yì}{休息|xiū xi}。
vocab.exampleEn: You must make sure you get some rest.

vocab.note: No need: {你|nǐ}{不用|bú yòng}{担心|dān xīn}; {不用谢|bú yòng xiè}！ (you're welcome). "Don't" is {别|bié} or {不要|bú yào}. {不|bù} is bú here.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{是|shì}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}，{不用|bú yòng}{上班|shàng bān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Tomorrow's Saturday; no need to go to work.

vocab.note: The object follows directly: {妈妈|mā ma}{很|hěn}{担心|dān xīn}{你|nǐ}; also a clause: {我|wǒ}{担心|dān xīn}{明天|míng tiān}{会|huì}{下雨|xià yǔ}. {别|bié}{担心|dān xīn}！ Don't worry!
vocab.example: {别|bié}{担心|dān xīn}，{我|wǒ}{没事|méi shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't worry, I'm fine.

vocab.note: Patients, children, old people, guests. {照顾|zhào gù}{好|hǎo}{自己|zì jǐ}: take good care of yourself. {顾|gù} is taught in lesson 06.
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{病|bìng}{了|le}，{她|tā}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{照顾|zhào gù}{孩子|hái zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The child is ill, so she's at home looking after them.

vocab.note: {蛋|dàn} (egg) + {糕|gāo} (cake). Counted with {个|gè} or, for a slice, {块|kuài}: {一|yí}{块|kuài}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{个|gè}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{太|tài}{大|dà}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{吃不完|chī bu wán}。
vocab.exampleEn: This cake is too big; we can't finish it.

vocab.note: Also written {冰淇淋|bīng qí lín}, just as common. {冰|bīng} is ice; {激凌|jī líng} is usually explained as a borrowing of the sound of "cream".
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{吃|chī}{冰激凌|bīng jī líng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Children all love ice cream.

vocab.note: "Convenient noodles": {方便|fāng biàn} (convenient) + noodles. Traditional 方便麵: 麵 is the noodle sense.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{太|tài}{忙|máng}{了|le}，{晚饭|wǎn fàn}{吃|chī}{了|le}{方便面|fāng biàn miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I was too busy; I had instant noodles for dinner.

vocab.note: "Western melon". Two level tones. Bought whole ({一|yí}{个|gè}{西瓜|xī guā}), by halves, or by the {斤|jīn}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{个|gè}{西瓜|xī guā}{很|hěn}{甜|tián}，{你|nǐ}{尝尝|cháng chang}。
vocab.exampleEn: This watermelon is very sweet. Have a taste.

vocab.note: Two level tones. Counted with {个|gè}; at the market sold by the {斤|jīn}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{斤|jīn}{香蕉|xiāng jiāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: I bought two jin (a kilo) of bananas.

vocab.note: Both sugar ({加|jiā}{糖|táng}, add sugar: lesson 07) and sweets ({一|yí}{块|kuài}{糖|táng}, a sweet).
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{不要|bú yào}{吃|chī}{太|tài}{多|duō}{糖|táng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Children shouldn't eat too many sweets.

vocab.note: Rising tone; {天|tiān} (day, sky) is level. An adjective: {很|hěn}{甜|tián}, {不|bú}{太|tài}{甜|tián}, {太|tài}{甜|tián}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{不|bú}{太|tài}{甜|tián}，{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}。
vocab.exampleEn: The cakes here aren't too sweet; I like them a lot.

vocab.note: Often doubled: {尝尝|cháng chang}, {尝|cháng}{一|yi}{尝|cháng}, or {尝|cháng}{一下|yí xià}. Rising tone, like {常|cháng} and {长|cháng}; {唱|chàng} (sing) falls. Traditional 嘗 (嚐 is also seen in Taiwan).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{尝尝|cháng chang}{这|zhè}{个|gè}{菜|cài}，{好吃|hǎo chī}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Taste this dish. Is it good?

vocab.note: An adjective: {我|wǒ}{饿|è}{了|le} (I'm hungry; I've got hungry), {有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{饿|è}. No {是|shì}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{饿|è}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm hungry; let's go and eat.

vocab.note: Mostly after {吃|chī} as a result: {吃饱|chī bǎo}{了|le} (I'm full), {吃不饱|chī bu bǎo} (can't get enough to eat). Third tone; {包|bāo} is level.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{吃饱|chī bǎo}{了|le}，{谢谢|xiè xie}{阿姨|ā yí}！
vocab.exampleEn: I'm full, thank you (to an older woman)!

vocab.note: Sounds like {可|kě}. The water radical 氵; {喝|hē} (drink) has 口 instead. Also {口渴|kǒu kě}.
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{太|tài}{热|rè}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{渴|kě}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's too hot; I'm really thirsty.

vocab.note: For food and air: {新鲜|xīn xiān}{的|de}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}, {新鲜|xīn xiān}{的|de}{空气|kōng qì} (fresh air). Two level tones.
vocab.example: {早上|zǎo shang}{的|de}{菜|cài}{最|zuì}{新鲜|xīn xiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: The vegetables are freshest in the morning.

vocab.note: Mostly a noun: {点|diǎn}{外卖|wài mài} / {叫|jiào}{外卖|wài mài} (order a takeaway), {送|sòng}{外卖|wài mài} (deliver), {外卖员|wài mài yuán} (delivery rider). Also a verb, of a restaurant: to sell food to take away.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{不|bú}{做饭|zuò fàn}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{点|diǎn}{外卖|wài mài}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's not cook today; let's order a takeaway.

vocab.note: A weight of 500 g in mainland China; {公斤|gōng jīn} (lesson 07) is the kilogram. Prices: {五|wǔ}{块|kuài}{钱|qián}{一|yì}{斤|jīn}. Level tone; {近|jìn} falls.
vocab.example: {苹果|píng guǒ}{多少|duō shao}{钱|qián}{一|yì}{斤|jīn}？
vocab.exampleEn: How much is a jin of apples?

vocab.note: Any alcoholic drink: {喝|hē}{酒|jiǔ} (drink alcohol), {啤酒|pí jiǔ} (beer). Sounds like {九|jiǔ}; {就|jiù} falls.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{开车|kāi chē}，{不能|bù néng}{喝|hē}{酒|jiǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm driving, so I can't drink.

vocab.note: {啤|pí} was made for the sound of "beer". Counted by the bottle or glass: {一|yì}{瓶|píng}{啤酒|pí jiǔ}, {一|yì}{杯|bēi}{啤酒|pí jiǔ}.
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{热|rè}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{喝|hē}{啤酒|pí jiǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: When it's hot, lots of people like drinking beer.

vocab.note: The general word for something to drink, as on a menu. {饮|yǐn} is the written "drink"; the spoken verb is {喝|hē}.
vocab.example: {你们|nǐ men}{要|yào}{什么|shén me}{饮料|yǐn liào}？
vocab.exampleEn: What would you like to drink?

vocab.note: {矿|kuàng} (mineral) + {泉|quán} (spring) + {水|shuǐ}: the usual word for bottled water. {一|yì}{瓶|píng}{矿泉水|kuàng quán shuǐ}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{一|yì}{瓶|píng}{矿泉水|kuàng quán shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: A bottle of mineral water, please.

vocab.note: Already has its object: {今天|jīn tiān}{我|wǒ}{请客|qǐng kè}. To name the person, use {请|qǐng}: {我|wǒ}{请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{吃饭|chī fàn} (never {请客|qǐng kè} + person).
vocab.example: {上|shàng}{次|cì}{你|nǐ}{请客|qǐng kè}，{今天|jīn tiān}{我|wǒ}{请|qǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: You paid last time; today it's on me.

meanings: to be a guest (at someone's home)
vocab.note: Usually {去|qù} / {到|dào} + someone + {家|jiā}{做客|zuò kè}.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{我|wǒ}{去|qù}{老师|lǎo shī}{家|jiā}{做客|zuò kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: Tomorrow I'm visiting my teacher at home.

vocab.note: A guest at home, and a customer in a shop or restaurant. {人|rén} keeps its rising tone.
vocab.example: {客人|kè rén}{来|lái}{了|le}，{快|kuài}{开门|kāi mén}！
vocab.exampleEn: The guests are here. Open the door, quick!

vocab.note: One {公斤|gōng jīn} is two {斤|jīn}. {公|gōng} marks the metric unit.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{个|gè}{西瓜|xī guā}{有|yǒu}{五|wǔ}{公斤|gōng jīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This watermelon weighs five kilos.

vocab.note: Light {不|bu}. Before an adjective "about as…" ({差不多|chà bu duō}{高|gāo}), before a number "almost" ({差不多|chà bu duō}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}), alone "about right" ({差不多|chà bu duō}{了|le}).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{和|hé}{姐姐|jiě jie}{差不多|chà bu duō}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: My sister and I are about the same height.

vocab.note: Spoken, like {很|hěn}{多|duō}, straight before a noun: {好多|hǎo duō}{人|rén}. Not {好|hǎo}{多|duō}{了|le} (much better), which is a comparison.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{超市|chāo shì}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{好多|hǎo duō}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are loads of people in the supermarket today.

vocab.note: Sounds like {家|jiā}. {加|jiā}{糖|táng} (add sugar), {加|jiā}{一|yí}{个|gè}{菜|cài} (order one more dish), {一|yī}{加|jiā}{一|yī} (one plus one).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{咖啡|kā fēi}{加|jiā}{糖|táng}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Do you take sugar in your coffee?

vocab.note: {菜|cài} (dish) + {单|dān} (list). {买单|mǎi dān} is "the bill, please".
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{看看|kàn kan}{菜单|cài dān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Could we see the menu, please?

vocab.note: A pair is {一|yì}{双|shuāng}{筷子|kuài zi} ({双|shuāng}: lesson 08). Don't stand them upright in rice.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{筷子|kuài zi}{呢|ne}？
vocab.exampleEn: Where are my chopsticks?

vocab.note: Measure word {把|bǎ}: {一|yì}{把|bǎ}{勺子|sháo zi}. Rising tone; {少|shǎo} (few) dips.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{要|yào}{一|yì}{把|bǎ}{勺子|sháo zi}，{谢谢|xiè xie}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like a spoon, please.

vocab.note: A long, warm coat: "big garment". Measure word {件|jiàn}.
vocab.example: {外面|wài miàn}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{穿|chuān}{上|shàng}{大衣|dà yī}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's cold outside; put your coat on.

vocab.note: A shirt with buttons, for men or women. Measure word {件|jiàn}. Two retroflex sounds: ch, sh.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{今天|jīn tiān}{穿|chuān}{了|le}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{白|bái}{衬衫|chèn shān}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's wearing a white shirt today.

vocab.note: "Short trousers": {短|duǎn} + {裤|kù}. Measure word {条|tiáo}.
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{太|tài}{热|rè}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{穿|chuān}{短裤|duǎn kù}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's too hot; I'm wearing shorts.

vocab.note: Both a skirt and a dress. Measure word {条|tiáo}: {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{裙子|qún zi}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{裙子|qún zi}{又|yòu}{便宜|pián yi}{又|yòu}{漂亮|piào liang}。
vocab.exampleEn: This skirt is cheap and pretty.

vocab.note: Anything worn above the waist; on labels often a jacket. Measure word {件|jiàn}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{上衣|shàng yī}{和|hé}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{裙子|qún zi}{很|hěn}{合适|hé shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This top goes well with your skirt.

vocab.note: A pair: {一|yì}{双|shuāng}{鞋|xié}; one shoe: {一|yì}{只|zhī}{鞋|xié}. Rising tone; {写|xiě} dips, {谢|xiè} falls.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{穿|chuān}{多|duō}{大|dà}{的|de}{鞋|xié}？
vocab.exampleEn: What size shoes do you take?

vocab.note: "Rain garment". Measure word {件|jiàn}.
vocab.example: {下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{你|nǐ}{穿|chuān}{雨衣|yǔ yī}{去|qù}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's raining; wear your raincoat.

vocab.note: For things that come in pairs: {一|yì}{双|shuāng}{鞋|xié}, {一|yì}{双|shuāng}{筷子|kuài zi}. Also "both, double": {双|shuāng}{手|shǒu} (both hands).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{双|shuāng}{鞋|xié}。
vocab.exampleEn: I bought two pairs of shoes.

vocab.note: Clothes that fit, and anything that suits: {大小|dà xiǎo}{合适|hé shì} (the size is right), {明天|míng tiān}{去|qù}{合适|hé shì}{吗|ma}？
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{大衣|dà yī}{你|nǐ}{穿|chuān}{很|hěn}{合适|hé shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This coat fits you well.

vocab.note: "Big-small": the size of clothes, shoes or anything. {大小|dà xiǎo}{合适|hé shì}{吗|ma}？ (Is it the right size?)
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{双|shuāng}{鞋|xié}{的|de}{大小|dà xiǎo}{正|zhèng}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: These shoes are just the right size.

vocab.note: One thing out, another in: {换|huàn}{衣服|yī fu} (change clothes), {换|huàn}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{大|dà}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{的|de} (change it for a bigger one). Not {还|huán} (give back), rising.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{太|tài}{小|xiǎo}{了|le}，{能|néng}{换|huàn}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: This one's too small. Can I change it?

vocab.note: The short, everyday verb; {选择|xuǎn zé} is a little more formal and is also a noun.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{件|jiàn}{你|nǐ}{选|xuǎn}{哪|nǎ}{件|jiàn}？
vocab.exampleEn: Which of these two are you going for?

vocab.note: Verb and noun: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{选择|xuǎn zé} (lots of choice), {选择|xuǎn zé}{一|yí}{个|gè} (choose one). More formal than {选|xuǎn}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{商店|shāng diàn}{的|de}{鞋|xié}{选择|xuǎn zé}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: This shop has a big choice of shoes.

vocab.note: {对|duì} + thing + {很|hěn}{满意|mǎn yì}: pleased with it. Works like an adjective: {很|hěn}{满意|mǎn yì}, {不|bù}{满意|mǎn yì}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衬衫|chèn shān}{很|hěn}{满意|mǎn yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm very pleased with this shirt.

vocab.note: Often doubled: {试试|shì shi}, or {试|shì}{一下|yí xià}. Same syllable as {是|shì} and {事|shì}. {试衣间|shì yī jiān}: fitting room.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{可以|kě yǐ}{试试|shì shi}{这|zhè}{双|shuāng}{鞋|xié}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can I try on these shoes?

vocab.note: Kinds and types: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}, {哪|nǎ}{种|zhǒng}, {三|sān}{种|zhǒng}{颜色|yán sè}. Third tone; {中|zhōng} is level.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{苹果|píng guǒ}{很|hěn}{甜|tián}。
vocab.exampleEn: This kind of apple is very sweet.

vocab.note: Adjective "poor": {很|hěn}{差|chà}. Verb "short of": {还|hái}{差|chà}{五|wǔ}{块|kuài}; time: {差|chà}{五|wǔ}{分|fēn}{八|bā}{点|diǎn} (five to eight). In {差不多|chà bu duō}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{菜|cài}{很|hěn}{差|chà}。
vocab.exampleEn: The food at this restaurant is poor.

vocab.note: {黄|huáng} alone works as an adjective ({黄|huáng}{衬衫|chèn shān}). Also the surname {黄|Huáng}.
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{穿|chuān}{着|zhe}{黄色|huáng sè}{的|de}{雨衣|yǔ yī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The child is wearing a yellow raincoat.

vocab.note: As an adjective: {蓝|lán}{衬衫|chèn shān}, {天|tiān}{很|hěn}{蓝|lán}. As a noun: {蓝色|lán sè} (the colour blue).
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{天|tiān}{真|zhēn}{蓝|lán}。
vocab.exampleEn: The sky is really blue today.

vocab.note: Measure word {张|zhāng}: {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{卡|kǎ}. In {银行卡|yín háng kǎ}, {信用卡|xìn yòng kǎ}; {刷卡|shuā kǎ} is to pay by card.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{张|zhāng}{卡|kǎ}{没|méi}{钱|qián}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's no money left on this card.

vocab.note: {信用|xìn yòng} is credit, trust. A bank card that isn't a credit card is a {银行卡|yín háng kǎ}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭店|fàn diàn}{可以|kě yǐ}{用|yòng}{信用卡|xìn yòng kǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can use a credit card at this restaurant.

vocab.note: {行|háng} here (a firm), not xíng. Two rising tones.
vocab.example: {银行|yín háng}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{开门|kāi mén}。
vocab.exampleEn: The bank opens at nine.

vocab.note: {办|bàn}{银行卡|yín háng kǎ}: to get a bank card (open an account).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{办|bàn}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{银行卡|yín háng kǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like to get a bank card.

meanings: number (of a phone, room or card)
vocab.note: {电话|diàn huà}{号码|hào mǎ}, {房间|fáng jiān}{号码|hào mǎ}. Digits are read one by one, 1 as yāo.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{电话|diàn huà}{号码|hào mǎ}{是|shì}{多少|duō shao}？
vocab.exampleEn: What's your phone number?

vocab.note: The action: {收|shōu}{钱|qián} (take money), {这里|zhè lǐ}{不|bù}{收|shōu}{现金|xiàn jīn} (no cash accepted). The result is {收到|shōu dào}. Level tone; {手|shǒu} dips.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{不|bù}{收|shōu}{信用卡|xìn yòng kǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This shop doesn't take credit cards.

vocab.note: {收|shōu} + the result {到|dào}: something has reached you. {收到|shōu dào}{了|le}{吗|ma}？ — {收到|shōu dào}{了|le}。 Negative {没|méi}{收到|shōu dào}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{收到|shōu dào}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{短信|duǎn xìn}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Did you get my text message?

vocab.note: Before the main verb, the tool: {用|yòng}{手机|shǒu jī}{付|fù}{钱|qián} (pay with a phone), {用|yòng}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō} (say it in Chinese). {不用|bú yòng} (lesson 05) is "no need".
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{会|huì}{用|yòng}{筷子|kuài zi}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can you use chopsticks?

vocab.note: Opposite {没|méi}{用|yòng} (useless, no use). Not {游泳|yóu yǒng} (to swim).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{对|duì}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{很|hěn}{有用|yǒu yòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This book is very useful for learning Chinese.

vocab.note: For paperwork and errands: {办|bàn}{卡|kǎ}, {办|bàn}{事|shì}. Sounds like {半|bàn}; {搬|bān} (move) is level.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{去|qù}{银行|yín háng}{办|bàn}{事|shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have to go to the bank today to sort something out.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{办法|bàn fǎ} (know what to do), {没|méi}{办法|bàn fǎ} (it can't be helped). {方法|fāng fǎ} (lesson 17) is a method of doing something.
vocab.example: {没|méi}{办法|bàn fǎ}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{没|méi}{电|diàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: It can't be helped: my phone's battery is dead.

vocab.note: Often {查|chá}{一下|yí xià}. Sounds like {茶|chá} (tea). In {检查|jiǎn chá} (examine, lesson 05).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{查|chá}{一下|yí xià}{火车|huǒ chē}{几|jǐ}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'll check what time the train arrives.

vocab.note: {带|dài}{钱|qián} (have money on you), {带|dài}{伞|sǎn} (take an umbrella, lesson 10). {你|nǐ}{带|dài}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{带|dài}{护照|hù zhào}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Have you brought your passport?

meanings: to switch on (a phone or computer)
vocab.note: For phones and computers; {开|kāi} + {机|jī} (machine).
vocab.example: {下|xià}{了|le}{飞机|fēi jī}{再|zài}{开机|kāi jī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Switch your phone back on after you get off the plane.

meanings: to switch off (a phone or computer)
vocab.note: {他|tā}{关机|guān jī}{了|le}: his phone is off. Lesson 03's {关|guān} (to close, switch off).
vocab.example: {上课|shàng kè}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{请|qǐng}{关机|guān jī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please switch off your phones during class.

meanings: (measure word for flat things: cards, tickets, tables)
vocab.note: {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{卡|kǎ}, {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{票|piào}, {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{桌子|zhuō zi}, {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{床|chuáng}. Also a verb (to open, stretch) and the surname {张|Zhāng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{张|zhāng}{电影|diàn yǐng}{票|piào}。
vocab.exampleEn: I bought two cinema tickets.

vocab.note: {早|zǎo}{起|qǐ} (get up early); {从|cóng} + time + {起|qǐ}: from… on ({从|cóng}{明天|míng tiān}{起|qǐ}). In {起床|qǐ chuáng}, {一起|yì qǐ}, {起来|qǐ lái}.
vocab.example: {从|cóng}{下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{起|qǐ}，{我|wǒ}{每天|měi tiān}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}{起|qǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: From next month on, I'm getting up at six every day.

vocab.note: {没|méi}{电|diàn}{了|le}: the battery is dead; {充电|chōng diàn}: to charge. The {电|diàn} of {电话|diàn huà}, {电脑|diàn nǎo}, {电视|diàn shì}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{快|kuài}{没|méi}{电|diàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: My phone's battery is nearly dead.

meanings: jiao (a tenth of a yuan, written)
vocab.note: The written word; in speech it's {毛|máo}. ¥0.50 = {五|wǔ}{角|jiǎo}. Also a horn and a corner. Sounds like {饺|jiǎo}.
vocab.example: {一|yì}{元|yuán}{是|shì}{十|shí}{角|jiǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: One yuan is ten jiao.

meanings: mao (a tenth of a yuan, spoken)
vocab.note: The spoken word for {角|jiǎo}: {五|wǔ}{毛|máo}{钱|qián}, {两|liǎng}{毛|máo}. Also body hair and fur; hair on the head is {头发|tóu fa}. Rising; {猫|māo} is level.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{个|gè}{三|sān}{块|kuài}{五|wǔ}{毛|máo}。
vocab.exampleEn: This one is three fifty.

vocab.note: Before the verb or the amount: {一共|yí gòng}{多少|duō shao}{钱|qián}？ {一|yí} rises before the fourth tone.
vocab.example: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{西瓜|xī guā}{一共|yí gòng}{二十|èr shí}{块|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: The two watermelons are twenty kuai altogether.

vocab.note: A time word, before the verb: {春天|chūn tiān}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}… Two level tones.
vocab.example: {北京|Běi jīng}{的|de}{春天|chūn tiān}{风|fēng}{很|hěn}{大|dà}。
vocab.exampleEn: Spring in Beijing is very windy.

vocab.note: Fourth tone + first tone. {夏|xià} is not {下|xià} (down), which sounds the same.
vocab.example: {夏天|xià tiān}{很|hěn}{热|rè}，{我|wǒ}{天天|tiān tiān}{吃|chī}{西瓜|xī guā}。
vocab.exampleEn: Summer is hot; I eat watermelon every day.

vocab.note: For many people in northern China the best season: cool and clear.
vocab.example: {秋天|qiū tiān}{不|bù}{冷|lěng}{也|yě}{不|bú}{热|rè}，{很|hěn}{舒服|shū fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Autumn is neither cold nor hot; it's very pleasant.

vocab.note: Two level tones; {东|dōng} (east) sounds the same.
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{冬天|dōng tiān}{一般|yì bān}{不|bú}{下|xià}{雪|xuě}。
vocab.exampleEn: It doesn't usually snow here in winter.

vocab.note: Mostly inside words: {季节|jì jié}, {四季|sì jì}, {雨季|yǔ jì} (rainy season). Alone, {季节|jì jié} is the usual word.
vocab.example: {一|yì}{年|nián}{有|yǒu}{四|sì}{季|jì}，{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{秋季|qiū jì}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are four seasons in a year, and I like autumn best.

vocab.note: Measure word {个|gè}: {一|yì}{年|nián}{有|yǒu}{四|sì}{个|gè}{季节|jì jié}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{哪|nǎ}{个|gè}{季节|jì jié}？
vocab.exampleEn: Which season do you like best?

vocab.note: {一年四季|yì nián sì jì}: all year round. Not {司机|sī jī} (driver, lesson 13).
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{一年四季|yì nián sì jì}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{新鲜|xīn xiān}{的|de}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's fresh fruit here all year round.

vocab.note: {刮风|guā fēng} (the wind blows), {风|fēng}{很|hěn}{大|dà} (it's very windy), {大|dà}{风|fēng} (a strong wind).
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{风|fēng}{很|hěn}{大|dà}，{多|duō}{穿|chuān}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's very windy today; wear something extra.

vocab.note: The verb for wind: {刮风|guā fēng}, {刮|guā}{大|dà}{风|fēng}. Also "to scrape". Traditional writes the wind sense 颳 (颳風) and "to scrape" {=刮=}.
vocab.example: {外面|wài miàn}{刮|guā}{着|zhe}{大|dà}{风|fēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a strong wind blowing outside.

vocab.note: In {冰箱|bīng xiāng} (fridge) and {冰激凌|bīng jī líng}. {加|jiā}{冰|bīng}: with ice. Level tone; {病|bìng} (illness) falls.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{饮料|yǐn liào}{要|yào}{加|jiā}{冰|bīng}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Do you want ice in your drink?

vocab.note: A pleasant coolness; {冷|lěng} (cold) is not pleasant. {快|kuai} is light.
vocab.example: {下|xià}{了|le}{雨|yǔ}，{现在|xiàn zài}{凉快|liáng kuai}{多|duō}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's rained, and now it's much cooler.

vocab.note: {出|chū}{太阳|tài yang}{了|le}: the sun's come out. {太阳|tài yang}{很|hěn}{大|dà}: the sun is strong. Light {阳|yang}.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{太阳|tài yang}{很|hěn}{大|dà}，{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{喝|hē}{水|shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The sun's strong today; don't forget to drink water.

vocab.note: {月|yuè} (moon; month) + {亮|liàng} (bright), light in this word.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{的|de}{月亮|yuè liang}{又|yòu}{大|dà}{又|yòu}{亮|liàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The moon is big and bright tonight.

vocab.note: {变|biàn} + adjective + {了|le}: {变|biàn}{冷|lěng}{了|le} (turned cold). {换|huàn} is swapping one thing for another.
vocab.example: {天气|tiān qì}{变|biàn}{冷|lěng}{了|le}，{你|nǐ}{要|yào}{多|duō}{穿|chuān}{衣服|yī fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's turned cold; you should wear more clothes.

vocab.note: Mostly a noun: {变化|biàn huà}{很|hěn}{大|dà} (a big change), {有|yǒu}{变化|biàn huà}. As a verb a little more formal than {变|biàn}.
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{春天|chūn tiān}{的|de}{天气|tiān qì}{变化|biàn huà}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: The weather here changes quickly in spring.

vocab.note: Adverb before the verb or at the start ({突然|tū rán}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}); adjective with {很|hěn} / {太|tài}…{了|le} ({太|tài}{突然|tū rán}{了|le}).
vocab.example: {天气|tiān qì}{突然|tū rán}{变|biàn}{了|le}，{下|xià}{起|qǐ}{雨|yǔ}{来|lái}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The weather suddenly changed and it started to rain.

vocab.note: Before the verb: usually ({我|wǒ}{一般|yì bān}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{起床|qǐ chuáng}). As an adjective: ordinary, so-so ({很|hěn}{一般|yì bān}). Not {一半|yí bàn} (half).
vocab.example: {星期天|xīng qī tiān}{我|wǒ}{一般|yì bān}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{休息|xiū xi}。
vocab.exampleEn: On Sundays I usually rest at home.

vocab.note: Measure word {把|bǎ}: {一|yì}{把|bǎ}{伞|sǎn}. {带|dài}{伞|sǎn} (take an umbrella), {打|dǎ}{伞|sǎn} (hold one up). Third tone; {三|sān} is level.
vocab.example: {外面|wài miàn}{下|xià}{着|zhe}{雨|yǔ}，{你|nǐ}{带|dài}{伞|sǎn}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: It's raining outside. Have you got an umbrella?

vocab.note: Any city or town: {大|dà}{城市|chéng shì}, {小|xiǎo}{城市|chéng shì}. {市|shì} alone is the city as a unit of government, in names: {北京市|Běi jīng shì}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}，{这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{哪儿|nǎr}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: I like this city: there are restaurants everywhere here.

vocab.note: Measure word {条|tiáo}: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{街|jiē}. {上|shàng}{街|jiē}: to go into town, to go shopping. Same sound as {接|jiē} (to meet, lesson 20).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{街|jiē}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{小|xiǎo}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of little restaurants on this street.

vocab.note: {过|guò}{马路|mǎ lù}: to cross the road. Measure word {条|tiáo}.
vocab.example: {过|guò}{马路|mǎ lù}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{看|kàn}{车|chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: When you cross the road, look out for cars.

vocab.note: A crossroads is a {十字路口|shí zì lù kǒu} (shaped like {十|shí}).
vocab.example: {到|dào}{了|le}{第|dì}{二|èr}{个|gè}{路口|lù kǒu}{往|wǎng}{右|yòu}{走|zǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Turn right at the second crossing.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{路边|lù biān}{等|děng}{你|nǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'll wait for you by the road.

vocab.note: The everyday word for any place; the second syllable is light. On notices the place of an event is {地点|dì diǎn}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{一|yí}{个|gè}{安静|ān jìng}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go somewhere quiet.

vocab.note: Written next to {时间|shí jiān} on notices, tickets and invitations. In conversation say {地方|dì fang}.
vocab.example: {时间|shí jiān}：{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{上午|shàng wǔ}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}。{地点|dì diǎn}：{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Time: Saturday, 10 a.m. Place: the school gate.

vocab.note: {看|kàn}{地图|dì tú} (to read a map), {在|zài}{地图|dì tú}{上|shàng} (on the map), {手机|shǒu jī}{地图|dì tú} (a map app).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{看|kàn}{看|kàn}{手机|shǒu jī}{上|shàng}{的|de}{地图|dì tú}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Have a look at the map on your phone.

vocab.note: {往|wǎng}{哪个|nǎ ge}{方向|fāng xiàng}{走|zǒu}？ (which way do I go?) {不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{方向|fāng xiàng} (to have lost your bearings).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{走|zǒu}{的|de}{方向|fāng xiàng}{不|bú}{对|duì}。
vocab.exampleEn: We're going the wrong way.

vocab.note: Alone after {往|wǎng} ({往|wǎng}{东|dōng}{走|zǒu}); otherwise {东边|dōng bian} / {东面|dōng miàn}. The four are listed {东|dōng}{南|nán}{西|xī}{北|běi}. {东西|dōng xi} dōngxi with a light xi is "thing".
vocab.example: {从|cóng}{这儿|zhèr}{往|wǎng}{东|dōng}{走|zǒu}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Walk east from here for five minutes and you're there.

vocab.note: Level tone; {洗|xǐ} (to wash) dips. {西边|xī bian} / {西面|xī miàn}: the west side.
vocab.example: {太阳|tài yang}{在|zài}{西边|xī bian}。
vocab.exampleEn: The sun is in the west.

vocab.note: Same syllable as {男|nán} (male). {南边|nán bian} / {南面|nán miàn}: the south side.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{学校|xué xiào}{在|zài}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{南边|nán bian}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our school is in the south of the city.

vocab.note: Third tone; {被|bèi} (passive, lesson 13) falls. {北边|běi bian} / {北面|běi miàn}: the north side. {北京|Běi jīng}: "the northern capital".
vocab.example: {银行|yín háng}{在|zài}{超市|chāo shì}{的|de}{北边|běi bian}。
vocab.exampleEn: The bank is north of the supermarket.

vocab.note: {在|zài} A {和|hé} B {中间|zhōng jiān}: between A and B. Also time: {中间|zhōng jiān}{休息|xiū xi}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}.
vocab.example: {银行|yín háng}{在|zài}{书店|shū diàn}{和|hé}{超市|chāo shì}{中间|zhōng jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: The bank is between the bookshop and the supermarket.

vocab.note: In names and compounds: {北京市|Běi jīng shì}, {市中心|shì zhōng xīn} (city centre), {市里|shì lǐ} (in town). For "a city" in general say {城市|chéng shì}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{在|zài}{市里|shì lǐ}，{离|lí}{公司|gōng sī}{很|hěn}{近|jìn}。
vocab.exampleEn: My home is in town, close to my company.

vocab.note: Fourth tone. The particle {地|de} ({慢|màn}{慢|màn}{地|de}{说|shuō}) is another word. {地|dì} is also in {地方|dì fang}, {地点|dì diǎn}, {地图|dì tú} and {地铁|dì tiě}.
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{地|dì}{上|shàng}{看|kàn}{电视|diàn shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children are sitting on the floor watching TV.

vocab.note: An adjective: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{有名|yǒu míng} (no {是|shì}). Before a noun: {有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{饺子|jiǎo zi}{很|hěn}{有名|yǒu míng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This restaurant's dumplings are famous.

vocab.note: A place word: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{附近|fù jìn}, {这|zhè}{附近|fù jìn} + {有|yǒu}. For "is near / is far" use {近|jìn} / {远|yuǎn}: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{离|lí}{学校|xué xiào}{很|hěn}{近|jìn}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{附近|fù jìn}{有|yǒu}{没有|méi yǒu}{超市|chāo shì}？
vocab.exampleEn: Is there a supermarket around here?

vocab.note: Where you live or work ({这个|zhè ge}{小区|xiǎo qū}{的|de}{环境|huán jìng}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}) and the natural environment (lesson 15).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{小区|xiǎo qū}{的|de}{环境|huán jìng}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{又|yòu}{安静|ān jìng}{又|yòu}{方便|fāng biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The surroundings on this estate are very good, quiet and convenient.

vocab.note: East or west comes first: {东北|dōng běi}, never {北|běi}{东|dōng}. Also the Northeast region of China: {东北人|Dōng běi rén}, {东北菜|Dōng běi cài}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{朋友|péng you}{是|shì}{东北人|Dōng běi rén}，{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{吃|chī}{饺子|jiǎo zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: My friend is from the Northeast and loves dumplings.

vocab.note: Literally "east-south".
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{在|zài}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{东|dōng}{南边|nán bian}。
vocab.exampleEn: The school is in the southeast of the city.

vocab.note: Literally "west-north". Also the Northwest region of China.
vocab.example: {从|cóng}{这儿|zhèr}{往|wǎng}{西北|xī běi}{走|zǒu}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Walk northwest from here for ten minutes and you're there.

vocab.note: Literally "west-south". Also the Southwest region of China.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{西|xī}{南边|nán bian}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{新|xīn}{小区|xiǎo qū}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of new housing estates in the southwest of the city.

meanings: the East (East Asia; also the east)
vocab.note: As a direction mostly for the sky: {太阳|tài yang}{在|zài}{东方|dōng fāng}.
vocab.example: {早上|zǎo shang}{的|de}{太阳|tài yang}{在|zài}{东方|dōng fāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the morning the sun is in the east.

meanings: the West (Europe and the Americas; also the west)
vocab.note: {西方国家|xī fāng guó jiā}: Western countries.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{来自|lái zì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{西方国家|xī fāng guó jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: He comes from a Western country.

meanings: the North (of China; also the north)
vocab.note: Beijing is in the North; {北方人|běi fāng rén}: northerners.
vocab.example: {北方|běi fāng}{的|de}{冬天|dōng tiān}{比较|bǐ jiào}{冷|lěng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Winters in the North are fairly cold.

meanings: the South (of China; also the south)
vocab.note: Shanghai is in the South; {南方人|nán fāng rén}: southerners.
vocab.example: {南方人|nán fāng rén}{吃|chī}{米饭|mǐ fàn}{比较|bǐ jiào}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: Southerners eat rice more often.

meanings: another place (not here, not one's home town)
vocab.note: {外地人|wài dì rén}: someone not from here. {去|qù}{外地|wài dì}: to go to another city.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{外地人|wài dì rén}，{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's not from here; he works in Beijing.

vocab.note: Written or formal; no {从|cóng} after it ({来自|lái zì}{英国|Yīng guó}). In conversation: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{英国|Yīng guó}{人|rén}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{学校|xué xiào}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{来自|lái zì}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{国家|guó jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: The students at our school come from many countries.

vocab.note: For "a country" on its own, say {国家|guó jiā}; {国|guó} is mostly in words ({中国|Zhōng guó}, {外国|wài guó}).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{国家|guó jiā}？
vocab.exampleEn: How many countries have you been to?

vocab.note: {世界上|shì jiè shàng}: in the world. {世界|shì jiè}{地图|dì tú}: a map of the world.
vocab.example: {世界上|shì jiè shàng}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{国家|guó jiā}，{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{看|kàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of countries in the world, and I'd like to see them.

vocab.note: After a number: {十八|shí bā}{岁|suì}{以上|yǐ shàng} (eighteen and over). In rules and the law it normally includes the number.
vocab.example: {十八|shí bā}{岁|suì}{以上|yǐ shàng}{的|de}{人|rén}{可以|kě yǐ}{开车|kāi chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: People aged eighteen and over can drive.

vocab.note: Third tone, not {一下|yí xià} yíxià (for a moment). {六|liù}{岁|suì}{以下|yǐ xià}: six and under.
vocab.example: {六|liù}{岁|suì}{以下|yǐ xià}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{不要|bú yào}{门票|mén piào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Children aged six and under don't need a ticket.

vocab.note: After a place or a limit: {北京|Běi jīng}{以外|yǐ wài}{的|de}{城市|chéng shì}. {除了|chú le}…{以外|yǐ wài} (apart from) is lesson 27's.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{北京|Běi jīng}{以外|yǐ wài}{的|de}{城市|chéng shì}{看|kàn}{看|kàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like to see some cities outside Beijing.

vocab.note: Mostly written: {在|zài}…{中|zhōng} (among, in). The {中|zhōng} of {中间|zhōng jiān}, {中午|zhōng wǔ} and {中国|Zhōng guó}.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{这些|zhè xiē}{城市|chéng shì}{中|zhōng}，{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{上海|Shàng hǎi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Of all these cities, I like Shanghai best.

vocab.note: Mostly in words: {公园|gōng yuán} (park), {花园|huā yuán} (garden), {动物园|dòng wù yuán} (zoo), {校园|xiào yuán} (campus). Alone in names and {园里|yuán lǐ}.
vocab.example: {园里|yuán lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{花|huā}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of flowers in the garden.

vocab.note: {越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè} + adjective: more and more ({天气|tiān qì}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{冷|lěng}{了|le}). A {越|yuè} + verb {越|yuè} + adjective: {雨|yǔ}{越|yuè}{下|xià}{越|yuè}{大|dà}. No {很|hěn} after {越|yuè}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{好|hǎo}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: Your Chinese keeps getting better!

vocab.note: Compares: {北京|Běi jīng}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{东北|dōng běi}{更|gèng}{冷|lěng}. Fine in {比|bǐ} sentences ({今天|jīn tiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{更|gèng}{冷|lěng}), where {很|hěn} isn't. Also read gēng in other words.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{北方|běi fāng}，{但是|dàn shì}{我|wǒ}{更|gèng}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{南方|nán fāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I like the North, but I like the South even more.

vocab.note: After an adjective, with {了|le}: {好|hǎo}{极|jí}{了|le}, {冷|lěng}{极|jí}{了|le} (spoken). Nothing goes before the adjective: not {很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{极|jí}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{饺子|jiǎo zi}{好吃|hǎo chī}{极|jí}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: The dumplings here are absolutely delicious!

vocab.note: Before an adjective: fairly, milder than {很|hěn} ({比较|bǐ jiào}{便宜|pián yi}). As a verb: to compare ({比较|bǐ jiào}{一下|yí xià}).
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{比较|bǐ jiào}{便宜|pián yi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Things here are fairly cheap.

vocab.note: The full word; in speech usually {车|chē}. Measure word {辆|liàng}. {开|kāi}{汽车|qì chē} (drive), {坐|zuò}{汽车|qì chē} (ride in).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{家|jiā}{门口|mén kǒu}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{辆|liàng}{新|xīn}{汽车|qì chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a new car outside his home.

vocab.note: You {骑|qí} a bike ({骑|qí}{自行车|zì xíng chē}, {骑车|qí chē}). Measure word {辆|liàng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{骑|qí}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{上班|shàng bān}。
vocab.exampleEn: I cycle to work every day.

meanings: to ride (astride: a bike, a horse)
vocab.note: For things you sit astride: {骑|qí}{自行车|zì xíng chē}, {骑|qí}{马|mǎ}. Vehicles you sit inside take {坐|zuò}.
vocab.example: {晚上|wǎn shang}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{骑车|qí chē}{不|bù}{安全|ān quán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Cycling alone at night isn't safe.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{辆|liàng}{汽车|qì chē}, {两|liǎng}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē}. Fourth tone; {两|liǎng} (two) is liǎng. Boats usually take {条|tiáo}.
vocab.example: {门口|mén kǒu}{有|yǒu}{三|sān}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are three bikes at the door.

vocab.note: Drivers are addressed as {师傅|shī fu} (shīfu), not {司机|sī jī}.
vocab.example: {司机|sī jī}{说|shuō}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The driver says we'll be there in ten minutes.

vocab.note: {红灯|hóng dēng} (red light), {绿灯|lǜ dēng} (green light). The rhyme: {红灯|hóng dēng}{停|tíng}，{绿灯|lǜ dēng}{行|xíng}.
vocab.example: {过|guò}{马路|mǎ lù}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{看|kàn}{红绿灯|hóng lǜ dēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: When you cross the road, watch the traffic lights.

vocab.note: {注意|zhù yì}{安全|ān quán} (be careful), {安全第一|ān quán dì yī} (safety first), {不|bù}{安全|ān quán} (unsafe).
vocab.example: {骑车|qí chē}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{注意|zhù yì}{安全|ān quán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Be careful when you're cycling.

vocab.note: {坐|zuò}{船|chuán}: to go by boat. Measure word {条|tiáo} in everyday speech. Rising tone; {穿|chuān} (to wear) is level.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{坐|zuò}{船|chuán}{去|qù}{吧|ba}！
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go by boat!

vocab.note: Short for the high-speed railway; also its trains. {坐|zuò}{高铁|gāo tiě}, {高铁站|gāo tiě zhàn}.
vocab.example: {从|cóng}{北京|Běi jīng}{坐|zuò}{高铁|gāo tiě}{去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{很|hěn}{方便|fāng biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's very convenient to take the high-speed train from Beijing to Shanghai.

vocab.note: For people. Trains and planes {晚点|wǎn diǎn}. How late goes after it: {迟到|chí dào}{了|le}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{上课|shàng kè}{别|bié}{迟到|chí dào}！
vocab.exampleEn: Don't be late for class tomorrow!

meanings: to be delayed (a train, bus or plane)
vocab.note: Not for people (they {迟到|chí dào}). In speech {晚点儿|wǎn diǎnr} can also mean "a bit later".
vocab.example: {飞机|fēi jī}{晚点|wǎn diǎn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: The plane was an hour late.

vocab.note: Often with {就|jiù}: {马上|mǎ shàng}{就|jiù}{到|dào} (almost there).
vocab.example: {别|bié}{着急|zháo jí}，{我|wǒ}{马上|mǎ shàng}{就|jiù}{到|dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't worry, I'll be there right away.

vocab.note: {急事|jí shì} (urgent business), {别|bié}{急|jí} (no rush). {着急|zháo jí} is the feeling of worry.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{急事|jí shì}，{要|yào}{马上|mǎ shàng}{回|huí}{家|jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: Something urgent has come up; I have to go home right away.

vocab.note: The {着|zhe} is zháo here, not the light zhe of {穿|chuān}{着|zhe}. {别|bié}{着急|zháo jí}: don't worry.
vocab.example: {别|bié}{着急|zháo jí}，{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't worry, there's still time.

vocab.note: HSK 2's {站|zhàn} is a stop or station. {站|zhàn}{着|zhe} (standing), {站|zhàn}{起来|qǐ lái} (to stand up), {站|zhàn}{在|zài}{路口|lù kǒu}.
vocab.example: {别|bié}{站|zhàn}{在|zài}{马路|mǎ lù}{中间|zhōng jiān}！
vocab.exampleEn: Don't stand in the middle of the road!

vocab.note: Also uncooked rice (cooked rice is {米饭|mǐ fàn}). Heights: 1.75{米|mǐ} is read {一|yì}{米|mǐ}{七五|qī wǔ}.
vocab.example: {往|wǎng}{前|qián}{走|zǒu}{一百|yì bǎi}{米|mǐ}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Go a hundred metres straight on and you're there.

vocab.note: Receiver + {被|bèi} + (doer) + verb + more: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{人|rén}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}. Mostly for unwelcome events. Fourth tone; {北|běi} (north) is běi.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{伞|sǎn}{被|bèi}{风|fēng}{刮|guā}{走|zǒu}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: My umbrella's been blown away by the wind!

vocab.note: Foreigners in China show it to buy train tickets and to check in at hotels.
vocab.example: {护照|hù zhào}{带|dài}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Have you got your passport?

vocab.note: The li is light. {带|dài}{行李|xíng li}: to take luggage. {行|xíng} is xíng here, not the háng of {银行|yín háng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{行李|xíng li}{不|bù}{多|duō}，{就|jiù}{一|yí}{个|gè}{箱子|xiāng zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I don't have much luggage, just one case.

vocab.note: A little older and more formal than {酒店|jiǔ diàn}; many hotels are called one or the other.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{住|zhù}{的|de}{宾馆|bīn guǎn}{离|lí}{车站|chē zhàn}{很|hěn}{近|jìn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The hotel we're staying in is close to the station.

vocab.note: No object: {我们|wǒ men}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{出发|chū fā}; {从|cóng}{北京|Běi jīng}{出发|chū fā} (set off from Beijing).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{出发|chū fā}。
vocab.exampleEn: We're setting off at eight tomorrow morning.

vocab.example: {飞机|fēi jī}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{起飞|qǐ fēi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The plane takes off at ten.

vocab.note: {开始|kāi shǐ}{检票|jiǎn piào} on station screens: boarding has begun. {检票|jiǎn piào}{口|kǒu}: the ticket gate.
vocab.example: {去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{的|de}{高铁|gāo tiě}{开始|kāi shǐ}{检票|jiǎn piào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: They've started checking tickets for the Shanghai train.

vocab.note: A visitor at a sight. {游|yóu} here is the {游|yóu} of {旅游|lǚ yóu} (to travel).
vocab.example: {星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{游客|yóu kè}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of tourists here on Saturdays.

meanings: to pass by (go through on the way)
vocab.note: Also a noun: {事情|shì qing}{的|de}{经过|jīng guò} (what happened, step by step).
vocab.example: {去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{的|de}{路上|lù shang}，{高铁|gāo tiě}{经过|jīng guò}{南京|Nán jīng}。
vocab.exampleEn: On the way to Shanghai, the train goes through Nanjing.

meanings: to leave (a place or a person)
vocab.note: With the place as object: {离开|lí kāi}{北京|Běi jīng}. Without one, {走|zǒu} is more natural ({我|wǒ}{走|zǒu}{了|le}).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}{离开|lí kāi}{北京|Běi jīng}。
vocab.exampleEn: We're leaving Beijing tomorrow.

vocab.note: {到处|dào chù}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{人|rén} (people everywhere); {到处|dào chù}{走|zǒu}{走|zǒu} (walk around).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{到处|dào chù}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{好吃|hǎo chī}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's good food all over this city.

vocab.note: Separable: {拍个照|pāi ge zhào}. The usual word on signs and for phones.
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{可以|kě yǐ}{拍照|pāi zhào}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can I take photos here?

vocab.note: Separable: {照|zhào}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{相|xiàng}. A little older than {拍照|pāi zhào}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{照|zhào}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{相|xiàng}，{好|hǎo}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Could you take a photo of us, please?

vocab.note: {相|xiàng} is xiàng here; in {相信|xiāng xìn} (to believe) it is xiāng.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{带|dài}{了|le}{相机|xiàng jī}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've brought my camera.

vocab.note: Measure word {张|zhāng}: {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{照片|zhào piàn}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{用|yòng}{手机|shǒu jī}{拍|pāi}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{照片|zhào piàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I took lots of photos on my phone.

vocab.note: {太阳|tài yang}{照|zhào}{着|zhe}{这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{街|jiē} (the sun shines on this street); {照|zhào}{了|le}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{照片|zhào piàn} (took a photo).
vocab.example: {太阳|tài yang}{照|zhào}{着|zhe}{这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{街|jiē}。
vocab.exampleEn: The sun is shining on this street.

meanings: while (一边…一边: two things at once)
vocab.note: Subject + {一边|yì biān} + verb + {一边|yì biān} + verb. Quick speech: {边|biān}{走|zǒu}{边|biān}{说|shuō}. Also "one side": {马路|mǎ lù}{的|de}{一边|yì biān}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{一边|yì biān}{走|zǒu}{一边|yì biān}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's talking on the phone as he walks.

vocab.note: Spoken, very common in the North. In writing use {一起|yì qǐ}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{一块儿|yí kuàir}{去|qù}{吧|ba}！
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go together!

vocab.note: Measure word {座|zuò} (zuò). {爬|pá}{山|shān} (to go hiking), {山上|shān shàng} (on the mountain), {山下|shān xià} (at its foot). sh, not the s of {三|sān}.
vocab.example: {星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}{吧|ba}！
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go hiking on Saturday!

vocab.note: Measure word {条|tiáo}: {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{河|hé}. {河边|hé biān}: the riverside. Same sound as {和|hé} (and).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{在|zài}{河边|hé biān}，{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{河边|hé biān}{跑步|pǎo bù}。
vocab.exampleEn: My home is by the river; every morning I go running along it.

vocab.note: {海边|hǎi biān} (seaside), {大海|dà hǎi} (the open sea). Third tone; {还|hái} hái rises.
vocab.example: {夏天|xià tiān}{我们|wǒ men}{经常|jīng cháng}{去|qù}{海边|hǎi biān}。
vocab.exampleEn: In summer we often go to the seaside.

vocab.example: {公园|gōng yuán}{的|de}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{坐|zuò}{着|zhe}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of people sitting on the grass in the park.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{小区|xiǎo qū}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{花园|huā yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a little garden on our estate.

meanings: to climb (on hands and feet; also to crawl)
vocab.note: {爬|pá}{山|shān} (to go hiking), {爬|pá}{树|shù} (to climb a tree), {孩子|hái zi}{会|huì}{爬|pá}{了|le} (the baby can crawl). {怕|pà} pà (to fear) falls.
vocab.example: {小|xiǎo}{孩子|hái zi}{不|bù}{能|néng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{爬|pá}{树|shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Small children shouldn't climb trees on their own.

vocab.note: Any small plant. {吃|chī}{草|cǎo}: to graze.
vocab.example: {羊|yáng}{在|zài}{山下|shān xià}{吃|chī}{草|cǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The sheep are grazing at the foot of the hill.

vocab.note: {请|qǐng}{别|bié}{在|zài}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{走|zǒu}: please keep off the grass.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{别|bié}{在|zài}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{走|zǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please keep off the grass.

vocab.note: Measure word {棵|kē} (kē): {一|yì}{棵|kē}{树|shù}. Fourth tone; {书|shū} (book) is level.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{门口|mén kǒu}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{棵|kē}{大|dà}{树|shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a big tree outside my home.

vocab.note: Verb + object: {开|kāi}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{花|huā}, or {花|huā}{开|kāi}{了|le} (the flowers are out). Not {花|huā}{开花|kāi huā}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{棵|kē}{树|shù}{四|sì}{月|yuè}{开花|kāi huā}。
vocab.exampleEn: This tree flowers in April.

vocab.note: {小|xiǎo}{动物|dòng wù} (small animals, pets).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{养|yǎng}{过|guo}{动物|dòng wù}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Have you ever kept animals?

vocab.example: {动物园|dòng wù yuán}{就|jiù}{在|zài}{山下|shān xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: The zoo is right at the foot of the hill.

vocab.note: Literally "big bear-cat"; often just {熊猫|xióng māo}. Counted {一|yì}{只|zhī}, {两|liǎng}{只|zhī}.
vocab.example: {动物园|dòng wù yuán}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{只|zhī}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are two giant pandas at the zoo.

vocab.note: Measure word {匹|pǐ} (pǐ). {骑|qí}{马|mǎ}: to ride a horse. Third tone; {妈|mā} mā is level and {吗|ma} ma light.
vocab.example: {骑|qí}{马|mǎ}{很|hěn}{好玩儿|hǎo wánr}。
vocab.exampleEn: Horse riding is great fun.

vocab.note: Measure word {头|tóu}: {一|yì}{头|tóu}{牛|niú}. Slang: {你|nǐ}{太|tài}{牛|niú}{了|le}！ (you're amazing!), only with friends. {牛奶|niú nǎi}: milk.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{养|yǎng}{了|le}{一|yì}{头|tóu}{牛|niú}。
vocab.exampleEn: My grandpa keeps a cow.

vocab.note: Counted {一|yì}{只|zhī}, {两|liǎng}{只|zhī}. {绵羊|mián yáng} (sheep) and {山羊|shān yáng} (goat) when it matters. Rising tone; {养|yǎng} yǎng dips.
vocab.example: {老人|lǎo rén}{养|yǎng}{了|le}{三十|sān shí}{多|duō}{只|zhī}{羊|yáng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The old man keeps more than thirty sheep.

vocab.note: The bird and its meat. Counted {一|yì}{只|zhī}, {两|liǎng}{只|zhī}. {鸡蛋|jī dàn}: egg.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{养|yǎng}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{只|zhī}{鸡|jī}。
vocab.exampleEn: When I was little we kept two chickens.

meanings: to keep (animals or plants; to raise)
vocab.note: {养|yǎng}{狗|gǒu} (to have a dog), {养|yǎng}{花|huā} (to grow flowers), {养|yǎng}{孩子|hái zi} (to bring up children).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{养|yǎng}{花|huā}。
vocab.exampleEn: My mum loves growing flowers.

meanings: school class (as a unit of the school)
vocab.note: The written, more formal word; in speech and in names people say {班|bān} ({我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}, {三|sān}{年级|nián jí}{二|èr}{班|bān}).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{班级|bān jí}{有|yǒu}{四十|sì shí}{个|gè}{学生|xué sheng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are forty students in this class.

vocab.note: Number + {年级|nián jí}: {一|yì}{年级|nián jí} (first year, grade one). {初二|chū èr} and {高一|gāo yī} are short forms for the years of junior and senior high.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{妹妹|mèi mei}{上|shàng}{小学|xiǎo xué}{三|sān}{年级|nián jí}。
vocab.exampleEn: My younger sister is in the third year of primary school.

vocab.note: Three years after {小学|xiǎo xué} and before {高中|gāo zhōng}. {初|chū} is "beginning".
vocab.example: {他|tā}{今年|jīn nián}{上|shàng}{初中|chū zhōng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He started junior high this year.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{学期|xué qī}{我们|wǒ men}{有|yǒu}{六|liù}{门|mén}{课|kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: We have six subjects this term.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{打开|dǎ kāi}{课本|kè běn}，{看|kàn}{第|dì}{十|shí}{页|yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone, please open your textbooks at page ten.

meanings: lesson text (the text of a lesson)
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{课文|kè wén}{我|wǒ}{读|dú}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've read this text three times.

vocab.note: Measure word {个|gè}: {一|yí}{个|gè}{句子|jù zi}. {子|zi} is light.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{句子|jù zi}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{长|cháng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This sentence is a bit long.

meanings: measure word for sentences and lines
vocab.note: A measure word, so nothing goes between it and its noun: {一|yí}{句|jù}{话|huà} (a sentence, a remark). The noun is {句子|jù zi}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{说|shuō}{了|le}{一|yí}{句|jù}{话|huà}{就|jiù}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He said one sentence and left.

vocab.note: Lists words; {字典|zì diǎn} lists single characters.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{词|cí}{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{词典|cí diǎn}{里|lǐ}{查|chá}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I looked this word up in the dictionary.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{字典|zì diǎn}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Is this character in the character dictionary?

vocab.note: {做|zuò}{笔记|bǐ jì} or {记|jì}{笔记|bǐ jì}: to take notes ({记|jì}, to note down, is lesson 18's word).
vocab.example: {上课|shàng kè}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{她|tā}{做|zuò}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{笔记|bǐ jì}。
vocab.exampleEn: She took lots of notes in class.

vocab.note: Both a notebook to write in and a laptop ({笔记本|bǐ jì běn}{电脑|diàn nǎo}); {本子|běn zi} is any notebook or exercise book.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{新|xīn}{的|de}{词|cí}{写|xiě}{在|zài}{笔记本|bǐ jì běn}{上|shàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I write the new words in my notebook.

vocab.note: Its measure word is {支|zhī} zhī ({一|yì}{支|zhī}{铅笔|qiān bǐ}), outside HSK 3; {个|gè} is also heard.
vocab.example: {考试|kǎo shì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{带|dài}{铅笔|qiān bǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: You need to bring a pencil to the exam.

vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{在|zài}{黑板|hēi bǎn}{上|shàng}{写|xiě}{了|le}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{字|zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher wrote a few characters on the board.

vocab.note: {做|zuò}{作业|zuò yè} or {写|xiě}{作业|zuò yè}: to do homework.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{作业|zuò yè}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a lot of homework today.

vocab.note: Fourth tone; {也|yě} yě (also) dips. {第|dì}{十|shí}{页|yè}: page ten.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{有|yǒu}{三百|sān bǎi}{页|yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: This book has three hundred pages.

vocab.note: A verb measure word: verb + number + {遍|biàn} ({读|dú}{两|liǎng}{遍|biàn}, {请|qǐng}{再|zài}{说|shuō}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}). {次|cì} counts occasions; {遍|biàn} counts complete runs through something.
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}，{请|qǐng}{您|nín}{再|zài}{说|shuō}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Could you say that again, please?

meanings: school is out (to finish school for the day)
vocab.note: For pupils and schools; adults {下班|xià bān}, university students {下课|xià kè}.
vocab.example: {孩子们|hái zi men}{下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}{放学|fàng xué}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children finish school at four in the afternoon.

vocab.note: A sheet of paper: {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{纸|zhǐ}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{纸|zhǐ}{吗|ma}？{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Have you got any paper? Give me a sheet.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{数学|shù xué}{成绩|chéng jì}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her maths results are very good.

vocab.note: {数|shù} is shù here (number); as a verb, "to count", it is {数|shǔ} shǔ.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{每天|měi tiān}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{数学|shù xué}{课|kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: We have maths every day.

vocab.note: Traditional {歷史|lì shǐ}; the {曆|lì} of {日曆|rì lì} (calendar) is another character.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{历史|lì shǐ}{课|kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: I really like history lessons.

vocab.note: The school subject ({体育|tǐ yù}{课|kè}) and sport in general; {运动|yùn dòng} is exercise.
vocab.example: {星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{下午|xià wǔ}{有|yǒu}{体育|tǐ yù}{课|kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's PE on Friday afternoon.

vocab.example: {学|xué}{外语|wài yǔ}{要|yào}{每天|měi tiān}{练习|liàn xí}。
vocab.exampleEn: When you learn a foreign language, you have to practise every day.

vocab.note: Language in general; a particular language is {汉语|Hàn yǔ}, {外语|wài yǔ}, {中文|Zhōng wén} and so on.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{三|sān}{种|zhǒng}{语言|yǔ yán}。
vocab.exampleEn: He can speak three languages.

vocab.note: Going over what you have learned; {预习|yù xí} yù xí (outside HSK 3) is preparing a lesson before class.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{考试|kǎo shì}，{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{复习|fù xí}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's an exam tomorrow, so I have to revise a bit.

vocab.note: Also a noun: {做|zuò}{练习|liàn xí} (do exercises).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每天|měi tiān}{练习|liàn xí}{写|xiě}{汉字|hàn zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I practise writing characters every day.

meanings: to drill (practise a skill, short form)
vocab.note: The short form, usually with a one-character object or a quantity: {练|liàn}{字|zì} (practise handwriting), {练|liàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{每天|měi tiān}{练|liàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{字|zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He practises handwriting for an hour every day.

vocab.note: Often with {水平|shuǐ píng} or {成绩|chéng jì}: {提高|tí gāo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{提高|tí gāo}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I want to improve my Chinese.

vocab.note: A third tone, then a second: the dip of shuǐ is short before píng.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her Chinese is at a very high level.

vocab.note: Also before a verb with {地|de}: {认真|rèn zhēn}{地|de}{听|tīng} (listen carefully).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{学习|xué xí}{很|hěn}{认真|rèn zhēn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's very conscientious about his studies.

vocab.note: A verb ({我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{努力|nǔ lì}) and an adjective ({他|tā}{很|hěn}{努力|nǔ lì}).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{学习|xué xí}{非常|fēi cháng}{努力|nǔ lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: She works very hard at her studies.

vocab.note: How to do something; {办法|bàn fǎ} (lesson 09) is a way out of a problem.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{学|xué}{汉字|hàn zì}{的|de}{方法|fāng fǎ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Your way of learning characters is very good.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{难题|nán tí}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: I thought about this hard problem for a long time.

vocab.note: Also a noun: {他|tā}{的|de}{回答|huí dá} (his answer).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{你|nǐ}{能|néng}{回答|huí dá}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can you answer this question?

vocab.note: Mostly a noun: {听|tīng}{对话|duì huà} (listen to a dialogue); also a verb, {跟|gēn}…{对话|duì huà} (to hold a dialogue with).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{听|tīng}{两|liǎng}{遍|biàn}{这个|zhè ge}{对话|duì huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: We'll listen to this dialogue twice.

meanings: to explain (also: to tell, to speak)
vocab.note: {讲|jiǎng}{课|kè} (to lecture), {讲|jiǎng}{清楚|qīng chu} (to explain clearly); in speech often the same as {说|shuō}.
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{讲|jiǎng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{清楚|qīng chu}，{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{听|tīng}{懂|dǒng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher explained it very clearly; I understood all of it.

meanings: to find out about (know well, understand)
vocab.note: {了|liǎo} is liǎo here, not le. Knowing a subject or a person well: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{了解|liǎo jiě}{他|tā}. Taiwan also writes {瞭解|liǎo jiě}; this course uses {了解|liǎo jiě}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{多|duō}{了解|liǎo jiě}{一下|yí xià}{中国|Zhōng guó}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like to find out more about Chinese history.

vocab.note: Also an adjective, "clear": {讲|jiǎng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{明白|míng bai}. {白|bai} is light.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{意思|yì si}{我|wǒ}{明白|míng bai}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I see what you mean.

meanings: clear (distinct; also: to be clear about)
vocab.note: An adjective ({写|xiě}{得|de}{很|hěn}{清楚|qīng chu}) and a verb ({我|wǒ}{不|bù}{清楚|qīng chu}: I'm not sure). {楚|chu} is light.
vocab.example: {黑板|hēi bǎn}{上|shàng}{的|de}{字|zì}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{不|bu}{清楚|qīng chu}。
vocab.exampleEn: I can't see the characters on the board clearly.

meanings: to grasp (a principle; know how to)
vocab.note: For understanding a principle or knowing how to do something ({懂得|dǒng de}{怎么|zěn me}{学习|xué xí}); {懂|dǒng} is the everyday word.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{懂得|dǒng de}{学习|xué xí}{的|de}{方法|fāng fǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: He knows how to study (he understands the method of learning).

vocab.note: Recognising a character, a road or a person (spoken); {认识|rèn shi} is the general word.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{我|wǒ}{认得|rèn de}，{但是|dàn shì}{不|bú}{会|huì}{写|xiě}。
vocab.exampleEn: I recognise this character, but I can't write it.

vocab.note: Giving an opinion, a little more formal than {觉得|jué de}. {为|wéi} is wéi here.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{认为|rèn wéi}{每天|měi tiān}{复习|fù xí}{很|hěn}{有用|yǒu yòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I think revising every day is very useful.

vocab.note: Usually for a belief that turned out wrong: {我|wǒ}{以为|yǐ wéi}…，{但是|dàn shì}… (I thought…, but…).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{以为|yǐ wéi}{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{来|lái}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: I thought you weren't coming!

vocab.note: Also with the source inside: {听|tīng}{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō} (I heard from the teacher that…).
vocab.example: {听说|tīng shuō}{明天|míng tiān}{要|yào}{考试|kǎo shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I hear there's an exam tomorrow.

vocab.note: {记|jì}{笔记|bǐ jì} (take notes), {记|jì}{在|zài}{本子|běn zi}{上|shàng} (write down in a notebook), {记|jì}{住|zhù} (to memorise). {记得|jì de} (HSK 2) is "to remember".
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}{的|de}{话|huà}，{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{记|jì}{在|zài}{本子|běn zi}{上|shàng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I wrote down everything the teacher said in my notebook.

vocab.note: Means the same as {忘|wàng} (HSK 2), a little more written; {忘|wàng}{了|le} is the usual spoken form.
vocab.example: {别|bié}{忘记|wàng jì}{带|dài}{护照|hù zhào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't forget to bring your passport.

vocab.note: {明|ming} is light.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{孩子|hái zi}{很|hěn}{聪明|cōng ming}。
vocab.exampleEn: This child is very clever.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{很|hěn}{简单|jiǎn dān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This question is very simple.

vocab.note: Before a verb: {容易|róng yì}{懂|dǒng} (easy to understand), {很|hěn}{容易|róng yì}{忘|wàng} (easy to forget, likely to be forgotten).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{很|hěn}{容易|róng yì}{写|xiě}{错|cuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: This character is easy to get wrong.

vocab.note: Mostly an adjective ({这个|zhè ge}{题|tí}{很|hěn}{难|nán}) and before a verb: {难|nán}{写|xiě} (hard to write), {很|hěn}{难|nán}{说|shuō} (hard to say).
vocab.example: {汉字|hàn zì}{难|nán}{写|xiě}，{但是|dàn shì}{不|bù}{难|nán}{认|rèn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Characters are hard to write, but not hard to recognise.

vocab.note: The room or rooms where people work; the company itself is {公司|gōng sī}.
vocab.example: {经理|jīng lǐ}{在|zài}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Is the manager in the office?

vocab.note: The formal word, also for big conferences ({会议|huì yì}{室|shì}: meeting room). Measure {个|gè} or {次|cì}.
vocab.example: {下午|xià wǔ}{的|de}{会议|huì yì}{在|zài}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{开|kāi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The afternoon meeting will be held on the third floor.

vocab.note: Separable: {开|kāi}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{会|huì}, {开|kāi}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{的|de}{会|huì}.
vocab.example: {经理|jīng lǐ}{正在|zhèng zài}{开会|kāi huì}{呢|ne}。
vocab.exampleEn: The manager is in a meeting.

vocab.note: The noun, mostly with {开|kāi}: {开会|kāi huì}, {开|kāi}{个|gè}{会|huì}. Not the verb {会|huì} "can" (HSK 1).
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{会|huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a meeting tomorrow morning.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{工作日|gōng zuò rì}{能|néng}{完成|wán chéng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This work can be done in five working days.

vocab.note: Also a title after the surname: {王|Wáng}{经理|jīng lǐ} (Manager Wang).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{经理|jīng lǐ}{姓|xìng}{李|Lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our manager's surname is Li.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{和|hé}{同事|tóng shì}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{吃|chī}{午饭|wǔ fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I go to lunch with my colleagues.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}{就|jiù}{解决|jiě jué}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The problem was soon solved.

vocab.note: For tasks and plans: {完成|wán chéng}{工作|gōng zuò}, {完成|wán chéng}{作业|zuò yè}. {完|wán} (HSK 2) is mostly a result complement: {做|zuò}{完|wán}.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{我|wǒ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{完成|wán chéng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've already finished today's work.
