vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{的|de}{售价|shòu jià}{是|shì}{五十|wǔ shí}{元|yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: This book sells for fifty yuan.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{辆|liàng}{车|chē}{的|de}{外观|wài guān}{很|hěn}{漂亮|piào liang}。
vocab.exampleEn: This car looks beautiful.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{机器人|jī qì rén}{的|de}{外形|wài xíng}{像|xiàng}{一|yì}{只|zhǐ}{猫|māo}。
vocab.exampleEn: This robot is shaped like a cat.

vocab.note: Traditional {+{网络|wǎng luò}+}.
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{没有|méi yǒu}{网络|wǎng luò}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's no internet here.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{输入|shū rù}{密码|mì mǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please enter your password.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{搜|sōu}{一下|yí xià}{就|jiù}{知道|zhī dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Look it up online and you'll see.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{搜索|sōu suǒ}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{资料|zī liào}。
vocab.exampleEn: I searched online for a lot of information.

vocab.note: {挑|tiāo} tiāo (choose); lesson 05's {挑战|tiǎo zhàn} is tiǎo.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{挑|tiāo}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Help me pick out something to wear.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{挑选|tiāo xuǎn}{了|le}{很|hěn}{久|jiǔ}{才|cái}{买|mǎi}。
vocab.exampleEn: She took ages choosing before she bought anything.

vocab.example: {用|yòng}{完|wán}{以后|yǐ hòu}{请|qǐng}{退出|tuì chū}{账号|zhàng hào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please log out when you've finished.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}{物价|wù jià}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Prices have been rising these last few years.

vocab.example: {租|zū}{房子|fáng zi}{要|yào}{先|xiān}{交|jiāo}{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{的|de}{押金|yā jīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: To rent a flat you first pay a month's deposit.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{的|de}{样式|yàng shì}{很|hěn}{新|xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This piece of clothing has a new design.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{音量|yīn liàng}{开|kāi}{小|xiǎo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please turn the volume down a bit.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{台|tái}{电脑|diàn nǎo}{的|de}{硬件|yìng jiàn}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{软件|ruǎn jiàn}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{旧|jiù}。
vocab.exampleEn: This computer's hardware is good, but the software is a bit old.

vocab.note: Traditional {+{用户|yòng hù}+}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{软件|ruǎn jiàn}{有|yǒu}{几|jǐ}{百万|bǎi wàn}{用户|yòng hù}。
vocab.exampleEn: This app has millions of users.

vocab.note: {载|zǎi} zǎi; xià zài is also heard (some dictionaries give it).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{可以|kě yǐ}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{下载|xià zǎi}{这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can download this book online.

vocab.example: {手机|shǒu jī}{上|shàng}{显示|xiǎn shì}{有|yǒu}{三|sān}{个|gè}{电话|diàn huà}{没|méi}{接|jiē}。
vocab.exampleEn: The phone shows three missed calls.

vocab.note: Before a noun: mobile ({移动支付|yí dòng zhī fù}, {移动网络|yí dòng wǎng luò}).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{移动|yí dòng}{这些|zhè xiē}{桌子|zhuō zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please don't move these tables.

vocab.note: {优惠|yōu huì}{价|jià} (a special price), {优惠券|yōu huì quàn} (a coupon).
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{买|mǎi}{有|yǒu}{优惠|yōu huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a discount if you buy today.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{不|bù}{收|shōu}{运费|yùn fèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: This shop doesn't charge for postage.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{账号|zhàng hào}{和|hé}{密码|mì mǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've forgotten my username and password.

vocab.note: {打|dǎ}{九|jiǔ}{折|zhé} = 10 % off.
vocab.example: {会员|huì yuán}{可以|kě yǐ}{打|dǎ}{九|jiǔ}{折|zhé}，{这个|zhè ge}{折扣|zhé kòu}{不错|bú cuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: Members get ten per cent off: that's a good discount.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{现在|xiàn zài}{不|bú}{在线|zài xiàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's not online at the moment.

vocab.note: Traditional {+{占线|zhàn xiàn}+}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{好几|hǎo jǐ}{次|cì}，{电话|diàn huà}{一直|yì zhí}{占线|zhàn xiàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I rang several times, but the line was always busy.

vocab.note: {涨|zhǎng} zhǎng.
vocab.example: {最近|zuì jìn}{菜|cài}{又|yòu}{涨价|zhǎng jià}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Vegetables have gone up again recently.

vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{有|yǒu}{足球|zú qiú}{比赛|bǐ sài}{的|de}{直播|zhí bō}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a live broadcast of the football match tonight.

vocab.note: Traditional {+{注册|zhù cè}+}.
vocab.example: {先|xiān}{注册|zhù cè}{一|yí}{个|gè}{账号|zhàng hào}，{再|zài}{登录|dēng lù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Register an account first, then log in.

vocab.note: Of machines and things; people act {主动|zhǔ dòng} (on their initiative).
vocab.example: {地铁|dì tiě}{的|de}{门|mén}{会|huì}{自动|zì dòng}{打开|dǎ kāi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The metro doors open automatically.

vocab.note: Informal names: {上班族|shàng bān zú}, {低头族|dī tóu zú}, {追星族|zhuī xīng zú}, {月光族|yuè guāng zú}.
vocab.example: {上班族|shàng bān zú}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Office workers are busy every day.

vocab.note: {本地|běn dì} is where the speaker is; {当地|dāng dì} is the place being talked about.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{本地|běn dì}{人|rén}，{这里|zhè lǐ}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{熟悉|shú xī}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm a local: I know this place well.

vocab.note: {老城区|lǎo chéng qū} (the old town), {新城区|xīn chéng qū} (the new districts).
vocab.example: {从|cóng}{村|cūn}{里|lǐ}{到|dào}{城区|chéng qū}{只要|zhǐ yào}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's only an hour from the village to the town.

vocab.note: Written and on signs: {步行|bù xíng}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}. In speech, {走路|zǒu lù} or {走|zǒu}{着|zhe}{去|qù}.
vocab.example: {从|cóng}{地铁站|dì tiě zhàn}{步行|bù xíng}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's a five-minute walk from the metro station.

vocab.note: The written partner of {方便|fāng biàn}: {交通|jiāo tōng}{便利|biàn lì}, {生活|shēng huó}{便利|biàn lì}.
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{交通|jiāo tōng}{便利|biàn lì}，{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{方便|fāng biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Transport here is convenient, and shopping is easy too.

vocab.note: The place being talked about: {当地|dāng dì}{居民|jū mín} (the residents there). Not "here" (that is {本地|běn dì}).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{请|qǐng}{了|le}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{当地|dāng dì}{人|rén}{当|dāng}{导游|dǎo yóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: We got a local to be our guide.

vocab.note: {北方|běi fāng}{地区|dì qū}, {山区|shān qū}, {发达|fā dá}{地区|dì qū}. {区域|qū yù} is the more technical word.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{地区|dì qū}{冬天|dōng tiān}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Winters are cold in this region.

vocab.note: {地下|dì xià}{停车场|tíng chē chǎng} (an underground car park). {底下|dǐ xia} dǐ xia (HSK 4) is "underneath".
vocab.example: {商场|shāng chǎng}{的|de}{地下|dì xià}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{超市|chāo shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a supermarket in the mall's basement.

vocab.note: A written, collective word; in speech, {房子|fáng zi} or {楼|lóu}.
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{房屋|fáng wū}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{三十|sān shí}{年|nián}{前|qián}{建|jiàn}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: Most of the houses round here were built thirty years ago.

vocab.note: {促进|cù jìn}{发展|fā zhǎn}, {促进|cù jìn}{交流|jiāo liú}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{新|xīn}{铁路|tiě lù}{促进|cù jìn}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{交流|jiāo liú}。
vocab.exampleEn: The new railway has boosted contact between the two cities.

meanings: to spur on (one thing driving another)
vocab.note: One thing pulls another along: {旅游|lǚ yóu}{带动|dài dòng}{了|le}{当地|dāng dì}{经济|jīng jì}.
vocab.example: {旅游|lǚ yóu}{带动|dài dòng}{了|le}{当地|dāng dì}{经济|jīng jì}{的|de}{发展|fā zhǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Tourism has driven the growth of the local economy.

vocab.note: Verb and adjective: {路上|lù shang}{很|hěn}{堵|dǔ} (the roads are jammed), {下水道|xià shuǐ dào}{堵|dǔ}{了|le} (the drain is blocked).
vocab.example: {下班|xià bān}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}{堵|dǔ}{得|de}{很|hěn}{厉害|lì hai}。
vocab.exampleEn: This road gets badly jammed at rush hour.

vocab.note: For conditions that were poor: {改善|gǎi shàn}{生活|shēng huó}, {改善|gǎi shàn}{环境|huán jìng}. A skill is {提高|tí gāo}.
vocab.example: {公交车|gōng jiāo chē}{开通|kāi tōng}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{村|cūn}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{交通|jiāo tōng}{改善|gǎi shàn}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: Transport in the village improved a lot once the bus started running.

vocab.note: {电动车|diàn dòng chē} (an e-bike, HSK 4), {电动|diàn dòng}{汽车|qì chē} (an electric car).
vocab.example: {现在|xiàn zài}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{开|kāi}{电动|diàn dòng}{汽车|qì chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: Lots of people drive electric cars now.

vocab.note: {发达|fā dá}{地区|dì qū}, {发达|fā dá}{国家|guó jiā}, {交通|jiāo tōng}{发达|fā dá} (with good transport links).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{交通|jiāo tōng}{很|hěn}{发达|fā dá}。
vocab.exampleEn: This city has excellent transport links.

vocab.note: {繁荣|fán róng}{的|de}{城市|chéng shì}, {经济|jīng jì}{繁荣|fán róng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{街|jiē}{以前|yǐ qián}{很|hěn}{繁荣|fán róng}，{现在|xiàn zài}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{店|diàn}{都|dōu}{关|guān}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This street used to thrive; now many shops have closed.

vocab.note: Mostly in compounds and set phrases ({富有|fù yǒu}, {丰富|fēng fù}); of a person, people say {有|yǒu}{钱|qián}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{地方|dì fang}{以前|yǐ qián}{很|hěn}{穷|qióng}，{现在|xiàn zài}{富|fù}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This place used to be poor; now it is well off.

vocab.note: Also "full of": {富有|fù yǒu}{特色|tè sè} (full of character), {富有|fù yǒu}{经验|jīng yàn} (very experienced).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{富有|fù yǒu}{经验|jīng yàn}{的|de}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's a highly experienced teacher.

vocab.note: {天安门|Tiān'ān mén}{广场|guǎng chǎng}, {社区|shè qū}{广场|guǎng chǎng}.
vocab.example: {晚上|wǎn shang}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{老人|lǎo rén}{在|zài}{广场|guǎng chǎng}{上|shàng}{跳舞|tiào wǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the evening lots of older people dance in the square.

vocab.note: {海外|hǎi wài}{的|de}{中国|Zhōng guó}{人|rén}, {海外|hǎi wài}{市场|shì chǎng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{在|zài}{海外|hǎi wài}{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{客户|kè hù}。
vocab.exampleEn: This company has many customers overseas too.

vocab.note: In Beijing speech often hútòngr or hútong.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{胡同|hú tòng}{里|lǐ}{住|zhù}{了|le}{六十|liù shí}{多|duō}{年|nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's lived in this hutong for over sixty years.

vocab.note: Adjective and verb: {地铁|dì tiě}{里|lǐ}{很|hěn}{挤|jǐ} (the metro is packed), {挤|jǐ}{上|shàng}{车|chē} (squeeze onto the bus).
vocab.example: {早上|zǎo shang}{的|de}{地铁|dì tiě}{挤|jǐ}{得|de}{要命|yào mìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The morning metro is horribly packed.

vocab.note: The short, all-purpose verb: {建|jiàn}{房子|fáng zi}, {建|jiàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{广场|guǎng chǎng}. {建于|jiàn yú} (written): built in.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{广场|guǎng chǎng}{是|shì}{去年|qù nián}{建|jiàn}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This square was built last year.

vocab.note: A whole place or system: {建设|jiàn shè}{城市|chéng shì}, {社区|shè qū}{建设|jiàn shè}. Also the noun.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}{城市|chéng shì}{建设|jiàn shè}{发展|fā zhǎn}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Urban development has been fast in recent years.

vocab.note: {建造|jiàn zào}{房屋|fáng wū}, {建造|jiàn zào}{一|yí}{座|zuò}{桥|qiáo}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{座|zuò}{桥|qiáo}{是|shì}{一百|yì bǎi}{年|nián}{前|qián}{建造|jiàn zào}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This bridge was built a hundred years ago.

vocab.note: Mostly the noun: {一|yí}{座|zuò}{古老|gǔ lǎo}{的|de}{建筑|jiàn zhù}; {建筑|jiàn zhù}{师|shī} (architect).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{座|zuò}{建筑|jiàn zhù}{已经|yǐ jīng}{有|yǒu}{三百多|sān bǎi duō}{年|nián}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This building is over three hundred years old.

vocab.note: Mostly written and figurative: {影响|yǐng xiǎng}{很|hěn}{广|guǎng}. Physical "wide" is {宽|kuān}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{的|de}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}{很|hěn}{广|guǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This book has had a wide influence.

vocab.note: {广大|guǎng dà}{地区|dì qū}; {广大|guǎng dà}{市民|shì mín} (the public, in notices).
vocab.example: {欢迎|huān yíng}{广大|guǎng dà}{市民|shì mín}{来|lái}{参观|cān guān}。
vocab.exampleEn: All members of the public are welcome to visit.

vocab.note: {社区|shè qū}{居民|jū mín}, {当地|dāng dì}{居民|jū mín}.
vocab.example: {社区|shè qū}{居民|jū mín}{对|duì}{新|xīn}{公园|gōng yuán}{很|hěn}{满意|mǎn yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The residents are very pleased with the new park.

vocab.note: Someone who happened to be there; in traffic rules, {行人|xíng rén}.
vocab.example: {一|yí}{位|wèi}{路人|lù rén}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{叫|jiào}{了|le}{救护车|jiù hù chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: A passer-by called an ambulance for me.

vocab.note: The written partner of {住|zhù}: {居住|jū zhù}{在|zài}{城区|chéng qū}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{一直|yì zhí}{居住|jū zhù}{在|zài}{这|zhè}{座|zuò}{小|xiǎo}{城|chéng}{里|lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's always lived in this little town.

meanings: to be at a distance from (written)
vocab.note: Written short form of {距离|jù lí}: {距|jù}{市中心|shì zhōng xīn}{十|shí}{公里|gōng lǐ}. In speech, {离|lí}.
vocab.example: {酒店|jiǔ diàn}{距|jù}{火车站|huǒ chē zhàn}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{两|liǎng}{公里|gōng lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The hotel is only two kilometres from the station.

vocab.note: {这个|zhè ge}{公园|gōng yuán}{对|duì}{市民|shì mín}{免费|miǎn fèi}{开放|kāi fàng} (free and open to residents). Also of people: open-minded.
vocab.example: {博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{每|měi}{周|zhōu}{一|yí}{不|bù}{开放|kāi fàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The museum is closed on Mondays.

vocab.note: Before a two-syllable verb: {进一步|jìn yí bù}{了解|liǎo jiě}, {进一步|jìn yí bù}{改善|gǎi shàn}. Also {进一步|jìn yí bù}{的|de} + noun.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{想|xiǎng}{进一步|jìn yí bù}{了解|liǎo jiě}{当地|dāng dì}{人|rén}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}。
vocab.exampleEn: We'd like to learn more about local people's lives.

vocab.note: {欧洲|Ōu zhōu}{人|rén}, {欧洲|Ōu zhōu}{国家|guó jiā}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{去|qù}{过|guo}{欧洲|Ōu zhōu}{的|de}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{国家|guó jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's been to lots of European countries.

vocab.note: {汽油|qì yóu}{车|chē} (a petrol car) vs {电动|diàn dòng}{汽车|qì chē}.
vocab.example: {汽油|qì yóu}{又|yòu}{涨价|zhǎng jià}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Petrol has gone up again.

vocab.note: More technical than {地区|dì qū}: an area on a map or in a plan.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{区域|qū yù}{禁止|jìn zhǐ}{停车|tíng chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: Parking is prohibited in this zone.

vocab.note: A category of people: {年轻人|nián qīng rén}{这个|zhè ge}{群体|qún tǐ}.
vocab.example: {老年|lǎo nián}{人|rén}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{需要|xū yào}{关心|guān xīn}{的|de}{群体|qún tǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Older people are a group who need care.

vocab.note: {人口|rén kǒu}{多|duō} / {少|shǎo}; {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{人口|rén kǒu}{有|yǒu}{八百|bā bǎi}{多|duō}{万|wàn}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{人口|rén kǒu}{不|bú}{到|dào}{五十万|wǔ shí wàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The city has fewer than 500,000 people.

vocab.note: People you see together: {人群|rén qún}{中|zhōng} (in the crowd).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{人群|rén qún}{中|zhōng}{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{了|le}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: She found her child in the crowd.

vocab.note: {山区|shān qū}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}, {住|zhù}{在|zài}{山区|shān qū}.
vocab.example: {外公|wài gōng}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{南方|nán fāng}{的|de}{山区|shān qū}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandpa lives in the mountains in the south.

vocab.note: {社区|shè qū}{中心|zhōng xīn} (community centre), {社区|shè qū}{医院|yī yuàn}.
vocab.example: {社区|shè qū}{里|lǐ}{新|xīn}{开|kāi}{了|le}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{小|xiǎo}{超市|chāo shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: A little supermarket has opened in the neighbourhood.

vocab.note: {公共|gōng gòng}{设施|shè shī}, {体育|tǐ yù}{设施|shè shī}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{小区|xiǎo qū}{的|de}{设施|shè shī}{很|hěn}{完善|wán shàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The compound is well equipped.

vocab.note: Opposite {富|fù} / {有|yǒu}{钱|qián}: {穷|qióng}{人|rén}, {穷|qióng}{地方|dì fang}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{很|hěn}{穷|qióng}。
vocab.exampleEn: His family was very poor when he was a child.

vocab.note: Notices address {广大|guǎng dà}{市民|shì mín} (the public).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{活动|huó dòng}{吸引|xī yǐn}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{市民|shì mín}。
vocab.exampleEn: The event drew a lot of local people.

vocab.note: A little more written than {到处|dào chù}: {四处|sì chù}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{人|rén}, {四处|sì chù}{看看|kàn kan}.
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{公园|gōng yuán}{里|lǐ}{四处|sì chù}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: At weekends there are people all over the park.

vocab.note: {修建|xiū jiàn}{铁路|tiě lù}; {高速|gāo sù}{铁路|tiě lù} (high-speed rail, {高铁|gāo tiě}).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{铁路|tiě lù}{是|shì}{十|shí}{年|nián}{前|qián}{修建|xiū jiàn}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This railway was built ten years ago.

vocab.note: Farmland and land in general: {土地|tǔ dì}{少|shǎo}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{土地|tǔ dì}{很|hěn}{适合|shì hé}{种|zhòng}{玉米|yù mǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The land here is good for growing maize.

vocab.note: {这个|zhè ge}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{位置|wèi zhì}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo} (well placed). Also a post, a seat.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{能|néng}{把|bǎ}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{位置|wèi zhì}{发|fā}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can you send me your location?

vocab.note: {顺|shùn}{着|zhe} (along, following); {工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{顺|shùn} (going smoothly).
vocab.example: {顺|shùn}{着|zhe}{这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}{一直|yì zhí}{走|zǒu}，{就|jiù}{能|néng}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{车站|chē zhàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Follow this road straight on and you'll see the station.

vocab.note: {推动|tuī dòng}{发展|fā zhǎn}, {推动|tuī dòng}{建设|jiàn shè}.
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{技术|jì shù}{推动|tuī dòng}{了|le}{经济|jīng jì}{的|de}{发展|fā zhǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: New technology has pushed the economy forward.

vocab.note: Notices and guidebooks; in speech, {在|zài}.
vocab.example: {博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{位于|wèi yú}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{中心|zhōng xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The museum is in the centre of the city.

vocab.note: {乡村|xiāng cūn}{生活|shēng huó}; a little more literary than {农村|nóng cūn}.
vocab.example: {越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}{的|de}{城|chéng}{里|lǐ}{人|rén}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{去|qù}{乡村|xiāng cūn}{过|guò}{周末|zhōu mò}。
vocab.exampleEn: More and more city people like to spend weekends in the countryside.

vocab.note: In traffic rules: {车辆|chē liàng}{要|yào}{让|ràng}{行人|xíng rén} (vehicles must give way to pedestrians).
vocab.example: {路口|lù kǒu}{的|de}{行人|xíng rén}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{开车|kāi chē}{要|yào}{小心|xiǎo xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of pedestrians at the junction: drive carefully.

vocab.note: Noun and verb; {现代化|xiàn dài huà}{的|de}{城市|chéng shì} (a modern city). {化|huà} is lesson 19's suffix.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{现代化|xiàn dài huà}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The city is getting more and more modern.

vocab.note: Roads, railways, bridges: {修建|xiū jiàn}{公路|gōng lù}.
vocab.example: {村|cūn}{里|lǐ}{修建|xiū jiàn}{了|le}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{新|xīn}{公路|gōng lù}。
vocab.exampleEn: A new road has been built in the village.

vocab.note: {沿|yán}{着|zhe} + route + verb of movement; {沿|yán} alone in {沿|yán}{河|hé}, {沿|yán}{街|jiē}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{沿|yán}{着|zhe}{河边|hé biān}{走|zǒu}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: We walked along the river for an hour.

vocab.note: {中外|zhōng wài}{游客|yóu kè}, {中外|zhōng wài}{学生|xué sheng}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{节日|jié rì}{吸引|xī yǐn}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{中外|zhōng wài}{游客|yóu kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: The festival attracts many visitors from China and abroad.

vocab.note: {市中心|shì zhōng xīn}, {社区|shè qū}{中心|zhōng xīn}; also the centre of attention.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{离|lí}{市中心|shì zhōng xīn}{不|bú}{太|tài}{远|yuǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: My home isn't far from the city centre.

vocab.note: Opposite {宽|kuān} (wide, lesson 28).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{胡同|hú tòng}{太|tài}{窄|zhǎi}，{车|chē}{开不进去|kāi bu jìn qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: This hutong is too narrow for cars to get in.

vocab.note: Deliberate change: {逐步|zhú bù}{改善|gǎi shàn}. Natural change is {逐渐|zhú jiàn} (lesson 22).
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{逐步|zhú bù}{改善|gǎi shàn}{了|le}{宿舍|sù shè}{的|de}{条件|tiáo jiàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The school improved the dorms step by step.

vocab.note: {游泳池|yóu yǒng chí} (a swimming pool), {池|chí}{子|zi}.
vocab.example: {公园|gōng yuán}{的|de}{池|chí}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{鱼|yú}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of fish in the pond in the park.

vocab.note: Of birds, insects and planes.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{只|zhī}{鸟|niǎo}{的|de}{翅膀|chì bǎng}{受伤|shòu shāng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This bird's wing is hurt.

vocab.note: The everyday word; {昆虫|kūn chóng} is the science word.
vocab.example: {苹果|píng guǒ}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{虫子|chóng zi}！
vocab.exampleEn: There's a worm in the apple!

vocab.note: {爱护|ài hù}{树木|shù mù}, {爱护|ài hù}{动物|dòng wù}: the verb of park signs.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{爱护|ài hù}{公园|gōng yuán}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{花|huā}{草|cǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please take care of the park's flowers and grass.

vocab.note: {朝|cháo} + direction or person + verb (concrete only); {朝|cháo}{南|nán} (facing south).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{朝|cháo}{我|wǒ}{笑|xiào}{了|le}{笑|xiào}。
vocab.exampleEn: He smiled at me.

vocab.note: {光线|guāng xiàn}{暗|àn} (the light is poor). Night has come: {天|tiān}{黑|hēi}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {房间|fáng jiān}{里|lǐ}{太|tài}{暗|àn}{了|le}，{开|kāi}{一下|yí xià}{灯|dēng}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's too dark in here: put the light on.

vocab.note: Counted with {头|tóu}: {一|yì}{头|tóu}{大象|dà xiàng}.
vocab.example: {孩子们|hái zi men}{在|zài}{动物园|dòng wù yuán}{里|lǐ}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{了|le}{大象|dà xiàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children saw elephants at the zoo.

vocab.note: {地面|dì miàn}{很|hěn}{滑|huá} (the floor is slippery).
vocab.example: {下雨|xià yǔ}{以后|yǐ hòu}{地面|dì miàn}{很|hěn}{湿|shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The ground is wet after the rain.

vocab.note: {山|shān}{洞|dòng} (a cave), {衣服|yī fu}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{个|gè}{洞|dòng} (a hole in the clothes).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{袜子|wà zi}{破|pò}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{洞|dòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a hole in my sock.

vocab.note: {非洲|Fēi zhōu}{国家|guó jiā}, {非洲|Fēi zhōu}{的|de}{大象|dà xiàng}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{非洲|Fēi zhōu}{工作|gōng zuò}{了|le}{三|sān}{年|nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: He worked in Africa for three years.

vocab.note: {登|dēng}{山|shān}, {登|dēng}{上|shàng}{山顶|shān dǐng} (written for {爬|pá}); also to publish in a paper: {登|dēng}{在|zài}{报纸|bào zhǐ}{上|shàng}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{早上|zǎo shang}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}{登|dēng}{山|shān}。
vocab.exampleEn: We started up the mountain at six in the morning.

vocab.note: {发生|fā shēng}{了|le}{地震|dì zhèn} (an earthquake happened).
vocab.example: {那|nà}{次|cì}{地震|dì zhèn}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{房子|fáng zi}{都|dōu}{要|yào}{重新|chóng xīn}{修|xiū}。
vocab.exampleEn: After that earthquake many houses had to be rebuilt.

meanings: to be distributed (spread over an area)
vocab.note: {分布|fēn bù}{在|zài} + place; {分布|fēn bù}{很|hěn}{广|guǎng} (widespread).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{鸟|niǎo}{主要|zhǔ yào}{分布|fēn bù}{在|zài}{南方|nán fāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This bird is found mainly in the south.

vocab.note: {垃圾|lā jī}{分类|fēn lèi} (sorting rubbish).
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{书|shū}{已经|yǐ jīng}{分|fēn}{好|hǎo}{类|lèi}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: These books have already been sorted.

vocab.note: 30{度|dù} (30 degrees); in {温度|wēn dù}, {速度|sù dù}, {角度|jiǎo dù}.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{最|zuì}{高|gāo}{气温|qì wēn}{三十五|sān shí wǔ}{度|dù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Today's high is 35 degrees.

meanings: root; (measure word for long thin things)
vocab.note: As a measure word: {一|yì}{根|gēn}{竹子|zhú zi}, {一|yì}{根|gēn}{头发|tóu fa}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{棵|kē}{树|shù}{的|de}{根|gēn}{很|hěn}{深|shēn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This tree has deep roots.

vocab.note: {光线|guāng xiàn}{好|hǎo} / {暗|àn}: for reading and photos.
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{光线|guāng xiàn}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}，{换|huàn}{个|gè}{地方|dì fang}{拍照|pāi zhào}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: The light isn't good here: let's take the photo somewhere else.

vocab.note: Of any plant; {水果|shuǐ guǒ} is fruit you eat.
vocab.example: {秋天|qiū tiān}，{树|shù}{上|shàng}{结|jié}{满|mǎn}{了|le}{果实|guǒ shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: In autumn the trees are full of fruit.

vocab.note: Written and collective; one river is {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{河|hé}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{地区|dì qū}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{河流|hé liú}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are many rivers in this region.

vocab.note: {湖|hú}{边|biān} (the lakeside), {西|xī}{湖|hú} (West Lake).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{湖|hú}{上|shàng}{划|huá}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{船|chuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: We rowed on the lake for an hour.

vocab.note: Counted with {只|zhī}.
vocab.example: {花园|huā yuán}{里|lǐ}{飞|fēi}{来|lái}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{只|zhī}{蝴蝶|hú dié}。
vocab.exampleEn: Two butterflies flew into the garden.

vocab.note: {灰|huī} alone is ash or dust; {灰色|huī sè} (lesson 10) is grey.
vocab.example: {桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{灰|huī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The table is covered in dust.

vocab.note: huá: {划|huá}{船|chuán} (to row a boat). In {计划|jì huà} the character is huà.
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{公园|gōng yuán}{划|huá}{船|chuán}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go rowing in the park at the weekend.

vocab.note: {回收|huí shōu}{旧|jiù}{手机|shǒu jī}, {回收|huí shōu}{利用|lì yòng}.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{瓶子|píng zi}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}{回收|huí shōu}。
vocab.exampleEn: All these bottles can be recycled.

vocab.note: {黑色|hēi sè} (black); {天|tiān}{黑|hēi}{了|le} (it has got dark).
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{已经|yǐ jīng}{黑|hēi}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{快|kuài}{回家|huí jiā}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's already dark: let's hurry home.

vocab.note: {空中|kōng zhōng}{飞|fēi}{着|zhe}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{鸟|niǎo}.
vocab.example: {风|fēng}{把|bǎ}{纸|zhǐ}{吹|chuī}{到|dào}{了|le}{空中|kōng zhōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The wind blew the paper up into the air.

vocab.note: The science word; in speech, {虫子|chóng zi}.
vocab.example: {蝴蝶|hú dié}{也|yě}{是|shì}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}{昆虫|kūn chóng}。
vocab.exampleEn: A butterfly is an insect too.

vocab.note: {地球|dì qiú}{上|shàng}{的|de}{陆地|lù dì} (the earth's land).
vocab.example: {地球|dì qiú}{上|shàng}{的|de}{陆地|lù dì}{比|bǐ}{海洋|hǎi yáng}{少|shǎo}{得|de}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's far less land on Earth than sea.

vocab.note: {别|bié}{靠近|kào jìn}{那|nà}{条|tiáo}{狗|gǒu}; {靠近|kào jìn}{窗户|chuāng hu}{的|de}{座位|zuò wèi} (a seat by the window).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{靠近|kào jìn}{水|shuǐ}{边|biān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please keep away from the water.

vocab.note: Written; in speech, {安静|ān jìng}: {夜里|yè li}{很|hěn}{静|jìng}.
vocab.example: {湖|hú}{面|miàn}{很|hěn}{静|jìng}，{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{风|fēng}{也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: The lake is still: there's no wind at all.

vocab.note: Photos, memories, ideas: {照片|zhào piàn}{很|hěn}{模糊|mó hu}, {记得|jì de}{很|hěn}{模糊|mó hu}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{张|zhāng}{照片|zhào piàn}{拍|pāi}{得|de}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{模糊|mó hu}。
vocab.exampleEn: This photo has come out a bit blurred.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{颗|kē}{种子|zhǒng zi}, {一|yì}{颗|kē}{星星|xīng xing}, {一|yì}{颗|kē}{牙|yá}. Trees take {棵|kē}.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{能|néng}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{一|yì}{颗|kē}{很|hěn}{亮|liàng}{的|de}{星星|xīng xing}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can see a very bright star tonight.

vocab.note: {新|xīn}{品种|pǐn zhǒng}, {很|hěn}{多|duō}{品种|pǐn zhǒng}{的|de}{苹果|píng guǒ}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{苹果|píng guǒ}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{新|xīn}{品种|pǐn zhǒng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This apple is a new variety.

vocab.note: {人类|rén lèi}{社会|shè huì}, {人类|rén lèi}{历史|lì shǐ}.
vocab.example: {水|shuǐ}{是|shì}{人类|rén lèi}{生存|shēng cún}{离不开|lí bu kāi}{的|de}{资源|zī yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Water is a resource humankind cannot survive without.

vocab.note: {大|dà}{片|piàn}{的|de}{沙漠|shā mò}; {沙|shā} (sand) + {漠|mò}.
vocab.example: {沙漠|shā mò}{里|lǐ}{白天|bái tiān}{很|hěn}{热|rè}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the desert it's hot by day and cold at night.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{把|bǎ}{沙子|shā zi} (a handful of sand).
vocab.example: {孩子们|hái zi men}{在|zài}{海边|hǎi biān}{玩|wán}{沙子|shā zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children are playing with sand by the sea.

vocab.note: {破坏|pò huài}{环境|huán jìng}, {破坏|pò huài}{关系|guān xi}; things that were whole.
vocab.example: {大|dà}{风|fēng}{破坏|pò huài}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{房子|fáng zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The strong wind damaged many houses.

vocab.note: Written; the everyday verb is {烧|shāo} / {着火|zháo huǒ}.
vocab.example: {木头|mù tou}{燃烧|rán shāo}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{发出|fā chū}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{响声|xiǎng shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The wood crackled loudly as it burned.

meanings: to dry in the sun; to tan
vocab.note: {晒|shài}{衣服|yī fu}, {晒|shài}{太阳|tài yang} (sit in the sun), {晒|shài}{黑|hēi}{了|le} (got tanned).
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{天气|tiān qì}{好|hǎo}，{把|bǎ}{被子|bèi zi}{拿|ná}{出去|chū qù}{晒晒|shài shai}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's a nice day: let's put the duvet out in the sun.

vocab.note: {动物|dòng wù}{离不开|lí bu kāi}{水|shuǐ}，{没有|méi yǒu}{水|shuǐ}{就|jiù}{无法|wú fǎ}{生存|shēng cún}.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{植物|zhí wù}{在|zài}{沙漠|shā mò}{里|lǐ}{也|yě}{能|néng}{生存|shēng cún}。
vocab.exampleEn: These plants can survive even in the desert.

vocab.note: Plants and animals: {竹子|zhú zi}{生长|shēng zhǎng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}. A person growing up is {成长|chéng zhǎng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{树|shù}{生长|shēng zhǎng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{慢|màn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This tree grows slowly.

vocab.note: {这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{路|lù}{很|hěn}{平|píng}; {平|píng}{地|dì} (flat ground).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{张|zhāng}{桌子|zhuō zi}{不|bù}{平|píng}，{你|nǐ}{看看|kàn kan}{下面|xià miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This table isn't level: have a look underneath.

vocab.note: Opposite {深|shēn}: {河|hé}{水|shuǐ}{很|hěn}{浅|qiǎn}; {浅|qiǎn}{蓝|lán}{色|sè} (light blue).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{河|hé}{很|hěn}{浅|qiǎn}，{孩子们|hái zi men}{可以|kě yǐ}{在|zài}{里面|lǐ miàn}{玩|wán}。
vocab.exampleEn: The river is shallow: the children can play in it.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{群|qún}{人|rén}, {一|yì}{群|qún}{羊|yáng}, {一|yì}{群|qún}{鸭子|yā zi}.
vocab.example: {一|yì}{群|qún}{孩子|hái zi}{在|zài}{广场|guǎng chǎng}{上|shàng}{踢|tī}{球|qiú}。
vocab.exampleEn: A group of children is playing football in the square.

vocab.note: {石|shí} + the suffix {头|tóu} (lesson 18). Counted with {块|kuài}.
vocab.example: {河|hé}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{漂亮|piào liang}{的|de}{石头|shí tou}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of pretty stones in the river.

vocab.note: Collective and written: {爱护|ài hù}{树木|shù mù}. One tree is {一|yì}{棵|kē}{树|shù}.
vocab.example: {山上|shān shàng}{的|de}{树木|shù mù}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多了|duō le}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are more and more trees on the hills.

vocab.note: {湖|hú}{的|de}{四周|sì zhōu} (all round the lake).
vocab.example: {房子|fáng zi}{的|de}{四周|sì zhōu}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{树|shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The house has trees all around it.

vocab.note: Light second syllable: wěi ba.
vocab.example: {小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{主人|zhǔ rén}{就|jiù}{摇|yáo}{尾巴|wěi ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: The puppy wags its tail when it sees its owner.

vocab.note: Noun and verb: {受到|shòu dào}{威胁|wēi xié} (be under threat).
vocab.example: {环境|huán jìng}{污染|wū rǎn}{对|duì}{人类|rén lèi}{的|de}{健康|jiàn kāng}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{威胁|wēi xié}。
vocab.exampleEn: Pollution is a big threat to human health.

vocab.note: {围|wéi}{着|zhe} + something: {大家|dà jiā}{围|wéi}{着|zhe}{火|huǒ}{坐|zuò}{着|zhe}; {围巾|wéi jīn} (lesson 12).
vocab.example: {孩子们|hái zi men}{围|wéi}{着|zhe}{老师|lǎo shī}{问|wèn}{问题|wèn tí}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children gathered round the teacher with questions.

vocab.note: {衣服|yī fu}{湿|shī}{了|le}; {湿透|shī tòu}{了|le} (soaked through).
vocab.example: {下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}{都|dōu}{湿|shī}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's raining: my clothes are wet through.

vocab.note: {弯|wān}{路|lù} (a winding road); {弯|wān}{下|xià}{腰|yāo} (bend down).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}{很|hěn}{弯|wān}，{开车|kāi chē}{要|yào}{慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: This road is full of bends: drive slowly.

vocab.note: The noise of a thing; a voice is {声音|shēng yīn}.
vocab.example: {夜里|yè li}{我|wǒ}{听|tīng}{到|dào}{外面|wài miàn}{有|yǒu}{响声|xiǎng shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the night I heard a noise outside.

vocab.note: {形状|xíng zhuàng}{像|xiàng}… (shaped like…).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{块|kuài}{石头|shí tou}{的|de}{形状|xíng zhuàng}{像|xiàng}{一|yì}{只|zhī}{鸟|niǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: This stone is shaped like a bird.

vocab.note: {北京|Běi jīng}{烤|kǎo}{鸭|yā} (Peking duck) uses {鸭|yā}.
vocab.example: {湖|hú}{边|biān}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{群|qún}{鸭子|yā zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a flock of ducks by the lake.

vocab.note: {消失|xiāo shī}{在|zài} + place: {消失|xiāo shī}{在|zài}{人群|rén qún}{中|zhōng}.
vocab.example: {太阳|tài yang}{慢慢|màn màn}{消失|xiāo shī}{在|zài}{山|shān}{后面|hòu miàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The sun slowly disappeared behind the hills.

vocab.note: {形成|xíng chéng}{了|le}{习惯|xí guàn}, {这个|zhè ge}{湖|hú}{是|shì}{怎么|zěn me}{形成|xíng chéng}{的|de}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{湖|hú}{是|shì}{一万|yí wàn}{多|duō}{年|nián}{前|qián}{形成|xíng chéng}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This lake formed over ten thousand years ago.

vocab.note: {被|bèi}{蚊子|wén zi}{咬|yǎo}{了|le} (bitten by a mosquito); {咬|yǎo}{了|le}{一|yì}{口|kǒu} (took a bite).
vocab.example: {小心|xiǎo xīn}，{这|zhè}{只|zhī}{狗|gǒu}{会|huì}{咬|yǎo}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Careful: this dog bites.

vocab.note: {无数|wú shù}{次|cì} (countless times), {天上|tiān shàng}{有|yǒu}{无数|wú shù}{颗|kē}{星星|xīng xing}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{故事|gù shi}{我|wǒ}{听|tīng}{了|le}{无数|wú shù}{次|cì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've heard this story countless times.

vocab.note: {这|zhè}{张|zhāng}{画|huà}{挂|guà}{斜|xié}{了|le} (the picture is hanging crooked).
vocab.example: {墙|qiáng}{上|shàng}{的|de}{画|huà}{挂|guà}{斜|xié}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The picture on the wall is hanging crooked.

vocab.note: {月亮|yuè liang}{又|yòu}{大|dà}{又|yòu}{圆|yuán}; {画|huà}{一|yí}{个|gè}{圆|yuán} (draw a circle).
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{月亮|yuè liang}{又|yòu}{大|dà}{又|yòu}{圆|yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: The moon is big and round tonight.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{颗|kē}{种子|zhǒng zi}; {种|zhǒng} here is zhǒng.
vocab.example: {春天|chūn tiān}，{爷爷|yé ye}{在|zài}{院子|yuàn zi}{里|lǐ}{种|zhòng}{了|le}{几|jǐ}{颗|kē}{种子|zhǒng zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: In spring Grandpa planted a few seeds in the yard.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{根|gēn}{竹子|zhú zi} (a bamboo cane); {熊猫|xióng māo}{吃|chī}{竹子|zhú zi}.

vocab.exampleEn: This bamboo grows tall and straight.

vocab.note: {水|shuǐ}{资源|zī yuán}, {自然|zì rán}{资源|zī yuán}, {人力|rén lì}{资源|zī yuán}.
vocab.example: {水|shuǐ}{是|shì}{很|hěn}{宝贵|bǎo guì}{的|de}{资源|zī yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Water is a precious resource.

vocab.note: {摘|zhāi}{苹果|píng guǒ}, {摘|zhāi}{花|huā}; {摘|zhāi}{眼镜|yǎn jìng} (take off glasses).

vocab.exampleEn: In autumn we go up the hill to pick apples.

vocab.note: Written for {种|zhòng}: {种植|zhòng zhí}{树木|shù mù}, {种植|zhòng zhí}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{地区|dì qū}{主要|zhǔ yào}{种植|zhòng zhí}{玉米|yù mǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This region mainly grows maize.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{直|zhí}{路|lù}; {一直|yì zhí} (straight on, all along).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}{很|hěn}{直|zhí}，{开车|kāi chē}{很|hěn}{方便|fāng biàn}。

vocab.note: Natural change; planned change is {逐步|zhú bù} (lesson 21).

vocab.exampleEn: Please fasten your seat belt once you get in.

vocab.note: {交通|jiāo tōng}{标志|biāo zhì} (traffic signs), {公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{标志|biāo zhì} (a company logo).

vocab.note: {公共|gōng gòng}{场所|chǎng suǒ} (public places); {娱乐|yú lè}{场所|chǎng suǒ}.

vocab.exampleEn: Smoking is prohibited in public places.

vocab.note: {出|chū}{车祸|chē huò} (have a road accident).

vocab.exampleEn: He was in a road accident when he was young.

vocab.note: Written and collective: {车辆|chē liàng}{请|qǐng}{慢行|màn xíng}.
vocab.example: {晚上|wǎn shang}{这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路上|lù shang}{车辆|chē liàng}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's little traffic on this road at night.

vocab.note: In reports and notices.

vocab.exampleEn: The car owner got out at once to have a look.

vocab.note: chù: {此处|cǐ chù} (here), {办事处|bàn shì chù}, {售票处|shòu piào chù}. {处|chǔ} chǔ ({处理|chǔ lǐ}) is lesson 11's.
vocab.example: {此处|cǐ chù}{禁止|jìn zhǐ}{停车|tíng chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: No parking here.

vocab.note: {保|bǎo}{住|zhù} (to hold on to), {保安|bǎo ān} (a security guard), {保修|bǎo xiū} (a warranty).

vocab.exampleEn: We must save this old tree.

vocab.note: In compounds, shops, offices.
vocab.example: {小区|xiǎo qū}{门口|mén kǒu}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{保安|bǎo ān}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a security guard at the gate of the compound.

vocab.note: {马上|mǎ shàng}{报警|bào jǐng}! (Call the police at once!)

vocab.exampleEn: Seeing someone grabbing things, he called the police at once.

vocab.note: {与|yǔ}…{不符|bù fú} (written): {与|yǔ}{事实|shì shí}{不符|bù fú}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{填|tián}{的|de}{名字|míng zi}{和|hé}{证件|zhèng jiàn}{上|shàng}{的|de}{不符|bù fú}。

vocab.note: {采取|cǎi qǔ}{措施|cuò shī} (take measures), {采取|cǎi qǔ}{办法|bàn fǎ}.

vocab.note: {超速|chāo sù}{驾驶|jià shǐ} (speeding).

vocab.exampleEn: He was fined for speeding.

vocab.note: {船|chuán}{沉|chén}{了|le} (the boat sank); {这个|zhè ge}{箱子|xiāng zi}{很|hěn}{沉|chén} (this case is heavy).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{包|bāo}{怎么|zěn me}{这么|zhè me}{沉|chén}？
vocab.exampleEn: Why is your bag so heavy?

vocab.note: To rush: {冲|chōng}{过去|guò qù}. Also to rinse or make with hot water: {冲咖啡|chōng kā fēi}, written with a different character in traditional script.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{冲|chōng}{进|jìn}{房间|fáng jiān}，{大声|dà shēng}{说|shuō}："{着火|zháo huǒ}{了|le}！"
vocab.exampleEn: He rushed into the room and shouted, "Fire!"

vocab.note: {采取|cǎi qǔ}{措施|cuò shī}; {安全|ān quán}{措施|cuò shī} (safety measures).
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{措施|cuò shī}{对|duì}{保护环境|bǎo hù huán jìng}{很|hěn}{有用|yǒu yòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: These measures are very useful for protecting the environment.

vocab.note: {上|shàng}{法院|fǎ yuàn} (go to court).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{最后|zuì hòu}{还是|hái shi}{交|jiāo}{给|gěi}{法院|fǎ yuàn}{处理|chǔ lǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the end the matter was handed to the court.

meanings: to block (shield, get in the way of)
vocab.note: {挡住|dǎng zhù} (to block), {挡|dǎng}{风|fēng} (keep out the wind), {挡|dǎng}{雨|yǔ}.
vocab.example: {前面|qián miàn}{的|de}{人|rén}{挡住|dǎng zhù}{了|le}{我|wǒ}，{我|wǒ}{什么|shén me}{也|yě}{看不见|kàn bu jiàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The person in front is blocking me: I can't see a thing.

vocab.note: dǎo: {摔倒|shuāi dǎo}, {撞倒|zhuàng dǎo}; {倒|dǎo}{车|chē} (to change buses). HSK 4's {倒|dào} dào is to pour.
vocab.example: {大|dà}{风|fēng}{把|bǎ}{树|shù}{吹|chuī}{倒|dǎo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The strong wind blew the tree down.

vocab.note: Usually bad results; can take a clause.
vocab.example: {超速|chāo sù}{很|hěn}{容易|róng yì}{导致|dǎo zhì}{车祸|chē huò}。
vocab.exampleEn: Speeding easily leads to accidents.

vocab.note: Written for {丢|diū}: {证件|zhèng jiàn}{丢失|diū shī}.
vocab.example: {如果|rú guǒ}{证件|zhèng jiàn}{丢失|diū shī}，{请|qǐng}{马上|mǎ shàng}{报警|bào jǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: If your papers are lost, call the police at once.

vocab.note: {腿|tuǐ}{断|duàn}{了|le}, {电话|diàn huà}{断|duàn}{了|le} (the line went dead), {停|tíng}{电|diàn} = {断|duàn}{电|diàn}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{正在|zhèng zài}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}，{电话|diàn huà}{突然|tū rán}{断|duàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I was on the phone when the line suddenly went dead.

vocab.note: {躲|duǒ}{开|kāi} (dodge), {躲|duǒ}{雨|yǔ} (shelter from the rain), {躲|duǒ}{在|zài}{后面|hòu miàn}.
vocab.example: {下|xià}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{找|zhǎo}{个|gè}{地方|dì fang}{躲|duǒ}{一|yi}{躲|duǒ}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's pouring: let's find somewhere to shelter.

vocab.note: {罚|fá}{他|tā} (punish him), {被|bèi}{罚|fá}{了|le}200{元|yuán}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{违反|wéi fǎn}{了|le}{规则|guī zé}，{被|bèi}{老师|lǎo shī}{罚|fá}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He broke the rules and was punished by the teacher.

vocab.note: Noun and verb: {交|jiāo}{罚款|fá kuǎn} (pay a fine), {罚款|fá kuǎn}200{元|yuán}.

vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{节目|jié mù}{的|de}{嘉宾|jiā bīn}{是|shì}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{作家|zuò jiā}。

vocab.note: {公布|gōng bù}{结果|jié guǒ}, {公布|gōng bù}{名单|míng dān}, {公布|gōng bù}{成绩|chéng jì}.
vocab.example: {考试|kǎo shì}{成绩|chéng jì}{下|xià}{星期|xīng qī}{公布|gōng bù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The exam results will be published next week.

vocab.note: {广泛|guǎng fàn}{的|de}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}; {广泛|guǎng fàn}{地|de}{使用|shǐ yòng} (widely used).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{方法|fāng fǎ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{被|bèi}{广泛|guǎng fàn}{使用|shǐ yòng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This method is already widely used.

vocab.note: Written: {即将|jí jiāng}{开幕|kāi mù}, {即将|jí jiāng}{出版|chū bǎn}. In speech, {快要|kuài yào}…{了|le}.
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{的|de}{地铁站|dì tiě zhàn}{即将|jí jiāng}{开通|kāi tōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The new metro station is about to open.

vocab.note: {消息|xiāo xi}{的|de}{来源|lái yuán}, {收入|shōu rù}{来源|lái yuán}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{消息|xiāo xi}{的|de}{来源|lái yuán}{不|bú}{太|tài}{清楚|qīng chu}。
vocab.exampleEn: The source of this story isn't clear.

vocab.note: {劳动节|Láo dòng jié} (Labour Day, 1 May); {参加|cān jiā}{劳动|láo dòng}.
vocab.example: {劳动|láo dòng}{能|néng}{让|ràng}{人|rén}{身体健康|shēn tǐ jiàn kāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Physical work keeps people healthy.

vocab.note: Everyday and warm; {人民|rén mín} is formal.
vocab.example: {老百姓|lǎo bǎi xìng}{最|zuì}{关心|guān xīn}{的|de}{是|shì}{生活|shēng huó}{和|hé}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: What ordinary people care about most is life and work.

vocab.note: {新闻媒体|xīn wén méi tǐ}, {当地|dāng dì}{媒体|méi tǐ}, {社|shè}{交|jiāo}{媒体|méi tǐ} (social media).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{引起|yǐn qǐ}{了|le}{媒体|méi tǐ}{的|de}{注意|zhù yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The matter drew the attention of the media.

vocab.note: No named source; to name one, {据|jù}{他|tā}{说|shuō}.
vocab.example: {据说|jù shuō}{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{菜|cài}{特别|tè bié}{好吃|hǎo chī}。
vocab.exampleEn: They say the food at this restaurant is especially good.

vocab.note: In order over a period: {客人|kè rén}{陆续|lù xù}{到|dào}{了|le}. {陆陆续续|lù lù xù xù} is more spoken.
vocab.example: {演出|yǎn chū}{快|kuài}{开始|kāi shǐ}{了|le}，{观众|guān zhòng}{陆续|lù xù}{进|jìn}{了|le}{剧场|jù chǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The show was about to start, and the audience came into the theatre one after another.

vocab.note: {据|jù}…{报道|bào dào}, {据|jù}{了解|liǎo jiě}, {据|jù}{统计|tǒng jì}; written short form of {根据|gēn jù}.
vocab.example: {据|jù}{了解|liǎo jiě}，{这个|zhè ge}{活动|huó dòng}{已经|yǐ jīng}{办|bàn}{了|le}{五|wǔ}{年|nián}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: We understand the event has been running for five years.

vocab.note: {农民|nóng mín} + {种地|zhòng dì} (farm the land).
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{农民|nóng mín}{种|zhòng}{的|de}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{很|hěn}{受|shòu}{欢迎|huān yíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The fruit these farmers grow is very popular.

vocab.note: {农业|nóng yè}{现代化|xiàn dài huà}; {工业|gōng yè} (industry).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{县|xiàn}{主要|zhǔ yào}{发展|fā zhǎn}{农业|nóng yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: This county is mainly developing agriculture.

vocab.note: Formal and collective; {老百姓|lǎo bǎi xìng} is the everyday word. {人民币|rén mín bì} (lesson 04).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{公园|gōng yuán}{叫|jiào}{人民|rén mín}{公园|gōng yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: This park is called People's Park.

vocab.note: {新闻人物|xīn wén rén wù} (a newsmaker); {小说|xiǎo shuō}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{人物|rén wù} (characters in a novel).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{小说|xiǎo shuō}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{人物|rén wù}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{有意思|yǒu yì si}。
vocab.exampleEn: The characters in this novel are all interesting.

vocab.note: A little more formal than {省|shěng}.
vocab.example: {中国|Zhōng guó}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{省份|shěng fèn}，{每|měi}{个|gè}{省份|shěng fèn}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{特点|tè diǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: China has many provinces, each with its own character.

vocab.note: {成都|Chéng dū}{是|shì}{四川|Sì chuān}{的|de}{省会|shěng huì}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{坐|zuò}{高铁|gāo tiě}{去|qù}{了|le}{省会|shěng huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: We took the high-speed train to the provincial capital.

vocab.note: {重大|zhòng dà}{事件|shì jiàn}, {新闻|xīn wén}{事件|shì jiàn}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{事件|shì jiàn}{引起|yǐn qǐ}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{的|de}{关注|guān zhù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The incident attracted a lot of people's attention.

vocab.note: {欢迎|huān yíng}{收看|shōu kàn}{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{节目|jié mù} (welcome to today's programme).
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{收看|shōu kàn}{了|le}{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{的|de}{比赛|bǐ sài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Lots of people watched last night's match.

vocab.note: {事故|shì gù}{现场|xiàn chǎng}; {现场直播|xiàn chǎng zhí bō} (a live broadcast).
vocab.example: {警察|jǐng chá}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}{现场|xiàn chǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The police soon arrived on the scene.

vocab.note: Below a county: {县|xiàn} → {乡|xiāng} → {村|cūn}. Also "country, home": {家乡|jiā xiāng}, {乡村|xiāng cūn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{乡|xiāng}{里|lǐ}{当|dāng}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He teaches in a small rural township.

vocab.note: {公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{形象|xíng xiàng}, {城市|chéng shì}{形象|xíng xiàng}; also "vivid" ({形象|xíng xiàng}{的|de}{比喻|bǐ yù}).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{对|duì}{公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{形象|xíng xiàng}{很|hěn}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is very bad for the company's image.

vocab.note: Written for {电影|diàn yǐng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{部|bù}{影片|yǐng piàn}{获得|huò dé}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{奖|jiǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This film has won many awards.

vocab.note: {影视明星|yǐng shì míng xīng}, {影视|yǐng shì}{作品|zuò pǐn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{大学|dà xué}{毕业|bì yè}{以后|yǐ hòu}{在|zài}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{影视|yǐng shì}{公司|gōng sī}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: After university he worked for a film and TV company.

vocab.note: Below a province or city: {县|xiàn}{城|chéng} (a county town).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{外公|wài gōng}{家|jiā}{在|zài}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{县|xiàn}{里|lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: My grandfather's home is in a small county.

vocab.note: {宣布|xuān bù}{开幕|kāi mù}, {宣布|xuān bù}{一|yí}{个|gè}{好|hǎo}{消息|xiāo xi}.
vocab.example: {主持|zhǔ chí}{人|rén}{宣布|xuān bù}{比赛|bǐ sài}{开始|kāi shǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The host announced the start of the contest.

vocab.note: {宣传|xuān chuán}{新|xīn}{产品|chǎn pǐn}, {做|zuò}{宣传|xuān chuán}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{多|duō}{宣传|xuān chuán}{这个|zhè ge}{活动|huó dòng}，{让|ràng}{更|gèng}{多|duō}{人|rén}{知道|zhī dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: We need to publicise the event more so more people know.

vocab.note: {印刷|yìn shuā}{书|shū}, {印刷厂|yìn shuā chǎng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{印刷|yìn shuā}{得|de}{很|hěn}{漂亮|piào liang}。
vocab.exampleEn: This book is beautifully printed.

vocab.note: {市政府|shì zhèng fǔ} (the city government), {当地|dāng dì}{政府|zhèng fǔ}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}{是|shì}{当地|dāng dì}{政府|zhèng fǔ}{修建|xiū jiàn}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This road was built by the local government.

vocab.note: Of a country with a president: {美国总统|Měi guó zǒng tǒng}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{国家|guó jiā}{每|měi}{五|wǔ}{年|nián}{选|xuǎn}{一|yí}{次|cì}{总统|zǒng tǒng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This country elects a president every five years.

vocab.note: {当时|dāng shí}{在场|zài chǎng}{的|de}{人|rén} (the people who were there).
vocab.example: {事故|shì gù}{发生|fā shēng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{你|nǐ}{在场|zài chǎng}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Were you there when the accident happened?

vocab.note: {主持|zhǔ chí}{节目|jié mù}, {主持|zhǔ chí}{会议|huì yì}; {主持|zhǔ chí}{人|rén} (a presenter, host).
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{会议|huì yì}{由|yóu}{王|Wáng}{经理|jīng lǐ}{主持|zhǔ chí}。
vocab.exampleEn: Today's meeting will be chaired by Manager Wang.

vocab.note: {真实|zhēn shí}{的|de}{故事|gù shi}, {真实|zhēn shí}{的|de}{感受|gǎn shòu}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{部|bù}{电影|diàn yǐng}{是|shì}{根据|gēn jù}{一|yí}{个|gè}{真实|zhēn shí}{的|de}{故事|gù shi}{拍|pāi}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: The film is based on a true story.

vocab.note: A little more written than {有名|yǒu míng}: {知名|zhī míng}{作家|zuò jiā}, {知名|zhī míng}{企业|qǐ yè}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{很|hěn}{知名|zhī míng}{的|de}{画家|huà jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's a well-known painter.

vocab.note: {重大|zhòng dà}{新闻|xīn wén}, {重大|zhòng dà}{事件|shì jiàn}, {重大|zhòng dà}{发现|fā xiàn}.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{重大|zhòng dà}{新闻|xīn wén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a major news story today.

vocab.note: Opposite {开幕式|kāi mù shì}.
vocab.example: {运动会|yùn dòng huì}{的|de}{闭幕式|bì mù shì}{在|zài}{晚上|wǎn shang}{举行|jǔ xíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The games' closing ceremony is held in the evening.

vocab.note: {月|yuè}{初|chū}, {年初|nián chū} (lesson 28), {二十|èr shí}{世纪|shì jì}{初|chū}; {初|chū}{一|yī} (the first day of a lunar month).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{下个月|xià gè yuè}{初|chū}{见面|jiàn miàn}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's meet at the start of next month.

meanings: the eve of the Spring Festival
vocab.note: The last night of the lunar year: {除夕|chú xī}{晚上|wǎn shang}{吃|chī}{年夜饭|nián yè fàn}.
vocab.example: {除夕|chú xī}{晚上|wǎn shang}，{一家人|yì jiā rén}{一起|yì qǐ}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: On New Year's Eve the family eats together.

vocab.note: Noun and adjective: {传统|chuán tǒng}{节日|jié rì}, {保留|bǎo liú}{传统|chuán tǒng}.
vocab.example: {春节|Chūn jié}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{最|zuì}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{传统|chuán tǒng}{节日|jié rì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China.

vocab.note: {保留|bǎo liú}{传统|chuán tǒng}, {保留|bǎo liú}{意见|yì jiàn} (keep one's own view).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{村子|cūn zi}{还|hái}{保留|bǎo liú}{着|zhe}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{老|lǎo}{房子|fáng zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The village still has many old houses.

vocab.note: {充满|chōng mǎn}{信心|xìn xīn}, {充满|chōng mǎn}{了|le}{快乐|kuài lè}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{对|duì}{未来|wèi lái}{充满|chōng mǎn}{了|le}{信心|xìn xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's full of confidence about the future.

vocab.note: {传下去|chuán xià qù} (hand down), {传|chuán}{到|dào} (spread to), {传|chuán}{球|qiú} (pass the ball).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{故事|gù shi}{从|cóng}{古代|gǔ dài}{一直|yì zhí}{传|chuán}{到|dào}{了|le}{今天|jīn tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This story has been handed down from ancient times to today.

vocab.note: Noun and verb: {一|yí}{个|gè}{古老|gǔ lǎo}{的|de}{传说|chuán shuō}; {传说|chuán shuō}… (legend has it that…).
vocab.example: {关于|guān yú}{这|zhè}{座|zuò}{山|shān}，{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{美丽|měi lì}{的|de}{传说|chuán shuō}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a beautiful legend about this mountain.

vocab.note: {灯光|dēng guāng}{很|hěn}{暗|àn} (the lighting is dim); {节日|jié rì}{的|de}{灯光|dēng guāng}.
vocab.example: {晚上|wǎn shang}，{广场|guǎng chǎng}{上|shàng}{的|de}{灯光|dēng guāng}{非常|fēi cháng}{漂亮|piào liang}。
vocab.exampleEn: At night the lights on the square are beautiful.

vocab.note: {朋友|péng you} is the opposite.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{小说|xiǎo shuō}{里|lǐ}，{他们|tā men}{本来|běn lái}{是|shì}{敌人|dí rén}，{后来|hòu lái}{成|chéng}{了|le}{朋友|péng you}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the novel they start as enemies and later become friends.

vocab.note: {风俗|fēng sú}{习惯|xí guàn}, {当地|dāng dì}{的|de}{风俗|fēng sú}.
vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{地方|dì fang}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{风俗|fēng sú}。
vocab.exampleEn: Every place has its own customs.

vocab.note: {春节|Chūn jié}{门|mén}{上|shàng}{贴|tiē} {福|fú}; {福气|fú qi} (good fortune of a person).
vocab.example: {春节|Chūn jié}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{家庭|jiā tíng}{的|de}{门|mén}{上|shàng}{都|dōu}{贴|tiē}{着|zhe}{一|yí}{个|gè}"{福|fú}"{字|zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: At the Spring Festival many homes have the character for "good fortune" on the door.

vocab.note: Predicate ({活动|huó dòng}{丰富多彩|fēng fù duō cǎi}) or before {的|de} + noun ({丰富多彩|fēng fù duō cǎi}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}); no {很|hěn} in careful usage.
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{的|de}{课|kè}{外|wài}{活动|huó dòng}{丰富多彩|fēng fù duō cǎi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The school's extracurricular activities are rich and varied.

vocab.note: In China, before the mid-19th century: {中国|Zhōng guó}{古代|gǔ dài}.
vocab.example: {中国|Zhōng guó}{古代|gǔ dài}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{伟大|wěi dà}{的|de}{发明|fā míng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Ancient China had many great inventions.

vocab.note: {光明|guāng míng}{的|de}{未来|wèi lái} (a bright future).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{相信|xiāng xìn}{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{未来|wèi lái}{是|shì}{光明|guāng míng}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: I believe our future is bright.

vocab.note: {国庆节|Guó qìng jié} (1 October), {国庆|guó qìng}{假期|jià qī}.
vocab.example: {国庆|guó qìng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{出去|chū qù}{旅游|lǚ yóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Lots of people travel over National Day.

vocab.note: {祝|zhù}{你好|nǐ hǎo}{运|yùn}! (Good luck!)
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{就|jiù}{要|yào}{考试|kǎo shì}{了|le}，{祝|zhù}{你好|nǐ hǎo}{运|yùn}！
vocab.exampleEn: The exam's tomorrow: good luck!

vocab.note: In the zodiac, {猴|hóu}: {属|shǔ}{猴|hóu} (born in a monkey year).
vocab.example: {山上|shān shàng}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{猴子|hóu zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of monkeys on the mountain.

vocab.note: {结婚|jié hūn}{纪念日|jì niàn rì} (a wedding anniversary).
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{父母|fù mǔ}{的|de}{结婚|jié hūn}{纪念日|jì niàn rì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Today is my parents' wedding anniversary.

vocab.note: {纪念|jì niàn} + person / event; {留|liú}{作|zuò}{纪念|jì niàn} (keep as a souvenir).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{张|zhāng}{照片|zhào piàn}{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{留|liú}{作|zuò}{纪念|jì niàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'll keep this photo as a memento.

vocab.note: {古|gǔ}{书|shū}{上|shàng}{记载|jì zǎi}… (old books record…).
vocab.example: {关于|guān yú}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}，{古|gǔ}{书|shū}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{记载|jì zǎi}。
vocab.exampleEn: There is a record of this in old books.

vocab.note: Written for {讲|jiǎng}: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{讲述|jiǎng shù}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}…{的|de}{故事|gù shi}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{部|bù}{电影|diàn yǐng}{讲述|jiǎng shù}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{农民|nóng mín}{的|de}{故事|gù shi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The film tells the story of a farmer.

vocab.note: In compounds and set phrases: {古城|gǔ chéng} (an ancient city), {古|gǔ}{书|shū} (old books), {古人|gǔ rén} (the ancients).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{座|zuò}{有|yǒu}{一千|yì qiān}{多|duō}{年|nián}{历史|lì shǐ}{的|de}{古城|gǔ chéng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is an ancient city over a thousand years old.

vocab.note: {古老|gǔ lǎo}{的|de}{传说|chuán shuō}, {古老|gǔ lǎo}{的|de}{建筑|jiàn zhù}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{村子|cūn zi}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{棵|kē}{古老|gǔ lǎo}{的|de}{大|dà}{树|shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's an ancient tree in the village.

vocab.note: In Chinese history books, about 1840 to 1919; {现代|xiàn dài} comes after.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{讲|jiǎng}{的|de}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{近代|jìn dài}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This book is about China's modern history.

vocab.note: Opposite {闭幕式|bì mù shì}.
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{在|zài}{电视|diàn shì}{上|shàng}{看|kàn}{了|le}{开幕式|kāi mù shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Lots of people watched the opening ceremony on TV.

vocab.note: A symbol of power and good fortune; {属|shǔ}{龙|lóng} (born in a dragon year).
vocab.example: {龙|lóng}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{文化|wén huà}{里|lǐ}{很|hěn}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{动物|dòng wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The dragon is a very important animal in Chinese culture.

vocab.note: {改变|gǎi biàn}{命运|mìng yùn} (change one's fate).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{相信|xiāng xìn}{自己|zì jǐ}{能|néng}{改变|gǎi biàn}{命运|mìng yùn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He believes he can change his fate.

vocab.note: 80{年代|nián dài} (the eighties); {那个|nà ge}{年代|nián dài} (those days).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}{是|shì}80{年代|nián dài}{很|hěn}{流行|liú xíng}{的|de}{歌|gē}。
vocab.exampleEn: This song was very popular in the eighties.

vocab.note: The family dinner on {除夕|chú xī}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{的|de}{年夜饭|nián yè fàn}{一定|yí dìng}{有|yǒu}{饺子|jiǎo zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are always dumplings at our New Year's Eve dinner.

meanings: to open (an event, raise the curtain)
vocab.note: {展览|zhǎn lǎn}{开幕|kāi mù}, {运动会|yùn dòng huì}{开幕|kāi mù}; {开幕式|kāi mù shì}.
vocab.example: {电影|diàn yǐng}{节|jié}{明天|míng tiān}{开幕|kāi mù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The film festival opens tomorrow.

vocab.note: {流传|liú chuán}{了|le}{几|jǐ}{百|bǎi}{年|nián} (handed down for centuries).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}{在|zài}{这个|zhè ge}{地区|dì qū}{流传|liú chuán}{了|le}{几|jǐ}{百|bǎi}{年|nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: This song has been handed down in the region for centuries.

vocab.note: {年代|nián dài}{久远|jiǔ yuǎn} (dating far back).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{座|zuò}{桥|qiáo}{年代|nián dài}{久远|jiǔ yuǎn}，{已经|yǐ jīng}{不|bù}{能|néng}{走|zǒu}{车|chē}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This bridge is very old: cars can no longer cross it.

vocab.note: In traditional characters calendar and history have different characters: {+{日历|rì lì}+} but {+{历史|lì shǐ}+}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{日历|rì lì}{上|shàng}{写|xiě}{下|xià}{了|le}{考试|kǎo shì}{的|de}{日子|rì zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: He wrote the date of the exam on the calendar.

vocab.note: shàn zi; the verb "to fan" is {扇|shàn} shān.
vocab.example: {夏天|xià tiān}{太|tài}{热|rè}{了|le}，{奶奶|nǎi nai}{一直|yì zhí}{拿|ná}{着|zhe}{扇子|shàn zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's so hot in summer that Grandma always has a fan in her hand.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{蛇|shé}; {属|shǔ}{蛇|shé} (born in a snake year).
vocab.example: {草|cǎo}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{蛇|shé}，{小心|xiǎo xīn}！
vocab.exampleEn: There's a snake in the grass: careful!

vocab.note: {中国|Zhōng guó}{神话|shén huà}, {神话|shén huà}{故事|gù shi}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{听|tīng}{神话|shén huà}{故事|gù shi}。
vocab.exampleEn: As a child I loved hearing myths.

vocab.note: The twelve {生肖|shēng xiào}; {你|nǐ}{属|shǔ}{什么|shén me}? (What's your animal?)
vocab.example: {中国|Zhōng guó}{的|de}{十二|shí èr}{生肖|shēng xiào}{里|lǐ}，{第|dì}{一|yī}{个|gè}{是|shì}{鼠|shǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The first of the twelve Chinese zodiac animals is the rat.

vocab.note: shān (verb); the fan itself is {扇子|shàn zi} shàn zi.
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{太|tài}{热|rè}{了|le}，{他|tā}{一边|yì biān}{走|zǒu}{一边|yì biān}{扇|shān}{扇子|shàn zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: It was so hot that he fanned himself as he walked.

vocab.note: {赏月|shǎng yuè} (enjoy the moon), {赏花|shǎng huā}; {欣赏|xīn shǎng} (lesson 10).
vocab.example: {中秋节|Zhōng qiū jié}{晚上|wǎn shang}，{一家人|yì jiā rén}{一起|yì qǐ}{赏月|shǎng yuè}。
vocab.exampleEn: On the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival the family enjoys the moon together.

vocab.note: {一路平安|yí lù píng ān} (have a safe journey), {平平安安|píng píng ān ān}.
vocab.example: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一路平安|yí lù píng ān}！
vocab.exampleEn: Have a safe journey!

vocab.note: {神秘|shén mì}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}, {很|hěn}{神秘|shén mì}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{古老|gǔ lǎo}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}{给|gěi}{人|rén}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}{神秘|shén mì}{的|de}{感觉|gǎn jué}。
vocab.exampleEn: This ancient place has a mysterious feel.

vocab.note: {网络时代|wǎng luò shí dài} (the internet age); {时代|shí dài}{变|biàn}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{生活|shēng huó}{在|zài}{一|yí}{个|gè}{网络时代|wǎng luò shí dài}。
vocab.exampleEn: We live in the internet age.

vocab.note: With a start and an end: {唐朝时期|Táng cháo shí qī}, {大学|dà xué}{时期|shí qī} (university days).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{他|tā}{一生|yì shēng}{中|zhōng}{最|zuì}{困难|kùn nan}{的|de}{时期|shí qī}。
vocab.exampleEn: This was the hardest period of his life.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{特色|tè sè}, {地方|dì fang}{特色|tè sè}, {特色|tè sè}{菜|cài} (the house speciality).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{特色|tè sè}{菜|cài}{是|shì}{烤|kǎo}{鸭|yā}。
vocab.exampleEn: This restaurant's speciality is roast duck.

vocab.note: In the zodiac, {兔|tù}: {属|shǔ}{兔|tù} (born in a rabbit year).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{家|jiā}{养|yǎng}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{只|zhī}{兔子|tù zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her family keeps two rabbits.

vocab.note: {统一|tǒng yī}{了|le}{中国|Zhōng guó}; {统一|tǒng yī}{的|de}{标准|biāo zhǔn} (a common standard).
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{给|gěi}{学生|xué sheng}{们|men}{发|fā}{了|le}{统一|tǒng yī}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: The school gave the students uniform clothes.

vocab.note: {中国|Zhōng guó}{特有|tè yǒu}{的|de}{动物|dòng wù} (an animal found only in China).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{这个|zhè ge}{地区|dì qū}{特有|tè yǒu}{的|de}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a fruit found only in this region.

vocab.note: {伟大|wěi dà}{的|de}{发明|fā míng}, {伟大|wěi dà}{的|de}{人物|rén wù}.
vocab.example: {纸|zhǐ}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{古代|gǔ dài}{一|yí}{个|gè}{伟大|wěi dà}{的|de}{发明|fā míng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Paper was a great invention of ancient China.

vocab.note: {中|zhōng}{式|shì}, {西|xī}{式|shì}, {新|xīn}{式|shì}; {开幕式|kāi mù shì} (a ceremony).
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{家|jiā}{是|shì}{中|zhōng}{式|shì}{的|de}{装修|zhuāng xiū}。
vocab.exampleEn: Their home is decorated in Chinese style.

meanings: the joys and sorrows of life
vocab.note: Literally sour, sweet, bitter, spicy; a noun phrase: {生活|shēng huó}{的|de}{酸甜苦辣|suān tián kǔ là}.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{国|guó}{外|wài}{留学|liú xué}{的|de}{这|zhè}{一|yì}{年|nián}，{酸甜苦辣|suān tián kǔ là}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: This year studying abroad has had all its ups and downs.

vocab.note: {现代|xiàn dài}{社会|shè huì}, {现代化|xiàn dài huà}; after {近代|jìn dài} in Chinese history books.
vocab.example: {现代|xiàn dài}{人|rén}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}。
vocab.exampleEn: People today lead busy lives.

vocab.note: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{幸运|xìng yùn}; {幸运|xìng yùn}{的|de}{是|shì}… (luckily…).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{幸运|xìng yùn}，{第|dì}{一|yī}{次|cì}{考试|kǎo shì}{就|jiù}{通过|tōng guò}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I was lucky: I passed at the first attempt.

vocab.note: Given to children at New Year, in a {红包|hóng bāo}.
vocab.example: {小时候|xiǎo shí hou}，{过年|guò nián}{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{的|de}{就是|jiù shì}{压岁钱|yā suì qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: As a child, what I loved most about New Year was the New Year money.

vocab.note: Noun and verb: {龙|lóng}{象征|xiàng zhēng}{着|zhe}{力量|lì liang}.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{中国|Zhōng guó}，{红色|hóng sè}{象征|xiàng zhēng}{着|zhe}{快乐|kuài lè}{和|hé}{好运|hǎo yùn}。
vocab.exampleEn: In China, red symbolises happiness and good luck.

vocab.note: In set phrases: {欢迎|huān yíng}, {迎新年|yíng xīn nián}, {迎|yíng}{客|kè}.
vocab.example: {大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{在|zài}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{迎新年|yíng xīn nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone is getting ready to welcome the New Year.

vocab.note: {迎接|yíng jiē}{客人|kè rén}, {迎接|yíng jiē}{新|xīn}{的|de}{一|yì}{年|nián}, {迎接|yíng jiē}{挑战|tiǎo zhàn}.
vocab.example: {学生|xué sheng}{们|men}{在|zài}{门口|mén kǒu}{迎接|yíng jiē}{新|xīn}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The students welcomed the new teacher at the door.

vocab.note: Almost always with {历史|lì shǐ}: {历史|lì shǐ}{悠久|yōu jiǔ}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{有着|yǒu zhe}{悠久|yōu jiǔ}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This city has a long history.

vocab.note: The Gregorian New Year; {春节|Chūn jié} is the lunar one.
vocab.example: {元旦|yuán dàn}{我们|wǒ men}{放|fàng}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{假|jiǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: We get three days off for New Year's Day.

vocab.note: {运气|yùn qi}{好|hǎo} / {不|bù}{好|hǎo}; light second syllable.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{运气|yùn qi}{真|zhēn}{好|hǎo}，{一|yì}{出门|chū mén}{就|jiù}{打|dǎ}{到|dào}{了|le}{车|chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: What luck today: I got a taxi as soon as I stepped out.

vocab.note: {早期|zǎo qī}{的|de}{作品|zuò pǐn} (early works), {早期|zǎo qī}{发现|fā xiàn} (early detection).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{他|tā}{早期|zǎo qī}{的|de}{一|yí}{部|bù}{作品|zuò pǐn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is one of his early works.

vocab.note: Formal and cultural: {中华文化|Zhōng huá wén huà}, {中华民族|Zhōng huá mín zú}.
vocab.example: {春节|Chūn jié}{是|shì}{中华文化|Zhōng huá wén huà}{里|lǐ}{最|zuì}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{节日|jié rì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The Spring Festival is the most important festival in Chinese culture.

vocab.note: {结婚|jié hūn}{十|shí}{周年|zhōu nián}, {一百|yì bǎi}{周年|zhōu nián}.
vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}{成立|chéng lì}{十|shí}{周年|zhōu nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: This year is our company's tenth anniversary.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{头|tóu}{猪|zhū}; {属|shǔ}{猪|zhū} (born in a pig year).
vocab.example: {外公|wài gōng}{家|jiā}{养|yǎng}{了|le}{几|jǐ}{头|tóu}{猪|zhū}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandpa keeps a few pigs.

vocab.note: Written: {至今|zhì jīn}{还|hái} / {仍|réng} / {没|méi}…; spoken {到|dào}{现在|xiàn zài}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{至今|zhì jīn}{还没|hái méi}{有|yǒu}{收到|shōu dào}{他|tā}{的|de}{回信|huí xìn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We still haven't had a reply from him.

vocab.note: Formal: {中华民族|Zhōng huá mín zú}{的|de}{传统|chuán tǒng}.
vocab.example: {春节|Chūn jié}{是|shì}{中华民族|Zhōng huá mín zú}{最|zuì}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{传统|chuán tǒng}{节日|jié rì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival of the Chinese nation.

vocab.note: A view you argue for. {看法|kàn fǎ} (HSK 4) is everyday "opinion"; {观点|guān diǎn} is more formal and is the word of essays and debates.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{同意|tóng yì}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{观点|guān diǎn}，{不过|bú guò}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{补充|bǔ chōng}{一|yì}{点|diǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I agree with your view, but I'd like to add one point.

meanings: reason (for a view or a choice)
vocab.note: {原因|yuán yīn} is the cause of something that happened; {理由|lǐ yóu} is a reason you give for a view or a decision: {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{理由|lǐ yóu}？
vocab.example: {他|tā}{没有|méi yǒu}{说明|shuō míng}{请假|qǐng jià}{的|de}{理由|lǐ yóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: He didn't explain his reason for asking for leave.

vocab.note: {事实|shì shí}{上|shàng} (in fact) starts a sentence that corrects an impression.
vocab.example: {事实|shì shí}{证明|zhèng míng}，{他|tā}{的|de}{判断|pàn duàn}{是|shì}{对|duì}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: The facts proved his judgement right.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{这么|zhè me}{说|shuō}，{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{证据|zhèng jù}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: What's your evidence for saying that?

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{道理|dào li}: makes sense, has a point. The second syllable is light.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{道理|dào li}。
vocab.exampleEn: You've got a point there.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{现象|xiàn xiàng}{在|zài}{大|dà}{城市|chéng shì}{很|hěn}{普遍|pǔ biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This kind of thing is very common in big cities.

vocab.example: {天气|tiān qì}{是|shì}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}{的|de}{一|yí}{个|gè}{重要|zhòng yào}{因素|yīn sù}。

vocab.note: {换|huàn}{个|gè}{角度|jiǎo dù}: from another angle.

vocab.exampleEn: Seen from another angle, this is a chance too.

vocab.note: {在|zài}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{程度|chéng dù}{上|shàng}: to a great extent.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{达到|dá dào}{了|le}{能|néng}{当|dāng}{翻译|fān yì}{的|de}{程度|chéng dù}。
vocab.exampleEn: His Chinese has reached the point where he could work as an interpreter.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{调查|diào chá}{的|de}{范围|fàn wéi}{太|tài}{小|xiǎo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The scope of this survey is too small.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{价值|jià zhí}: valuable.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{意见|yì jiàn}{对|duì}{我们|wǒ men}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{价值|jià zhí}。
vocab.exampleEn: These suggestions are very valuable to us.

vocab.example: {如果|rú guǒ}{大家|dà jiā}{没有|méi yǒu}{疑问|yí wèn}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{开始|kāi shǐ}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: If nobody has any questions, let's begin.

vocab.note: Also an adjective: {不|bú}{现实|xiàn shí} (unrealistic).
