vocab.exampleEn: It's a good plan, but not very realistic.

vocab.example: {好|hǎo}{的|de}{报道|bào dào}{既|jì}{有|yǒu}{事实|shì shí}，{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{细节|xì jié}。
vocab.exampleEn: A good report has both facts and details.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {特点|tè diǎn} (HSK 4).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{鸟|niǎo}{最|zuì}{大|dà}{的|de}{特征|tè zhēng}{是|shì}{尾巴|wěi ba}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This bird's most striking feature is its long tail.

vocab.note: {差|chā} here, as in {差距|chā jù} (lesson 28).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{种|zhǒng}{方法|fāng fǎ}{的|de}{差别|chā bié}{不|bú}{大|dà}。
vocab.exampleEn: There isn't much difference between the two methods.

vocab.note: {从|cóng}{整体|zhěng tǐ}{来|lái}{看|kàn}: taken as a whole.
vocab.example: {从|cóng}{整体|zhěng tǐ}{来|lái}{看|kàn}，{这|zhè}{次|cì}{活动|huó dòng}{很|hěn}{成功|chéng gōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Taken as a whole, the event was a success.

vocab.note: {表面|biǎo miàn}{上|shàng}: on the surface (but really…).
vocab.example: {表面|biǎo miàn}{上|shàng}{他|tā}{很|hěn}{冷静|lěng jìng}，{其实|qí shí}{心里|xīn li}{很|hěn}{紧张|jǐn zhāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: On the surface he's calm, but inside he's very nervous.

vocab.note: {在|zài}…{当中|dāng zhōng}: among.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{我|wǒ}{认识|rèn shi}{的|de}{人|rén}{当中|dāng zhōng}，{他|tā}{最|zuì}{幽默|yōu mò}。
vocab.exampleEn: Of all the people I know, he's the funniest.

vocab.note: {物质|wù zhì}{生活|shēng huó} / {精神|jīng shén}{生活|shēng huó}: material and spiritual life.
vocab.example: {除了|chú le}{物质|wù zhì}{生活|shēng huó}，{精神|jīng shén}{生活|shēng huó}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{重要|zhòng yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Besides material comforts, the life of the mind matters too.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {自己|zì jǐ}.
vocab.example: {问题|wèn tí}{在于|zài yú}{产品|chǎn pǐn}{自身|zì shēn}{的|de}{质量|zhì liàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The problem lies in the quality of the product itself.

vocab.note: Opposite: {主观|zhǔ guān}.
vocab.example: {写|xiě}{报道|bào dào}{一定|yí dìng}{要|yào}{客观|kè guān}。
vocab.exampleEn: A report must be objective.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ}{太|tài}{主观|zhǔ guān}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: His view is too subjective.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{举|jǔ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{具体|jù tǐ}{的|de}{例子|lì zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please give a specific example.

vocab.note: Also a verb: {明确|míng què}{目标|mù biāo} (to make the goal clear).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{目标|mù biāo}{很|hěn}{明确|míng què}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our goal is clear.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{很|hěn}{合理|hé lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This shop's prices are very reasonable.

vocab.note: Same sound as {有利|yǒu lì} (favourable): {有力|yǒu lì}{的|de}{证据|zhèng jù} is strong evidence.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{有力|yǒu lì}{的|de}{证据|zhèng jù}。
vocab.exampleEn: That's a very strong piece of evidence.

vocab.note: {对|duì}…{有利|yǒu lì}: good for. Same sound as {有力|yǒu lì} (strong).
vocab.example: {这样|zhè yàng}{的|de}{天气|tiān qì}{对|duì}{我们|wǒ men}{很|hěn}{有利|yǒu lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Weather like this is in our favour.

vocab.note: {对|duì}…{不利|bú lì}: bad for.
vocab.example: {长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān}{看|kàn}{手机|shǒu jī}{对|duì}{眼睛|yǎn jing}{不利|bú lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Looking at a phone for a long time is bad for your eyes.

vocab.note: Often at the start of a sentence: {显然|xiǎn rán}，…
vocab.example: {显然|xiǎn rán}，{他|tā}{还|hái}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Obviously he doesn't know about this yet.

vocab.example: {不|bù}{努力|nǔ lì}，{失败|shī bài}{是|shì}{必然|bì rán}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you don't work at it, failure is inevitable.

vocab.note: {没有|méi yǒu}{必要|bì yào}: there's no need.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{没有|méi yǒu}{必要|bì yào}{为|wèi}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{小|xiǎo}{事|shì}{担心|dān xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's no need for you to worry about such a small thing.

vocab.note: {印象|yìn xiàng}{深刻|shēn kè}: a deep impression.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{留下|liú xià}{了|le}{深刻|shēn kè}{的|de}{印象|yìn xiàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The trip left a deep impression on me.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{对|duì}{他|tā}{的|de}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}{非常|fēi cháng}{深远|shēn yuǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This had a very far-reaching effect on him.

vocab.note: Adjective and verb: {表现|biǎo xiàn}{突出|tū chū} (outstanding), {突出|tū chū}{重点|zhòng diǎn} (to bring out the main points).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{比赛|bǐ sài}{中|zhōng}{的|de}{表现|biǎo xiàn}{很|hěn}{突出|tū chū}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her performance in this competition was outstanding.

vocab.example: {除非|chú fēi}{有|yǒu}{特殊|tè shū}{情况|qíng kuàng}，{请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{迟到|chí dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please don't be late unless something unusual comes up.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{名字|míng zi}{写|xiě}{完整|wán zhěng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please write your full name.

vocab.example: {只|zhǐ}{用|yòng}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}{方法|fāng fǎ}{学习|xué xí}，{太|tài}{单一|dān yī}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Studying with just one method is too limited.

vocab.note: Listed as an adverb; used mostly before nouns: {个别|gè bié}{同学|tóng xué}.
vocab.example: {个别|gè bié}{同学|tóng xué}{还|hái}{没|méi}{交|jiāo}{作业|zuò yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: A few students still haven't handed in their homework.

vocab.note: {同一|tóng yī}{个|gè} + measure word.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{同一|tóng yī}{个|gè}{小区|xiǎo qū}。
vocab.exampleEn: We live in the same compound.

vocab.note: {穿|chuān}{反|fǎn}{了|le}: put on inside out or back to front. {相反|xiāng fǎn} (HSK 4) is "opposite".
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}{穿|chuān}{反|fǎn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: You've got your top on inside out.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{一直|yì zhí}{存在|cún zài}。
vocab.exampleEn: This problem has always been there.

vocab.note: With abstract nouns: {具有|jù yǒu}{意义|yì yì}, {具有|jù yǒu}{特点|tè diǎn}; {有|yǒu} for things.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{会议|huì yì}{具有|jù yǒu}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{意义|yì yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This meeting is of great significance.

vocab.note: {包括|bāo kuò} (lesson 02) lists the parts; {包含|bāo hán} says what is inside.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{价格|jià gé}{包含|bāo hán}{早餐|zǎo cān}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Does the price include breakfast?

vocab.note: {由|yóu}…{构成|gòu chéng}: to be made up of.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{由|yóu}{三|sān}{个|gè}{部分|bù fen}{构成|gòu chéng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The book is made up of three parts.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{小|xiǎo}{事|shì}{体现|tǐ xiàn}{了|le}{他|tā}{的|de}{性格|xìng gé}。
vocab.exampleEn: This small thing shows what kind of person he is.

vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{强调|qiáng diào}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{重点|zhòng diǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher stressed three key points.

vocab.note: {补充|bǔ chōng}{一|yì}{点|diǎn}: to add a point.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{补充|bǔ chōng}{一|yì}{点|diǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let me add one point.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{不|bù}{能|néng}{完全|wán quán}{否定|fǒu dìng}{他|tā}{的|de}{成绩|chéng jì}。
vocab.exampleEn: We can't dismiss what he's achieved altogether.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{赞成|zàn chéng}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{计划|jì huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm in favour of your plan.

vocab.note: Also a noun: {网上|wǎng shàng}{的|de}{评价|píng jià} (online reviews).
vocab.example: {大家|dà jiā}{对|duì}{他|tā}{的|de}{评价|píng jià}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone thinks very highly of him.

vocab.note: {满足|mǎn zú}{需求|xū qiú}: to meet a need.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{尽量|jǐn liàng}{满足|mǎn zú}{顾客|gù kè}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú}。
vocab.exampleEn: We should do our best to meet customers' requests.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {缺少|quē shǎo} (HSK 4).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{聪明|cōng ming}，{只是|zhǐ shì}{缺乏|quē fá}{经验|jīng yàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's clever; he just lacks experience.

vocab.note: Also a verb: {确定|què dìng}{时间|shí jiān} (to fix a time).
vocab.example: {开会|kāi huì}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}{还|hái}{没|méi}{确定|què dìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The time of the meeting hasn't been fixed yet.

meanings: to be in (a state or position)
vocab.note: {处|chǔ} is chǔ here. Written: {处于|chǔ yú}…{阶段|jiē duàn} / {时期|shí qī} / {状态|zhuàng tài}.
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{现在|xiàn zài}{处于|chǔ yú}{困难|kùn nan}{时期|shí qī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company is going through a difficult time.

vocab.note: No {是|shì} before it in writing.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{书|shū}{属于|shǔ yú}{学校|xué xiào}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: These books belong to the school library.

vocab.note: {问题|wèn tí}{在于|zài yú} / {关键|guān jiàn}{在于|zài yú}…: the problem / the key is….
vocab.example: {成功|chéng gōng}{的|de}{关键|guān jiàn}{在于|zài yú}{坚持|jiān chí}。
vocab.exampleEn: The key to success lies in keeping at it.

vocab.example: {针对|zhēn duì}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}，{学校|xué xiào}{采取|cǎi qǔ}{了|le}{新|xīn}{的|de}{措施|cuò shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: To deal with this problem, the school has taken new measures.

vocab.note: Also literal: {地球|dì qiú}{围绕|wéi rào}{着|zhe}{太阳|tài yang}{转|zhuàn} (the earth goes round the sun).
vocab.example: {讨论|tǎo lùn}{围绕|wéi rào}{网上|wǎng shàng}{评价|píng jià}{展开|zhǎn kāi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The discussion centred on online reviews.

vocab.note: Written: {把|bǎ} A {视为|shì wéi} B, A {被|bèi}{视为|shì wéi} B. Neutral: {看作|kàn zuò}.
vocab.example: {茶|chá}{被|bèi}{视为|shì wéi}{中国|Zhōng guó}{文化|wén huà}{的|de}{代表|dài biǎo}{之|zhī}{一|yī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Tea is regarded as one of the symbols of Chinese culture.

vocab.note: {把|bǎ} A {看作|kàn zuò} B. Lesson 12's {当作|dàng zuò} is "to treat as".
vocab.example: {他|tā}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{失败|shī bài}{看作|kàn zuò}{一|yí}{次|cì}{学习|xué xí}{的|de}{机会|jī huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He sees this failure as a chance to learn.

vocab.note: {促使|cù shǐ} + person + action.
vocab.example: {那|nà}{次|cì}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{促使|cù shǐ}{她|tā}{下|xià}{决心|jué xīn}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{中文|Zhōng wén}。
vocab.exampleEn: That trip made her determined to learn Chinese properly.

vocab.note: {使得|shǐ de} + a clause: {大|dà}{雨|yǔ}{使得|shǐ de}{航班|háng bān}{推迟|tuī chí}{了|le}。 Not {似的|shì de} shì de (as if, lesson 06).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{场|chǎng}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}{使得|shǐ de}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{航班|háng bān}{推迟|tuī chí}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The heavy rain caused many flights to be delayed.

vocab.note: After a fact: {这|zhè}{道|dào}{题|tí}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{做|zuò}{对|duì}{了|le}，{可见|kě jiàn}{很|hěn}{难|nán}。 {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn} (from this it can be seen) starts a sentence.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{没|méi}{来|lái}{上课|shàng kè}，{可见|kě jiàn}{病|bìng}{得|de}{不|bù}{轻|qīng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He hasn't been to class for three days, so he must be quite ill.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {也许|yě xǔ} (HSK 4).
vocab.example: {或许|huò xǔ}{他|tā}{说|shuō}{得|de}{对|duì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Perhaps he's right.

vocab.note: Written {就|jiù}, after the subject: {一|yī}…{便|biàn}…. {便|biàn} is biàn here ({便宜|pián yi} has pián).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{一|yí}{到|dào}{公司|gōng sī}{便|biàn}{开始|kāi shǐ}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He started work the moment he got to the office.

vocab.note: Before an adjective: {较|jiào}{高|gāo} (rather high); before a noun it is {比|bǐ}: {今年|jīn nián}{较|jiào}{去年|qù nián}{多|duō}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{较|jiào}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: This shop's prices are rather high.

vocab.note: Joins nouns, not clauses: {老师|lǎo shī}{及|jí}{学生|xué sheng}.
vocab.example: {参加|cān jiā}{会议|huì yì}{的|de}{有|yǒu}{老师|lǎo shī}{及|jí}{学生|xué sheng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Those at the meeting included teachers and students.

vocab.note: Often before the last item of a list, and can join longer phrases.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{写|xiě}{上|shàng}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{姓名|xìng míng}、{电话|diàn huà}{以及|yǐ jí}{住址|zhù zhǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please write your name, phone number and address.

vocab.note: Points back to something just named: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{及|jí}{其|qí}{员工|yuán gōng}. You know it from {其中|qí zhōng} and {其他|qí tā}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{及|jí}{其|qí}{员工|yuán gōng}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{重视|zhòng shì}{质量|zhì liàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company and its staff all take quality very seriously.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{走|zǒu}，{其余|qí yú}{的|de}{人|rén}{明天|míng tiān}{再|zài}{来|lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: We'll go first; the rest will come tomorrow.

vocab.note: {某|mǒu}{人|rén} (someone), {某|mǒu}{天|tiān} (one day), {某|mǒu}{些|xiē} (some).
vocab.example: {某|mǒu}{公司|gōng sī}{正在|zhèng zài}{招聘|zhāo pìn}{工程师|gōng chéng shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: A certain company is recruiting engineers.

vocab.note: {你|nǐ}{觉得|jué de}{如何|rú hé}？ (What do you think?)
vocab.example: {如何|rú hé}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{中文|Zhōng wén}，{是|shì}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{关心|guān xīn}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}。
vocab.exampleEn: How to learn Chinese well is a question many people care about.

vocab.note: {原来|yuán lái}{如此|rú cǐ} (so that's how it is).
vocab.example: {没|méi}{想|xiǎng}{到|dào}{这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{风景|fēng jǐng}{如此|rú cǐ}{美丽|měi lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I never expected the scenery here to be so beautiful.

vocab.note: In notices {如|rú} is {如果|rú guǒ}: {如|rú}{有|yǒu}{疑问|yí wèn} (if you have any questions).
vocab.example: {如|rú}{有|yǒu}{疑问|yí wèn}，{请|qǐng}{咨询|zī xún}{服务|fú wù}{台|tái}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you have any questions, please ask at the information desk.

vocab.example: {时间|shí jiān}{如同|rú tóng}{流|liú}{水|shuǐ}，{一|yí}{去|qù}{不|bù}{回|huí}。
vocab.exampleEn: Time is like flowing water: once gone, it never comes back.

vocab.note: Introduces a list: {具体|jù tǐ}{安排|ān pái}{如下|rú xià}.
vocab.example: {具体|jù tǐ}{安排|ān pái}{如下|rú xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: The arrangements are as follows.

vocab.note: Before a verb or noun: {需|xū}{提前|tí qián}{预约|yù yuē} (booking required).
vocab.example: {参观|cān guān}{需|xū}{提前|tí qián}{预约|yù yuē}。
vocab.exampleEn: Visits must be booked in advance.

vocab.note: Rules and formal advice: {应当|yīng dāng}{遵守|zūn shǒu}.
vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{应当|yīng dāng}{遵守|zūn shǒu}{交通|jiāo tōng}{规则|guī zé}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone should obey the traffic rules.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {一定|yí dìng} or {必须|bì xū}. {必|bì}{读|dú} (required reading).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{学生|xué sheng}{必|bì}{读|dú}{的|de}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a book every student must read.

vocab.note: {周|zhōu}{二|èr}{至|zhì}{周|zhōu}{日|rì} (Tuesday to Sunday), {至今|zhì jīn} (until now).
vocab.example: {本|běn}{店|diàn}{营业|yíng yè}{时间|shí jiān}{为|wéi}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{至|zhì}{晚上|wǎn shang}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The shop is open from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.

vocab.note: As a preposition it's written or regional ("with"); in {同一|tóng yī}, {相同|xiāng tóng} it means "the same".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{同|tóng}{他|tā}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{北京|Běi jīng}{出差|chū chāi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm going on a business trip to Beijing with him.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{可以|kě yǐ}{周|zhōu}{六|liù}{或是|huò shì}{周|zhōu}{日|rì}{来|lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can come on Saturday or Sunday.

vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{画|huà}{是|shì}{首次|shǒu cì}{在|zài}{国|guó}{内|nèi}{展出|zhǎn chū}。
vocab.exampleEn: These paintings are on show in this country for the first time.

vocab.note: Notices and news: {今日|jīn rì}{闭馆|bì guǎn} (closed today).
vocab.example: {本馆|běn guǎn}{今日|jīn rì}{闭馆|bì guǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The museum is closed today.

vocab.note: News: {近日|jìn rì}{宣布|xuān bù} (announced recently).
vocab.example: {博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{近日|jìn rì}{宣布|xuān bù}{了|le}{新|xīn}{的|de}{开放|kāi fàng}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: The museum recently announced its new opening hours.

vocab.note: It looks both ways; the verb decides: {近期|jìn qī}{将|jiāng}{举办|jǔ bàn} (will soon hold).
vocab.example: {近期|jìn qī}，{我们|wǒ men}{将|jiāng}{举办|jǔ bàn}{一|yí}{次|cì}{大型|dà xíng}{展览|zhǎn lǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We'll be holding a major exhibition soon.

vocab.example: {此时|cǐ shí}，{台|tái}{上|shàng}{的|de}{灯|dēng}{忽然|hū rán}{亮|liàng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: At that moment the lights on the stage suddenly came on.

vocab.example: {他|tā}2025{年|nián}{来|lái}{到|dào}{北京|Běi jīng}，{此后|cǐ hòu}{一直|yì zhí}{在|zài}{这里|zhè lǐ}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He came to Beijing in 2025 and has worked here ever since.

vocab.example: {此前|cǐ qián}，{博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}{闭馆|bì guǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Before this, the museum closed at five in the afternoon.

vocab.example: {经理|jīng lǐ}{先|xiān}{介绍|jiè shào}{了|le}{新|xīn}{项目|xiàng mù}，{随后|suí hòu}{大家|dà jiā}{开始|kāi shǐ}{讨论|tǎo lùn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The manager first presented the new project; then everyone began the discussion.

vocab.note: After a time phrase: {暑假|shǔ jià}{期间|qī jiān} (during the summer holidays).
vocab.example: {会议|huì yì}{期间|qī jiān}，{请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{手机|shǒu jī}{调|tiáo}{成|chéng}{静|jìng}{音|yīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: During the meeting, please set your phone to silent.

vocab.note: Before a verb: {先后|xiān hòu}{去|qù}{过|guo} (went to… one after another).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{先后|xiān hòu}{去|qù}{过|guo}{十|shí}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{国家|guó jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has been to more than a dozen countries, one after another.

vocab.note: Written {一|yì}{开始|kāi shǐ}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{最初|zuì chū}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{这|zhè}{份|fèn}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: At first he didn't like the job at all.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{到|dào}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{他|tā}{早已|zǎo yǐ}{离开|lí kāi}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: By the time I arrived, he had long since left.

vocab.note: {关键|guān jiàn}{时刻|shí kè} (a crucial moment); {时刻|shí kè} + verb: at all times.
vocab.example: {开车|kāi chē}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{时刻|shí kè}{注意|zhù yì}{安全|ān quán}。
vocab.exampleEn: When you drive, pay attention to safety at all times.

vocab.note: {早晚|zǎo wǎn}{各|gè}{一|yí}{次|cì} (once morning and evening); {早晚|zǎo wǎn}{会|huì}… (will sooner or later).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{他|tā}{早晚|zǎo wǎn}{会|huì}{知道|zhī dào}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: He'll find out about this sooner or later.

vocab.note: Before a noun: {众多|zhòng duō}{观众|guān zhòng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{展览|zhǎn lǎn}{吸引|xī yǐn}{了|le}{众多|zhòng duō}{观众|guān zhòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The exhibition drew huge numbers of visitors.

vocab.note: {价格|jià gé}{随|suí}{季节|jì jié}{变化|biàn huà} (prices change with the season); you know {随着|suí zhe} and {随时|suí shí}.
vocab.example: {菜|cài}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{随|suí}{季节|jì jié}{变化|biàn huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: Vegetable prices change with the season.

vocab.example: {馆|guǎn}{内|nèi}{的|de}{物品|wù pǐn}{请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{随意|suí yì}{摸|mō}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please don't touch the things in the museum.

vocab.note: Before a verb: {白|bái}{跑|pǎo}{一|yí}{趟|tàng} (made the trip for nothing).
vocab.example: {博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{今天|jīn tiān}{闭馆|bì guǎn}，{我们|wǒ men}{白|bái}{跑|pǎo}{了|le}{一|yí}{趟|tàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The museum is closed today: we came for nothing.

vocab.note: {正如|zhèng rú}{大家|dà jiā}{所|suǒ}{知|zhī} (as everyone knows).
vocab.example: {正如|zhèng rú}{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}{的|de}{那样|nà yàng}，{坚持|jiān chí}{最|zuì}{重要|zhòng yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Just as the teacher said, keeping at it is what matters most.

vocab.note: {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn} (it can be seen from this).
vocab.example: {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}，{方法|fāng fǎ}{比|bǐ}{时间|shí jiān}{更|gèng}{重要|zhòng yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: So it's clear that method matters more than time.

vocab.note: {以|yǐ}…{为|wéi}… (to take X as Y): {以|yǐ}{学生|xué sheng}{为|wéi}{主|zhǔ} (mostly students).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{班|bān}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{以|yǐ}{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{为|wéi}{主|zhǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The students in this class are mostly young people.

vocab.note: Written {因此|yīn cǐ} / {所以|suǒ yǐ}: a result follows from a cause.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}{车辆|chē liàng}{较|jiào}{多|duō}，{因而|yīn ér}{经常|jīng cháng}{堵车|dǔ chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a lot of traffic on this road, so it's often jammed.

vocab.note: Joins a means to the result it brings: {改进|gǎi jìn}{服务|fú wù}，{从而|cóng ér}{吸引|xī yǐn}{更|gèng}{多|duō}{顾客|gù kè}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{坚持|jiān chí}{练习|liàn xí}，{从而|cóng ér}{提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{水平|shuǐ píng}。
vocab.exampleEn: By practising every day he raised his level.

meanings: by (as in 为人们所熟悉)
vocab.note: wéi, in {为|wéi} + doer + {所|suǒ} + verb: {为|wéi}{大家|dà jiā}{所|suǒ}{接受|jiē shòu}. Not {为|wèi} (for, {为了|wèi le}).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{故事|gù shi}{为|wéi}{人|rén}{们|men}{所|suǒ}{熟悉|shú xī}。
vocab.exampleEn: This story is familiar to people.

vocab.note: After {包括|bāo kuò}: {包括|bāo kuò}{我|wǒ}{在内|zài nèi} (including me).
vocab.example: {包括|bāo kuò}{我|wǒ}{在内|zài nèi}，{一共|yí gòng}{有|yǒu}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are five people altogether, including me.

vocab.note: Before a noun: {原|yuán}{计划|jì huà} (the original plan), {原|yuán}{价|jià} (the original price).
vocab.example: {原|yuán}{计划|jì huà}{下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{完成|wán chéng}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}，{现在|xiàn zài}{提前|tí qián}{完成|wán chéng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The work that was originally planned for next month has been finished early.

vocab.note: {原有|yuán yǒu}{的|de}{规定|guī dìng} (the existing rules).
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{规定|guī dìng}{实施|shí shī}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{原有|yuán yǒu}{的|de}{规定|guī dìng}{停止|tíng zhǐ}{执行|zhí xíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Once the new rules take effect, the existing ones no longer apply.

vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{制定|zhì dìng}{了|le}{新|xīn}{的|de}{管理|guǎn lǐ}{制度|zhì dù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company has drawn up a new set of management rules.

vocab.note: {制定|zhì dìng} for rules and plans; {制订|zhì dìng} (lesson 03) is also used for plans.
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{正在|zhèng zài}{制定|zhì dìng}{新|xīn}{的|de}{规定|guī dìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The school is drawing up new rules.

vocab.note: {执行|zhí xíng}{任务|rèn wu} (to carry out a task).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{项|xiàng}{规定|guī dìng}{从|cóng}{下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{开始|kāi shǐ}{执行|zhí xíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The rule will be enforced from next month.

vocab.note: Plans, rules and laws: {实施|shí shī}{计划|jì huà}.
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{的|de}{开放|kāi fàng}{时间|shí jiān}{将|jiāng}{于|yú}{七|qī}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{日|rì}{起|qǐ}{实施|shí shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The new opening hours will take effect from 1 July.

vocab.note: Systems and methods: {实行|shí xíng}{新|xīn}{制度|zhì dù}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{实行|shí xíng}{垃圾|lā jī}{分类|fēn lèi}{已经|yǐ jīng}{五|wǔ}{年|nián}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The city has had rubbish sorting for five years now.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{权|quán} (to have the right to).
vocab.example: {顾客|gù kè}{有|yǒu}{权|quán}{要求|yāo qiú}{商家|shāng jiā}{退|tuì}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: Customers have the right to ask the seller for their money back.

vocab.note: Not {权力|quán lì} (power, authority: HSK 6).
vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{受|shòu}{教育|jiào yù}{的|de}{权利|quán lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone has the right to an education.

vocab.note: {权利|quán lì}{和|hé}{义务|yì wù} (rights and duties).
vocab.example: {遵守|zūn shǒu}{规定|guī dìng}{是|shì}{每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{的|de}{义务|yì wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Obeying the rules is everyone's duty.

vocab.example: {这样|zhè yàng}{做|zuò}{对|duì}{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{公平|gōng píng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Doing it this way is fair to everyone.

vocab.note: {自由|zì yóu}{时间|shí jiān} (free time), {自由|zì yóu}{选择|xuǎn zé} (to choose freely).
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{自由|zì yóu}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Weekends are my free time.

vocab.note: {这|zhè}{类|lèi} (this kind of), {各|gè}{类|lèi} (all kinds of).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{类|lèi}{问题|wèn tí}{以后|yǐ hòu}{会|huì}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: Problems of this kind will become more and more common.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{什么|shén me}{类型|lèi xíng}{的|de}{电影|diàn yǐng}？
vocab.exampleEn: What kind of films do you like?

vocab.note: {种类|zhǒng lèi}{很|hěn}{多|duō} (there are many kinds).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{超市|chāo shì}{的|de}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{种类|zhǒng lèi}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: This supermarket has a wide variety of fruit.

vocab.note: For things and organisations, not people ({名字|míng zi}).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{写|xiě}{上|shàng}{公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{名称|míng chēng}{和|hé}{地址|dì zhǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please write the company's name and address.

vocab.note: {问题|wèn tí}{的|de}{性质|xìng zhì} (the nature of the problem).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{的|de}{性质|xìng zhì}{完全|wán quán}{不同|bù tóng}。
vocab.exampleEn: These two matters are completely different in nature.

vocab.note: {文章|wén zhāng}{的|de}{结构|jié gòu} (the structure of an essay).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}{结构|jié gòu}{清楚|qīng chu}，{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{懂|dǒng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This essay is clearly structured and easy to follow.

vocab.note: {从|cóng}{本质|běn zhì}{上|shàng}{看|kàn} (in essence).
vocab.example: {从|cóng}{本质|běn zhì}{上|shàng}{看|kàn}，{这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{问题|wèn tí}{是|shì}{一样|yí yàng}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: In essence, the two problems are the same.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{新|xīn}{的|de}{概念|gài niàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a very new idea.

vocab.note: {新|xīn}{事物|shì wù} (new things).
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{对|duì}{新|xīn}{事物|shì wù}{总是|zǒng shì}{很|hěn}{好奇|hào qí}。
vocab.exampleEn: Children are always curious about new things.

vocab.note: {甲方|jiǎ fāng} / {乙方|yǐ fāng} (party A / party B, in contracts); {甲|jiǎ}{类|lèi} (class A).
vocab.example: {合同|hé tong}{上|shàng}{写|xiě}{着|zhe}{甲|jiǎ}、{乙|yǐ}{双方|shuāng fāng}{的|de}{名称|míng chēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The contract gives the names of both parties, A and B.

vocab.note: After {甲|jiǎ}: {甲|jiǎ}、{乙|yǐ}{两|liǎng}{类|lèi} (two classes, A and B).
vocab.example: {讲解员|jiǎng jiě yuán}{分为|fēn wéi}{甲|jiǎ}、{乙|yǐ}{两|liǎng}{类|lèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Guides are divided into two classes, A and B.

meanings: to rise (on a scale: figures, temperature)
vocab.note: Figures, temperatures and ranks; prices more often {上涨|shàng zhǎng}.
vocab.example: {最近|zuì jìn}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}{气温|qì wēn}{上升|shàng shēng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: The temperature has been rising fast these last few days.

vocab.note: {升|shēng}{到|dào} (rise to), {升|shēng}{为|wéi} (be promoted to). Not {升|shēng} the litre (HSK 6).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{去年|qù nián}{升|shēng}{为|wéi}{经理|jīng lǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He was promoted to manager last year.

vocab.note: Also of interest or a market: {旅游|lǚ yóu}{市场|shì chǎng}{开始|kāi shǐ}{升温|shēng wēn}。
vocab.example: {下|xià}{周|zhōu}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{各地|gè dì}{将|jiāng}{逐渐|zhú jiàn}{升温|shēng wēn}。
vocab.exampleEn: From next week temperatures will gradually rise everywhere.

vocab.note: Prices, rents and water levels.
vocab.example: {最近|zuì jìn}{菜|cài}{价|jià}{上涨|shàng zhǎng}{了|le}{不|bù}{少|shǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Vegetable prices have gone up quite a bit lately.

vocab.note: zhǎng, the same sound as {长|zhǎng} (to grow).
vocab.example: {下|xià}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{雨|yǔ}，{河|hé}{水|shuǐ}{涨|zhǎng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: After three days of rain the river has risen.

vocab.note: By effort: {提升|tí shēng}{水平|shuǐ píng}, {提升|tí shēng}{质量|zhì liàng}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{不断|bú duàn}{提升|tí shēng}{服务|fú wù}{质量|zhì liàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: We must keep raising the quality of our service.

vocab.note: Written, in set phrases: {增|zēng}{至|zhì} (to rise to).
vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{参观|cān guān}{人数|rén shù}{增|zēng}{至|zhì}{十万|shí wàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This year visitor numbers rose to 100,000.

vocab.note: Its opposite is {缩小|suō xiǎo}.
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{打算|dǎ suàn}{明年|míng nián}{扩大|kuò dà}{规模|guī mó}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company plans to expand next year.

vocab.note: {差距|chā jù}{缩小|suō xiǎo}{了|le} (the gap has narrowed).
vocab.example: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{城市|chéng shì}{之间|zhī jiān}{的|de}{差距|chā jù}{正在|zhèng zài}{缩小|suō xiǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The gap between the two cities is narrowing.

vocab.note: Its opposite is {缩短|suō duǎn}.
vocab.example: {暑假|shǔ jià}{期间|qī jiān}，{博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{延长|yán cháng}{了|le}{开放|kāi fàng}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: During the summer holidays the museum stays open longer.

vocab.example: {新|xīn}{的|de}{高铁|gāo tiě}{把|bǎ}{两|liǎng}{地|dì}{之间|zhī jiān}{的|de}{交通|jiāo tōng}{时间|shí jiān}{缩短|suō duǎn}{了|le}{一半|yí bàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The new high-speed line has halved the journey between the two places.

vocab.example: {近年来|jìn nián lái}，{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{发展|fā zhǎn}{明显|míng xiǎn}{加速|jiā sù}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: In recent years the city's development has clearly speeded up.

vocab.note: Without a break; {连续|lián xù} counts units in a row.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{场|chǎng}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}{持续|chí xù}{了|le}{整整|zhěng zhěng}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: The heavy rain went on for two whole days.

vocab.note: {连续|lián xù}{三|sān}{年|nián} (three years running).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{连续|lián xù}{三|sān}{年|nián}{得|dé}{了|le}{冠军|guàn jūn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He won three years running.

vocab.note: Short, before an amount: {超|chāo}{两万|liǎng wàn}{人|rén}; also {超速|chāo sù}, {超级|chāo jí} (super).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{月|yuè}{的|de}{话费|huà fèi}{又|yòu}{超|chāo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: My phone bill has gone over again this month.

vocab.note: {超出|chāo chū}{预计|yù jì}, {超出|chāo chū}{范围|fàn wéi} (beyond the scope).

vocab.exampleEn: This room is less than twenty square metres.

vocab.note: Also "to amount to": {不|bù}{说|shuō}{等于|děng yú}{同意|tóng yì} (saying nothing amounts to agreeing).

vocab.exampleEn: The number of people signed up is already close to a thousand.

vocab.note: An adverb, straight before a number: {将近|jiāng jìn}{一|yì}{年|nián}.

vocab.note: {大多|dà duō} + verb: {大多|dà duō}{是|shì}{学生|xué sheng}.

vocab.note: {平均|píng jūn}{每|měi}{天|tiān} (on average every day).

vocab.exampleEn: On average he works ten hours a day.

vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{报名|bào míng}{的|de}{总数|zǒng shù}{将近|jiāng jìn}{八百|bā bǎi}{人|rén}。

vocab.note: {差|chā}, as in {差别|chā bié} (lesson 26).

vocab.note: Also a noun: {做|zuò}{个|gè}{对比|duì bǐ} (make a comparison).

vocab.exampleEn: The current state of the market is very favourable to us.

vocab.note: Listed as a verb; used as "current, present": {当前|dāng qián}{的|de}{形势|xíng shì}.

vocab.note: {第|dì}{三|sān}{季度|jì dù} (the third quarter).

vocab.exampleEn: Third-quarter sales were ten per cent up on the second quarter.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}.

vocab.exampleEn: Experts predict that the economy will keep growing next year.

vocab.note: {按|àn}…{排列|pái liè} (arranged by…).

vocab.note: Written; in speech {慢|màn}.

meanings: quantity (an amount, as in 重量)

vocab.note: {一|yì}{吨|dūn}{等于|děng yú}{一千|yì qiān}{公斤|gōng jīn}.

vocab.note: {预订|yù dìng}{机票|jī piào}, {预订|yù dìng}{房间|fáng jiān}.

vocab.note: Mostly a noun: {住宿|zhù sù}{费|fèi} (the cost of accommodation).

vocab.note: Written; the place follows directly: {前往|qián wǎng}{北京|Běi jīng}.

vocab.note: {过|guo}{海关|hǎi guān} (to go through customs).
vocab.example: {过|guo}{海关|hǎi guān}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{排|pái}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{的|de}{队|duì}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a long queue at customs.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{游览|yóu lǎn}{古|gǔ}{城|chéng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Tomorrow morning we'll tour the old town.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {走|zǒu}.
vocab.example: {晚上|wǎn shang}{在|zài}{山|shān}{路上|lù shang}{行走|xíng zǒu}{要|yào}{特别|tè bié}{小心|xiǎo xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Take special care walking on mountain paths at night.

vocab.note: No object: {在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{迷路|mí lù}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {第|dì}{一|yī}{次|cì}{来|lái}{这里|zhè lǐ}，{我|wǒ}{差点儿|chà diǎnr}{迷路|mí lù}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: It was my first time here and I nearly got lost.

vocab.note: {绕|rào}{路|lù}, {绕|rào}{一下|yí xià} (go round). You've met it in {围绕|wéi rào}.
vocab.example: {前面|qián miàn}{堵车|dǔ chē}，{我们|wǒ men}{绕|rào}{一下|yí xià}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a jam ahead: let's go round.

vocab.note: {一路|yí lù}{上|shang} (on the way).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{一路|yí lù}{上|shang}{一直|yì zhí}{在|zài}{聊|liáo}{天|tiān}，{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{也|yě}{不|bù}{觉得|jué de}{累|lèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: We chatted the whole way and didn't feel tired at all.

vocab.note: A whole sentence, to someone setting off: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一路顺风|yí lù shùn fēng}！ Some prefer {一路平安|yí lù píng ān} for flights.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{你|nǐ}{就|jiù}{要|yào}{走|zǒu}{了|le}，{祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一路顺风|yí lù shùn fēng}！
vocab.exampleEn: You're off tomorrow: have a good trip!

vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{天空|tiān kōng}{特别|tè bié}{蓝|lán}。
vocab.exampleEn: The sky is especially blue today.

vocab.example: {天上|tiān shàng}{一|yí}{片|piàn}{云|yún}{也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: There isn't a single cloud in the sky.

vocab.note: {起|qǐ}{雾|wù}{了|le} (it's getting foggy).
vocab.example: {早上|zǎo shang}{雾|wù}{很|hěn}{大|dà}，{看|kàn}{不|bu}{清|qīng}{前面|qián miàn}{的|de}{路|lù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The fog was thick this morning: you couldn't see the road ahead.

vocab.example: {下午|xià wǔ}{突然|tū rán}{下|xià}{了|le}{一|yì}{场|chǎng}{暴雨|bào yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: There was a sudden downpour in the afternoon.

vocab.note: {今年|jīn nián}{雨水|yǔ shuǐ}{很|hěn}{多|duō} (it's been a wet year).
vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{夏天|xià tiān}{雨水|yǔ shuǐ}{特别|tè bié}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's been an especially wet summer this year.

vocab.note: The word of weather reports. Listed as a verb; mostly used as a noun.
vocab.example: {预计|yù jì}{明天|míng tiān}{全|quán}{市|shì}{有|yǒu}{降水|jiàng shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Rain is expected across the city tomorrow.

vocab.note: For short spells of weather or sound: {一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{雨|yǔ}, {一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{风|fēng}, {一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{笑|xiào}{声|shēng}.
vocab.example: {刚才|gāng cái}{下|xià}{了|le}{一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{雨|yǔ}，{现在|xiàn zài}{停|tíng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: There was a shower just now, but it's stopped.

vocab.note: {天气|tiān qì}{预报|yù bào} (the weather forecast).
vocab.example: {天气|tiān qì}{预报|yù bào}{说|shuō}{明天|míng tiān}{傍晚|bàng wǎn}{有|yǒu}{雨|yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The forecast says it'll rain tomorrow evening.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{傍晚|bàng wǎn}{到达|dào dá}{了|le}{山|shān}{下|xià}{的|de}{小镇|xiǎo zhèn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We reached the little town at the foot of the mountain at dusk.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{大学|dà xué}{学|xué}{的|de}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{文学|wén xué}。
vocab.exampleEn: She studied Chinese literature at university.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{首|shǒu}{诗|shī} (a poem): measure word {首|shǒu}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{睡觉|shuì jiào}{前|qián}{都|dōu}{要|yào}{读|dú}{一|yì}{首|shǒu}{诗|shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He reads a poem every night before he goes to sleep.

vocab.example: {李白|Lǐ Bái}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{最|zuì}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{诗人|shī rén}{之|zhī}{一|yī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Li Bai is one of China's most famous poets.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{故事|gù shi}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{古人|gǔ rén}{的|de}{智慧|zhì huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a lot of ancient wisdom in this story.

vocab.example: {北京|Běi jīng}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{年轻|nián qīng}{的|de}{白领|bái lǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are a lot of young white-collar workers in Beijing.

meanings: brilliance (talent in the arts or writing)
vocab.note: Shining talent, usually artistic or intellectual: {很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{才华|cái huá}. Compare {才能|cái néng}, practical ability.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{才华|cái huá}，{画画|huà huà}、{写作|xiě zuò}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{出色|chū sè}。
vocab.exampleEn: She is very talented: she paints and writes brilliantly.

vocab.note: Ability to do things: {管理|guǎn lǐ}{才能|cái néng}, {发挥|fā huī}{才能|cái néng}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{岗位|gǎng wèi}{能|néng}{让|ràng}{他|tā}{发挥|fā huī}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{才能|cái néng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This post will let him make full use of his abilities.

meanings: to found (and run: a school, company, paper)
vocab.note: The most general "to found": {创办|chuàng bàn}{学校|xué xiào}, {创办|chuàng bàn}{公司|gōng sī}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{十|shí}{年|nián}{前|qián}{创办|chuàng bàn}{了|le}{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He founded this company ten years ago.

vocab.note: Stresses building a new structure: {创建|chuàng jiàn}{部门|bù mén}, {创建|chuàng jiàn}{网站|wǎng zhàn}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{打算|dǎ suàn}{创建|chuàng jiàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{新|xīn}{的|de}{部门|bù mén}。
vocab.exampleEn: We plan to set up a new department.

meanings: to found (formal: a company, a school of thought)
vocab.note: Formal, often with a date: {创立|chuàng lì}{于|yú}… (founded in…).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{集团|jí tuán}{创立|chuàng lì}{于|yú}1990{年|nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: The group was founded in 1990.

vocab.note: Written: {从业人员|cóng yè rén yuán} (people in the trade), {从业|cóng yè}{经验|jīng yàn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{旅游|lǚ yóu}{业|yè}{从业|cóng yè}{已经|yǐ jīng}{十|shí}{年|nián}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has worked in tourism for ten years.

vocab.note: Also slang: to visit a famous place and post about it.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{前|qián}{要|yào}{打卡|dǎ kǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: At our company you have to clock in before nine every morning.

vocab.note: Holidays, insurance, meals, training: {福利|fú lì}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{工资|gōng zī}{不|bù}{高|gāo}，{可是|kě shì}{福利|fú lì}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The pay at this company isn't high, but the benefits are good.

vocab.note: Often with {在|zài}…{上|shàng} or {新|xīn}{的|de}: {在|zài}{工作|gōng zuò}{岗位|gǎng wèi}{上|shàng}. Compare {职位|zhí wèi} (title) and {职务|zhí wù} (post, formal).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{新|xīn}{的|de}{岗位|gǎng wèi}{上|shàng}{干|gàn}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's doing very well in her new job.

vocab.note: Goes only before nouns: {副|fù}{经理|jīng lǐ}, {副|fù}{总|zǒng}{经理|jīng lǐ}, {副|fù}{教授|jiào shòu}. HSK 5's {副|fù} is the measure word ({一|yí}{副|fù}{眼镜|yǎn jìng}).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{副|fù}{总|zǒng}{经理|jīng lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: He is the company's deputy general manager.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{大型|dà xíng}{集团|jí tuán}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He works for a large group.

meanings: to work part-time (alongside other work or study)
vocab.note: Verb and noun: {他|tā}{在|zài}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{兼职|jiān zhí} / {找|zhǎo}{一|yí}{份|fèn}{兼职|jiān zhí}. Opposite: {全职|quán zhí} (full-time).
vocab.example: {上|shàng}{大学|dà xué}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{她|tā}{做|zuò}{过|guo}{三|sān}{年|nián}{兼职|jiān zhí}{导游|dǎo yóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: At university she worked as a part-time guide for three years.

meanings: to open (a course, a branch, an account)
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{今年|jīn nián}{开设|kāi shè}{了|le}{一|yì}{门|mén}{新|xīn}{课|kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: The school has started a new course this year.

vocab.note: {年终奖|nián zhōng jiǎng} (an end-of-year bonus), {年终|nián zhōng}{总结|zǒng jié} (year-end review).
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{每|měi}{年|nián}{都|dōu}{发|fā}{年终奖|nián zhōng jiǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company pays an end-of-year bonus every year.

vocab.note: The decision at the end of {招聘|zhāo pìn}: {被|bèi}{录用|lù yòng}.
vocab.example: {经过|jīng guò}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}{面试|miàn shì}，{公司|gōng sī}{决定|jué dìng}{录用|lù yòng}{她|tā}。
vocab.exampleEn: After two interviews the company decided to take her on.

vocab.note: {很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{潜力|qián lì}, {发展|fā zhǎn}{潜力|qián lì}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{潜力|qián lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This young person has a lot of potential.

vocab.note: {人事部|rén shì bù} (the personnel department), {人事|rén shì}{主管|zhǔ guǎn}.
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{员工|yuán gōng}{要|yào}{先|xiān}{去|qù}{人事部|rén shì bù}{报到|bào dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: New staff go to the personnel department first to report.

vocab.note: Opposite: {下级|xià jí} (subordinate).
vocab.example: {遇到|yù dào}{问题|wèn tí}{要|yào}{及时|jí shí}{向|xiàng}{上级|shàng jí}{汇报|huì bào}。
vocab.exampleEn: When you meet a problem, report it to your superior promptly.

vocab.note: {求职信|qiú zhí xìn} (a covering letter), {求职|qiú zhí}{者|zhě} (job seeker).
vocab.example: {毕业|bì yè}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{他|tā}{一直|yì zhí}{在|zài}{求职|qiú zhí}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's been looking for a job ever since he graduated.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{从|cóng}{八十|bā shí}{份|fèn}{简历|jiǎn lì}{里|lǐ}{筛选|shāi xuǎn}{出|chū}{了|le}{十二|shí èr}{份|fèn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We picked out twelve of the eighty CVs.

vocab.note: {员工|yuán gōng}{素质|sù zhì}, {综合素质|zōng hé sù zhì} (overall quality).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{很|hěn}{重视|zhòng shì}{员工|yuán gōng}{的|de}{素质|sù zhì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company sets great store by the quality of its staff.

vocab.note: Something you can list: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{特长|tè cháng}{是|shì}{摄影|shè yǐng}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{特长|tè cháng}？
vocab.exampleEn: What are your special skills?

vocab.note: Compare {工资|gōng zī}, the everyday word and the one on payslips and contracts; ads write {薪水|xīn shuǐ}{面议|miàn yì}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{份|fèn}{工作|gōng zuò}{薪水|xīn shuǐ}{不|bù}{高|gāo}，{可是|kě shì}{很|hěn}{有意思|yǒu yì si}。
vocab.exampleEn: The pay for this job isn't high, but it's very interesting.

vocab.note: {用人单位|yòng rén dān wèi} (an employer). Not to be confused with {佣人|yōng rén} (a servant).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{用人|yòng rén}{很|hěn}{严格|yán gé}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company is very particular about whom it hires.

meanings: trade, industry (as a suffix: 服务业)
vocab.note: After a field: {服务|fú wù}{业|yè}, {旅游|lǚ yóu}{业|yè}, {农业|nóng yè}.
vocab.example: {服务|fú wù}{业|yè}{的|de}{从业人员|cóng yè rén yuán}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: More and more people work in the service industry.

vocab.note: {申请|shēn qǐng}{职位|zhí wèi}. Compare {职务|zhí wù} and {岗位|gǎng wèi}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{申请|shēn qǐng}{了|le}{经理|jīng lǐ}{助理|zhù lǐ}{的|de}{职位|zhí wèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: He applied for the post of assistant to the manager.

vocab.note: Formal: {担任|dān rèn}{职务|zhí wù} (hold a post).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{公司|gōng sī}{担任|dān rèn}{副|fù}{经理|jīng lǐ}{职务|zhí wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: She holds the post of deputy manager in the company.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{银行|yín háng}{的|de}{普通|pǔ tōng}{职员|zhí yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's an ordinary clerk at a bank.

vocab.note: {明确|míng què}{职责|zhí zé}, {履行|lǚ xíng}{职责|zhí zé}.
vocab.example: {导游|dǎo yóu}{的|de}{职责|zhí zé}{首先|shǒu xiān}{是|shì}{照顾|zhào gù}{好|hǎo}{游客|yóu kè}{的|de}{安全|ān quán}。
vocab.exampleEn: A guide's first duty is the visitors' safety.

vocab.note: Anyone who helps, at work or at home; a job title is {助理|zhù lǐ}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{工作|gōng zuò}{上|shàng}{的|de}{好|hǎo}{助手|zhù shǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's a great help to me at work.

vocab.example: {集团|jí tuán}{总裁|zǒng cái}{下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{来|lái}{北京|Běi jīng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The group's president is coming to Beijing next month.

meanings: to recruit (spoken, short for 招聘)
vocab.note: Spoken {招聘|zhāo pìn}: {招|zhāo}{人|rén}, {招|zhāo}{两|liǎng}{名|míng}{导游|dǎo yóu}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}{要|yào}{招|zhāo}{三|sān}{个|gè}{兼职|jiān zhí}{导游|dǎo yóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our company wants to take on three part-time guides.

vocab.note: {轮流|lún liú}{值班|zhí bān} (take turns on duty).
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{谁|shéi}{值班|zhí bān}？
vocab.exampleEn: Who's on duty tonight?

meanings: manager (person in charge of a section)
vocab.note: Noun and verb: {人事|rén shì}{主管|zhǔ guǎn}; {他|tā}{主管|zhǔ guǎn}{销售|xiāo shòu}.
vocab.example: {有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{可以|kě yǐ}{找|zhǎo}{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{人事|rén shì}{主管|zhǔ guǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: If there's a problem, you can see our HR manager.

vocab.note: {经理|jīng lǐ}{助理|zhù lǐ}, {运营助理|yùn yíng zhù lǐ}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{以前|yǐ qián}{是|shì}{总|zǒng}{经理|jīng lǐ}{助理|zhù lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: She used to be the general manager's assistant.

vocab.note: {国际|guó jì}{博览会|bó lǎn huì}.
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{在|zài}{博览会|bó lǎn huì}{上|shàng}{认识|rèn shi}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{厂家|chǎng jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: They met a lot of manufacturers at the trade fair.

vocab.note: {谈判|tán pàn}{策略|cè lüè}, {市场|shì chǎng}{策略|cè lüè}.
vocab.example: {谈判|tán pàn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{讲|jiǎng}{策略|cè lüè}。
vocab.exampleEn: In negotiations you need tactics.

vocab.note: Compare {厂商|chǎng shāng}, the firms as a group.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{直接|zhí jiē}{跟|gēn}{厂家|chǎng jiā}{买|mǎi}，{便宜|pián yi}{一些|yì xiē}。
vocab.exampleEn: We buy straight from the manufacturer: it's a bit cheaper.

vocab.note: {参展|cān zhǎn}{厂商|chǎng shāng} (exhibitors).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{博览会|bó lǎn huì}{有|yǒu}{三百|sān bǎi}{多|duō}{家|jiā}{厂商|chǎng shāng}{参展|cān zhǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Over three hundred firms are exhibiting at this fair.

vocab.note: {保修|bǎo xiū}{一|yì}{年|nián} (a one-year warranty), {保修|bǎo xiū}{期|qī}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{耳机|ěr jī}{保修|bǎo xiū}{一|yì}{年|nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: These earphones have a one-year warranty.

vocab.note: Buying for a company, not shopping for yourself.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{公司|gōng sī}{负责|fù zé}{采购|cǎi gòu}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's in charge of purchasing at the company.

vocab.example: {去|qù}{别人|bié ren}{家|jiā}{做客|zuò kè}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{规矩|guī ju}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are a lot of rules about being a guest in someone's home.

vocab.note: {正式|zhèng shì}{场合|chǎng hé} a formal occasion; {看|kàn}{场合|chǎng hé} it depends on the occasion.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{正式|zhèng shì}{场合|chǎng hé}，{最好|zuì hǎo}{穿|chuān}{得|de}{正式|zhèng shì}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: On formal occasions it's best to dress a bit more formally.

vocab.note: {要|yào}{面子|miàn zi} to care about face; {给|gěi}{面子|miàn zi} to show respect, save someone's face; {丢|diū}{面子|miàn zi} to lose face.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{要|yào}{面子|miàn zi}，{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{当|dāng}{着|zhe}{大家|dà jiā}{批评|pī píng}{他|tā}。
vocab.exampleEn: He cares a lot about face: don't criticise him in front of everyone.

vocab.note: hào kè: {好|hào} hào is "to be fond of".
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{人|rén}{非常|fēi cháng}{好客|hào kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: People here are very hospitable.

vocab.note: {服务|fú wù}{周到|zhōu dào} attentive service; {考虑|kǎo lǜ}{得|de}{很|hěn}{周到|zhōu dào} to have thought of everything.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{酒店|jiǔ diàn}{的|de}{服务|fú wù}{很|hěn}{周到|zhōu dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: The service at this hotel is very attentive.

vocab.note: {交际|jiāo jì}{能力|néng lì} social skills; {很|hěn}{会|huì}{交际|jiāo jì} good with people.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{很|hěn}{会|huì}{交际|jiāo jì}，{认识|rèn shi}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{朋友|péng you}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's good with people and knows lots of friends.

vocab.note: Talking with someone: {跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{交谈|jiāo tán}, {用|yòng}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{交谈|jiāo tán}.
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{用|yòng}{英语|Yīng yǔ}{交谈|jiāo tán}{了|le}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: They talked in English for half an hour.

vocab.note: Takes the topic as its object: {谈论|tán lùn}{天气|tiān qì}, {谈论|tán lùn}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}.
vocab.example: {大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{在|zài}{谈论|tán lùn}{那|nà}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone is talking about that match.

vocab.note: Always {跟|gēn} / {和|hé} + someone + {打交道|dǎ jiāo dào}; takes no object of its own.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{要|yào}{跟|gēn}{客人|kè rén}{打交道|dǎ jiāo dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: My job means dealing with customers every day.

vocab.note: lái wǎng, everyday. {跟|gēn}{他|tā}{没有|méi yǒu}{来往|lái wǎng} not in touch with him.
vocab.example: {毕业|bì yè}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我们|wǒ men}{还|hái}{一直|yì zhí}{有|yǒu}{来往|lái wǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: We've stayed in touch since graduating.

vocab.note: The written twin of {来往|lái wǎng}, for places and organisations.
vocab.example: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{城市|chéng shì}{之间|zhī jiān}{的|de}{往来|wǎng lái}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are more and more exchanges between the two cities.

vocab.note: Polite and modest: you {拜访|bài fǎng} someone you respect.
vocab.example: {春节|Chūn jié}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{拜访|bài fǎng}{了|le}{以前|yǐ qián}{的|de}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: At the Spring Festival we called on our old teacher.

vocab.note: Formal and mostly written: people meeting in their roles.
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{总裁|zǒng cái}{会见|huì jiàn}{了|le}{合作|hé zuò}{公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{客人|kè rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company's president met the guests from the partner company.

vocab.note: {在|zài}…{的|de}{陪同|péi tóng}{下|xià}: accompanied by….

vocab.exampleEn: Accompanied by a guide, we visited the old town.

vocab.note: For a trip to see something with your own eyes: {考察|kǎo chá}{市场|shì chǎng}.
vocab.example: {经理|jīng lǐ}{下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{要|yào}{去|qù}{南方|nán fāng}{考察|kǎo chá}{市场|shì chǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Next month the manager is going south to study the market.

vocab.note: {观光客|guān guāng kè} tourists, {观光|guān guāng}{车|chē} a sightseeing bus.
vocab.example: {每|měi}{年|nián}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{外国|wài guó}{游客|yóu kè}{来|lái}{这里|zhè lǐ}{观光|guān guāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Every year many foreign tourists come sightseeing here.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{跟|gēn}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{同伴|tóng bàn}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}{了|le}。

vocab.note: quān. {跑|pǎo}{三|sān}{圈|quān} to run three laps; {朋友|péng you}{圈|quān} one's circle of friends (also a messaging app's feed).
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{在|zài}{黑板|hēi bǎn}{上|shàng}{画|huà}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{圈|quān}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher drew a circle on the board.

vocab.note: Opposite {入境|rù jìng}.
vocab.example: {出境|chū jìng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{检查|jiǎn chá}{护照|hù zhào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Your passport is checked when you leave the country.

vocab.note: Opposite {出境|chū jìng}.
vocab.example: {入境|rù jìng}{以前|yǐ qián}，{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{飞机|fēi jī}{上|shàng}{填|tián}{好|hǎo}{了|le}{表|biǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Before entering the country, I filled in the form on the plane.

vocab.note: {免税|miǎn shuì}{店|diàn} a duty-free shop.
vocab.example: {机场|jī chǎng}{的|de}{免税|miǎn shuì}{店|diàn}{东西|dōng xi}{不|bù}{一定|yí dìng}{便宜|pián yi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Things in the airport duty-free shop aren't necessarily cheap.

vocab.note: {办理|bàn lǐ}{退税|tuì shuì} to claim a tax refund.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{商场|shāng chǎng}{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}，{可以|kě yǐ}{在|zài}{机场|jī chǎng}{办理|bàn lǐ}{退税|tuì shuì}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you shop in this mall, you can claim the tax back at the airport.

vocab.note: tuō yùn; its first character is "to entrust", as in {委托|wěi tuō}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{箱子|xiāng zi}{太|tài}{大|dà}{了|le}，{得|děi}{托运|tuō yùn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This case is too big: it has to be checked in.

vocab.note: Written: announcements, news. In speech, {到|dào}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{航班|háng bān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{抵达|dǐ dá}{北京|Běi jīng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our flight arrives in Beijing at eight in the evening.

vocab.note: Verb: {出入|chū rù}{请|qǐng}{关|guān}{门|mén}. Noun: {有|yǒu}{出入|chū rù}, not quite matching.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{说|shuō}{的|de}{跟|gēn}{实际|shí jì}{情况|qíng kuàng}{有些|yǒu xiē}{出入|chū rù}。
vocab.exampleEn: What he said doesn't quite match what actually happened.

vocab.note: Verb ({移民|yí mín}{到|dào}{加拿大|Jiā ná dà}) and noun ({新|xīn}{移民|yí mín}).
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{十|shí}{年|nián}{前|qián}{移民|yí mín}{到|dào}{了|le}{加拿大|Jiā ná dà}。
vocab.exampleEn: His family emigrated to Canada ten years ago.

vocab.note: Written, for people and news: {海内外|hǎi nèi wài}{的|de}{游客|yóu kè}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{吸引|xī yǐn}{了|le}{海内外|hǎi nèi wài}{的|de}{游客|yóu kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: This museum draws visitors from home and abroad.

vocab.note: {国|guó}{内外|nèi wài} at home and abroad; {室|shì}{内外|nèi wài} indoors and outdoors.
vocab.example: {屋子|wū zi}{内外|nèi wài}{都|dōu}{打扫|dǎ sǎo}{得|de}{很|hěn}{干净|gān jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The house has been cleaned inside and out.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{国外|guó wài}{生活|shēng huó}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{年|nián}，{还是|hái shi}{常常|cháng cháng}{想念|xiǎng niàn}{祖国|zǔ guó}。
vocab.exampleEn: She has lived abroad for many years and still often misses her homeland.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{大学|dà xué}{学|xué}{的|de}{是|shì}{外交|wài jiāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: She studied diplomacy at university.

vocab.note: {大|dà}{使馆|shǐ guǎn} an embassy.

vocab.exampleEn: His father was an ambassador, so he lived in many countries as a child.

vocab.note: The title in many countries (Canada, Australia…); Britain's and Japan's head of government is usually called {首相|shǒu xiàng}.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{加拿大|Jiā ná dà}，{政府|zhèng fǔ}{最|zuì}{高|gāo}{的|de}{领导|lǐng dǎo}{叫|jiào}{总理|zǒng lǐ}。

vocab.example: {联合国|Lián hé guó}{有|yǒu}{六|liù}{种|zhǒng}{工作|gōng zuò}{语言|yǔ yán}，{中文|Zhōng wén}{是|shì}{其中|qí zhōng}{之一|zhī yī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The United Nations has six working languages, and Chinese is one of them.

vocab.note: Not {洲|zhōu} (a continent). {加|jiā}{州|zhōu} California; the {州|zhōu} of {广|guǎng}{州|zhōu} and {苏州|Sū zhōu} was a prefecture.
vocab.example: {美国|Měi guó}{有|yǒu}{五十|wǔ shí}{个|gè}{州|zhōu}。
vocab.exampleEn: The United States has fifty states.

vocab.note: {洲|zhōu}, with 氵.

vocab.note: Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific islands.
vocab.example: {澳大利亚|Ào dà lì yà}{是|shì}{大洋洲|Dà yáng zhōu}{最|zuì}{大|dà}{的|de}{国家|guó jiā}。

vocab.note: Noun and adjective: {追求|zhuī qiú}{时尚|shí shàng}, {穿|chuān}{得|de}{很|hěn}{时尚|shí shàng}.

vocab.exampleEn: She dresses in a way that's both fashionable and comfortable.

vocab.note: The design of a garment or product.

vocab.exampleEn: This coat's design is very new.

vocab.note: The overall look a stylist creates; also the shape of an object.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{换|huàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{新|xīn}{造型|zào xíng}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{说|shuō}{很|hěn}{好看|hǎo kàn}。

vocab.example: {她|tā}{平时|píng shí}{不|bú}{化妆|huà zhuāng}，{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{在|zài}{正式|zhèng shì}{场合|chǎng hé}{才|cái}{化|huà}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: She doesn't usually wear make-up: only a little on formal occasions.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{送|sòng}{了|le}{妈妈|mā ma}{一|yì}{瓶|píng}{香水|xiāng shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: She gave her mother a bottle of perfume.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{对|duì}{耳环|ěr huán} a pair of earrings.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{对|duì}{耳环|ěr huán}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{奶奶|nǎi nai}{留|liú}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This pair of earrings was left to me by my grandmother.

vocab.note: mó tèr: {特儿|tèr} is one syllable.

vocab.exampleEn: She used to work as a fashion model.

vocab.note: {一身|yì shēn}{黑|hēi} all in black; {一身|yì shēn}{汗|hàn} sweating all over.

vocab.exampleEn: He wore a whole new outfit to the wedding.

vocab.example: {夏天|xià tiān}{他|tā}{总是|zǒng shì}{穿|chuān}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{背心|bèi xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: In summer he always wears a vest.

vocab.example: {出门|chū mén}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{要|yào}{多|duō}{带|dài}{几|jǐ}{件|jiàn}{内衣|nèi yī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Take a few extra sets of underwear when you travel.

vocab.note: {长|cháng}{袖|xiù} long-sleeved, {短|duǎn}{袖|xiù} short-sleeved.

vocab.example: {北方|běi fāng}{的|de}{冬天|dōng tiān}{离不开|lí bu kāi}{羽绒服|yǔ róng fú}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can't get through a northern winter without a down jacket.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{羽绒服|yǔ róng fú}{又|yòu}{轻|qīng}{又|yòu}{保暖|bǎo nuǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This down jacket is light and warm.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{围巾|wéi jīn}{摸|mō}{起来|qǐ lái}{很|hěn}{柔软|róu ruǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This scarf feels very soft.

vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{颜色|yán sè}{鲜艳|xiān yàn}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Children all like brightly coloured clothes.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{一|yì}{双|shuāng}{棕色|zōng sè}{的|de}{皮鞋|pí xié}。
vocab.exampleEn: He bought a pair of brown leather shoes.

vocab.note: {粉|fěn}{色|sè} or {粉|fěn}{红色|hóng sè} pink; {一|yì}{包|bāo}{粉|fěn} a packet of powder.

vocab.exampleEn: She painted her room pink.

vocab.note: {黄色|huáng sè} yellow; as a verb, {叶子|yè zi}{黄|huáng}{了|le} the leaves have turned yellow.
vocab.example: {秋天|qiū tiān}{到|dào}{了|le}，{树|shù}{叶|yè}{都|dōu}{黄|huáng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Autumn has come, and the leaves have all turned yellow.

vocab.note: For clothes and meat, not people (say {胖|pàng}).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{裤子|kù zi}{太|tài}{肥|féi}{了|le}，{换|huàn}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{小|xiǎo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{的|de}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: These trousers are too loose: try a smaller pair.

vocab.example: {外面|wài miàn}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{冷|lěng}，{你|nǐ}{披|pī}{上|shàng}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{外套|wài tào}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's a bit cold out: put a coat round your shoulders.

vocab.note: {染|rǎn}{头发|tóu fa} to dye one's hair.

vocab.exampleEn: She dyed her hair brown.

meanings: to stick into (a needle, a thorn)
vocab.note: zhā. {扎|zhā}{手|shǒu} to prick one's hand; {扎针|zhā zhēn} acupuncture, an injection. Read zā, the same character is "to tie up": {把|bǎ}{头发|tóu fa}{扎|zā}{起来|qǐ lái} to tie one's hair up (traditional {紮|zā}).
vocab.example: {吃|chī}{鱼|yú}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{手|shǒu}{被|bèi}{鱼|yú}{刺|cì}{扎|zhā}{了|le}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: I pricked my hand on a fish bone while eating fish.

vocab.note: {趁|chèn} + a passing chance + verb: {趁|chèn}{热|rè}{吃|chī}, {趁|chèn}{年轻|nián qīng}, {趁|chèn}{他|tā}{不|bú}{在|zài}. {趁|chèn}{着|zhe} is the same.
vocab.example: {趁|chèn}{天|tiān}{还|hái}{没|méi}{黑|hēi}，{我们|wǒ men}{快|kuài}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's hurry home while it's still light.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{串|chuàn}{葡萄|pú tao}, {一|yí}{串|chuàn}{钥匙|yào shi}; {羊肉串|yáng ròu chuàn} lamb kebabs.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{手|shǒu}{里|lǐ}{拿|ná}{着|zhe}{一|yí}{串|chuàn}{钥匙|yào shi}。
vocab.exampleEn: He had a bunch of keys in his hand.

vocab.note: Measure word ({一|yì}{滴|dī}{水|shuǐ}) and verb ({滴|dī}{几|jǐ}{滴|dī}{醋|cù}).

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{小姨|xiǎo yí}{在|zài}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{工作|gōng zuò}。

vocab.note: A brother's daughter is {侄女|zhí nǚ}.

vocab.exampleEn: My nephew (my brother's son) started middle school this year.

vocab.note: A sister's daughter is {外甥女|wài shēng nǚ}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{外甥|wài shēng}{今年|jīn nián}{七|qī}{岁|suì}。
vocab.exampleEn: My nephew (my sister's son) is seven.

vocab.note: xí fu; {儿媳妇|ér xí fu} a son's wife.

vocab.note: Polite: {您|nín}{夫人|fū rén}, {王先生|Wáng xiān sheng}{和|hé}{夫人|fū rén}. For your own wife, {我|wǒ}{爱人|ài ren} / {我|wǒ}{太太|tài tai}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{代|dài}{我|wǒ}{向|xiàng}{您|nín}{夫人|fū rén}{问|wèn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please give my regards to your wife.

meanings: family members (of a patient, an employee)
vocab.note: {病人|bìng rén}{家属|jiā shǔ}.
vocab.example: {医生|yī shēng}{请|qǐng}{家属|jiā shǔ}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}{谈一谈|tán yi tán}。

vocab.note: Written and legal.

vocab.note: zhǎng bèi.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{说话|shuō huà}{很|hěn}{温柔|wēn róu}。

vocab.note: {别|bié}{逗|dòu}{他|tā}{了|le}; {你|nǐ}{真|zhēn}{逗|dòu}！

vocab.exampleEn: Stop teasing the child: he's about to cry.

vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{一|yì}{家人|jiā rén}{相处|xiāng chǔ}{得|de}{很|hěn}{和谐|hé xié}。

vocab.note: {亲密|qīn mì}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}.

vocab.exampleEn: This is the book I treasure most.

vocab.note: {心疼|xīn téng}{孩子|hái zi} (to dote on a child); {心疼|xīn téng}{钱|qián} (to begrudge the money).
vocab.example: {奶奶|nǎi nai}{最|zuì}{心疼|xīn téng}{我|wǒ}。

vocab.note: {对|duì}…{有|yǒu}{好感|hǎo gǎn}.

vocab.note: Leans to a special trip or effort: {特地|tè dì}{赶|gǎn}{来|lái}.

vocab.exampleEn: I made this dish specially for you.

vocab.note: Usually {偷偷|tōu tōu}{地|de} in writing.

vocab.note: {说|shuō}{别人|bié ren}{的|de}{长短|cháng duǎn} to gossip about people; {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{裙子|qún zi}{长短|cháng duǎn}{正好|zhèng hǎo} (the length is just right).

vocab.note: {别|bié}{冲动|chōng dòng}: don't do anything rash.

vocab.note: In reports and news; in speech {吵架|chǎo jià}.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{欺骗|qī piàn}{了|le}{所|suǒ}{有的|yǒu de}{人|rén}。

vocab.note: After the verb: {感动|gǎn dòng}{不已|bù yǐ}, {后悔|hòu huǐ}{不已|bù yǐ}.

vocab.note: {核心|hé xīn}{问题|wèn tí}, {核心|hé xīn}{观点|guān diǎn}.

vocab.note: + a two-syllable verb or adjective: {毫不|háo bú}{在意|zài yì}, {毫不|háo bù}{犹豫|yóu yù}.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{说法|shuō fǎ}{毫无|háo wú}{道理|dào li}。

vocab.note: In compounds: {解|jiě}{题|tí} (to solve a problem), {解|jiě}{开|kāi} (to untie).

vocab.note: {局限|jú xiàn}{于|yú}: to be confined to. As a noun: {这|zhè}{项|xiàng}{研究|yán jiū}{有|yǒu}{它|tā}{的|de}{局限|jú xiàn}。

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{理|lǐ} (to be in the right), {讲|jiǎng}{理|lǐ} (to be reasonable).

vocab.note: Usually a noun: {没有|méi yǒu}{例外|lì wài}, {不|bú}{例外|lì wài}.

vocab.exampleEn: The rule is the same for everyone: no one is an exception.

vocab.note: Written; mostly {没|méi}{料|liào}{到|dào} and {料|liào}{到|dào}. Lesson 12's {料|liào} is a noun (material).

vocab.example: {遇到|yù dào}{问题|wèn tí}，{我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{理性|lǐ xìng}{地|de}{分析|fēn xī}。

vocab.note: {片面|piàn miàn}{地|de}{看|kàn}{问题|wèn tí}: to see a question from one side only.

vocab.note: {在|zài}…{的|de}{前提|qián tí}{下|xià}: on condition that.

vocab.note: The second syllable is light. More written than {情况|qíng kuàng}.

vocab.note: {显著|xiǎn zhù}{的|de}{变化|biàn huà}, {显著|xiǎn zhù}{的|de}{效果|xiào guǒ}.

vocab.note: {不|bù}{足以|zú yǐ}: not enough to.

vocab.note: After the second subject: {前者|qián zhě}…，{后者|hòu zhě}{则|zé}…; after a condition, written {就|jiù}.

vocab.note: {从|cóng}{经济|jīng jì}{层面|céng miàn}{看|kàn}: from the economic angle.

vocab.note: bù dé; not {不得不|bù dé bù} (to have to).

vocab.note: Also spoken: {不许|bù xǔ}{说话|shuō huà}！

vocab.note: {不宜|bù yí} + verb: {不宜|bù yí}{久|jiǔ}{留|liú}.

vocab.note: {抄写|chāo xiě}, {抄|chāo}{作业|zuò yè} (to copy homework).

vocab.note: {请|qǐng}{出示|chū shì}{证件|zhèng jiàn} / {门票|mén piào}.
vocab.example: {进|jìn}{门|mén}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{请|qǐng}{出示|chū shì}{门票|mén piào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please show your ticket at the door.

vocab.note: {问题|wèn tí}{本身|běn shēn}, {这|zhè}{本身|běn shēn}{就|jiù}….
vocab.example: {问题|wèn tí}{本身|běn shēn}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{难|nán}，{难|nán}{的|de}{是|shì}{时间|shí jiān}{太|tài}{短|duǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The problem itself isn't hard: what's hard is the lack of time.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{个|gè}{典型|diǎn xíng}{的|de}{例子|lì zi}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{典型|diǎn xíng}{的|de}{例子|lì zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a very typical example.

vocab.note: {给|gěi}…{下|xià}{定义|dìng yì}: to give a definition of.
vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{对|duì}"{成功|chéng gōng}"{的|de}{定义|dìng yì}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone defines "success" differently.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{用|yòng}{黑色|hēi sè}{钢笔|gāng bǐ}{填写|tián xiě}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please fill this in with a black pen.

vocab.note: With {前者|qián zhě} (the former).
vocab.example: {城市|chéng shì}{和|hé}{农村|nóng cūn}{各|gè}{有|yǒu}{好处|hǎo chù}，{前者|qián zhě}{方便|fāng biàn}，{后者|hòu zhě}{安静|ān jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: City and country each have their advantages: the former is convenient, the latter quiet.

vocab.note: By an organisation: {学校|xué xiào}{的|de}{公告|gōng gào}.
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{在|zài}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{上|shàng}{发|fā}{了|le}{一|yí}{份|fèn}{公告|gōng gào}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company posted an announcement on its website.

vocab.note: gāi; before a noun with no measure word: {该|gāi}{公司|gōng sī}, {该|gāi}{产品|chǎn pǐn}. Not HSK 3's {该|gāi} "should".
vocab.example: {王|wáng}{先生|xiān sheng}{在|zài}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{工作|gōng zuò}，{该|gāi}{公司|gōng sī}{成立|chéng lì}{于|yú}2010{年|nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: Mr Wang works for a company; the company was founded in 2010.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{生|shēng}{词|cí}{写|xiě}{在|zài}{卡片|kǎ piàn}{上|shàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I write new words on cards.

vocab.note: Takes a two-syllable verb as its object: {加以|jiā yǐ}{解决|jiě jué}, {加以|jiā yǐ}{说明|shuō míng}.
vocab.example: {对|duì}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}，{我们|wǒ men}{必须|bì xū}{加以|jiā yǐ}{研究|yán jiū}。
vocab.exampleEn: This question must be studied.

vocab.note: Mostly a noun: {文章|wén zhāng}{的|de}{结尾|jié wěi}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{篇|piān}{小说|xiǎo shuō}{的|de}{结尾|jié wěi}{很|hěn}{感人|gǎn rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: The ending of this story is very moving.

vocab.note: Followed by the date: {截至|jié zhì}{十|shí}{月|yuè}{底|dǐ}.
vocab.example: {截至|jié zhì}{昨天|zuó tiān}，{已|yǐ}{有|yǒu}{三千|sān qiān}{人|rén}{报名|bào míng}。
vocab.exampleEn: As of yesterday, three thousand people had signed up.

vocab.note: Usually after the date ({十|shí}{月|yuè}{五|wǔ}{日|rì}{截止|jié zhǐ}) or before {日期|rì qī}.
vocab.example: {报名|bào míng}{明天|míng tiān}{截止|jié zhǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Registration closes tomorrow.

vocab.note: Mostly a noun: {文章|wén zhāng}{的|de}{开头|kāi tóu}, {万|wàn}{事|shì}{开头|kāi tóu}{难|nán}.
vocab.example: {文章|wén zhāng}{的|de}{开头|kāi tóu}{要|yào}{能|néng}{吸引|xī yǐn}{读者|dú zhě}。
vocab.exampleEn: The opening of an article should draw the reader in.

vocab.note: Written {非常|fēi cháng}, before two-syllable words: {极为|jí wéi}{重要|zhòng yào}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{一|yì}{发现|fā xiàn}{极为|jí wéi}{重要|zhòng yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: This discovery is extremely important.

vocab.note: Written {比较|bǐ jiào}: {较为|jiào wéi}{复杂|fù zá}.
vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{情况|qíng kuàng}{较为|jiào wéi}{复杂|fù zá}。
vocab.exampleEn: This year's situation is relatively complicated.

vocab.note: juàn; HSK 5's {试卷|shì juàn} (exam paper). Lesson 12's {={卷|juǎn}=} juǎn (traditional {=捲=}) is "to roll".
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{部|bù}{小说|xiǎo shuō}{一共|yí gòng}{有|yǒu}{三|sān}{卷|juàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This novel has three volumes in all.

vocab.example: {图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{书|shū}{按|àn}{类别|lèi bié}{排放|pái fàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The books in the library are arranged by category.

vocab.example: {先|xiān}{看|kàn}{目录|mù lù}，{再|zài}{找|zhǎo}{你|nǐ}{要|yào}{的|de}{那|nà}{一|yì}{章|zhāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Look at the contents first, then find the chapter you want.

vocab.note: Written, in phrases: {免|miǎn}{收|shōu}{门票|mén piào}, {以免|yǐ miǎn}, {闲人免进|xián rén miǎn jìn} (staff only).
vocab.example: {六|liù}{岁|suì}{以下|yǐ xià}{的|de}{儿童|ér tóng}{免|miǎn}{票|piào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Children under six go free.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{段|duàn}{描写|miáo xiě}{很|hěn}{生动|shēng dòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This passage of description is very vivid.

meanings: in the meantime (during that time, written)
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{国外|guó wài}{住|zhù}{了|le}{十|shí}{年|nián}，{其间|qí jiān}{写|xiě}{了|le}{三|sān}{本|běn}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: He lived abroad for ten years, and in that time wrote three books.

meanings: notice (on a board, in a paper)
vocab.note: {招聘|zhāo pìn}{启事|qǐ shì} (a job advertisement), {寻|xún}{物|wù}{启事|qǐ shì} (a lost property notice).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{楼|lóu}{下|xià}{贴|tiē}{了|le}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{启事|qǐ shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He put up a notice downstairs.

vocab.note: With {后者|hòu zhě} (the latter).
vocab.example: {前者|qián zhě}{便宜|pián yi}，{后者|hòu zhě}{质量|zhì liàng}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The former is cheaper; the latter is of better quality.

meanings: first ten days of a month
vocab.note: {九|jiǔ}{月|yuè}{上旬|shàng xún}: early September.
vocab.example: {展览|zhǎn lǎn}{将|jiāng}{于|yú}{十二|shí èr}{月|yuè}{上旬|shàng xún}{结束|jié shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The exhibition will close in early December.

vocab.note: {问题|wèn tí}{的|de}{实质|shí zhì}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{种|zhǒng}{说法|shuō fǎ}{在|zài}{实质|shí zhì}{上|shàng}{没有|méi yǒu}{区别|qū bié}。
vocab.exampleEn: In substance there's no difference between the two claims.

vocab.note: Written: {上述|shàng shù}{问题|wèn tí}, {上述|shàng shù}{情况|qíng kuàng}.
vocab.example: {上述|shàng shù}{问题|wèn tí}{我们|wǒ men}{会|huì}{尽快|jǐn kuài}{解决|jiě jué}。
vocab.exampleEn: We will deal with the above problems as soon as possible.

vocab.note: {注意|zhù yì}{事项|shì xiàng} (points to note).
vocab.example: {出发|chū fā}{以前|yǐ qián}，{请|qǐng}{仔细|zǐ xì}{阅读|yuè dú}{注意|zhù yì}{事项|shì xiàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Before you set off, please read the points to note carefully.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{收藏|shōu cáng}{了|le}{大量|dà liàng}{古代|gǔ dài}{书籍|shū jí}。
vocab.exampleEn: This library holds a great many ancient books.

vocab.note: {书写|shū xiě}{工具|gōng jù}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{用|yòng}{钢笔|gāng bǐ}{书写|shū xiě}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please write in pen.

vocab.note: {书面语|shū miàn yǔ} (written language), {书面|shū miàn}{申请|shēn qǐng} (a written application).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{提交|tí jiāo}{书面|shū miàn}{申请|shēn qǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please submit a written application.

vocab.note: In letters and notices: {特此|tè cǐ}{通知|tōng zhī}, {特|tè}{向|xiàng}…{表示|biǎo shì}{感谢|gǎn xiè}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{特|tè}{向|xiàng}{各位|gè wèi}{表示|biǎo shì}{感谢|gǎn xiè}。
vocab.exampleEn: We would like especially to thank everyone.

vocab.note: {未|wèi}{参加|cān jiā} (did not take part), {未经|wèi jīng}{许可|xǔ kě} (without permission), {尚未|shàng wèi} (not yet).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{未|wèi}{参加|cān jiā}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{会议|huì yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He did not attend this meeting.

vocab.note: wèi hé; written {为什么|wèi shén me}.
vocab.example: {为何|wèi hé}{会|huì}{出现|chū xiàn}{这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{情况|qíng kuàng}？
vocab.exampleEn: Why has this happened?

vocab.note: {虽|suī}…{但|dàn} / {却|què}….
vocab.example: {虽|suī}{有|yǒu}{困难|kùn nan}，{但|dàn}{我们|wǒ men}{会|huì}{按时|àn shí}{完成|wán chéng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Although there are difficulties, we'll finish on time.

meanings: (structural particle before a verb: that which)
vocab.note: {我|wǒ}{所|suǒ}{知道|zhī dào}{的|de} (what I know), {为|wéi}{人们|rén men}{所|suǒ}{熟悉|shú xī} (familiar to people). HSK 5's {所|suǒ} is the measure word ({一|yì}{所|suǒ}{学校|xué xiào}).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{就是|jiù shì}{我|wǒ}{所|suǒ}{知道|zhī dào}{的|de}{情况|qíng kuàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: That's all I know about it.

vocab.note: wèi cǐ; starts a sentence that responds to what came before.
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{读者|dú zhě}{反映|fǎn yìng}{字|zì}{太|tài}{小|xiǎo}，{为此|wèi cǐ}{我们|wǒ men}{修改|xiū gǎi}{了|le}{网页|wǎng yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many readers said the print was too small, so we have changed the page.

meanings: last ten days of a month
vocab.note: {九|jiǔ}{月|yuè}{下旬|xià xún}: late September.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{打算|dǎ suàn}{下旬|xià xún}{出发|chū fā}。
vocab.exampleEn: We plan to set off in the last ten days of the month.

vocab.note: {最|zuì}{大|dà}{限度|xiàn dù} (to the greatest extent), {最|zuì}{低|dī}{限度|xiàn dù}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{最|zuì}{大|dà}{限度|xiàn dù}{地|de}{减少|jiǎn shǎo}{浪费|làng fèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: We must cut waste to the greatest possible extent.

vocab.note: {名人效应|míng rén xiào yìng} (the celebrity effect).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{就是|jiù shì}{所|suǒ}{谓|wèi}{的|de}"{名人效应|míng rén xiào yìng}"。
vocab.exampleEn: That's what's called the "celebrity effect".

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{会议|huì yì}{的|de}{要点|yào diǎn}{记|jì}{下来|xià lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please write down the main points of the meeting.

vocab.example: {时间|shí jiān}、{地点|dì diǎn}、{人物|rén wù}{是|shì}{故事|gù shi}{的|de}{三|sān}{个|gè}{要素|yào sù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Time, place and characters are the three essential elements of a story.

vocab.note: {限于|xiàn yú}{本|běn}{校|xiào}{学生|xué sheng}, {限于|xiàn yú}{时间|shí jiān} (for reasons of time).
vocab.example: {本|běn}{次|cì}{活动|huó dòng}{限于|xiàn yú}{本|běn}{校|xiào}{学生|xué sheng}{参加|cān jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: This event is open to students of the school only.

vocab.note: Written {带|dài}: {请|qǐng}{携带|xié dài}{身份证|shēn fèn zhèng}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{携带|xié dài}{有效|yǒu xiào}{证件|zhèng jiàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please bring valid identification.

vocab.note: {修订|xiū dìng}{版|bǎn}: a revised edition.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{词典|cí diǎn}{已经|yǐ jīng}{修订|xiū dìng}{过|guo}{三|sān}{次|cì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This dictionary has been revised three times.

vocab.note: {未经|wèi jīng}{许可|xǔ kě} (without permission).
vocab.example: {未经|wèi jīng}{许可|xǔ kě}，{不得|bù dé}{进入|jìn rù}。
vocab.exampleEn: No entry without permission.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{按|àn}{时间|shí jiān}{顺序|shùn xù}{叙述|xù shù}{事情|shì qing}{的|de}{经过|jīng guò}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please give an account of what happened, in order.

vocab.note: {严禁|yán jìn}{吸|xī}{烟|yān}.
vocab.example: {馆|guǎn}{内|nèi}{严禁|yán jìn}{吸|xī}{烟|yān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Smoking is strictly forbidden in the building.

vocab.note: Opposite {难以|nán yǐ} (hard to).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{方法|fāng fǎ}{易于|yì yú}{掌握|zhǎng wò}。
vocab.exampleEn: This method is easy to master.

vocab.note: yī yī: {一|yī} keeps its first tone both times.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{把|bǎ}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}{一一|yī yī}{回答|huí dá}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He answered everyone's questions one by one.

vocab.note: For rules: {一律|yí lǜ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}, {一律|yí lǜ}{不得|bù dé}.
vocab.example: {迟到|chí dào}{的|de}{人|rén}{一律|yí lǜ}{不得|bù dé}{入场|rù chǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: No latecomers will be admitted, without exception.

vocab.note: Starts the second clause: what you want to make possible.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{提前|tí qián}{到|dào}{场|chǎng}，{以便|yǐ biàn}{安排|ān pái}{座位|zuò wèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please arrive early so that seats can be arranged.

vocab.note: Starts the second clause: what you want to avoid. Spoken {免得|miǎn de}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{保管|bǎo guǎn}{好|hǎo}{贵重|guì zhòng}{物品|wù pǐn}，{以免|yǐ miǎn}{丢失|diū shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please look after your valuables so that they aren't lost.

vocab.note: Often before a noun: {因|yīn}{病|bìng}, {因|yīn}{雨|yǔ}, {因|yīn}{故|gù}.
vocab.example: {比赛|bǐ sài}{因|yīn}{雨|yǔ}{推迟|tuī chí}{到|dào}{下|xià}{周|zhōu}。
vocab.exampleEn: The match has been put off to next week because of rain.

meanings: middle ten days of a month
vocab.note: {十|shí}{月|yuè}{中旬|zhōng xún}: mid-October.
vocab.example: {会议|huì yì}{定|dìng}{在|zài}{十|shí}{月|yuè}{中旬|zhōng xún}。
vocab.exampleEn: The meeting is set for mid-October.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{部|bù}{著作|zhù zuò}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{一生|yì shēng}{留下|liú xià}{了|le}{十|shí}{几|jǐ}{部|bù}{著作|zhù zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He left more than ten works in his lifetime.

vocab.note: Written {好像|hǎo xiàng}: {犹如|yóu rú}{一|yí}{面|miàn}{镜子|jìng zi}.
vocab.example: {湖|hú}{面|miàn}{平静|píng jìng}，{犹如|yóu rú}{一|yí}{面|miàn}{镜子|jìng zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The lake is calm, like a mirror.

vocab.note: {指定|zhǐ dìng}{地点|dì diǎn}, {指定|zhǐ dìng}{的|de}{人|rén}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{在|zài}{指定|zhǐ dìng}{地点|dì diǎn}{停车|tíng chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please park in the designated area.

meanings: to go so far as to
vocab.note: Turns to a new topic. Not lesson 26's {不至于|bú zhì yú}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{决定|jué dìng}{去|qù}{苏州|Sū zhōu}，{至于|zhì yú}{住|zhù}{哪儿|nǎr}，{到|dào}{了|le}{再说|zài shuō}。
vocab.exampleEn: We've decided on Suzhou; as for where to stay, we'll see when we get there.

vocab.note: Written {很|hěn}{多|duō}: {诸多|zhū duō}{问题|wèn tí}, {诸多|zhū duō}{困难|kùn nan}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{活动|huó dòng}{得到|dé dào}{了|le}{诸多|zhū duō}{朋友|péng you}{的|de}{帮助|bāng zhù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The event received help from a great many friends.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{一共|yí gòng}{十二|shí èr}{章|zhāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This book has twelve chapters in all.

meanings: in (at, on: written, time and place)
vocab.note: {建|jiàn}{于|yú}1958{年|nián}, {于|yú}{本|běn}{周五|zhōu wǔ}, {多|duō}{于|yú}{去年|qù nián}, {适用|shì yòng}{于|yú}.
vocab.example: {会议|huì yì}{将|jiāng}{于|yú}{本|běn}{周五|zhōu wǔ}{举行|jǔ xíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The meeting will be held this Friday.

vocab.note: Result first, then {是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}…; after the subject.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{之所以|zhī suǒ yǐ}{成功|chéng gōng}，{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}{从来|cóng lái}{不|bú}{放弃|fàng qì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The reason he succeeded is that he never gave up.

vocab.note: Usually four characters, fixed in form.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{成语|chéng yǔ}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}{意思|yì si}？
vocab.exampleEn: What does this idiom mean?

vocab.note: Often {被|bèi}{称作|chēng zuò}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{字体|zì tǐ}{被|bèi}{称作|chēng zuò}"{楷书|kǎi shū}"。
vocab.exampleEn: This style of script is called "standard script".

vocab.note: Before a noun with {的|de}, or after {有|yǒu}.

readingList.title: The Chairman's Bao
readingList.level: Graded news articles by HSK level (to HSK 6 and above)
readingList.note: Short news stories rewritten for learners and graded by HSK level, with audio, a pop-up dictionary and simplified or traditional characters. At the end of this course read the top levels: they are the commentary and news Chinese of lessons 10 and 26 ({日前|rì qián}, {据报道|jù bào dào}, {一项调查显示|yí xiàng diào chá xiǎn shì}). A subscription service.

readingList.title: Du Chinese
readingList.note: An app and website of graded lessons and stories with audio, adjustable pinyin and a pop-up dictionary. After HSK 6 the Advanced and Master lessons fit; read them with pinyin off and listen at normal speed. Each story has a free chapter; the rest needs a subscription.

readingList.title: Mandarin Bean
readingList.note: Short graded texts marked with HSK levels, with recordings, pinyin and tap-to-translate words. The HSK 6 texts are a good daily reading habit for the last month before the exam (lesson 30). The graded reading lessons are free.

readingList.title: Chinese Reading Practice ({练读中文|liàn dú zhōng wén})
readingList.note: Short texts in simplified characters with pinyin and an English translation you can switch on and off, no account needed. Read the advanced texts without the translation, then write a two-sentence summary in Chinese, as the exam's reading part trains you to find a text's main idea.

readingList.title: Chinese Text Project ({中国|Zhōng guó}{哲学|zhé xué}{书|shū}{电子化|diàn zǐ huà}{计划|jì huà})
readingList.note: A free online library of pre-modern Chinese texts, many with English translations side by side and a character dictionary. The 《{道德经|Dào dé jīng}》 of honors lesson 30h1 is there, chapter by chapter; use it to read on from the three sayings, a few lines at a time.

readingList.title: Chinese Wikisource ({维基文库|Wéi jī wén kù})
readingList.note: A free library of public-domain texts in Chinese, from classical prose such as {陶渊明|Táo Yuān míng}'s 《{桃花源记|Táo huā yuán jì}》 (honors lesson 30h2) to early modern literature. There are no learner notes, so read with a dictionary; the pages can be shown in simplified or traditional characters.

readingList.title: Chinese Grammar Wiki
readingList.note: A free reference of Chinese grammar points sorted by level, each with many example sentences in characters, pinyin and English. Its B2 and C1 points cover much of this course's grammar ({与其|yǔ qí}…{不如|bù rú}, {即便|jí biàn}, {进而|jìn ér}, {之所以|zhī suǒ yǐ}…{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}, the formal written words); use it when you want more examples of a pattern.

readingList.title: HSK sample papers and syllabus
readingList.note: The official HSK site, with the HSK 3.0 syllabus, sample papers and online demos of the new exam, test dates and test centres. Do a complete sample paper under exam conditions in the last month (lesson 30), and check the format, the speaking test and the pass mark there before you register.
